Also some other reviews complained about the scent but I actually really love it!

I’ve been using a smaller size that came in a pack of PTR products & just bought my full sized bottle. It’s only been2-2 1/2 weeks & my skin already looks amazing! It smells great, leaves your skin feeling soft but NEVER over-dried. LOVE LOVE LOVE

product_name: Estee Lauder Advanced Night Repair Synchronized Multi-Recovery Complex Serum
review_text: Hmmmm...on the one hand It didn’t clog my pores. I had no breakouts with this product, but I didn’t really see a difference in my skin either. I got this product for free to test.

I’m going to pick up a few more to have in every bag, car and makeup bag. Love!!

product_name: Makeup Setting Spray Organic Sunscreen SPF 30
review_text: It is normal for me to experiment with lots of different types of  products and rarely re purchase. This is one that I will use over again. review_title: Easy way to add sun protection!

review_text: Very gentle yet thorough - leaves my skin baby soft!  Love it.

product_name: Mini Mandelic Acid + Superfood Unity Exfoliant
review_text: Noticed a difference in my skin immediately .Skin felt smoother and more hydrated , have received regular compliments on my skin since using the product .Highly recommend

product_name: Mini Cicapair Tiger Grass Color Correcting Treatment SPF 30
review_text: I got a deluxe size with one of Sephora favorites sets. I was excited to try this product but ended up not liking it at all. product_name: Lip Sleeping Mask Intense Hydration with Vitamin C
review_text: Fave lip gloss. Have a different flavor in each desk/bag/car/etc!

product_name: City Skin Age Defense Broad Spectrum SPF 50 PA++++
review_text: This is my absolute favorite sun screen. I have photosensitivity (which means I’m allergic to sun light) and this is the best I’ve every tried. However I found it is sold out everywhere for months. Any reasons why?
review_title: The best but why sold out everywhere

review_text: I’ve tried many cleansing oils before but this one is incomparable to the others! I love how gentle it is on my skin and how great it is at getting rid of daily buildup as well as makeup! Would recommend! Gifted by dermalogica

product_name: Argan Infinity Cream Intensive Creamy Oil
review_text: I purchased this and the argan milk and, while I’m still on the fence about the milk, I luuuvvv this stuff. I think Josie likes to compare it to petroleum jelly without the “petroleum“ part and that’s a pretty good comparison. I wouldn’t say it’s as sticky as PJ, but it does have a similar texture. I use it on my lips and it’s been a boon for my winter cold ravaged cheeks. I carry it around in my purse and apply it whenever my cheeks start to feel uncomfortable. Plus, it’s $35 for a sizable tube and you really don’t need much per use. I’m definitely considering the tinted lip/cheek versions of this next!

product_name: Smart Clinical Repair Wrinkle Correcting Eye Cream
review_text: I received a sample from Topbox #freeproduct.  The product was nice, it eft my eye area feeling hydrated and not greasy. I also didn’t have any itching or redness which I usually get from eye creams. It was hard to assess if there was any change to the fine lines on my face given the limited amount of time that I used it for. I’d need to use it for a longer period of time to see results. I would definitely consider including this product as part of my routine.

This was for my daughter she is 11 and I saw a difference the first weeks but after that the breakouts start coming back. We love the brand so we will look for something stronger with in the murad family

product_name: Tea Elixir Niacinamide & Hyaluronic Acid Anti-Aging Serum
review_text: I am a fan of Fresh Beauty, so I was very excited to try this new product. The Tea Elixir Serum has a thin consistency and a light tea fragrance that didn’t bother me. It evened out my skin tone and, overall, made my face glowy and super hydrated.

product_name: Bright Eyes Collagen-Infused Brightening Colloidal Silver Eye Masks
review_text: These eye gels are thick and contain a great amount of product. They stay on well and after removing them, my skin feels super soft and really does brighten the area below my eyes. I really like this product.

product_name: Wrinkle Blur Bakuchiol Eye Gel Crème
review_text: I am in love with this eye cream! I love that I can use it morning and night. It leaves my under eyes feeling hydrated and smooth. It also has lessened my under eye darkness and it really does give a blurring effect. A little goes a long way so I think this will last me a long time! I will be repurchasing this!

I have been using this product for a few days now and I love it. It’s on the thicker side which is nice so it doesn’t drip down your arms as you are trying to apply it. Overall, I feel like this product has made my skin super smooth.

I use this every night on blemishes and I can definitely tell a difference in the morning. Many of my blemishes disappear before they get worse after using this product. I haven’t had a product ACTUALLY do what it claims in this regard but this product does. I will definitely keep this in my routine.
Made me breakout after 24 hours — don’t recommend for oily skin, feels like the product clogs pores and just sits on your face

product_name: Advanced Night Repair Synchronized Multi-Recovery Complex Duo
review_text: I received a trial size bottle of this from Influenster in exchange for a review. The serum feels great, but didn’t result in a noticeable enough result that would justify the price tag. My skin felt hydrated but none of my other concerns (aging, redness, oiliness) where changed, and I have some great HG products that are in the $20-30 range.

I don’t quite understand the hype here. The smell is wonderful but the list of chemicals is concerning. I didn’t really notice a difference to be honest if anything I noticed more breakouts and it didn’t really make a difference with lines or discoloration. I’m not sure what this kit is supposed to do because I didn’t notice a difference and I used it for a few weeks before making an opinion. Honestly not worth the money to me.

I have used many eye gel patches and tried different brands. First off, this doesn’t fall off your face!! I love that a lot. And it leaves my under eyes feeling hydrated! I love using this in the morning!

product_name: Ceramic Slip French Green Clay Cleanser

review_title: PLEASE BRING THE OLD FORMULA BACK

really love the metal applicator but the product itself stings my eyes and literally burns my under eye area

review_title: Great addition to my skin routine

product_name: Cicapair Tiger Grass Color Correcting Treatment SPF 30
review_text: wear this almost everday. Great for if you want a little coverage for redness but don’t actually want to wear makeup. Also awesome that it has sunscreen. product_name: Take The Day Off Cleansing Balm Makeup Remover
review_text: It doesn’t lie ! It saves me so much time at night & I have such sensitive skin ! I have no bad reactions or redness I absolutely love it!
review_title: YES ! must have every I go !

review_text: This Oat Cleansing Balm has a different consistency than I expected, a vaseline like consistency. The first 2-4 times I used it, I could hardly squeeze it out of the tube, it was so hard. After that, either the temperature made it soften, or it wasn’t mixed well and I got to a softer part. Either way, I would recommend kneading the tube a bit before the first use to mix it up well and soften it.It worked surprisingly well for me. It goes on almost like vaseline as well, and I didn’t think I would like it. But, it cleans well, and leaves my skin very soft and supple. It doesn’t seem like it rinses off all the way, so I thought I’d have problems with breaking out, but no. It must rinse off, and just leaves a nice moisturized, soft effect on my face. It’s a nice product that I didn’t anticipate liking! Would definitely buy again.
review_title: Surprised that I liked it! No dryness or breakout

product_name: Alpha Beta Extra Strength Daily Peel Pads
review_text: I really love this treatment. I’m 42 and my skin is no longer as smooth as I’d like it to be. These actually made my skin smoother and brighter. I would cut one in half and use half in the morning and half at night. The results were amazing! The only drawback is they are pricy, but I’ll probably purchase again.
This was a nice cream but it didn’t really work for me. it was extra thick and didn’t absorb well into my skin. It also caused other products I used to pill up and move around.
Yes spot treatment from dr zenovia skin care was great for those spots that show up. Got the zit gone. A little peeling

Not sure if I received a bad batch but it smells slightly... spoiled. So it was hard to wear as a mask bc the smell was just brutal. I tried this mask three times and found that it really didn’t do much for my skin. At the end of the day only a healthy diet, a good night’s rest, and h2o will do what SF Jet Lag claims to do. I’ll sadly be returning this.

product_name: All About Eyes Rich Eye Cream
review_text: At first I wasn’t totally sure if this was the right eye cream for me. But after using it for a couple of weeks I’ve come to the conclusion that it is. It tightens the skin around my eyes. No more puffs, dark cricles minimized, and honestly I think it smooths out my fine lines too. I have super sensitive skin/ eyes and this eye cream doesn’t irritate either my skin or eyes. It’s also reasonably priced and comes in a HUGE jar. Will be buying this again but I imagine it will take me at least 6 months to finish this jar!

product_name: The Serum Stick: Treatment & Touch Up Balm
review_text: Love this serum stick! I love that I can put it on all over or just where I need it! I typically apply before make up on a clean face. I rub it all over then massage in with my finger tips which is not required I just like to make sure I get everywhere! It evens out my fine lines and keeps my skin super hydrated without leaving it oily!

product_name: Mini Watermelon Glow PHA + BHA Pore-Tight Toner
review_text: My favourite toner, have repurchased many times and will continue. Highly recommend
Kind of thick and not seeing results. I recommend fresh products and Saturday skin

product_name: Confidence in a Cream Anti-Aging Hydrating Moisturizer
review_text: I love that this moisturizer is for any skin type. I have dry skin & it hydrated my skin well. I will definitely be repurchasing this moisturizer again.

I received this product complimentary of Influenster. I really love this mask! Personally, I like clay masks more because they tend to be more effective, but sheet masks are easier to use. This Purifying Mud Mask combines what I like about each type into one product.The application process takes a little longer than a typical sheet mask because you have to peel off the outer layers first. But once it’s on your face, it’s easy to smooth out and get it to stick to all the nooks and crannies. It has a muddy cotton texture at first, and it slowly dries into a hard paper mache-esque consistency. When you’re done, you peel it off like a pore mask. This part left my skin pretty red for the next 30 minutes, but it didn’t aggravate my face. I wouldn’t recommend applying one of these masks if you’re planning to go somewhere right away.Results-wise, my face is less oily, my pores are less noticeable, my skin seems more smooth, and my face isn’t dried out. While the price point is a little higher on these masks, the results are better than cheaper ones.

product_name: Advanced Génifique Yeux Light-Pearl Eye Serum
review_text: I absolutely love this product! I didn’t expect much from it’s use but it’s now a part of my everyday  skincare and makeup routine!

I’ve used so many eye creams, and this is the first that I feel like actually softened my fine lines. I was scared of the texture at first, but it smooths out much nicer than I expected. Smell is pleasant, I haven’t had any issues with it piling under makeup, and I am just really pleased with it as a product!!
I highly recommend this product. I’ve been having issues with acne and within two washes I could already see a difference. Defiantly worth the money.

product_name: Mini The Essence  Skincare Boosting Treatment
review_text: I read the expert review by kajaysenay. I appreciate having explanations on how to use an expensive product and that was great. At any rate, this essence is just what I was afraid of. GREAT. I can see a difference in my skin after using it only a couple of weeks. Fewer lines and wrinkles, skin seems brighter and dewy. All the things an over 60, or anyone wants.

product_name: Hello FAB Coconut Skin Smoothie Priming Moisturizer
review_text: I LOVE this. I love that it’s two in one - after I cleanse I use a serum and then this on top and then I’m ready for make up. It’s a lightweight moisturizer, and my skin isn’t overly dry so I’m not sure what it would be like for someone with really dry skin.It feels really great on my face and has definitely helped make my make up last longer. It smells amazing (if you like the smell of coconuts).It does have micropearls in it that really do shimmer when you put it on. Once it absorbs into the skin it’s a bit less shimmery, but it does make you look a bit “humid“ initially!

product_name: Zincscreen 100% Mineral Sunscreen Lotion SPF 40 PA+++
review_text: This sunscreen adds a glow and a nice blurring effect to skin. My only complaint is that it stays fairly greasy, which isn’t so bad if you live in a cold dry place or you have dry skin. It’s definitely a winter sunscreen for me, probably will finish the bottle but probably won’t purchase again.
review_title: Pretty on skin but feels greasy!

review_text: This worked remarkably well with the Clarisonic facial brush! The exfoliating qualities of the mask were enhanced with the sonic action of the brush. Like most Fresh products this smells heavenly and is stocked full of quality ingredients. It’s gentle enough, but effective!

product_name: Barrier+ Skin Barrier Niacinamide Restoring Gel Cream
review_text: I really like the SkinFix Barrier Niacinamide Restoring Gel Cream. It is a hybrid of a gel and cream and it goes on smooth without any pilling. My skin is combination and gets oily on my t-zone. I’ve noticed a decrease in how shiny I get towards the end of the day. The formula feels great and my skin feels ultra hydrated.

I’m very happy with this retinol. I have used others in the past (Sunday Riley Luna, Sunday Riley A+, Good Genes, Estee Lauder etc.) and have been really impressed with this one, especially for the cost. The only other retinol that I can say works better is the Sunday Riley A+ Serum. If you are looking for something affordable and effective, this is the way to go.

product_name: Mini Yo Glow AHA & BHA Facial Enzyme Scrub
review_text: I rarely do reviews, but just tried this from a sample and I feel like I have to. DO NOT WASTE YOUR MONEY! It literally does nothing, plus the mess it makes, just gross.

This moisturizer is amazing!! I have been using it for a few days now and it is already top shelf. I love how it gets rid of all of my dead skin cells but it stills moisterizers me. I have combination skin and it is absolutley perfect for me. It moisturizes just enough for my dry patches without making them oily. It also doesn’t make my t zone look clogged or make me break out. I love this moisturizer very much and I reccommmend it for people who have combination skin. (I am reviewing this for a contest.)

product_name: Mini Take The Day Off Cleansing Balm Makeup Remover
review_text: I didn’t realize it was important to take your makeup off before washing your face. I’ve used eye makeup remover before but this was the first product I tried for my whole face. I have to spend a little more time rubbing my eyes to remove eye makeup with this product compared to other eye makeup removers.

I didn’t really see any results from using this on my skin and for the  price tag, its not for me  I would suggest getting a sample first before buying a full size version to see if it’s a good fit for reference I’m 29 with very young/healthy skin so this product might be good for older people/ wrinkless  it has a nice smell and the packaging is ok.   Received free from Influenster

product_name: Powerful-Strength Dark Circle Reducing Vitamin C Eye Serum
review_text: This silicone feeling cream was so nice on the eyes. My under eye dark circles didn’t completely disappear, but I’ve tried everything and they have never felt this refreshed. I’m really happy with how it makes my eyes appear brighter and keeps me looking refreshed. I have added it to my nightly skincare routine.

product_name: Mini GOOPGLOW Microderm Instant Glow Exfoliator
review_text: I am more partial to chemical exfoliators on my face so I was nervous to try this, but I love it! product_name: Vitamin Enriched Face Base Priming Moisturizer
review_text: I’m a firm believer that the preparation of your skin before applying make is the most important part and Bobbi Brown delivered all I’ve been looking for in this product. It prepares my skin for a fresh, healthy looking glowy makeup. The absorption of vitamins is super quick and grips the foundation to the skin but make it hydrated and plumped looking.

This is my holy grail moisturizer! I have been using this for almost a year now, and the quality of my skin is the best it has ever been! It makes my skin heal quicker and feels very natural. I recommend this to everyone, and there has been no complaints so far!

review_text: Giving it 4 stars because I expected more color to it. However, The color has really grown on me now that I’ve been using it. It feels light under my cream foundation and smells great for a self tanner. The price scared me for such a small bottle but I’m really loving it!

product_name: Banana Bright+ Vitamin CC Eye Sticks
review_text: This product is so neat for dark circles. I like that it has vitamin C and caffeine to actually treat them while also having pigment to color correct. review_text: I received this as complimentary in exchange for my honest review from influenster. This product did not work on my skin. product_name: T.L.C. Sukari Babyfacial AHA + BHA Mask
review_text: I purchased this just yesterday during the Rouge sale. I own a few other DE products and have really enjoyed everything so far. Very soft. I will never go back.

review_text: This is a staple part of my routine to de-scale my face and on my underarms to help minimize ingrown hairs the day after shaving. I am careful not to use any cleansers that have active ingredients (such as tea tree) before applying this to my skin and follow up with the marula oil mixed with aloe vera gel. I have no reason to swap this out for something else because this has worked consistently for three years. I am a Black American with oily, acne prone skin.

I used a whisk since my blender bottle was dirty, and I let it sit for a few minutes and whisked again. Almost all of the powder dissolved and left me with a creamy, chocolaty drink. The taste: if you are one that has used other green powders, you know they can be horrid. This was not. This was creamy, light mint, cocoa with just a hint of sweetness. You could taste just a tiny bit of the “green“ at the end, but really, not bad at all. If you’ve never tried green powders before, you may indeed not like it. But I’m all over this stuff. Very, very good! Now, if it makes me look better, bonus! I would just get it for all the other health benefits it contains.

review_text: Disclosure: I received a complimentary sample of this product in exchange for my honest opinion. To be perfectly honest and transparent, I’m not a woman that has a “complex - 10 minutes in the morning - 20 minutes in the evening - skincare regimen”. I’m moreso a handmade oatmeal coldpressed soap and water type of woman. So when I received this sample it was something “Out of the Norm” for me, but I was open to give it a try. I tried it out for a week straight and much to my surprise it wasn’t that complicated or time consuming to use and I actually liked it. It rolls on smooth and absorbs into the skin like butter melting on a hot biscuit fresh out the oven. And don’t get me started on how your sense of smell is awakened to a symphony of citrus as you’re applying it to your face. I gave this product 4 out of 5 stars because again, I’m a simple woman who barely wears makeup and is content with her homemade soap and water routine. I’m definitely going to use this product some more and would recommend it to anyone who is looking for something refreshing for their face. I hope my honest review helps someone.

product_name: The Camellia Oil 2-in-1 Makeup Remover & Cleanser
review_text: I absolutely love this product! I have very sensitive and persnickety skin, so I’ve spent hundreds of dollars on minis and trial sizes figuring out what works. After finishing up the travel size I knew I had to invest in the full size product. It removes my makeup easily without harsh rubbing around my eyes in particular, all while starting my cleansing process. I’ve loved this product so much that I branched our to other Tatcha products and am noticing a dramatic decrease in pimples, redness, and blackheads. I have some Rosacea and that’s clearing up as well. I LOVE this product

I don’t particularly like overnight masks but this one is relatively good! It leaves my skin feelings so hydrated in the morning and comes with a mini tlc which I think was a good added touch. The one thing I will say is it took a while to dry down before bed so put it on at least 30 minutes before you want to go to sleep!

I’ve tried quite a few sunscreen sticks from supergoop to kbeauty and I enjoy this one most. The sunscreen itself is not sticky or greasy and rubs in easily to the skin. The sunscreen smell is very light, the stick is easy to clean after each use, goes on clear and no white cast, and the packaging is great (cap never comes off while being jostled in the bag and it feels luxe/has a nice weight to it lol). Also, this is one of the few sunscreen sticks that don’t completely MELT in the heat; I brought it to the beach with me all summer and it held up through the glaring heat.

product_name: The Dewy Skin Cream Plumping & Hydrating Moisturizer
review_text: I love this face cream so much. I’m able to layer it under foundation with no issues but I have dry skin. I get so many compliments on how much my skin glows when I use this. I love to pair it with the dewy skin mist too. Highly recommend.
Smells really great and makes my skin feel super soft. Great for a daily cleaner. Not harsh or irritating at all and I have pretty sensitive skin.

product_name: Vitamin Enriched Face Base Priming Moisturizer
review_text: I love this Bobbi Brown primer and moisturizer. It’s super creamy and absorbs nicely.  It hydrates my face and preps it before I put on any makeup. My skincare and makeup both layer on top of it well, it makes my makeup look smoother and keeps it in place better. I love the glowy and dewy look it gives my skin.  I even like to wear it by itself without anything else. Works great with my combination skin and doesn’t cause any irritations. It is definitely a keeper!
review_title: Works great and love the way my skin looks!!

review_text: I received a sample of this product. It’s amazing! I just ordered the full size! I love everything about this oil. It is great! I can’t believe the difference in my skin. And it doesn’t have that weird “Argan oil” smell

product_name: Premier Cru Anti Aging Cream Moisturizer with Hyaluronic Acid
review_text: My skin is super dry in the winter.  This cream is outstanding!  So rich and creamy. Love this product!
This is the worst lip balm I have ever used.  Yuck

product_name: Mini Cicapair Tiger Grass Color Correcting Treatment SPF 30
review_text: I wanted to like this but for me it resulted in being a waste of $52. I have rosacea so I thought this would be good to cover the redness. It is a weird consistency and I don’t like how it feels on my face. It does go on green but does not turn beige on my skin. It ends up looking greasy and white. It does not cover the redness I can still see it. It is currently sitting in my medicine cabinet all the way in the back. My skin tone is olive and it makes me look like a ghost.
review_title: don’t like it at all. waste of my hard earned $$$

review_text: I have long, thick, coarse, wavy, curly, and frizzy hair with some split ends. I iron the hair near my scalp in the morning and let the bottom stay wavy. The top is usually so frizzy it looks like I’m in a constant static shock. I have used lots of different kinds of products to try to relax the frizz: leave-in conditioners, straightening agents, gels, mousses, etc., from both Sephora and also the drugstore variety. However, I have NEVER had as much success as I have had with this product! I towel dry, apply a little bit of this product from root to end while my hair is damp, and it has an IMMEDIATE effect. Completely weightless and free of any stickiness and doesn’t do what hair gel does, which is group hairs together. All of my hair continues to flow loosely, but it’s softer, more manageable, and free of frizz!
review_title: Tossed out all of my hair gels - this kills frizz!

product_name: Barrier+ Skin Barrier Niacinamide Restoring Gel Cream
review_text: Loving this moisturizer on first application! Long lasting hydrating with skin loving ingredients it acts as a beautiful smoothing canvas for makeup application. I’ve been on the hunt for a clean moisturizer that meshes well with my other products and so far this has been a welcome addition. Can’t wait to see long term benefits after continued use

product_name: Avocado Fine Line Eye Cream with Retinol
review_text: I loved the texture of this cream — it went on so smoothly and felt as though it would really hydrate my undereye area. Unfortunately, it actually broke me out in this area — I had red, swollen pimples which I’ve never had before. This and the fact that I didn’t notice a change in any brightness / lines made me disappointed in the product.

Honestly this is my holy grail BHA product. I never had acne as a teenager, but as an adult I find my skin to have gotten oilier and getting more break outs. After I ran out of my first bottle I hesitated to get a second one and I noticed a HUGE difference in my skin. My pores got clogged and I was breaking out again after I stopped using it. I recently purchased a second bottle and I use it twice a day after cleansing my face and my skin cleared right up! In love with this.

product_name: T.L.C. Framboos Glycolic Resurfacing Night Serum
review_text: I got a sample of this because nearly every other serum I’ve used has made me either breakout or has done nothing for my skin. But this product is the best serum ever, no breakouts and my skin has never felt so soft. I have some acne scars but after two weeks of using this, they have disappeared. I apply this serum after I use the dr.dennis gross alpha beta wipes. Total game changer, my skin has never been more clear and glowing.

I was interested in trying this cleanser due to the ingredients. It reminded me of a light gel consistency similar to Fresh Soy Face cleanser. Does not have any harsh fragrance and the gel is light and rich with amino acids that left my skin hydrated. I was pleased with my experience and recommend if your a fan of Soy Fresh cleanser.

I’ll start off by saying I absolutely adore the pear scented one! The scent was is a 10/10 for me. I actually bought all 4 when they came out. While I do like them, I don’t know that they’re really doing much for me in terms of making my lips more moisturized. I have extremely dry lips and living in AZ certainly does not help. I was hoping this product would alleviate some of the dryness in my lips. When it’s on, my lips look glossy and nice, but after it’s worn off I don’t feel like they’re any more moisturized than they were before I used it. When they run out I probably will repurchase the pear one if there’s a sale or discount code active, but it will literally only be because I like the scent, not because I feel it really does much for me in terms of hydrating.

Very gentle low foaming cleanser that has a pleasant sent but isn’t any more effective than other similar cleaners (Cerve, Purity, etc). It has a lot of slip & can be tricky to completely rinse off so residue can be an issue. Pricey for what it really does. I finished the travel sized tube but won’t be repurchasing a full size one.

Absolute game changer. I’m 37. Extremely oily skin. Large pores. Redness. Rosacea. And I’m at the perfect age where I’m starting to get wrinkles but still have full blown adult acne on my jaw line and neck. Awesome! I cannot live without this stuff. It has been the ONLY thing to clear my acne. Really. If I stop using it I break out. I’ve been buying the small ones but splurged for the Sephora sale on the large one. Why is this not hyped more? My face looks, plump, firm, radiant, clear, bright, smooth, glowy, less oil production, less pores, hydrated, youthful…just… exactly what I want. It’s thick but more of a gel/cream hybrid perfect all year. Don’t sleep on this one ladies! Especially mature women with signs of aging or ones with adult acne! It’s a miracle cream. And it takes a LOT to impress me! I’m sensitive to smells and this has a SUPER light scent but just so nice - maybe slight citrus? Delicious. Don’t sleep on this one!!! Try the small version if you’re hesitant.

product_name: Super Multi-Corrective Anti-Aging Face and Neck Cream
review_text: I love this face cream! It’s super moisturizing and a little goes a long way. It has evened out my skin tone and dramatically reduced my frown lines in less than a month. This stuff makes my skin glow! Would definitely recommend

product_name: Green Clean Makeup Removing Cleansing Balm
review_text: My review is short and sweet. This product is ✨MAGIC✨. It is so efficient that it’s cut my Face Off routine by 75% and it leave my skin feeling soooo nice. Honestly, just try it.

product_name: Avocado Soothing Skin Barrier Serum with Ceramides
review_text: Received complimentary from Glow Recipe. Love this this serum! Love the texture, how it feels on my skin and how it absorbs into my skin. Great at taking away the redness of my skin and smells amazing. Hydrated and softened my skin. Has great skin benefits for my dry skin. It nourishes, soothes, strengthens skin barrier and makes skin feel more hydrated.

This is perfect for my dry skin! it doesnt dry it out and makes my face feel clean. I use my clarisonic mia and this together and its magic. I feel like my face is glowing. I had tried the sample and was skeptical of buying the full version cause i was using purity by phillosophy at the same time but I bit the bullet and did it,(still gunna pick up purity later) and i do not regret it one bit. Word of advice, if there is a sehora local to you buy it there, I see here it is 35 then shipping and handling. At my local sephora I got it for 29.50!

product_name: Out of Trouble 10 Minute Mask to Rescue Problem Skin
review_text: This mask is amazing you need this mask. It’s the best after a late night or a hungover morning. It’s icy cold and really helped clear up my face immediately. It’s good to slap on if you feel a breakout coming on.

The product itself is lovely.  My skin feels clean but not stripped.  The scent is subtle and herb-y.  The price point is pretty great for the amount of product you get.  My only complaint is the packaging.  I’ve super freaked out about having a glass bottle in the shower, especially with so many other products vying for space.  And the pump is a pain to open; it’s one of those twist to unlock types, but you have to hold a tiiiiny middle section stationary while you twist.  Pull out the needle nose pliers.
This moisturizer is the only thing that helps my skin in the winter time!
review_title: The  best thing for dry/sensitive skin

product_name: Beauty Elixir Prep, Set, Glow Face Mist
review_text: A must for all beauty fanatics,tones and tightens my pores! Love it!

product_name: High-Potency Night-a-Mins Resurfacing Cream with Fruit-Derived AHAs
review_text: I have really dry skin and this does wonders for me! Love It!

I put this on as soon as I get out of bed. By the time I shower I look 50% better. Then I apply before my makeup. I wear it as a primer. I will buy again. It is a great deal for your money. It will last months.

I like this and the mint tingle. The lid is difficult to get off. And it cost more than it should for what you get. The lid is the most aggravating, sorry, but i want something easy to open in the car as I’m driving.

I really like this renewing cream. It is very good for combination skin like mine. I like that the texture is light so it doesn’t feel heavy on the skin. I must also say that it hydrates a lot and I love that it leaves my skin so soft and smooth. I am using it day and night.

I love skincare especially now that I have entered the 30s world. I began to use retinol, I have always had dry combination skin. Due to the retinol, my skin got irritated and dry. I LOVE THIS SERUM. I apply it right after I shower, I pat it on my face and neck. My skin not only looks, but feels so plump and healthy. It did not break my out. All of my dry irritated patches and the peeling stopped, some of my fine lines diminished. My skin looks so fresh. I have used the hyaluronic acid by The Inkey List and tbh I love them both. The Inkey List is not as eco friendly because of their tiny plastic containers. This serum does have a slightly tacky feel to it, but it subsides shortly after application. I love the glass bottle and the dropper. Not to mention this is BUDGET FRIENDLY AND ECO FRIENDLY. The only thing is I learned they were bought out by Estee Lauder. I really hope The Ordinary does not lose its integrity and change their formulations.
review_title: BABY SOFT SKIN TIS A WIN

review_text: It exfoliates a bit, but not very much, and it’s messy to clean up. There are other products that do a better job and are  less messy.

product_name: Mini Watermelon Glow PHA + BHA Pore-Tight Toner
review_text: I love what this does to my skin! I have visible pores and it really does help with them. It smells like real, fresh watermelon. It loses a star because of the weird viscous texture but I still plan to purchase it again in the future.

product_name: Indigo Overnight Repair Serum in Cream Treatment
review_text: I liked this but it broke my out on my chin because of how thick and emollient it is. I really miss the signature tatcha scent the creams normally have but it’s probably a good thing it’s fragrance free in order to avoid irritation. Otherwise I liked it and it’s good for dry skin.
review_title: Liked it but it broke me out

product_name: All About Eyes Serum De-Puffing Eye Massage
review_text: Alright, I was really excited to buy this product, but I have to say that I was a little let down. Although it does help with puffiness, the roller does feel really cool, gentle and refreshing -- it does dry out the eyes a bit so I had to use another eye cream on top. I wouldn’t reccommend it for somone with fine lines or wrinkles around the eyes.If you look closely, there is a tiny bit of shimmer or something put in it, which has an illuminating effect, making dark circles look brighter.Overall, not the best product, but not a total waste of money either.

This product was in a sample skincare set I bought from Sephora a few weeks ago. I LOVED IT!! My skin felt so clean and fresh after each use. It’s got such a fresh scent and feels light on my skin. I just ran out of the sample size and have purchased the full size bottle.

product_name: Triple Algae Eye Renewal Balm Eye Cream
review_text: The results of the Triple Algae Eye Renewal Balm with Multi-Peptide Complex are astounding! “Eye“ am not the only one noticing the results either, my husband actually looks into my eyes again.  The eye area of my face has been a dark, wrinkly area that I covered with sunglasses daily. Now, I wear eyeshadow,mascara,and NO SHADES!

product_name: Mini Ready Steady Glow Daily AHA Tonic
review_text: It really started to damage my skin and cause hyperpigmentation after around 2 and a half weeks of use. At first it helped texture and I was happy but after consistent use it caused 2 really dark splotches on my face out of nowhere. It was not from a breakout or anything else. I bought this to help with my hyperpigmentation and it made it way worse. Now I have to look for something else to lighten these horrible ugly splotches that even makeup won’t cover. Throwing the whole bottle in the garbage.
review_title: Caused even more hyperpigmentation in my tan skin.

review_text: One on my favorite lip balms! Not only is it hydrating,butit feels great on the lips. Not too sticky and this tin has a ton of product that lasts for a very long time. I love the scent also.

product_name: Perfect Canvas Clean Jelly Oil Cleanser
review_text: Will be adding this product to my skincare routine. I’ve always heard how double cleansing is super beneficial for ensuring a clean face. This product is amazing at melting away makeup and oil plugs. It’s also great for preventing your skin from being stripped from other cleansers.
Smells so yummy! And my lips are nice and moisturized all day following use!

This is definitely one of the best products out there. I had pumps all over my chest and back. After using it for 2 months every day, they have cleared. I still have bottle of it in my bathroom just Incase I see something coming up.
This is my first time using a retinol, and I am very happy with this product! I have not experienced any irritation or dryness, any have seen major improvements in my skin.

product_name: Brumisateur Natural Mineral Water Facial Spray Travel Duo
review_text: This was a great buy, only $11, travels great in my purse, and hydrates my skin in a flash!

product_name: Clear Improvement Charcoal Honey Mask to Purify and Nourish
review_text: I have super sensitive skin, this was the first charcoal mask I’ve tried that didn’t leave my face inflamed and burning! I love this stuff! I use it twice a week. You actually can see a small appearance of your pores and it leaves your skin so soft. I love this stuff!
Love this product; I have sensitive skin and seem to be prone to be breakouts, but this has been great!
So lovely for a winter, daytime moisturizer. Highly recommend

So I started to use this products about 3 weeks ago. In all honesty from the first time I put it on my face it made a difference. I’m not that into changing up my skin care but when I got sent this compliment from Influenster I was shook. It smells so good, gently on the skin. And also doesn’t leave my skin feeling dried out. I would recommend this to anyone who has oily skin and has most of there acne in the chin and lower cheeks area.

Shiseido Sunscreen Stick is a must-have for an outdoorsy person like me. The sun in California is pretty much year-round. I love that I can re-apply sunscreen without touching is with my hands or spraying it everywhere and disturbing people around me. It’s compact. It’s easy to use. It’s clear and doesn’t leave any oily or white residue. And the SPF is 50 on top of all that! I think I finally found sunscreen that can keep up with me!

product_name: Mini Lapis Blue Tansy Face Oil - For Oily & Acne-Prone Skin
review_text: I am so happy I took the time to talk to the Sephora people and choose the Lapis oil. I have oily skin and this oil has prevented a lot of under the skin acne, flare ups, and I do not break out if I accidentally leave my makeup on. It has a slight smell that disappears once it absorbs into the skin. Another benefit is that my makeup does not oxidize as much, and my makeup looks less orange after wearing for a few hours. I have had for a month and it looks like this bottle might last me til December.

product_name: Advanced Génifique Wrinkle & Dark Circle Eye Cream
review_text: I have been using this for a few weeks now and am pretty impressed. The formula is thick and goes on so smoothly. It is not heavy at all and a little bit goes a long way. I have struggled with dark circles and have tried many products. I can honestly say that after just a few weeks, I notice my dark circles are slowly fading. I am using less concealer and cannot wait to not have to use it at all. I am in love with this eye cream and will definitely be purchasing it again.

product_name: Mini The Essence  Skincare Boosting Treatment
review_text: I received this product to test and I do think it is nice. It is very watery, and I honestly can’t tell if it has done anything...maybe more time will tell.
This is a staple in my beauty routine...I have one on my nightstand, car, and purse. It’s the best moisturizering gloss. I love wearing it to bed-my lips are always soft in the morning.

I received Dior Dreamskin complimentary from Influenster in exchange for my honest review. I received the 1.6 oz bottle which retails for $120. The first thing that made an impression on me was the beautiful packaging. It comes in a pretty light pink and silver refillable bottle. The next thing I noticed was its smell. It has a light fragrance but it reminded me of an older lady’s perfume. I didn’t care for it. As far as the application, it went on smoothly and I felt like it hydrated my skin. It blurred all my imperfections and helped my tinted moisturizer and foundation to go on smoothly. I’ve only used it for a week so I can’t really tell if it reduces fine lines over time or reduced my dark spots. So far it hasn’t. Although it did a nice job as a primer, there are many other primers out there that do the same job for a fraction of the cost. I do not feel like this is worth the price tag and I will not be repurchasing this product. Thanks for the opportunity Influenster and Dior!
review_title: Decent primer, but not worth the $

review_text: I LOVE this cream! It makes my skin feel so soft and hydrated when I use it. The texture is thick yet easily absorbs into skin. It gave my skin a nice radiant glow for most of the day. I think it has a mild yet yummy scent that is pleasant. This really does keep your skin plump and moisturized especially now that we’ve hit those drying winter months.

product_name: Superberry Hydrate + Glow Dream Night Mask with Vitamin C
review_text: I used up a sample of this product. I noticed no benefits. I also developed blemishes around my chin area after using this.

Listen, I absolutely love this cleanser. It is amazing, doesn’t strip my dry skin. However, docked one star because the fragrance is so overpowering! It’s not even a bad scent it is just very very strong.
Very pleased with this moisturizer! I have very dry skin and one pump of Protini leaves me feeling moisturized and ready to go.
This product is so such an emmolient. It feels like a luxury brand and leaves my skin enriched and hydrated. Best product for winter time!!

product_name: Chia + Moringa Algae Enzyme Cleansing Oil
review_text: So excited I got the chance to try this product out! It leaves my skin feeling so hydrated and very clean. The packaging itself is very nice and luxe. Takes all my makeup off easily, but does irritate my eyes some!

I loveeeee this product! I’ve been using it for 2 years now and wouldn’t change it. The packaging is glass and it’s  very aesthetically pleasing. Whenever I use it doesn’t leave my face feeling tight and works perfectly with my sensitive skin since it has no added fragrance. They also sell the refill bottle which is slightly bigger than this one.
Amazing product in the morning my face feels so soft.

product_name: T.L.C. Sukari Babyfacial AHA + BHA Mask
review_text: This product had me hyped. After reading all of the wonderful reviews I couldn’t wait to drop $80 on this at home facial and let my beauty shine! But after several uses the only thing that was shining were my brand new BLEMISHES. WWWHHHYYYY D.E.? I wanted to love you so badly! Now my wallet is light, my soul is heavy and my face is uggggghh.
review_title: Connecting the dots... on my face.

product_name: Mini Liquid Silk Canvas: Featherweight Protective Primer
review_text: I received this product complementary for testing purposes and it is amazing. It’s my first Tatcha product and I will definitely be looking into them more after this one. This product is so light weight on the skin and is great alone or with makeup. It helps your makeup last all day and protects your skin in the process.

The Algenist packaging is beautiful and the product is equally impressive. I live in Colorado where the climate is extremely dry, especially during winter, so finding products with staying power can be challenging. The sleeping collagen is thick but silky to touch and gildes on easily. I paired it with the liquid collagen and woke up with my skin still feeling smooth and hydrated. It seems odd to double up with the liquid collagen plus the sleeping collagen but I tried using them separately and found that but they actually work better when applied together. I’ve been using the product for just over a week and I’ve seen a noticeable difference in my skin (lines are less prominent and skin has a hydrated glow that I don’t always see in winter). I’m definitely a fan! I also love that the Algenist skincare line is vegan. I received this product complimentary for sampling purposes but all opinions are my own.

product_name: Ultimate Sun Protector Lotion SPF 50+ Sunscreen
review_text: I received this product as a sample  to try  this product just wasn’t for me it left my skin feeling very dry and almost dirty feeling I loved the smell of it however I couldn’t see myself wearing this the texture is very watery and greasy feeling.
I’m so oily as it is, this makes me oilier unfortunately

LOVE this product! I normally use St.Tropez foam and let it sit for 3 hours and wash. I LOVE that I don’t have to wash this off and I still get a quick tan. It goes on easily, although I never found that it complete mixed with my lotion. I do think I could’ve gone with the darkest shade, I am pretty pale naturally but I am using this in the summer and would like a deeper tan.

This does good job, removes eye makeup as well. But I wanna wash my face after using this, especially around my nose because I can see my pores are kinda clogged. So I currently use this as eye makeup remover. Not sure if I will repeat purchasing or not.

product_name: Mini Ultra Facial Moisturizing Cream with Squalane
review_text: This is the best facial moisturizer I have ever used. A tiny amount does so much and just sinks into my skin so easily. It really doesn’t take a lot to work miracles. I never want to be without it.

product_name: Advanced Night Repair Synchronized Multi-Recovery Complex Duo
review_text: I received this as a free sample from Influenster. I tried it and by the third night, my skin around my mouth got red and flaky. Very dry. I stopped using it and everything cleared up in about a week.

I never had major problems with acne until my early 20s, when I started breaking out on my forehead and chin. I tried multiple products from Sephora, but nothing works as well as this mask! I read all the reviews, and it seemed the majority of people commenting on this product were of a similar age demographic, which prompted me to purchase the product. I use it every other day on my problem areas, and all over once a week. It has SIGNIFICANTLY reduced my breakouts, and has even helped with some of my acne scarring on my cheeks. I can’t say enough about this mask!!

This moisturizer is amazing and SO worth the money! I have dry skin and this just feels like it quenches my skin’s thirst! Also, the tiniest amount goes allll the way, so I am probably going to run out of this lotion in 2020.

I enjoyed this moisturizer. I have pretty dry skin around my nose and chin and this kept it from getting flaky throughout the day. Plus it made my skin feel so soft. It does have an odd smell, but it’s not horrible.

This is seriously the best peel mask i’ve ever used. I leave it on in the shower for 5 minutes while im washing my hair and showering and scrub it off after. It works so well as an exfoliator and it literally looks like a blueberry smoothie!! My face is soo soft and it helps with my hormonal breakouts as well. I use this stuff at least 4 days a week and I need to repurchase more as we speak!!!!!
review_title: The absolute best for exfoliation and soft skin

product_name: Mini Take The Day Off Cleansing Balm Makeup Remover
review_text: I really love the liquid version of this and wanted to try this. I found I had to scrub harder to get eye makeup off, but it worked ok. Prefer the liquid version.

product_name: Sugar Advanced Lip Balm Intense Hydration Treatment
review_text: I absolutely will repurchase this over and over and over and over again! It smells AMAZING but subtle. The smell is what sold me but as soon as applied it I was in love! I’m purchasing one for my purse, my vanity and my bedside table!

Best. Eye cream. Ever. I have tried every eye cream under the sun—from la met, to drunk elephant, to fresh—you name it, Ive tried it. This is the first eye cream that I’ve fallen in love with, instantly. Overnight, my eyes looked brighter. It depuffs really fast too. This will forever be a staple for me. Really surprised and impressed by something this cheap. Love it!!

It’s not terrible but not what I’d normally go for. Wasn’t a fan of the scent and I look for more of a dewy look. Overall it’s a lightweight moisturizer and I use it in the morning. Will finish it up but not repurchase!

I started using this oil about 1 year ago first time using an oil. The girl at sephora told me she didnt recommend it for me because i have acne prone skin... i have combo/oily skin.. but I really wanted to give it a try so I still bought it... for the first week i started breaking out and I was about to stop using it but again I didnt want to give up on it and kept using it every night and i would use the clinique moisturizer on top of the oil and here I am today still using it every night with clear skin I hardly get any breakouts!!!
This line of acne products is the only thing that has ever cleared up my adult acne

I love this facial mask. This masks comes out a pink colour with a somewhat sticky texture. The smell is amazing, to me it smells like it has a hint of lemon and is a little fruity in scent without being to overpowering. It applies easily to the skin and doesn’t burn even on my sensitive skin. After you rub it in it turns white and once it dries down it becomes a little clear. It’s easy to remove with water and a towel and my skin feels so refreshed afterwards. I notice that after using this product my skin felt cleaner, exfoliated and the redness was definitely subdued. Overall I had a great experience with this mask and would definitely purchase it on my own. I received this product complimentary of Influenster but in no way does this change my opinions of this mask.

I have been using this a month.  I usually apply it twice a day after cleansing but before acids and creams.  I have noticed a reduction in the fine lines between my brows and around my eyes. I have been pleasantly surprised by this product.  I love most of what I have tried from The Ordinary, but this is truly a gem.
review_title: Getting rid of the 11's and crows feet!

review_text: This is my absolute favorite intensive lip balm treatment. My fave is the mint version. I use it at night before bed, and wake up to scrub my lips off with a washcloth and they are very soft and moisturized. Might be a little thick if you slather it on during the day, so I only use it at night.

product_name: Prism AHA + BHA Exfoliating Glow Facial
review_text: This product is fine but the results don’t warrant the price. It may work wonderfully for people who have sensitive skin, as it’s not irritating in the least. But again, there are better products for less money. I’ve been an esthetician for 25 years and am constantly vetting products. I like my cleansers to have some grit to help with exfoliating and with this cleanser I decide just how much grit is right for me. If I feel like I need a deep scrub or a lite buffing, this cleanser can do that.

product_name: Clean Bee Ultra Gentle Facial Cleanser
review_text: Hands down my favorite face wash. Not only does it remove my makeup, it is gentle enough for my extremely sensitive skin.

product_name: Watch Ya Tone 5% Niacinamide Dark Spot Serum with Vitamin C
review_text: I’ve used this product for the last week and it has been lifechanging. My skin looks so much brighter and I noticed that some of my dark spots have begun to fade. This serum was easily incorporated into my daily skincare routine. It doesn’t pill up or behave weirdly when I use my other products as well. The applicator is super cute and easy to use. I Love how this give great oil control without feeling oily or sticky.

But upon first use, the sugar granules within the cleanser dissolved and left my skin feeling super refreshed and clean. It didn’t feel too abrasive on my skin. I’m looking forward to further use of it throughout these warmer months!I received this product complimentary for testing purposes.

product_name: The Silk Peony Melting Eye Cream
review_text: Love this eye cream! I always get super dry and flakey under eyes and especially eyelids, it’s hard for me to wear makeup because it’s so dry. Yes, this is on the pricy side but I personally think it’s worth it because a little goes such a long way. It’s very thick so for me I don’t even take a little chunk out I just swirl my finger around and that’s usually enough for my entire eye. It is slightly scented so if your not into scents you probably wouldn’t like it however it’s not overbearing. Packaging is nice and it’s sturdy yet small so it’s great for traveling. Overall my skin quality on my eyes has definitely changed and my eyes aren’t flaky or dry at all. My under eyes are very smooth and foundation/concealer looks great over it now!

It is not my go-to eye cream for routine use with minimal moisturizing or anti-wrinkle results, but would use this as a fill-in during short trips (<1 week long). review_text: I was really excited to get this in my influenster voxbox because I wanted to try it and give it my honest opinion. I love this. Very lightweight and works wonders on my skin.

I like this product but not sure if it was causing dyness due to me using it to much might try again to see if it would work for me

product_name: Squalane + Omega Repair Deep Hydration Moisturizer

product_name: Mini Cicapair Tiger Grass Color Correcting Treatment SPF 30
review_text: I absolutely love this product. I use it every day just by itself for a natural look or under foundation to help neutralize my red undertones. Can’t name another product I use that works better than the ones by this brand I absolutely love love love it I will continue to swear by this brand until someone proves me other wise I love love love their products I highly recommend! Made my skin look amazing!

product_name: CC+ Cream Oil-Free Matte with SPF 40

product_name: Hyaluronic Marine Makeup Removing Meltaway Cleanser

One of the best facial cotton I have ever used.

review_title: Amazing feel and smell. Highly recommend!

review_text: I was given this product for free in exchange for my honest review. I’ve had positive experiences with Sunday Riley products and was excited to try this moisturizing cream.
