I tended to apply at night; however, I actually think this would be a better day time moisturizer as for my skin (combination), I should probably use something a bit heavier at night (especially now that my apartment heat is on all the time and air is so dry). I would describe this as a solid moisturizer and something that’s great for every day, but if you’re looking for a moisturizer that is targeted at a specific skin problem (anti-aging, ultra moisturizing to apply at night, acne reducing, etc.) you may want to supplement. Overall, a four star moisturizer for me!

product_name: Superberry Hydrate + Glow Dream Night Mask with Vitamin C
review_text: I hate giving this product only 4 stars because it is good! I just don’t love it. It is very creamy and a little thick. The smell is very unique (I’m sorry, I’m horrible at describing scents). The product itself is very interesting in that every time I used it, I felt as though it almost made my face matte? It was so weird. My face was still plump and juicy and (not wet, but you could tell I had a mask on)...and yet it looked almost matte. I don’t know. Maybe I’m just weird. Anyways...and I prefer something that makes my skin glowy and dewy (even if they do the same thing, which is hydrate my skin during the night). It’s a nice mask and if you are interested in it at all, I’d say go for it. It does what it claims to. I didn’t wake up feeling dry or anything like that. I just prefer more glow-giving products.

product_name: Pumpkin Enzyme Mask Enzymatic Dermal Resurfacer
review_text: When I first put this mask on, it hurt so badly that I thought I was having an allergic reaction. Then I washed it off...and oh my lawd. My skin is gorgeous.

product_name: Clean Bee Ultra Gentle Facial Cleanser
review_text: This is my 4th time repurchasing. I love it. Keep in mind if you  wear makeup you need a makeup balm first this alone will not remove everything. Also this is a cleanser its not suppose to treat anything only cleanse your skin to get it ready for Face serum. Serums will help your acne or skin concerns !
review_title: My one and only face wash !!!

product_name: Confidence in a Cream Anti-Aging Hydrating Moisturizer
review_text: Absolutely LOVE this moisturizer--so glad I gave it a try! Feels luxurious, no scent, thick and creamy so a little bit goes a long way. My skin feels plumper, smoother, and fine lines & pores are visibly smaller. Now I need to try the nighttime cream! Especially in winter, this will be my go-to daily moisturizer. Highly recommend!

product_name: Mini Yo Glow AHA & BHA Facial Enzyme Scrub
review_text: Love the way my skin feels after I use this scrub.. I have oily skin with texture.. my skin feels so soft and silky after I’m done... you nailed it Huda ❤️

product_name: Green Clean Makeup Meltaway Cleansing Balm Limited Edition Jumbo
review_text: absolutely delightful to use! i originally thought that botanic farms grain ferment cleansing balm would be my only holy grail, but this green clean shares the HG label :) i have super dry skin, and this washes off cleanly without making my skin feel tight

product_name: Water Drench Hyaluronic Hydrating Moisturizer SPF 45
review_text: this product exceed all my expectations! Very moisturizing and protective, very light on the skin. Did not cause any break outs which sunscreen based tends to do to my skin.
Love this .... help for break out... even the skin texture...

product_name: Beauty Elixir Prep, Set, Glow Face Mist
review_text: It’s a good product, I like how cooling it feels on the skin, it’s very refreshing. Wakes up your skin in the morning. But there’s just one thing that I absolutely hate, the smell. It’s a floral, minty scent that is way way too strong, if you have a sensitive nose I 100% would not recommend this for you, gives me a headache every time I use it. It’s still a nice product, but the scent is just so strong.

I received Dr. Barbara Strum glow drops in exchange for my honest review. Here’s the deal, this is definitely a pause before you purchase item. The price tag is high, however, this definitely serves you a luxury experience with great results. I used these drops for about 3 weeks as directed and my skin has had a natural even all over glow. I found I only need a drop for my face to provide the right amount of glow. The dropper works well, but I did find it a little messy if I’m not careful with it. I think because the formula is on the thick side. I did use this along with the hyaluronic serum and facial cream, and found that it spread easily and evenly. Last but not least when used with a liquid foundation (mine is water based) I was able to achieve a great natural no makeup makeup look. I think that if you’re looking for a premium skin care brand I would definitely recommend looking into Dr. Barbara Strum products. They do not disappoint.

product_name: Midnight Recovery Concentrate Moisturizing Face Oil
review_text: Just oil with heavy oily texture that does not absorbs at all... in summary, just another oil on a cute package.Don’t fall for the hype.

product_name: Mini Adaptogen Deep Moisture Cream with Ashwagandha + Reishi
review_text: I would have been blown away with this moisturizer if it actually wasn’t comedogenic. Silly me believed the label but there are comedogenic ingredients in the first five listed.... I broke out like crazy and I thought it was anything but this moisturizer.  So my breakout continued and I finally recovered after figuring out what it was.  It’s unfortunate because it is truly moisturizing and dry skin girls will love this!  My nose is a big time problem area for texture and this moisturizer kicked a punch for soothing the texture. If you don’t break out much or at all this would work great for you I’m sure.  But sensitive girls I would not buy this until you’ve tested it for at least a week. Don’t believe the noncomedogenic warning. Do your research on the ingredients.

I was skeptical - about the product and the price. But it turns out this is one of the best things I’ve ever done for my red, acne-prone skin. It made it visibly better in just 3 days. It decreased the amount of zits and how long they last (though doesn’t do much for the deep, hormonal ones). Makes my skin look and feel super healthy. Converted!

product_name: Argan Beta Retinol Pink Algae Serum
review_text: I received this product complimentary from Influenster for my review. This is my first time using retinol as a serum and I’m loving it! The packaging is great and the dropper is one of the best I’ve used out of all the ones I’ve tried. It grabs a lot of product and you barely have to put any effort into squeezing the dropper. The smell is ok, not terrible but not great either. I usually apply mine every other night and my skin has looked so glowy since using it. The serum is not drying at all! I drop three drops on my face and let it soak in for 5 minutes or so before applying my night cream. There is a ton of product in this little bottle, I’m sure it will last me for months!

This was gifted by Dermalogica. This is a great exfoliator! It’s very unique as it’s a powder exfoliator. You add some powder to your hand and then a bit of water until you form a paste and then I massage it into my skin. It leaves my skin the softest it’s ever been!! I love this so much it’s my favorite exfoliator now!

AMAZING results. By far the best retinol product I have ever used. Doesn’t dry out my skin, boosted radiance and I feel firmer and my lifted skin already. This is a game changer... it’s correcting every sign I see of aging without irritating my skin. I have already purchased a third time. THE BEST.

I love how glowy and non oily my skin looks in the morning after this. Plus the texture is so nice and it feels so rich and moisturizing. This is a must have for oily skin, if I feel lazy it’s all I put on my face.

product_name: Lip Sleeping Mask Intense Hydration with Vitamin C
review_text: I bought this because my lips were starting to be so chapped and dry they kept bleeding! I used this and after only one night they were much softer. On the second night they started to really repair! I am very generous when I apply this on because I know my lips are sensitive.  I use it every night to keep them soft.

product_name: Pep-Start Daily UV Protector Broad Spectrum SPF 50
review_text: I got this in the mini set and I seriously would love the full size. You don’t need very much of it and it lasts all day. I also notice the white bumps towards the end of the day on my pores but it can be fixed with a matte setting powder. Overall really beautiful feel to it and I see a difference in my complexion.

Amazing and warming scrub, it really is like a sauna scrub for your face. Definitely noticed an improvement in blemishes after I started using this scrub. It feels SO good when the scrub heats up and warms your face, like seriously such a treat. Minus one star because the tube isn’t that big and with daily use, it runs out quite fast. I’m on tube #3!

Not the product/function I thought it would be. I was looking for a light weight toner for wiping off using cotton pads, prior to applying another lotion (Shiseido, Eudermine Revitalising Essence). Prior to getting this product I used Innisfree’s Fermented Soybean Firming Energy Essence for the same purpose.Feel of use:The fluid is white and looks slightly starchy (sincere apologies, but it looks like sp**m... I really cannot describe in any other way...). After several days using cotton pads, it didn’t seem to give me the “wiped clean“ feel so I have stopped using pads.Once applied to my face it is light, not heavy or starchy at all.Compared to the second lotion I use (Eudermine), the scent is more chemical. I cover it with the second lotion so as long as I use two, the scent is not much of an issue.There is a slight tingling after maybe 30 seconds from application. This tingling has not gone away after about a month’s use.Other note:The lid came crushed and broken, so I am keeping the content in a seal-tight glass bottle.
review_title: Not what I was looking for

product_name: Clear Improvement Pore Clearing Moisturizer with Salicylic Acid
review_text: As someone with light acne, I found that this moisturizer helped slightly with clearing my skin but not to the point where I could accredit the moisturizer for it. The color is gray which I found cool (never seen a moisturizer like that) and the texture was pretty nice. It didn’t make my skin too oily and gave me a lot of moisture throughout the day.

product_name: The Camellia Oil 2-in-1 Makeup Remover & Cleanser
review_text: Was looking for something gentle that will take off my makeup without irritating my skin and ran across this wonderful product! I have been using this instead of makeup wipes (which tend to irritate my skin for some reason) and I have noticed quite an improvement on my skin just after 2 uses!! Can’t wait to try out other Tatcha skin care products!

product_name: Skinlongevity Long Life Herb Anti-Aging Face Serum
review_text: Very lightweight and effective! I’ve been using this for the past month, and I feel like it’s really been brightening up my skin. It’s a very lightweight liquid that I like to use under my moisturizer, and it acts almost like a moisturizer primer. I love that it is made from all natural ingredients. It really has made my skin feel and look so much better! Some pros: lightweight, natural ingredients, brightens skin, easy to use under moisturizer without pilling your moisturizer, pump is effective Some cons: takes about a month to see resultsI’ll continue to use this going forward, it’s part of my skincare routine now.

product_name: Capture Totale Super Potent Rich Cream
review_text: Wonderful moisturizer especially for the winter months! My skin is very oily and surprisingly this moisturizer controlled my shine, gave me a nice glow and most importantly was hydrating. Within a week I could see and feel that my face was a lot firmer and even helped disminish the pore sizes on my cheeks. The texture is quite creamy and velvety and has a faint rose smell. I cannot speak to improving fine lines as I currently do not have any. The package itself is very heavy which I had to get used to since it’s not like most lightweight quick grab facial products. Overall I’d recommend especially for oily skin that have trouble finding the right moisturizers. I did recieve this product complimentary via Influenster but my review is 100% my honest opinion.
review_title: Wonderful hydrating moisturizer for oily skin

review_text: Like the smell and the texture, it does help to smooth my skin.

I received this product as a complimentary Item in return for my honest review. I LOVE THIS! This lip mask is rich enough to give an amazing amount of moisture in a super short amount of time. My house gets really dry in the winter which results in me waking up with cracked lips, not anymore!!!!
this product doesn’t help at all and it’s not worth the money.

It doesn’t make my skin worse... but I don’t think it does much. Great for sensitive skin - even when my perioralis dermatitis was at its worst this didn’t irritate (but it also didn’t do much to solve the PD). I don’t think I’ll buy again. Too pricey to not do much.

product_name: T.L.C. Framboos Glycolic Resurfacing Night Serum
review_text: I noticed a different in my skin the very next morning after using this this amazing product and I wish that I had used this years ago. I love love love.
This was SO drying and made my skin break out. I would never recommend this for me again because of how sensitive my skin is.  Not for me.
Amazing product , a little goes a long way. I have sensitive skin and this product did not give me any irritations. Silky smooth application , and very long lasting hydration.
I used this for about two weeks. It instantly hydrates my skin. I have dry skin so this works great before my other skin care. Helps keeps my face hydrated all day.

product_name: Mini Deep Cleanse Gentle Exfoliating Cleanser
review_text: I have tried so many exfolaitors/cleansers that have either done nothing for my skin or have made it worse. This product has improved my skin by leaps and bounds.  I think the only drawback is the cost. I actually didn’t pay for my product, I actually got this product as a deluxe sample from Tatcha. So I may have to save up for it but I will definitely be purchasing again!
Disappointed with the flavor, weird aftertaste. Not like caramel at all. Just another lip balm. Not worth the price tag.

product_name: FAB Skin Lab Retinol Eye Cream with Triple Hyaluronic Acid
review_text: Haven’t noticed a huge difference, will continue to use this tube until the product is gone but will stick with my old trusty Ole Henrikson going forward!

product_name: Lapis Blue Tansy Face Oil - For Oily & Acne-Prone Skin
review_text: I noticed a difference the next day after using this once. I have sensitive oily/combination and VERY acne prone skin (most of which is hormonal too) and i’ve been looking for an oil to gua sha with and this is the one!!! my skin is so much more balanced and SOFT and just looks better overall. I still use my tretinoin along side this and so far so good! hurts the bank account but it’s worth it. I’m so happy  this exists.
Great product , love the consistency, feel and smell.However, I definitely think there are stronger/more potent vitamin c serums/creams out there. This is good for daily use though!

I loved the tin cans but always found it a little messy; also made me uneasy about applying it from the tin to my lips with my fingers; can’t always have clean hands y’know! Now it comes in a tube!!! How awesome is that! I love it!Lightly scented, tinted but very, very flattering natural tint on the lips when applied. Doesn’t feel greasy at all but very hydrating!

product_name: Papaya Sorbet Smoothing Enzyme Cleansing Balm & Makeup Remover
review_text: I love it. The smell of this product is amazing, also I stopped using my cleansing water to remove make up because this does all the work. The only thing is after washing the product, my skin feels a little bit oily so after using it, I wash my face with my night soap. And all done, no make up, and fresh for go to bed.

The product is great for double cleansing and I go in with the CeraVe foam cleanser after rinsing off with this. It does a good job at taking off makeup but not so well with my Maybelline Sky High waterproof mascara.
review_title: Good but leaves a weird moist texture after

product_name: C5 Super Boost Vitamin C Moisturizer
review_text: I love Paula’s Choice and this moisturizer has quickly become apart of my everyday routine! The product has a lightweight, creamy texture and absorbs super quickly into the skin! After a few weeks of using my skin feels more hydrated and glowy! My skin barrier is much happier and my skin is less irritated. I absolutely love how my skin feels and looks
review_title: New part of my daily routine!!

product_name: Magic Cream Moisturizer with Hyaluronic Acid
review_text: I received this product for free as a sample and to give an honest review of the product.  Being I already use Charlotte Tilbury foundation and love it, I figured I would love this product as well.  I was NOT DISAPPOINTED at all, in fact I am beyond happy with this product.  There is an immediate difference to the feel of your skin after using this moisturizer.  It is not greasy and feels light on the skin.  My face felt so smooth and my makeup went on smoothly as well and lasted all day long.  After exfoliating my face and using the next day, it was even more amazing to feel my skin.  I really really like this product and am looking to purchase more products from the Charlotte Tilbury line!

product_name: Alpha Beta Universal Daily Peel Pads
review_text: I love this product!. I have very dry skin and my face recently broke out due to my birth control so i had a bunch blemishes and small bumps all over my face. I was going to buy a Clarisonic and my friend told me to try this and I love it. I only 3 nights in a row and saw difference. My skin felt smooth and it greatly reduced the bumps and blemishes and that was only after 3 days.

What I love Ole Henriksen so much is all their products are simple but effective. This moisturizer is perfect for me as I was just looking for a cream that do hydration. I sometime find simple is the best and it is doing everything I had expected

I was so happy to receive this from Influenster!!  This stuff works.  It’s been a hard winter in NJ and my skin was flakey and dry.  This moisturizes beautifully and feels lovely on the skin.  I hope they make it forever, as I’m now addicted!

I really love how clean and refreshing my skin feels after using this product. I have combination skin and this cleanser doesn’t make my skin feel dyed out after using. It also has helped tremendously with keeping my skin clear from blemishes. It has little to no scent which I love! I would definitely recommend this cleanser.

I got this a while ago as a sample and tried it out (I just purchased the full size) and this stuff is amazing recently due to allergy season my eyes are super dry (I also get dry patches under my eyes due to eczema) and I tried multiple moisturizers and under eye creams nothing worked...Until I tried this. This moisturizing cream was the only thing that has kept my under eyes moist. Love it!!!!
It doesn’t work. Period. And I’m writing more just to get to the 50 characters minimum. Lol! Save your money and try something else.

product_name: Yo Glow AHA & BHA Facial Enzyme Scrub
review_text: Forget everything you thought you knew about exfoliation. I have told my sister, my neighbor, my mom and now I’m telling you about this product. I mean the dead skin just falls off!  Also, a little goes a long way. I will purchase again andddd I have sensitive skin and eczema and it did not irritate me!
review_title: I hardly ever leave reviews but...

product_name: T.L.C. Sukari Babyfacial AHA + BHA Mask
review_text: So far, so good! My skin is brighter and clearer after one use and did not over irritate my skin. Also the packaging is fantastic as usual with Drunk Elephant products. When I ordered this online, I did not realize that they put a good sized sample of the Marula Oil in the box as well, so that was a nice surprise! Worth the money. Treat yo self!
Gently removes make up and leaves my face soft, hydrated and clean. Love it.

product_name: Mini PLAY Everyday Lotion SPF 50 with Sunflower Extract
review_text: Finally, a Supergoop product that’s affordable. It is sticky to the touch once on your face and it doesn’t really absorb (better for protecting against the sun imo). BUT I don’t mind the stickiness because it smells great, leaves zero residue, doesn’t burn my eyes, gives a great glow, and smells amazing.I do have normal skin though, so I wouldn’t recommend for anyone with oily skin.

product_name: Instant Reset Brightening Overnight Recovery Gel-Cream With Niacinamide + Kalahari Melon Oil
review_text: Absolutely love how this makes my face feel! Really great smell too.

So I’ve been using the glow recipe serum with AHA in the mornings and decided to add this to my night routine! The combination has cleared up my skin significantly! I had some dark spots from the sun and they’re gone! Definitely did some work!

product_name: UV Expert Aquagel Defense Sunscreen, Primer & Moisturizer SPF 50 Duo
review_text: This moisturizer is a little watery but feels great, melts into your skin and provides protection from the sun and a little primer as well. I use another primer on top of this, but if this is all you use, it would be enough! I received this product for free for my honest review, but all opinions are my own.
I love these healing dots, I highly recommend them for any acne prone skin. I deal with regular and hormonal acne and it works great on both for me!

I’m addicted to face mists and this particular one did not disappoint. I love using it throughout the day when my face starts to feel a bit tight due to the AC blasting, to set makeup, and even as a toner in my daily skincare routine.Overall it’s a great mist and great value. Give it try!

This cleanser is excellent!  I like to remove my makeup first and then cleanse my skin.  I have very combination skin with normal and dry areas and Lily on and around my nose.  I have large pores around my nose and some fine lines on my forehead.  This cleanser leaves my skin clean but doesn’t feel stripped and it has helped improve the look of the large pores.  It works well using just my fingers but works amazing with the Clarisonic.  I’m delighted that I received this to review and will buy it in the future!
review_title: Leaves skin soft and clear.  Great for combo skin

review_text: I have very sensitive dry skin that is acne prone and also have a lot of redness. I was worried that this may harsh but I have to say it is a pretty gentle moisturizer. It does not dry out my skin nor does it feel uncomfortable or tacky. My skin does not have any poor reaction either. I am hopeful that over time this will help the redness and the acne because of the tea tree leaf extract found in this moisturizer! I am not sure if there are any immediate improvements but it definitely hasn’t made my skin worse. I would recommend it if you’re looking for a good clean product and have acne prone skin and/or a lot of redness.

I was gifted by moon juice. I was so excited to try this plump jelly! I’ve been eyeing the moon juice products for quite some time now so I’m so excited that I finally got to try one! This serum sinks into my skin and doesn’t leave it feeling sticky or tacky. I can tell just after a few uses that my skin looks much more plump and youthful. A little bit of this goes a long way so one or two squirts is enough to do your face and neck. Highly recommend giving this a try!

product_name: Advanced Night Repair Eye Concentrate Matrix Synchronized Multi-Recovery Complex
review_text: I was thoroughly impressed with this product. I haven’t used many night repair eye creams before so I was excited to try this. I love the applicator. The little ball tip makes it feel so smooth going on. I started to notice a difference in 2+ weeks and could tell that my dark circles were going away and my eyes were looking brighter.

I have owned every moisturizer known to man. This is a simple light moisturizer that leaves my face feeling hydrated but not filmy. Soaks in well. I have acne prone combo skin that is quite oily in the t zone. $65 is a steal because Im not constantly buying new ones. No need to keep looking. I think this is the 1st moisturizer I have ever repurchased. On my 3rd. Prior to purchasing though each time I asked Sephora associates about it I was told it would be too heavy for me and even once that it has salicylic acid in it. Glad I eventually just bought it anyway. If you are combo/oily/ acne prone you will love this.
This is a really nice and fresh night cream, it smells great and is thick but not too thick. Really pleased with it!
My skin loves this stuff! It has felt significantly smoother when I’m cleansing, which is very satisfying. The glow I get the following morning is everything!

I’ve bought this mask two or three times before receiving a full size in this month’s Influenster box and finally got around to doing a review for it! I’m a sucker for beautiful packaging lol, my only complaint is that it very much is like a painters tube or toothpaste and will crinkle and lose it’s shape easily which makes it less beautiful. For the product itself, it’s pretty good and gives a nice energizing but also soothing cooling effect (like drinking water after a mint feeling), scent is a bit medicinal. I often used it to soothe my skin after using too many AHAs/BHAs and it’s GREAT for tired under eyes and seems to plump sunken undereyes overnight (also possible that just sleep did that lol). However, the cooling sensation was a bit too strong and lightly stung when i had open cystic acne and when my skin was more calm it caused some pimples and milia if i used it as a nighttime moisturizer too often (i would only use it 1-2x a week) overall, i think it’s a versatile mask that can work for a lot of people over different skin types and most of all it’s fun! definitely expensive, but I find it a lot more hydrating and relaxing than sheet masks and lasts a while because it’s a thick cream consistency so you don’t need much.

I gave it 4 stars because I’m still squaring the fence about this product. It kinda burns my skin. I’m not sure because I exfoliate after I use it of what. I will give it a couple more weeks to see if I want to try it.

I was skeptical but the hype is real. These are amazing! So easy to use and just makes your skin tan the same colour as it would naturally from the sun. Definitely wash fingers and palms well after use! Will go with Dark next time to use less drops. Zero complaints - definitely try it.

product_name: Clear Improvement Charcoal Honey Mask to Purify and Nourish
review_text: I absolutely loved this product! Before applying, I wet my face with warm water to open up my pores as it said on the back of the packaging would give better results. After having the product on my face and letting it dry, I washed it all off to reveal much cleaner, clearer, and smoother skin. For weeks I had been struggling with my face and not being able to clear my skin like it was before, and this product worked wonders. It did have a little tingling sensation at first but it was bearable. I received this product complimentary for testing purposes and loved it.

product_name: Double Serum Firming & Smoothing Anti-Aging Concentrate
review_text: I wasn’t really impressed with this serum product. The concept of having to mix the two products together is interesting but not really explained as to why. The sample packaging is kind of awkward to use and get the product out of. There is too much fragrance added for something that is supposed to contain all kinds of botanicals. I didn’t really see any difference in my skin after using it for a week and it made my skin breakout in a way that it hasn’t for over 15 years. I wouldn’t purchase this for myself. Not recommended for people with sensitive skin.
review_title: Not for me, especially at this price

review_text: This is one of the best hydrating moisturizers I have used. I have really dry skin (on top of using tretinoin) and this has kept my skin hydrated all day on top of not being irritating, not causing breakouts and leaving such a nice finish.

I am in awe of how much this stuff works and cannot believe how many people chalk up the “balling up“ to just the product. The first time I used it my sink was covered in grey dead skin particles. The product itself balls up white so there had to be dead skin in there! Plus my face feels amazing soft and smooth after the fact! I uploaded a photo of all the grey junk that literally fell off of my face - NOT just the product. It is pricey, but I feel like I need it maybe once every 2 weeks - but that’s just my skin type. It’s a great staple to have on hand that will really last you a long time!

I use this mostly at night as my nightly moisturizer and it has dramatically improved my skin. Its helped reduce my acne scars. I tend to get eczema in the winter time on my face and it has not surfaced yet thanks to this. My skin is not flaky as it normally would be in the winter. It is also perfect for the summer as well, it is not too heavy and it soaks into the skin quickly. I would recommend this to anyone!

product_name: Lip Sleeping Mask Intense Hydration with Vitamin C
review_text: Noticed a difference after one night! My lips looked hydrated and full in the morning and made my lipstick go on a lot smoother and look a lot better throughout the day. I suffer from extremely dry lips and have to reapply lip balm every hour in the colder months and I think this might be my winter solution! Excited to be able to wear lipstick without my lips cracking underneath. I started with a sample and will be purchasing the full product.

I have been using Two Faced Beauty Balm for about 5 years but it was discontinued about a year ago and I haven’t been able to find a lip moisturized that is match...until I found Rosebud Strawberry Lip Balm. This stuff is a must have! The subtle strawberry scent, large amount in a purse ready container and great price will keep me coming back for more:-)
review_title: Couldn't find Two Faced Beauty Balm, found this!

product_name: Watermelon Glow PHA + BHA Pore-Tight Toner
review_text: I’m 36 and my pores are the smallest they’ve ever been. I just put a few drops in my hands and apply morning and night.
review_title: I can’t believe it works this well!

review_text: This product is worth a try, the price is incredible! I have sensitive skin so I don’t use this every night- I rotate with a retinol (highly recommend the one from Josie Maran) but I have found results with this. Helps even out skin, helped with hormonal acne. The only negative is the consistency- it’s a bit sticky on the skin.

I have been using this cleanser as part of a new skincare routine for 3 months. I use it at night after removing my makeup before my serums. It is gentle, but effective! Will keep using - still not done with the bottle!

Love love love! This serum is great for helping to repair the moisture barrier and draw in moisture. It is helping me keep dry, flaky, winter skin at bay. I use it AM and PM after cleansing or masking. When I have problem skin, I will also add in The Ordinary’s Niacinamide and/or Salicylic Acid to the Hyaluronic Acid and apply all at once.To avoid any pilling, use less product. You probably only need two or three drops max! More than that and the product goes on too thick and doesn’t dry down properly.
review_title: Easy step to add in for improving moisture

product_name: Floral Recovery Overnight Mask with Squalane
review_text: I’ve been really enjoying this mask! It can be used as a wash off mask or an overnight mask, I have only used it as an overnight mask. I am really impressed with the results! The mask works great as an intensive moisturizer and also pairs well with the rest of the products in my routine. I have always had redness and am pleasantly surprised with the reduction I notice while using this! This will be really great for events to prep the skin as well as every today use.

Omg. I’ve tried so many cleansing oils. I’ve been using cleansing oil for 15 years every single night and this is by far my new favorite. I’ve used dhc, origins, loccitane, Mac..and countless drugstore/cheaper brands and while I’ve been happy with all of them for the most part, this one is by far the most effective. It’s more liquidy then any others (which I prefer) but gets all of my makeup off, including my very hard to remove mascara which I had, until this cleanser, just given up on trying to remove completely. I’m actually shocked at how clean my face was without even double cleansing (I still do, but probably more out of habit then actually having to with this) I think my days of trying new cleansing oils are over!

I’ve tried the air-whip moisturizer because I saw it was good for oily-dehydrated skin and loved it. So I got a sample of this to test it out and see if it was worth getting a full size and BOY IT’S GREAT. I noticed when my skin is dry, it softens and hydrates while reducing the amount of sebum on my T zone so I barely get oily throughout the night and day. I got a 2nd sample with my points and plan to get a full size once they’re both out. I love using it as my moisturizer after a toner and serum.

product_name: Ultra Facial Advanced Repair Barrier Cream
review_text: I have been using this product for several weeks in the dry cold winter of NE Ohio.  I use it as a balm at night because it’s a bit thick for daytime use unless you would be outside skiing or hiking or something like that. Would recommend for winter!

This is my new holy grail product!! Noticed a huge difference in my skin after only one week. Helped my acne scars fade, controlled my oiliness in my t-zone and got rid of my redness, giving me a much more even skin tone. It also got rid of my acne bumps on my forehead, now they are barely noticeable. Absolutely amazing product, highly recommend!!

product_name: SEA drink of H2O hydrating boost moisturizer
review_text: I loved this as soon as I got it. And it worked well the first couple of days but now it’s done a 180. It actually leaves my skin feeling drier than if I hadn’t put it on at all. I’m not sure if I’m suddenly allergic or what, but I’m disappointed because I did like this product originally.

I was excited to use this at first because usually in a big fan of drunken elephant products but I didn’t fine much use for this. It left my face greasy. But I applied it before showering and It did help with the black eyeliner residue that is usually left over after you use it.

Sugar Face Polish has been great for my sensitive skin. It really helped with my dry skin and left my skin feeling very soft. My only complaint is that it does not wash off clean, it seems to leave a residue.

product_name: Double Serum Firming & Smoothing Anti-Aging Concentrate
review_text: I received a seven day trial of clarins double serum complete age control concentrate as a free sample from Influenster. After the first couple uses saw no change, but by the end there was a slight difference. My skin felt firmer and softer. My roommate complimented me on how I seemed to be “glowing“ lately. I have a few bumpy areas on my forehead, which were not changed (due to the fact that this is not a acne cream) but on the rest of my face I noticed a difference. I would love to keep using it longer to see its effects !

AMAZING RESULTS! My skin has never been more smooth and plump. I started out using it in my morning morning routine and didn’t see results and then after some research I figured out peptides don’t do well with lower PHs, and acids, and I use a vitamin C serum during the daytime. I then started using this at nighttime instead and saw results almost immediately. I’d recommend incorporating this before your retinol/retinoid or nighttime moisturizer. It’s seriously a game changer if you use it correctly!

I had high expectations of this product...caused an over-night breakout. And I have zero allergies. After researching, I learned ‘marula oil’ is highly comedogenic. So how can the brand state the benefits like it does? Beware.
This leaves my skin so smooth and literally radiant and glowing

Feels like a magic potion! Been using this for a month and has made a significant change in my skin. I’m combination skin and acne prone and this has really help with that and have my face feel balanced. I haven’t had a big breakout since using this just a couple of those very tiny and annoying pimples. Not I’m left to figure out my ance scars.

product_name: Volcanic AHA Pore Clearing Clay Mask
review_text: This mask is so soothing and feels great on. I have sensitive skin and it doesn’t irritate it at all like other clay masks can. I do find it makes my skin look clear and my pores a little smaller, and it can help calm some zits that are starting to flare up. Great price point as well.

product_name: Advanced Retinol + Ferulic Overnight Texture Renewal Peel
review_text: I really like how this pad is powered by proprietary Phyto-Retinol BlendTM. After using it i see clear improvement of lines wrinkles and I also felt my face having more radiance. I use the pads once a week with the serum.I like how it boost hydration on my skin when I apply it.

Dermalogia gifted me their PreCleanse cleansing oil.  This scent free and super gentle oil really removes all my tinted spf! I use two pumps and massage it into my skin. For my second cleanse I use the dermalogica daily glycolic cleanser. These two go perfectly together.
review_title: I love how gentle it is

review_text: I received this product complimentary from Influencer in a vox box. I have oily/acne prone skin that I’ve been stuck with since I was 13. This year I decided I wanted to try new products to try and help reduce my acne once and for all. This product is a great one to help pull any funk out and clean deep in your pores. After some changes in medicine, some cystic acne began appearing on my face. This mask helped get rid of the cystic acne in only a two days! Usually they can stay for up to a week on my face. I plan on using this product every other day to help with the rest of my large/clogged pores!
all inclusive for lips, cuticles, elbows and anything that needs a bit of protection and moisturizing. smells wonderful!
It is very thick. Sometimes it doesn’t stick very well to my skin, but when it does, it really helps with my acne.

I’m 43  have very sensitive skin and a damaged skin barrier after a microneedling session at a medispa that left me with a skin infection, and then being diagnosed with an overactive thyroid node. To help recover and combat the otherworldly dryness, I now use Skinmedica’s HA5 and layer this on tope of it at night. I no longer have to keep layering things throughout the day to keep my skin from looking crepey. My skin looks nicer again when I wake up in the morning. I’m very impressed. I’ve tried so many products over the past 9 months and nothing has compared to this combination. It balm isn’t heavy, or overly oily. It’s a jelly that melts on your fingers as you massage it into your skin. It doesn’t irritate my sensitive skin, and absorbes very quickly.  I am SO grateful I found this. My skin texture is noticeably better. Big fan.
review_title: Incredible for 40+ Dry, Crepey or Damaged Skin

product_name: All About Eyes Rich Eye Cream
review_text: It’s a nice moisturizer, but I personally have not seen any impact on circles or puffiness.

product_name: Mini Instant Reset Brightening Overnight Recovery Gel-Cream With Niacinamide + Kalahari Melon Oil
review_text: Helps great with my combo skin! Feels nice going on and moisturizes very well.

product_name: The Rice Polish Foaming Enzyme Powder
review_text: I bought this because all of the reviews were so great and Ill try any skin care product. I wouldn’t say this anything special. The smell is weird. Not gross, just weird. And it really doesn’t exfoliate that well. I wont buy it again because the price is too much for the average job.

product_name: The Serum Stick: Treatment & Touch Up Balm
review_text: Pros of this product: Easy to carry for day to day use. Sturdy product! Very versatile since you can use it however you seem fit in the daily routine.Cons: it works better as a serum without any makeup because when you try to use it as a touch up balm, it tends to drag the makeup a little bit. Best to use finger if using it to touch up!I would recommend it if the price isn’t too much out of budget.

I was kindly gifted by Dermalogical Sampling  this product and I am so happy! During pregnancy my skin really breaks out pretty badly and the heat certainly doesn’t help. This microfoliant not only makes my skin look fresh but also feel fresh. I plan to purchase the full sized bottle and add to my daily skin routine!

product_name: Mini Cicapair Tiger Grass Color Correcting Treatment SPF 30
review_text: Best! I have red toned skin that this product has transformed!

This formula does what it claims. I did not read the label at first. Trial and error, made me realize that twice a day was too much. I cannot use it on my neck or decolletage. My skin got overly sensitive right away the very first day I tried to use it twice. So I switched to once a day, in the morning, since I was finishing up some retinol ester and lactic acid combo at night. And the GA is good to prep the skin to absorb vitamin C and make it work better (which I use every morning). I then noticed the directions state to use it in the PM, since the product makes the skin more sensitive to skin damage from UV rays. I finished my retinol ester and lactic acid combo, and have started using a glycolic night cream with a vitamin C and turmeric oil.Anyway, it gently exfoliates my skin. has smoothed out my skin texture and makes my complexion more vibrant. The formula does not dry my skin out, or break me out. I have only been using it for a few weeks, and so far so good.Cant beat the price either.I would highly recommend this product.

product_name: Clear Improvement Pore Clearing Moisturizer with Salicylic Acid
review_text: I want to start off by saying I have combo skin that leans more on the oily side during warmer months. This moisturizer texture is okay and feels fine on. It has a very strong scent of mint and men’s cologne but it does go away after a while. I stopped using it after 2 weeks since there are moisturizers I like more and are more effective. I feel like this would be better for acne prone or oily skin.

Rich but not greasy. Soothing, restoring, and smells great. My skin just drinks this up. I initially started using this as an evening cream because the texture is on the heavier side. But it sinks in so great that I’ve started using it as my day cream as well. It plays well with makeup and doesn’t leave any tacky feeling, though it definitely feels ultra moisturizing. It’s becoming my go-to moisturizer.

product_name: Rose & Hyaluronic Acid Deep Hydration Moisturizer
review_text: I received Rose & Hyaluronic Acid Deep Hydration Moisturizer Reformulation as a gift. This is the first product I’m using from fresh and I am in love with it.  It is perfect for combination skin without making the skin feel greasy.

product_name: Beauty Elixir Prep, Set, Glow Face Mist
review_text: I bought this elixir to refresh my skin midday as it tends to look dry with the Bare Minerals makeup that I wear. It feels nice and looks wet when it goes on but once it is dry my skin looks exactly the same as it did before. I am glad I only bought the travel size.
review_title: Does not do the job I bought it for

review_text: I’ve tried so many different cleansers. I’m 28 and still breakout AND have a tendency for dry skin. I’ve used Proactiv, Philosophy, Clinique, etc. etc. etc...This is the only cleanser that keeps my skin constantly clear AND doesn’t dry it out AT ALL.Love it!

product_name: Lala Retro Whipped Refillable Moisturizer with Ceramides
review_text: Drunk elephant packaging is the best. Open the lid and push down on the container and the exact amount pops up. Swipe and ready to go. It is whipped to perfection and goes on so smoothly. It absorbs and leaves no stickiness. My skin is so soft and my makeup goes on so much better.

I was totally skeptical of this... I’m not the biggest GOOP fan but received this as a gift to try. I’m prettttty particular about my face creams and usually just stick to my La Mer but I have to say... this is ALMOST as good! And for the price it truly can’t be beat. Def worth the investment!

product_name: Mini Advanced Night Repair Synchronized Multi-Recovery Complex
review_text: I got this sample from Influenster and I loved it. It made my skin really soft and hydrated the next morning. I would recommend this product to whoever needs it
I have oily/combo sensitive skin and this toner DOESN’T make my skin red, blotchy, irritated or dry. I will repurchase!

product_name: Take The Day Off Cleansing Balm Makeup Remover
review_text: This product is really helpful and definitely removes all my makeup. I also love the glow it leaves as it is a bit like a facial oil/balm as well. However I’m not sure it’s great for removing eye makeup. You probably should use a separate eye makeup remover for that, because this gets in my eyes and clouds up my eyes kind of like an oil.

product_name: Blue Tansy BHA and Enzyme Pore Refining Mask
review_text: I will definitely be repurchasing this mask forever! I have very acne-prone skin that is sensitive, red, and oily. I followed the instructions by using the mask for 4 days in a row and then 2-3 times per week after that. After the second use, I noticed a difference myself. After the third use, I was getting compliments from friends on how my skin looked. It’s now been almost 3 weeks and I am blown away! I have never found a product that works so well, yet feels so gentle and doesn’t irritate my skin at all while soothing any redness. I haven’t had any major breakouts since I started using it (just a small pimple here and there when I’ve worn heavy makeup). My skin feels smooth and soft, and looks bright and clear. No product (and I have tried them all) has worked this well. Wow!

My cousin gave me the remainder of her bottle, which was about a quarter full. I used it daily and my skin seemed to look a little smoother after about two weeks. But then that was like, it. So yeah, I don’t really agree with the hype. I also can’t stand the smell. It reminds me of stinky feet. Thank goodness the smell fades after it absorbs. I’d give this two stars but it’s taking me forever to finish what’s left of the bottle. So +1 star for longevity of the product
i loved this face wash! i only needed a small amount and my skin felt smooth, clean and radiant! this was not harsh, oily or drying. love it.

product_name: Barrier+ Triple Lipid-Boost 360° Brightening Eye Cream
review_text: Skinfix barrier+ Lipid-Boost 360 Eye has become my favorite! I will repurchase this over and over again, because I had never tried such lightweight yet nourishing formula! This is the best eye cream for 25+ to prevent early aging and make skin around eyes smooth and elastic. review_title: The best eye cream I’ve tried

product_name: Clear Improvement Active Charcoal Mask to Clear Pores
review_text: I do like using masks every now and then. I got this one as a sample. The first time is always the most remarkable; smaller pores, brighter skin, softer skin, really clean and fresh feeling. I bought the 3.4oz bottle after using it twice, ive used it many times now. I have sensitive skin, this mask does not irritate my skin and so far still hasnt. I wudnt recommend using it more than once a week tho. This mask leaves my face feeling and looking great. Not sure how I missed the boat on these tanning drops, but I’m back on!  These drops are super easy to use (no mitt, etc.) after exfoliating and application, you can see yourself get tan by the minute.

product_name: Revitalizing Supreme+ Youth Power Creme Moisturizer
review_text: I tried a deluxe sample of the  Estée Lauder Revitalizing Supreme + Youth Creme Moisturizer and the creme is thick moisturizer that i did not need to use too much of. I can instantly tell the difference when I applied the moisturizer because my skin was very dry and I did use a toner before applying this creme. The creme help seal in moisture and make my skin softer in appearance and the texture smooth. I like that the cream can be applied under my makeup and does not pill if combined with other skincare. The cream absorbs easily into my skin without any oiliness or heavy feeling.
This product didn’t really do anything at all lifting wise but it does have a huge amounts of oil after the magnets are took off, it’s fun if u don’t mind the mess but not worth the price

The smell is quite pleasant and relaxing. The 15 minutes that I had it on I was relaxed and didn’t want to take it off. I can’t say that I saw immediate results but then again I don’t have massive issues with my pores. I used my Clarisonic to scrub my face before applying the mask. I have to give 5* to the brush because it’s fantastic and I will be using it now with my other masks. I did notice that my skin was glowing afterwards especially after a very long day of work and working out. Will try it in the morning to take adventage of the glow. Overall, I will be using this products for the gloss and relaxation effect. I received this product complimentary for testing purposes.

product_name: The Silk Canvas Protective Primer Mini
review_text: Tried this with so many foundations on so many occasions and honestly it was the worst primer that I ever used. It gave me ugly skin. I Followed the instructions and read tips online from people on how to properly apply but it was still awful. And yes, I have used all different amounts as I know it can look patchy if you use too much. Doesn’t matter - this primer emphasized my lines, pores, every little dry patch and exposed peach fuzz that I didn’t even know was there. Honestly maybe the worst $20 I ever spent. I have mostly dry skin with a few oily patches and acne and this primer did anything but help.
review_title: This was a huge purchase regret

product_name: PRO ACV Healthy Gut Vegan Gummies with 100% Organic Apple Cider Vinegar and Probiotics
review_text: Really like these gummies. They taste really good and don’t get caught in my teeth. The most amazing thing is I feel less discomfort after eating, so I believe the probiotic aspect is really helping me.

product_name: Intensive Eye Renewal Cream with Firming Peptides
review_text: Good eye cream! Absorbs into skin easily and not greasy. It is basically odorless (which is a huge improvement from their face cream that smells horrible). I could see gradual results in a couple of weeks but nothing super dramatic.

I LOVE THIS FACE WASH. It smells so nice, subtle of course. It washes my skin well and doesnt leave it feeling dry and I have super dry skin with psoriasis. But dang why does it have to be so expensive!? I literally have to treat myself to get this face wash. It works great but for the price there should be chunks of gold in there or something.

product_name: Goodbye Acne AHA/BHA Acne Clearing Gel Face Body Spot Treatment
review_text: This gel does exactly what it says on description. Its great in removing the blemishes without overdrying the skin.I was hoping for this to help me with acne as recommended to me by Sephora esthetician. But this doesnt really work that well on acne.But this is a miracle gel for blemishes. Usually when i have acne blemishes it takes up to 3 months for the blemish to lighten up. With this gel I could see the results with in 5 days from using it once everyday.Its really good when it comes to blemish. If only this was as good at working on acne !!!But I glad that it delivers what it promises and without drying the skin (my skin type is oily, so the results could be different for someone with dry skin).Thanks to Sephora esthetician and the Gel!!!

I love those, it’s high quality for the same price of drugstores brands

review_text: I got this after reading reviews and expecting something amazing; I have other Sugar products that I love! Unfortunately, this one was disappointing. Overall, its way too pricey and didn’t work well for me.

product_name: C.E.O. Vitamin C Brightening Rich Hydration Moisturizer
review_text: I really wanted to love this. When I first applied it, it felt like a thick barrier over my skin and I liked it. I put it on around 6pm and by 9pm my face felt really greasy (if you don’t like oils, you will not like this). I used it 3 nights in total before my face got severely dry, red and ITCHY. Don’t know what ingredient triggered this but there was another review from a person that had the same experience. If you don’t have sensitive skin, like heavier moisturizers and don’t mind greasy feeling skin then this may be your holy grail. I will say that I suffer from acne and this didn’t add anymore or any less. However, my skin now has to be repaired from this product.

product_name: Alpha Beta Universal Daily Peel Pads
review_text: Got it as a sample. Definitely worth the price but people with sensitive skin need to use it with precaution. I wouldn’t ise it regularly because of how sensitive my skin is. But it does work and you can see a difference instantly.

review_text: I was very disappointed in this scrub. The texture and smell of the scrub is nice, until you try to use it on your face. I attempted to use it over the course of several weeks, and each time, the product beaded up and was difficult to use. I also noticed my skin appeared in irritated after each use. Unfortunately, I can’t recommend this product.

review_text: i wanted to like this so bad. However, it doesn’t do anything. It works at first right when you put it on and feels really nice, but in the morning my lips were not smooth and still chapped.

review_text: I used this product for about a month, 1-2x a week and it definitely leaves your skin feeling super hydrated and smooth.
