product_name: Find Your Balance Oil Control Cleanser
review_text: Fav for oily skin! It’s fairly sized for a trial size. I ended up getting the kit but I purchased a full size of each product! It smells very earthy and clean, and the gel texture makes it really easy to spread once you add a bit of water. It’s been helping a lot since my combo skin leans more oily in the Florida heat!

product_name: SEA drink of H2O hydrating boost moisturizer
review_text: It didn’t really sink in, so it just felt like something dried on my face. I didn’t feel that it hydrated my skin very well. Smelt nice and the cooling sensation was pleasant, but not worth it.

Meh. I have combo skin (the skin type the packaging recommends to use) so I had high hopes for this, but it leaves my oily areas extremely shiny and gross feeling. On the plus side, it didn’t irritate my skin and had a mild but pleasant scent. I think this would be okay for someone with dry, dull skin, but it just doesn’t work for me, so I’ll be returning it.

product_name: Magic Cream Moisturizer with Hyaluronic Acid
review_text: This cream from Charlotte is my favorite, for when I want to have spectacular skin and that my makeup looks fabulous with this cream I never fail it combines perfectly with all my foundations. I love it I don’t even have to use primer this cream does it all, fills in my expression lines and the makeup lasts perfectly all day! Highly recommended.

I’ve used prescription retinol for over a decade. Lately, it’s become too harsh for me. I tried this and it gives me the same results without the irritation. It makes my skin glow in the morning and did fade faint lines after a month of use. The only con is it leaves blue streaks on your pillow. It does easily come out in the wash.

I received this product complimentary from Farmacy Beauty. I have been loving this new moisturizer! It’s definitely meant for dry skin or sensitized skin. Perfect for the colder months as it moisturizers all day and all night. The texture is very thick and creamy, but it absorbs really nicely. The packaging is also worth mentioning as it is gorgeous, the metal scooper with the magnetic lid makes it super sanitary and convenient. I feel like for the price you’re getting a great deal since a little does go a long way! Love it!!

I used this moisturizer for about two months. It is very light but at the same time very moisturizing. It’s not heavy but it does seem to plump your skin and it absorbs beautifully. It’s very hydrating but definitely won’t leave you oily. I have combination skin and it did not cause any more shine in my oily areas. It has no fragrance which I love because it’s not irritating on my skin. I did not notice any anti aging benefits other than it did hydrate which will definitely plump your skin and make it look more radiant. I used this morning and night. Since it absorbs well it’s okay to use under makeup during the day. I gave this five stars and did not take any away for price. It is rather expensive for a face cream but if it’s within your price range it’s definitely worth the splurge. I highly recommend.

For years, people have been complaining about the “messy“ tin packaging & apparently Smith’s listened. I bought this as a Christmas gift for my mom. She loves the original in the tin but doesn’t carry it with her because 1- it’s too hard to apply while driving and 2- it has melted in the past. People are often quick to point out that Rosebud Salve is “glorified petroleum jelly“ but it works! This is a great product with more convenient packaging, an overall winner.

product_name: Rénergie Lift Multi-Action Ultra Dark Spot Correcting Cream SPF 30
review_text: I have tried many sun creams in my life, but non like LAMCOM. It lets your face hydrate, especially for those who have a combination of skin. I love it!

I have dry/combination skin, and I found the argan oil to be extremely balancing. The dry skin around my nose/cheeks area has disappeared, with no breakouts or increased oiliness elsewhere. I highly recommend this product for a glowing complexion!

I absolutely love the Belif products and this eye cream is no different. It has a gel like consistency that absorbs quickly without feeling greasy. Makeup applies beautifully over the top of it. It also has a slight cooling effect. Great product overall! I received this product complimentary from Influenster, but the thoughts and review are my own.
I absolutely love this face oil! I get so many compliments on my skin when i am using it. I find the scent of many face oils bothers me, this one is not scented which is great.

I’ve tried other ginseng serums/essences before that have been very runny and given no immediate effect. I see an immediate “glow from within” and plumping effect from the moment I apply it to my skin. It sits beautifully under makeup and other skincare without pilling. Plus, it smells divine (but not too strong)—fresh and exotic. The price is a little steep, but if you’re into luxurious skincare then this is a must try!

product_name: The Rice Polish Foaming Enzyme Powder
review_text: Love, love this product. Gentle enough to use everyday.

This may be the best moisturizer I’ve ever used. I use at night, cleanse, and use again with my beauty routine in the morning. The texture is whipped and light, goes on like a dream. Makes my skin feel plump, smooth, and hydrated. Also helps makeup apply flawlessly. Smells great. Isn’t sticky. I can’t say enough great things. Will purchase again when I run out. Moisture lasts full 24 hours as promised on my skin.

I was pretty excited to try this product but the results weren’t outstanding. The cream felt good. It wasn’t oily or too thick and it went on well but I was hoping for a bigger change to my under eyes. I’m still finishing it up so perhaps I’ll see more results later. The price is good deal so I would recommend trying it out.

product_name: Cicapair Tiger Grass Color Correcting Treatment SPF 30
review_text: I really like this product! I have a lot of redness on my face and this cream does a great job of hiding it. It goes on my skin very smoothly. I definitely recommend this product!

product_name: Ultra Glow Serum: Glow + Strengthen Vitamin C Serum
review_text: Yes I like it, makes skin glowing , I use it every day am and pm
Feels great on my skin great product I would recommend this

product_name: Alpha Beta Extra Strength Daily Peel Pads
review_text: Great Product. I liked how it felt on my skin. I liked the process, it didn’t take long. I did get a pimple after first use but I heard that is not uncommon. Made my skin feel soft.
review_title: Nice but caused a little breakout at first

review_text: Love this toner-its nothing super flashy. It just gently nourishes your skin and protects your skin barrier. I love adding a drop of tea tree oil to the cotton pad after the toner is on-this helps me combat any blemishes or breakouts. It’s great! It takes a second to soak into a cotton pad but the ingredients are so great-one of the few toners that doesn’t use stripping ingredients (like denatured alcohol etc). Totally recommend this stuff-its great for sensitive skin too.

product_name: Clear Improvement Active Charcoal Mask to Clear Pores
review_text: I had purchased this a few months ago and recently received another one for free from Influenster. I love this mask! I use it about once a week to clear out my pores and detox my skin!
I really enjoyed how soft this made my skin feel. It was a noticeable difference from my usually semi-dry skin. It’s very gentle on the skin too, doesn’t leave you greasy or dry out your skin.

product_name: Wild Nettle & Niacinamide Instant Firming Serum
review_text: I didn’t see any breathtaking results but this would be a great product for anyone with redness or acne. This would also be great for sunburn since aloe is second or third ingredient. I personally wasn’t a fan of the texture. It dries quickly but it’s ends up being a sticky texture until it dries completely or your add your moisturizer on top.

What a difference this makes when I used it before applying my makeup. I use it as my last step before moisturizer and SPF and my makeup and skin look incredible all day. I am so angry that I will have to repurchase this as part of my skincare now!

product_name: Mini Glowscreen Sunscreen SPF 40 PA+++ with Hyaluronic Acid + Niacinamide
review_text: This product left a white film on my face all day after 1 application. I rubbed it in and went swimming and it was still white and pasty on my face. I will not be using again.

i got this as a gift for my brother who is too “manly“ to admit he uses my masks when he thinks i dont notice. The packaging is great because its not super feminine. but it did nothing for his skin, it just made him smell like a rotten egg for the full day after using it.

product_name: Superberry Hydrate + Glow Dream Night Mask with Vitamin C
review_text: I’m usually not a huge fan of masks I’m encouraged to leave on overnight (think of my clean sheets!) BUT this was wonderful. The product smells incredible, like a childhood candy that I can’t remember the name of but the smell memory is intense, and the texture is so so nice. It goes on feeling like I’ve definitely put on A Mask, but melts into the skin like any good deep moisturizing cream. My skin feels very soft after using it three nights in a row - on a particularly dry day I even used it as my base moisturizer and loved it.

In fact, I’m not convinced it peeled ANY dry patches off my face. At best, it certainly doesn’t complete the job. I have extremely oily, acne-prone skin and use acne medications. Sometimes, I get dry patches from the medication and if I don’t exfoliate that skin, my makeup the next day will accentuate those dry areas. I like other PTR products, but this one must not be strong enough to exfoliate anything.
review_title: Does' t Peel Much Dry Skin Off

review_text: i wanted to love this moisturizer soooo badly but i have sensitive skin and the fragrant oils completely broke out my face it was awful. If it wasn’t for that, this would truly be a great moisturizer. I did like the way it felt and was very moisturizing.

I decided to purchase it after reading so many good reviews and also my friend’s recommendation. I like it a lot. It is very gentle, calming and refreshing. It smells very good: cucumber I believe. I have had oily skin, but I feel that recently it is changing to more combination-dry cheeks and oily T zone. I will continue using it until I switch to anti-aging products.

product_name: Watermelon Glow PHA + BHA Pore-Tight Toner
review_text: It’s thicker than your typical toner and a little goes a long way! I put the product on my hands, warm it up a little with my hands, then pat it into my skin. The smell is exactly like a watermelon jolly rancher so if your skin is sensitive to products with fragrance in it or you just wouldn’t like that smell, this probably isn’t for you but I loved it. It’s not too strong but after application it lingers for a little bit and then goes away after awhile. It’s very hydrating, didn’t break me out, helped keep acne off my dry skin. Would recommend & will repurchase.

product_name: Adaptogen Deep Moisturizing Cream with Ashwagandha + Reishi
review_text: I was super skeptical about this and didn’t really care for its strange fragrance. After using it every day as my day time moisturizer I absolutely love it. Doesn’t not break out my oily combo skin and my skin looks and feels refreshed.
This is a PHENOMENAL facial cleanser. A little goes a long way, very gentle on my eczema prone skin, doesn’t have any fragrances or dyes which is also a plus! Highly recommended!

product_name: Brumisateur Natural Mineral Water Facial Spray Travel Duo
review_text: I love these little Evian facial sprays. They are great to use while on a run or anywhere when you need a refreshing break.

I love this cleanser because it is so refreshing and cooling to put on my skin. The first time I tried it I was so impressed by how clean my skin felt because it wasn’t harsh like other cleansers. The smell took me a while to get used to but now it doesn’t bother me. It’s the perfect morning cleanser and it’s great for those who want to double cleanse with something that isn’t too harsh. I rarely repeat buy products because I’m always changing my skincare routine, but I have bought this multiple times and will continue to use it. Highly recommend!!!

I received this product as a sample on a VoxBox from Influenster’s and it is amaxing. It scrubs ans exfoliates without making my skin feel rough and no breakouts! It Smells very nice and it is really easy to apply and remove. Great product
It’s not any better than any other cleanser. It really stinks and makes your face smell bad. I don’t like it and I don’t recommend it.

This is a very nice moisturizer. I’ve been using it in areas where I have large pores to test the “poreless“ aspect and my pores have been looking amazing! A nice lightweight moisturizer that sinks in easily and leaves my skin super soft! I have dry skin, so I use a heavier moisturizer over top and it lays nicely over this product! I have also my makeup going on smoother as well.  I really like this! I received this product complimentary in exchange for review.

product_name: Lip Sleeping Mask Intense Hydration with Vitamin C
review_text: When I wear long-wearing lip stains it tends to make my lips peel. Using this every night stops that. One pot will last you a year or more. It’s worth it.

product_name: Green Clean Makeup Removing Cleansing Balm
review_text: Omg, the product just sink in to your skin and melt away the make up so freaking good!

product_name: D-Bronzi Anti-Pollution Bronzing Drops with Peptides
review_text: I purchased this to cover up the white cast of my mineral sunscreen. Within one use I had a deep breakout. A good reminder to trust what you know about your own skin. The marketing and hype got me. For me, rubbing a colored oil into my skin = breakout.

I absolutely love this! I wish I had founded sooner. It works for me and I wear it daily. I have sensitive skin and mild rosacea plus tons of allergies. It makes my suple and glowing without looking oily. I pour a few drops and warm it with my hands and then massage it all over my face, neck and décolletage. I don’t wear foundation because my face is darker than my neck and I am just not good at the whole makeup game. But I am trying to add skincare now that I am in my 40’s. I loveeee this and highly recommend it!

product_name: Drink Up Intensive Overnight Hydrating Mask with Avocado & Swiss Glacier Water
review_text: This has been the ultimate skin saver this winter! My face is usually on the dryer side, but becomes extremely dehydrated in the winter. I bought a $4 pod to try out and fell in love with this in just 2 days! It smells amazing too!!! I put this on right before bed time and wake up with fresh, hydrated skin. A little goes a long way, so don’t slather this on or it might feel sticky on your pillow like other reviewers said. If your skin is dehydrated, get this and receive a miracle!
I think thid product helps control my oily skin but i have noticed more sudden breakouts so i may need to adjust ny regimen to maybe the acne solutions.
I’ve used it for months now and I notice no difference. I think it is too late to get my money back though :( oh well, lesson learned

product_name: Advanced Retinol + Ferulic Texture Renewal Serum
review_text: I usually use this serum at night, only once a day. Because it contains retinol, I need to use it cautiously to build tolerance for my skin. After using it for a few days, I feel pretty good. I hope to see the effect of removing fine lines and shrinking pores as soon as possible.

I have been suffering with my adult acne for a couple of months. I thought I was going to be stuck with these bursts of acne forever, but I tried this lotion and it has transformed my skin miraculously! The large acne cysts died within a couple of days and the smaller ones disappeared overnight. I love this face lotion and I’m going to try her other products!
Can’t ever be too far from this lip moisturizer!

After I turned 20, my once flawless skin broke out like crazy. My skin no longer responded to ingredients that used to be so effective (benzoyl peroxide, salicylic acid, etc.) so I decided to try out niacinamide serum. This product has helped my skin ALOT when you consider the price. Breakouts still happen, but are less frequent and intense. Pimples are WAY smaller and heal faster. I can’t speak to it’s effect on oil production, as I have normal-dry skin. It applies nicely and adds an extra layer of hydration. My acne left my cheeks full of PIE (different than PIH) and this is slowly helping to heal it. Bottom line-If you’re looking for a product to stop acne in the first place, this isn’t it. But it is an effective step to add in your skincare routine if you are struggling with acne. When I run out or forget to use, my skin noticeably worsens. ***FYI-some people’s skin doesn’t react well with niacinamide, so if this breaks you out,etc. thats probably why.
This product was definitely not for me I broke out so bad I thought I was back in my high school days and left my face feeling so dry
your face will feel like a baby’s butt afterwards

I was looking for something that could cut my makeup removal and face washing down to one step so I decided to give this a shot. It definitely washed all my makeup off (made sure afterwards with a makeup wipe) but as a face wash I wasn’t crazy about it. It dried out my skin quite a bit after using it for a couple weeks and made the texture of my skin very rough. I switched back to my original face wash and since then my skin has become more smooth so I’m sure it was the face wash. I know it has good reviews so I’m sure it’s just a skin type thing! If you have more dry skin than oily I would be cautious though!

I can’t be without this toner! I have extremely sensitive skin (anything and everything breaks me out) and I’m prone to hyperpigmentation because I’m very fair too. Basically I’m always broken out OR I look like I’m broken out. This stuff transforms my skin like nothing else. It doesn’t break me out, helps to heal my break outs faster, AND it tackles the hyperpigmentation too. I’ve tried other products in this category (when this product is sold out) and none of them hold up like this one. It is powerful stuff though, so when I use it regularly it has a very slight stinging sensation, but when I haven’t used it for a bit it’s even stronger. I love this stuff though. I’ve purchased more than 5 and I will continue purchasing for the foreseeable future. It’s the best value for the best product.
Really impress bu this product. It really makes my skin glow and works actually more then my Dior cream. The only thing would be that it leaves my skin a little sticky after I use it

Used this for about 2 months now, threw it away today. It’s decent for a balm, but the smell became nauseating after awhile. I don’t feel like it’s worth the price but it does feel nice on the lips and is averagely hydrating. Just doesn’t last very long-it’s not a gloss so don’t expect it to be long lasting and thick. Have to reapply every 30 mins or so if you want the shine to stay
I think it’s wonderful and not too powerful! I got this Sunday so after a week or two I’ll be able to see if it helped my acne and wrinkles.

There are a few things that make my evenings even better like a good hydrating face mask. I’ve been really enjoying the @summerfridays Jet Lag face mask, it gives me the nicest glow after using it. I heard that some people use it as a face moisturiser as well. Haven’t tried it tho as I’m not sure how I feel about that. Also a lovely smelling candle always make my mood better, smells absolutely amazing!
absolutely love this product so much!!!! Will be buying this product again. it makes my face look and feel so glowyI really want to try more of the glow recipe products!!

product_name: Vitamin C Dark Circle Correcting Eye Serum
review_text: Due to having a toddler at home, I have major dark circles - Vita-C Dark Circle Color Corrector helped them dramatically. Will forever sing its praises to family and friends.
This wasn’t anything special in my opinion. I don’t think this did anything too special for my skin. I don’t think I would repurchase this.
The product does do what it says, the only down fell is that you have to apply a lot of pressure on your face to get it to work, which is hard to do on your t-zone! It smells like Xmas!

product_name: Umbra Tinte Physical Daily Defense SPF 30
review_text: I’m a DE junkie and like that this is a physical blocker (reason for the 2 stars), but I can’t continue to use this product. It doesn’t leave a white cast like the regular Umbra, but they both have the same problems. This new formulation pills. I exfoliate and moisturize and mix with B-Hydra and Lala, but it pills no matter what. And especially if I dare to put any makeup on it. It’s also needlessly non-vegan? Weird. The Tinte version also makes me super oily when other sunscreens do not, even when I am very dry. I found a different physical sunscreen that is vegan, does not pill at all, doesn’t make me oily, and does not leave a white cast though it is not tinted. I’d keep looking, sadly. Hopefully DE will try another reformulation.

product_name: Ultimate Sun Protector Lotion SPF 50+ Sunscreen
review_text: I love this SPF! It is nude and penetrates the skin without leaving a residue or clogging my pores. A little goes a long way and I feel the coverage without feeling greasy.

I love how hydrating this new glow recipe product is! It definitely doesn’t apply thick at all and it doesn’t cause my face to break out or appear oily throughout the day. I’m always a fan of glow recipe products!

product_name: Pimple Paste Overnight Blemish Drying Paste
review_text: This pimple paste really saved my skin, I’ve been having problems with my skin lately and active acne was always my biggest struggle to get rid of. This product really speeds up the process without causing scarring on my face!

product_name: FILLING GOOD hyaluronic acid plumping serum
review_text: I received this product complementary from Farmacy, and this is a pretty promising hyaluronic acid serum! This contains both HA as well as their proprietary honey blend, thyme extract, and peptides. It has a rather viscous consistency, but sinks into the skin pretty quickly. I like to use this after a hydrating toner, and I found that my skin looks nice and healthy afterwards! I haven’t noticed any skin plumping benefits though, but there was no irritation, which was a plus. I would suggest not using too many pumps of this product as it may pill with more than 1-2 pumps. There’s a honey scent that’s shared among their honey line, which didn’t bother me but was definitely noticeable! Overall, a pretty good but not outstanding HA serum. This may be more suitable for drier skin types, but my oily/combo skin drank this up as well!
It’s a super rich and thick moisturizer. I thought I could get used to the smell but it’s too much for me. In terms of efficacy, it definitely hydrates and gives you a glow.
review_title: Still recommend but not for me

product_name: Mini Yo Glow AHA & BHA Facial Enzyme Scrub
review_text: While it is an okay exfoliant, the product clumps up immediately upon use which makes you feel like it is taking off a lot dead skin...but it isn’t. So, it feels like a misleading sensation. I didn’t notice any real different than using, for example, maybe Simple or other drugstore brands. I just feel like you should be getting more bang for your buck.

I received this product free to test out and review from TopBox. I’ve loved the Laneige lip mask for a really long time and this has just replaced it! It does wonders for your lips and it’s packaged in a nice squeezy tube which I prefer much more than the lip mask that comes in a little pot. The balm is super moisturizing and smells really yummy (but it’s not overpowering) and looks glossy and really nice on the lips!

I have tried the Inkey List Hydrating Serum. This has proven a nice effect on my skin. I like this serum. It’s a nice addition to my skincare routine. It doesn’t leave my skin sticky and my skin is still softer and plumper the next day. It isn’t my favorite smell but also not the worst.
Good product, I find it identical to the Ordinary version. the bottle for this is so annoying. it lets too much product out and gets crusty immediately.

product_name: The POREfessional Smooth Sip Lightweight Gel-Cream Moisturizer
review_text: I like this by itself, but I got to say that I loved the original moisturizer so much better. I felt like it just dinked into my skin better. This one is still ok but it’s not my favorite but it does sit good under makeup
I love this moisturizer! It’s very moisturizing but isn’t too heavy.

I suffer from very oily skin with acne in my T-zone. I was really hoping this would help but it didn’t do much. Any large acne I had would reduce a little but then throughout the day it would just go back to how it was before. I applied this in both the morning and the evening and still nothing. It has a very strong smell so I wouldn’t recommend it to people with sensitive skin.
Extremely rich and moisturizing cream. I love this on days where the corners of my nose or mouth are dry in the winter and a little really goes a long way!

I have used this product for several days now, and while I haven’t noticed an immediate change in my skin, I love the way my skin feels now. The product does make my skin tingle when using it, so I have been a little less frequently until my skin gets used to it. Please make sure to use sunscreen in the day time- this makes your skin more sensitive than usual to the sun.

product_name: Estee Lauder Advanced Night Repair Synchronized Multi-Recovery Complex Serum
review_text: LOVE the feel of this serum, but given the sample size it’s hard to see any results.

I loved the smell and feel of this cleanser but ultimately it ended up being too drying for my skin. It definitely made my skin feel clean but also felt like it stripped away a lot. Maybe better for someone with oily or normal skin

Love how convenient this sunscreen stick is for touching up your spf on the go. And I use it on my 4 yr old without any complaints from him, which is definitely a win for me. I received this complementary product in exchange for my honest review.

product_name: Squalane + Omega Repair Deep Hydration Moisturizer
review_text: Super moisturizing! It’s expensive but it’s totally worth the money. A little goes a long way.

I received this product complimentary from Influenster for for testing purposes. I tried to give this product a few weeks before writing a review. I have extremely dry and sensitive skin.  The first time using this, I used at night after washing my face. I did use the liquid collagen as well. I found the texture to be surprising, it was much thicker than anticipated. There was little to no fragrance, which I appreciate. Both products went on very easy. A little goes a long way! Within a week, I noticed a significant difference in my skin. It wasn’t dry and flaky and my fine lines and wrinkles appeared less prominent. I would recommend this product.
Love the Korres Probiotic Gel-Cream. Leaves my face feeling refreshed and hydrated without making it feel greasy. This product is great for all types of skin.

product_name: Green Clean Makeup Removing Cleansing Balm
review_text: I always double cleanse and this stuff takes off EVERYTHING! and smells AMAZING!!!!

I love this facial essence and won’t do without it.  Have been using it for a year.  Am 57 and my skin definitely looks better and feels better since I have been using it.  Clearer, brighter, more even-toned, smoother, and wrinkles no longer look startling and unattractive, but just look like expectable aging, if that makes any sense.   And wrinkling process seems arrested.   I used this  also as a refresher as it feels so good.  I don’t like the SK2 moisturizer.   I this facial essence with DE Protini Moisurizer, SR Tidal Water Brightening Enzyme Moisturizer, or Tatcha Water Cream Moisturizer (ie sometimes all three moisturizers at the same time), just as an FYI.  I put the SK2 facial essence all over my face, eyes, neck, chest and chest.  I often mix it with my moisturizers and eye cream.  It’s a great pick-me-up at work mixed with a little moisturizer.   Obviously, I live the stuff.   I usually don’t write reviews, but I love the feedback that I get from reviews, so I wanted to write one for this facial essence.   Obviously it’s EXPENSIVE, but periodically Sephora allows me to use 2,500 rewards points to get $100 off of the largest “value” size.   Or I wait until the 20% off sale to purchase the largest value size.

product_name: Smart Clinical Repair Wrinkle Correcting Cream
review_text: I received this from topbox circle for testing purposes I received a tiny sample to try I really love it it feels good on my skin i would recommend it to you to try it
review_title: Smart Clinical Repair Wrinkle Correcting Cream

review_text: It taste like orange juice but a little grainy but for the amount of benefit for the skin its a win win! gave me enough energy works like a coffee.i received this for free from influenster

I tried this cream to try and help hydrate my dry skin, I was pleasantly surprised by how well it worked. With the summer heat my skin had been feeling parched and this cream hydrated without the thick greasy feel other creams give. I used it after a sunburn I got too and it took away the sting and helped keep me from peeling. I would definitely recommend for someone looking for a lightweight cream that doesn’t have a lot of scent or heavy feeling.

Pricey but worth it. I am almost 28 & new to retinol & I was pleased with this when paired with a few other products I have been trying. I am hoping to prevent wrinkles but without purging or peeling to deal with & this does the trick. I avoid where my rosacea is worst to make sure I don’t irritate it too much.

product_name: B-Hydra Intensive Hydration Serum with Hyaluronic Acid
review_text: Could not live without. A glass of water for your skin. Very light feeling

product_name: Honey Whip Peptide and Collagen Moisturizer
review_text: I loveeee this product, it is super airy and feels good on skin. It might tingle a bit but it will go away in minutes. I feel smoother skin already. I have super sensitive dry skin and this is my new holy grail

I’ve heard a lot about the Shiseido Facial Cotton as being the top tier facial cotton you could ever treat your face to. But I balked at buying it because I figured it would be really expensive to buy. But after seeing it in the travel size section on the way to the register for only $5, I figured it was worth a try. I’m so used to using the rather rougher (but cheaper) cotton pads on my face, so I wasn’t sure what to expect until I finally decided to try it out after running out of my go-to cotton pads. I was floored - the cotton is just unbelievably soft - much softer than any of the softest makeup brush I currently own. I had to do a double take because the fact that Shiseido was willing to sell a travel size version of this for only $5? And I expected Shiseido to charge more since they’re more on the department store tier of brands. Simply put, this is one of those things where you just have to try at least once in your life - even if you never buy it again.

product_name: Lip Sleeping Mask Intense Hydration with Vitamin C
review_text: I love this for my lips and use it a few times a day. I somehow lost the little spatula that came with it so now I have to stick my finger in there (which I hate). Reviewing products for a living, I see A LOT of cleansers & products that make a lot of claims, some filled with sugar plum fairies & the fountain of youth unlocked in a bottle. And having tried Tatcha’s previous cleansers, I would be lying if I said I wasn’t planning for more of the same. With that said...THIS BLEW ME AWAY! In all my years, in all the cleansers I have tried, I have NEVER been this impressed by a face wash. When I test a cleanser, I test & look for a few things:1) I perform what I call the residual test. After trying the new cleanser I use a toner on a white cloth to see if there’s any residue or dirt left behind. There was absolutely nothing left with this one. (Which is a rarity in of itself.) 2) The first day I use it and several days after, I use a skin moisture & oil detector to see if my skin becomes excessively oily after use, (& I continue testing up to 12 hrs after) as well to see if my skin becomes too dry, or if it holds moisture and/or has more moisture then it normally does. After several tests, for several days, on both my skin & my fiancé’s (Because he is in love with this as well.) BOTH of our oil levels had decreased even throughout the day compared to what they normally are, but our moisture levels had significantly increased vs other cleansers used, and our baseline readings. This was the only product my fiancé used for the day, & the only product I changed in my normal skincare routine. 3) I look at how my skin feels after using up to the 24 hr mark. Did I have any dry patches? No. Did I feel oily? No. Did my skin feel more hydrated? Yes. Did my makeup apply easily after using? Yes. Did my skin seem more textured then usual? No. Blotchy? No. Reactions or redness? None. (I am super sensitive to skincare products, but my fiancé is super sensitive. A lot of products break him out on his chin. This one did not.) Tatcha...you put your foot in this one babes. Our faces have never felt so amazing. Thanks.

I use DE skin care products exclusively. I followed the instructions meticulously with this product and I even stuck it out through the side effects because everything I read sounded like these would eventually subside if I was patient. I worked up from once per week to twice per week and then to every other night by the 12 week mark. I was getting breakouts on my chin that are not normal for me. Like I said, I stuck it out. Around week 16 I dropped it back to twice a week. I’m at week 19 now and I have another awful breakout on my chin. My chin has never been completely clear since starting this product. If you work it for a while with enough water you get a little more milky foam than otherwise. This leaves my skin calm and happy. It doesn’t remove waterproof mascara, but otherwise it does well with my makeup (I use a liquid mineral makeup by Illuminare). When I open a new bottle I notice more of the cucumber-like fragrance, but that seems to dissipate after a week or so. For years I had trouble finding a cleanser that didn’t eventually give me weird flaky skin and red patches, even after trying the recommended super gentle ones. I finally read about pH-level, and how cleansers with a lower PH level don’t disturb the skin’s natural barrier as much as those with a higher level. This cleanser has a lower pH than many of them (around 5.5), which may be why it agrees with my skin. It also doesn’t cause any product irritation breakouts, which is common for me with most other products.Another huge plus is the smaller size tube that fits the guidelines for carry-on travel. I use an exfoliating powder from Good Molecules to remove the dead skin, and rehydrate with my regular routine, and finish off with this. It is now an essential step at night, and during the day to fend off dreaded winter dryness. I no longer have flaky patches all over my face (including my eyelids).
Love it! No fragrance, Easy to foam, Move makeup thoroughly, and never feel dry after use. Most importantly, its great price!

product_name: Good Genes All-In-One AHA Lactic Acid Treatment
review_text: I was apprehensive about this product, given the cost, but it has completely changed the texture of my skin, pretty much immediately.

Hydration provided by this serum is sufficient (Not great), but what makes this a 2-Star instead of a 3- or 4-Star is that the serum dries HORRIBLY. It leaves a sticky, cakey residue behind that sticks to the tiny hairs on my face. Yuck. I guess you get what you pay for.

product_name: Superscreen Daily Moisturizer Sunscreen SPF 40 PA+++
review_text: I love this sunscreen because it just feels like a really good moisturizer instead of sunscreen.  It’s the best.  I wish they would also make it without sunscreen for overnight.

I bought this due to the high ratings but never anticipated that it had the worst smell. It’s very strong and it has a stale unpleasant “medicine“ smell, Works well as a cleanser but I couldn’t get past the stench and I’m very tolerant of smells in makeup, cleansers, etc.

product_name: Rose & Squalane Deep Hydration Oil-Infused Serum
review_text: This product comes with luxurious packaging and aesthetic quality.  The glass bottle feels expensive and the product has the results to bat.  Perfect for all skin types. I received this product complimentary for review purposes.
These are ok. No better than a biore strip, but costs a lot more.

product_name: SEA drink of H2O hydrating boost moisturizer
review_text: I received a sample size of this and am so glad I didn’t purchase it full-size. I have combo skin, so my hydration needs aren’t high. First, I cannot stand the smell. It smells like old-school Noxema from the 80s and 90s. This stays sticky and doesn’t seem to hydrate my skin at all, in fact, it dries out my drier areas even more. It also does not play well with makeup. I also suspect it is the cause of the not so lovely pimple on my nose.  Definitely not a fan and will not use the rest of the sample.

product_name: Sugar Recovery Lip Mask Advanced Therapy
review_text: This is my first time trying this lip mask. I put it on and left it over night. It’s nice and thick but not sticky and it has a nice smell to it. I woke up the next morning and my lips felt so soft.

product_name: Squalane + Antioxidant Makeup Removing Cleansing Oil
review_text: First time trying product and it’s stung my eyes and burnt my face I got it returned asap
this is perfect. fixes dry cracked skin in 1-2 days!
Made me break out at first. A little goes a long way but overall a great product that i would recommend for combination skin. Lightly fragranced but overall amazing

product_name: The Deep Cleanse Gentle Exfoliating Cleanser
review_text: ive been using this cleanser for almost two years and i have to say its an amazing product. i have rosacea so my skin is very red and sensitive, this is very calming and soothing while also giving you a pretty deep cleanse. it is a little on the pricier side but it also lasts me over 9 months (i wash my face twice a day everyday) you only need a pea size amount cause a little goes a long way so for the price i think is ok.

product_name: Lip Sleeping Mask Intense Hydration with Vitamin C
review_text: If I’m being honest, I was disappointed. I was expecting more based on what I heard about it. Yes it was nice while it was on, but as for moisturizing and healing, my lips felt no different when I woke up in the morning after having it on all night. I used up the whole container and didn’t find it ever did anything for me. I have simple lip balms that make my lips feel way better! I wanted to love it :(

Loved this! Definitely a must have in your daily skin routine. I used this morning and night. Its very moisturizing without looking greasy. After a couple of weeks i started noticing my skin looking younger and smoother
Pretty decent. However I prefer a more chemical free facial product.
So easy to use! I added it to my morning moisturizing routine. It’s so natural and customizable it’s REVOLUTIONARY! More user friendly than any foam/lotion I’ve ever used.

product_name: Beauty Elixir Prep, Set, Glow Face Mist
review_text: I use this everyday, morning and night. Lost count of how many bottles i’ve repurchased. This helps alot with preventing maskacne and calms my skin down when its irritated. My husband was sunburnt at one point and I used this on his irritated skin and it was also very soothing for him.
Received a sample of this. Really weird smell…not my cup of tea.

I’ve been using this for 6 months now as a night creme and I LOVE it. I love the smell, I love the way it brightens my face and I love the way it hydrates me. My skin is very dry and feels so moist and refreshed every morning. It’s the perfect night cream, now to find the perfect day cream for my dry/flaky day skin.....

If i could give this zero stars I would :(i wanted this to work, i was so excited. everyone has left such amazing reviews and heard so much good about it. i liked the smell.but it broke me out the worst ive ever been in my entire life. i used it for a couple of days .i normally get a couple of pimples here and there but this is just a whole nother level. i have never experienced my ENTIRE face being completely blanketed with whiteheads, blackheads, pimples, red spots, bumps - the whole shabang. in ever area - even places where i have never broken out before. i honestly considered seeing a doctor i was/am really concerned.i don’t know how long i have to wait for all of these pimples to go away nowdo not recommend! im sorry!please beware :(
review_title: The worst breakout of my entire life

product_name: Squalane + Vitamin C Rose Firming Oil
review_text: I can’t believe I didn’t buy this sooner. This is magical. My skin was so dry that i couldnt even put foundation on even though i primed my skin with 5 layers of moisturizer and primer but my skin is so soft omg. Trust me. I’ve tried a ton of oil and this is the only one that shows result after 1 night.

This moisturizer does exactly what it claims to do: mattifies, reduces the look of pores and It makes my skin sooo soft! I personally use this moisturizer as a night cream, and it really does help reduce my oiliness overnight. I’ve had way less breakouts, my pores have shrunk, and I found myself having less whiteheads around my nose and chin! I also use to have these annoying white bumps on my cheeks that have completely vanished since I started using this! I also appreciate it being fragrance free, oil free and cruelty free. You really can’t beat this, it’s worth the price and I 100% recommend it for combination sensitive skin! P.S. I use the Coconut Water Cream from FAB as a morning moisturizer, First Aid Beauty has the best skincare products!

Mix this with my Drunk Elephant jelly cleanser for extra scrub and grim removal. I wish I could use alone but it dries me out a little although it is marketed as gentle and soft after use. I love how it smells and it has become a part of my daily routine.

Purchased this product for my husband at Christmas and he loves it - especially because it does not bother his eyes the way that other moisturizing products do such as Neu******* However is already asking me to purchase another bottle so not sure if he is using too much or that it takes a lot to moisturize -- so will see if it garners a better rating after prolonged usage
review_title: Josie Maran Argan Oil - Initial purchase

review_text: I use a plethora of glow recipe products, from their cleanser to their serums, toner and even creams. I have never felt so let down by a product. No matter what moisturizer I use under this (a gel or lotion) this sunscreen pills. My entire face is covered in white pilling spots. The sunscreen smells nice and feels fine but it is completely unusable.

I was apprehensive trying out this product because I have a clarisonic and lived by it. I decided to try this cleanser because my skin gets SO dry in the winter months. It has changed my LIFE. It feels great on the skin, doesn’t make me oily at all, and it saves time because I no longer use my clarisonic. My skin is the best it’s been and it is so smooth. I don’t know what the summer time will bring, I may go back to my clarisonic and the oil may be too much, but so far I would absolutely repurchase this.
It smells amazing ! I love it ..definitely buying it again.

Absolutely love this moisturizer. As a woman who suffers from dry skin this is the best thing I have ever tried! It was sent to be complimentary from Influenster, and I am so happy! It smells amazing and leaves my face feeling so soft and moisturizer. I will definitely be buying more of this! Such a hit!
I got this as a gift from my husband and I love this oil it makes my skin so soft and I am seeing my dark marks getting a little lighter over all I am seeing improvement on my skin.

Loved waking up to softer skin! Going to sleep with Dewtopia on my face, it was a little sticky! But the results of softer skin, a smoother appearance, along with dark spots literally being erased felt amazing! The smell is a light lemony scent, not overwhelming! Love the consistency and thickness of the gel.
review_title: Would definitely use to help overall appearance!

review_text: Refreshing on the skin and love the clean scent. It doesn’t leave an over-dried feeling, but rather a more “awake“ feeling. I highly recommend for anyone that wants a no-fuss cleanser that’s good for your skin.

product_name: The Dewy Skin Cream Plumping & Hydrating Moisturizer
review_text: Hate it. It’s like butter on my face. Don’t get absorbed. Such a waste of money

I have oily-combo skin, and have really enjoyed using this. I just finished my first tube and will be buying another. You really get a lot of bang for your buck. It leaves my face feeling clean but not stripped. Would highly recommend for the price point. Note: I find this is a hit or miss product. Some people swear by it, some say it did nothing for them. Get a sample!

I hate that i even have to give this 1 star. The worst product Ive ever tried! I have combination skin and it broke me out so bad! Really wanted to like this but its awful. It feels like creamy grease on your skin. Doesnt absorb at all. Just a slick tacky mess.

I struggle with hyperpigmentation and my face is covered in dark spots from acne. After reading positive reviews about this product, I thought I had finally found something that could minimize the appearance of my hyperpigmentation, but alas, it did nothing. I applied it in the morning and night after cleansing and toning my face, as per my skin care regimen. Over a month has passed and I see no visible difference in my skin. I might as well have not used the product at all. Overall, I’m disappointed. It was a waste of money, but I’m happy I didn’t pay too much for it. I will not be using this product again.

product_name: Rose & Hyaluronic Acid Deep Hydration Moisturizer
review_text: i was surprised by the scent of the cream. its very minimal and has the slightest hint of rose. it feels so nice on the skin, becauseit containsIsostearyl Isostearate, the ingredientthat can possibly clog your pores and lead to breakouts. the product description claims that the cream suits normal, oily, combo, dry skin. However if you have oily skin, I wont recommendit, because of the ingredient that I mentioned above. There isSodium Hyaluronate instead of HA and its on the very down on the ingredient list, so it will be in the lowest percentage.
review_title: feel nice, but beware of Isostearyl Isostearate

review_text: I love this stuff. It works great if you’re dry. I put it on in the night and the next morning my skin is so soft!!!

This exfoliating face wash truly can be used everyday! It’s very gentle and the more water you add, the more gentle it becomes. I love the texture of it! I have pretty dry, sensitive skin and this did not dry or agitate it. It smells great and leaves skin feeling soft and smooth. I’ve been on the search for a good exfoliating face wash and I could see myself purchasing a full size of this product after using the complimentary sample I received for review purposes.
Love this product.  So glad it was available.  I was on the “waiting list“ and thought it would never happen.  Really refreshing and cleansing.

I have good results with this product, not perfect but noticeable. But I can’t wear it as a night cream a lot of the time. The smell (spoiled milk?) bothers me too much. Sometimes I use it as a mask and wash it off but I worry I am not getting the full benefits and for the price...?

Light moisturizer that feels good on my oily skin.  It feels radiant, light and clean.  I’m in my 40s and still have acne.  I feel great using this moisturizer on top of my acne serum products.  It’s refreshing !  I use it in the morning with my spf and at night with serum.
review_title: Moisturizer that feels radiant and refreshing

review_text: Sits on skin; doesn’t absorb. Skin looks and feels dry, with a layer of oil on top. Oil seems pure; is not irritating.

product_name: Mini Glowscreen Sunscreen SPF 40 PA+++ with Hyaluronic Acid + Niacinamide
review_text: Unfortunately this sun screen made me break out like crazy! I really wanted to love it and it gives a beautiful glow but if you have sensitive or oily skin it will probably make you break out.

product_name: Smart Clinical Repair Wrinkle Correcting Serum
review_text: I found this serum left my skin hydrated, smooth and velvety. I’ve only tried it a few times but it seems to minimize and fill in my fine lines. I  did notice some pilling when I apply at night, so I may need to apply my facial products in a different order. Overall, I did like and do recommend it!

product_name: Volcanic AHA Pore Clearing Clay Mask
review_text: I’ve been using this for about two weeks now and I am in love. Really smoothed my skin out, super soft. I hope to see more benefits in the future weeks to come with continued use!

I absolutely love this gentle cleanser. Texture is so lightweight it feels like cloud. My skin looks clean, feels very hydrated and soft. It cleanses my skin very effective without stripping it. I love that it’s safe for sensitive skin

I absolutely love the Dermalogica’s Daily Microfoliant Exfoliator I received complimentary from Dermalogica. It is super easy to use and gentle enough to use daily! I love the way my face feels and looks after using it. It helps get rid of dull skin leaving your face soft, brightened and evens out skin tone as well. It gets all of the dirt and excess oil out, leaving my skin refreshed and my pores even look smaller. It has become one of my favorite exfoliants.

This product arrived broken unfortunately but it smelt great. I love the packaging as it is also a great display to guest when they stop by. The gems alone bring all to the party but the refillable pods make it so much more interesting.

product_name: Watermelon Glow PHA + BHA Pore-Tight Toner
review_text: Glow Recipe can seriously do no wrong!!! This toner is absolutely amazing. It’s so hydrating and helps exfoliate and smooth my skin. I love using this at night along with their plum products for extra hydration

product_name: Lip Sleeping Mask Intense Hydration with Vitamin C
review_text: Love this lip mask. I use it daily and at night.The product has lasted me really long time and helps keep my lips moisturized throughout the year.

product_name: Mini Ultra Facial Moisturizing Cream with Squalane
review_text: Ultra hydrating cream that works beautifully on my combination skin. Feels thick, but not at all heavy on skin & absorbs quickly. Skin stays hydrated all day long!!!! Definite game changer in my beauty routine!

My skin stayed about the same with this cleanser. It froths well, has no scent, was gentle enough for my sensitive skin, and feels clean. But at the end of the day, ya girl still had plenty of acne to go around (the normal amount). Bar was smaller than I expected (aka a traditional bar size). For the price / size, I’ll try other bars rather than re-purchase this one

product_name: DERMAPORE Ultrasonic Pore Extractor & Serum Infuser
review_text: I recieved this product maybe one week ago and it has already made a huge difference in my life! I struggle with persistent mild/moderate pimples, black heads, and oiliness as well as a skin picking disorder and I bought this to use it as a way to prevent there from being anything I can pick at in my skin. I was blown away by the first use, it cleaned out some really congested pores and left my skin feeling even and soft. I used it again 3 days later and way less gunk came out than the first time and again my skin has less blemishes and is feeling soft! I read lots of reviews and watched videos before buying so I already had an idea of the technique to use, but I definitely started pushing way too hard and had to adjust. Even with a lighter hand my skin will look red and irritated after using so I’ll continues to use it as part of my nighttime routine on days I need it.

Okay I literally love this mask!!! It smells so good and it’s not grainy like some clay masks are. You don’t need much to do your whole face because you have to run it in anyways so one pump will do your whole face!! When you first put it on it stings a little bit but besides that I absolutely LOVE it!!! I’ve only used it twice and after the second time my pores are almost completely gone!!! And you only have to do it once or twice a week!! Besides the little bit of stinging when you first put it on which is pretty much the only thing I can find wrong with it I give it a 10/10!!!! And DEFINITELY recommend this mask to people with larger pores!!!

product_name: Mini Crème de la Mer Moisturizer
review_text: This creme is all that and a bag of chips! I had some sun burn coz of working outside in the hot sun, I bought and started applying night and day...it has really cleared my skin up. My skin tone is evening up. I have oily skin and it doesn’t make me feel oily. Highly recommended!
review_title: All that and a bag of chips!

product_name: Daily UV Defense Invisible Broad Spectrum SPF 36 Sunscreen
review_text: My favorite sunscreen! I used to use La Roche Posays Anthelios and this one is now my go to. I do prefer La Roche’s kind of satin finish because I prefer a matte as possible without looking dry kind of gal, but I don’t mind the slight glow this sunscreen gives me. Easy to apply and blend and it smells just a litttttttttttttttttle bit like Diet Coke so I’m always smelling and dreaming of soda while applying my protection. I love the price of this one too. I use it daily and I still haven’t finished my first bottle. I’ve already purchased a backup!

product_name: Alpha Beta Extra Strength Daily Peel Pads
review_text: Wow, not what I expected.  I received 3 samples from PinchMe and was impressed.  After three days of use; my face was clearer and shiny.
As mentioned, it is a ‘moisturizing bomb’ . My skin felt amazing. It’s definitely very very hydrating. It’s a great travel size product. So this one’s definitely going on my travel pouch.

This product is not moisturizing enough for my dry skin, but I love it for mixing in with my foundation to create my own tinted moisturizer. It melt right into the foundation and looks seem less. This will forever be in my collection!
review_title: Great for mixing in with foundations

product_name: Blue Tansy BHA and Enzyme Pore Refining Mask
review_text: Well it’s been a while since I last did a review. But wow! This mask gave me instant results. (very few products I’ve tried give me instant results; hence the slow replies since I actually try before I review). So I wanted a AHA/BHA because of my blackheads (nose) and KP on sides of face. I left this on for 20 minutes and it didn’t burn/tingle on my sensitive skin. The smell is strong. Almost like a mix of Vicks Vapor Rub and Apple Cider Vinegar. The colour is beautiful in the jar but a bit translucent when you put it on your face. The first time I think I put too little, the second time I was more generous. And I don’t feel guilty being generous since this product is $46/Cnd. It’s only 2.3oz but the bottle is filled, almost overflowing (be carefully when you open as it’s on the top of the lid as well). The second day I used it (says to use 3-4 days in a row and then reduce to a few times a week) I felt a cooling sensation but again, I put a lot more product on my face.So after I removed the mask with a warm cloth I started my “extractions“. I have never had an easier time extracting in my life! & to top it off they didn’t hurt extracting. Usually the kertosis pilaris on the sides of my face are so far down in the skin that I need a needle to lance them out but not this time.If you want a product that will help you DEEP CLEAN your pores you need this in your life! I’m going to try other products in their line and hope they are as amazing as this mask.

product_name: Lip Sleeping Mask Intense Hydration with Vitamin C
review_text: Literally amazing! If you think spending $20 on just a lip mask is too much money, this one is definitely worth it!! I was very suspicious of this product because I wasn’t totally willing to spend so much money on a sort of lip balm but it has helped my lips so much every night. Totally recommend this, made my lips soft and supple for sure!
Great cleanser to remove makeup from my face. Foams up real nice into a lather.

With my sensitive skin I was afraid of being stripped, but it was not stripping at all. I do however use an remover balm before using, so I do not know how well it removes makeup. But my skin isn’t tight and dry feeling.

product_name: Ready Steady Glow Daily AHA Tonic
review_text: I received this product to try.  I was pleasantly surprised at how much I liked this.  It had a nice, light scent.  I used it twice a day and can tell the difference.  I will continue to use this product.
I had a hard time finding a good cleansear and received this as a sample. I am hooked!

product_name: Daily UV Defense Invisible Broad Spectrum SPF 36 Sunscreen
review_text: My face is a perfect combo: oily t-zone, dry cheeks. Some sunscreens have been way too matte and made the dryness worse, and some have been way too oily and made me look like an oil slick. But this one is like adding a moisturizer! I’ve even added after my moisturizer AND a facial oil, and everything just blends together! Also, this one doesn’t make my eyes burn like most sunscreens do. Highly recommended!
review_title: I understand why it’s sold out!

product_name: Superfood Air-Whip Lightweight Moisturizer with Hyaluronic Acid
review_text: This smells really gree, i wouldn’t say i like it but i don’t dislike it either. Its not an intense scent so even if you dont like it you can get over it. I have combination skin. So far im loving this as a morning and might moisturizer. Its light on the skin and doesn’t leave me shiny. It’s great for a morning moisturizer. On my dry days i use a more heavy duty moisturizer at night because i don’t think this would cut it for dry skin. On normal days this is all i need and it makes me feel like im nourishing my skin and making it super healthy.

product_name: C.E.O Glow Vitamin C + Turmeric Face Oil
review_text: Received this oil in my allure beauty box and have been obsessed with it ever since. I’m not all about the hype with the glow (I don’t feel particularly more glowy than usual), but I do genuinely notice that it’s clearing up my dark spots and keeps me moisturized (now that I’ve figured out when to put it on in my routine: cleanse->exfoliate 2xweek->tone-> serum -> CEO Glow oil->moisturizer). I literally use the tiniest drop for my whole face and pat with my hands before going to town with a jade roller. It’s my favorite step of my routine and once my bottle runs out (which I don’t think will be for months), I’ll definitely repurchase. I actually find the smell quite pleasant and the consistency is very spreadable/absorbent. I’ve been using it twice daily for a month and a half now.

product_name: Calendula Deep Clean Foaming Face Wash
review_text: I have acne and unfortunately this wash did not help or worsen my skin. It was a bit overdrying as well. Gave it 3 starts because my boyfriend loved it and he does not use face wash but does now. Figures. He does not have acne and it did not make him breakout or overdry his skin. Worked well for him.

product_name: Dewy Glow Moisturizer with Cherry Blossom & Niacinamide
review_text: Great light weight but very moisturizing summer face gel! Leaves your face soft like baby skin! Will buy again when I run out!

Love this stuff! Gives me the perfect amount of moisture without being greasy, or disappearing right after application. Perfect for winter, but also light enough for summertime if that makes sense! I keep one in my purse at all times! Love that its unscented too. Also, it lasts forever!
i have gone through bottles and bottles of this stuff. Great for my sensitive skin. Cleans very well, takes all my makeup off.

I’ve been waiting to try this product since I seen Daisy Marquez show on her Snapchat then I seen the price and I was like nope.. then i received it free from Influenster for free in the treat yourself voxbox which I was beyond excited about.. once I applied it to my face it smelt minty and when applied to the face nice and cool feeling.. once washed off let my skin feeling hydrated and glowy definitely worth the hype

product_name: Skin Hydrator Ceramide and Hyaluronic Acid Supplement
review_text: First of all, make sure that you follow directions! I got this complementary skin hydrator to try and I have been pleasantly surprised. I honestly thought that because I have combination skin this wouldn’t work as well as on others with dry skin. I have been taking this skin hydrator supplement for two months now and I have the most radiant glow in my skin. Make sure that you do follow the directions and eat and drink your water.

product_name: 100% Organic Cold-Pressed Rose Hip Seed Oil
review_text: I use this literally on my whole body. Works as a body lotion and is minimizing stretch marks and imperfections, leaves a soft finish and will nourish your skin. Use it as a moisturizer and eye cream and even as a hair mask. If you leave it on for 30 minutes and then wash your hair you will end up with soft hair. I love this brand, affordable and delivers

product_name: The Dewy Skin Cream Plumping & Hydrating Moisturizer
review_text: I’m only leaving this review based on my skin type so it may be good for some, for me gives me beet red hives and I gave it to my mom because I didn’t want to waste the product and she had the same problem...I am sensitive so I thought that was normal but she is not , hopefully I will find some one to give it to but not for oily sensitive skin..I thought it would have been ok because I absolutely love the water cream and was looking for something a little richer when the weather changed and I needed a bit more moisture,unfortunately this wasn’t it , it just sits on top of the skin and afterwards I have a weird dry feeling I’ve never had with any product
Love the smell and texture. I also personally love lemons so this was the perfect scrub. Used 2x/week on my sensitive skin

product_name: T.L.C. Framboos Glycolic Resurfacing Night Serum
review_text: I love this product! It is one of the few skincare products that I continue to repurchase. The price is the only downfall. I love how clear and radiant my skin looks after using this product (I typically use it every other night or a couple times a week). I have naturally dry skin and I don’t find that this makes my skin drier. I rarely break out. Love it!
My skin has been a lot better since I started to use this. I would definitely recommend it.

This product was gifted by Fresh and leaves my lips buttery soft and feels super comfortable on! Great for layering under your lipstick or gloss for the day, OR for a sheer wash of color on the lips. It’s become a staple for my bag!

I love how Milk came out with this new product, it is so gentle on my skin, especially I have sensitive and dry skin. This cleanser is perfect for me. While it washes away the dirt on my skin, it also feels so moisturizing due to the “milk” in this product. I also like the smell of it, it’s not too fragrancy. I just loved it. It leaves my skin feeling smooth and clean. Would buy it after I’m done with it.

I love everything about this range. This new range of products was received free for testing from #influenster and I became obsessed immediately. I like how it just disappears on my skIn and doesn’t make it oily or anything. Orange makes your skin feel refreshed instantly. I have combination skin and I am so happy that it doesn’t make my skin oily after a while, which is my biggest concern otherwise. I absolutely love orange anything so that’s a plus for me. I am now obsessed with everything origins.

Bought my very first FOREO after my Clarisonic finally died.  I chose the fofo because of the size and I thought having the sensors to let me know the dryness of my skin  will benefit me. Plus no charging cords to worry about. I absolutely love the size and how it works- the vibration really works to take off every trace of dirt and makeup. The sensor portion of this was very helpful but it stopped working after the 3rd time I used it. It acts as if it’s reading my skin and just stops. After restarting the app and the device several times, it finally started working again but same issue happened a few days later. I only had this device for about a week or so and returned it for the FOREO 3.

I am a fan. I received this complimentary for my honest review.  It does have a perfumey scent that I’m not used to primers having,  and the scent lingers for a good 30 minutes after application. However, it’s non-irritating and the scent is pleasant, so I’m ok with it. It is not sticky and it gives a slight radiance to your skin. I tried wearing it alone and underneath 3 different foundations (Dior, Clinique, and Pat McGrath). I had very little transfer of foundation using this primer, which is AMAZING considering the Pat McGrath foundation usually transfers like crazy and usually breaks down after just a few hours. This Dior primer making my PM foundation last up to 6 hours sold me! My other two foundations lasted up to 8 hours. I would purchase this in the future.

product_name: Mineral Sunscreen Zinc Oxide Broad Spectrum SPF 30
review_text: this has been one of the best sunscreens i have tried, it does not leave white, and it is easy to apply, the best thing for me is that it is not greasy because my skin is oily and sensitive, and not all sunscreens work for me, some make my skin burn, but this NEW Zinc Oxide Mineral Sunscreen Broad Spectrum SPF 30 from First Aid Beauty, is super good, it has become my favorite, I use it every day and it is very easy to reapply. I can only say that I love it.!!!!

product_name: Advanced Génifique Radiance Boosting Face Serum
review_text: I have sensitive skin and this product works really well on my face. It’s light weight and does not leave my face shiny or oily after using. I’m no beginner to retinol, AHAs, BHAs, etc., so I just jumped right to using it every day and I was fine. No peeling, burning, or redness. Make sure to wear sunscreen every day.We all know that products like this are hit or miss. Everyone’s results are different. I think this is worth spending the $18 on the mini to try out because if you’re someone it works for, it really does help. If this doesn’t end up working for you, at least you tried.

Completely protected and I didn’t break out once from either of the products which is AMAZING considering I have very sensitive skin to products like this. So finding these and using them over time I’m so happy to say I actually found my holy grail sun screen

The product does not seem to be working for me. I think I am breaking out due to stress. My acne seems to be worse since I started using the product. Maybe in combination with the spot treatment it might work.

Not to mention, this product does not irritate my eyes at all. I can’t stress enough how great this product is. Definitely worth the price.
Very hydrating and noticed it decreased the appearance of my fine lines.
My skin has never looked so glowy and clear in the morning !! I’m so happy with this product

I originally tried this in the birthday gift last year, and I loved it so much I had to come back for the full size. I do not find it pulling on my skin, and a little bit goes a long way. My face feels fresh and moisturized all day. product_name: Good Genes All-In-One AHA Lactic Acid Treatment
review_text: This is a good AHA.  Gentle but effective, even for people used to acid products.
Clinique is a brand I can trust.
one of my fav masks  love the smell, color, and the way it makes my skin feel. mainly under eye when I wake at. 5am

product_name: Every. Single. Face. Watery Lotion SPF 50
review_text: Gifted by Supergoop! I have been testing out various sunscreen in preparation for the summer and this is a great option! It has 50 spf, is oil free and doesn’t cause my sensitive skin to break out. There is a bit of a residual shine lift behind but that can be reduced with some setting powder and spray.

I tried this product after reading reviews. I have tried every lip balm out there. I have a problem with getting fever blisters on my lips from the sun, so it is imparitive I have a great one with SPF. The Jack Black has a higher SPF than I have been able to find before. It is also very moisturizing. I use it plain and under my lip gloss. Great product, pleasant taste , and high SPF. I can not go wrong. I will keep a supply of this always.

I love the way this makes my skin look- absorbs nicely into the skin and gives you a nice and healthy looking glow! Would recommend this to a friend and the packaging is sustainable which is always a plus.

product_name: Green Clean Makeup Meltaway Cleansing Balm Limited Edition Jumbo
review_text: All the reviews speak for themselves this stuff Is incredible! Not only does it remove all of my makeup it soothes my rosace prone skin which is a definite plus. I also have a question to anyone who’s been using this for a while. Has anyone seen a difference in their eyelashes and eyebrows? They’ve both been very full lately and this is the only product that I rub into my eyes other than usual cleansers I’m very curious to know.

product_name: Alpha Beta Universal Daily Peel Pads
review_text: These are a god sent! Amazing ! I can not believe after a week the difference of my skin. Worth every penny.

I love this product, it’s my first time using it, I heard about this product a lot from a group on Facebook, which is about skin care, this product will help to minimise ur pores. I bought it and using is from last week. Its working gradually and my skin is getting a lot more smoother. I love ordinary serums and drops. I hv been using other products too like lactic acid, Alpha Arbutin since two years and loving it.

My eyelids burn from using this product on and around them, my skin is more dry than it was before using this cream, never in a thousand years would I purchase the full size of this product but would DEFINITELY purchase the dewy cream.

product_name: Double Serum Firming & Smoothing Anti-Aging Concentrate
review_text: I like the concepts, though it’s a little messy as a sample size when mixing the fluids. It’s a bit tacky and oily somehow at the same time when first applying, but it leaves my skin feeling so soft and smooth. I like applying before bed and wake up feeling more moisturized.

product_name: Lala Retro Whipped Refillable Moisturizer with Ceramides
review_text: Very moisturizing.  I picked up this moisturizer when my skin was going through a rough patch and was very red and itchy from over-exfoliation.  After one use it calmed my irritated skin and gave it a nice moisturizing barrier. It does feel very oily for a couple hours after applicstion, which I don’t love.
This is a really lovely mask! I highly recommend it for any skin type. I tend to use it as a moisturizer but it has plenty of uses, yes it’s a little pricey but it’s totally worth it

product_name: Volcanic AHA Pore Clearing Clay Mask
review_text: Mine came with the cap loose and I think that affected the consistency of my mask. It was super thick and hard to spread around. I don’t know if this affected the mask’s potency.

product_name: Ultra Facial Moisturizing Cream with Squalane
review_text: I brought this moisturizer because my skin is dry because I’m using a retinol that was prescribed to me. I recommend to use the moisturizer at night only because when I used it in the morning to would make my face oily.
I’m a big fan of anything that comes in a stick…. But not this. Save your money if you wish to see results. The eye stick is great - just not this!

product_name: Makeup Setting Spray Organic Sunscreen SPF 30
review_text: Such a great and innovative product! I have always had an issue reapplying SPF over my makeup, and this is the answer! Such a great scent, and the fact it’s also organic definitely resonates with my lifestyle! Thumbs up!

I was sent this product complimentary by Influenster, and it’s AMAZING. I’m not a HUGE skincare guru by any means... but this product changed the game for me. I use this every other day. My skin is FLAWLESS thanks to this wonderful product.

1) Super soft - I have very sensitive skin, redness, mild rosacea. So using cotton balls when cleaning my face is a must. Maybe I bought cheap cotton balls but Shiseido cotton is even softer than them!2) In my opinion the price is justified because of the quality and quantity.3) I will definitely keep buying these
