I was surprised that Tarte’s maracuja oil not only hydrated me, but leaves my skin smoother and firmer and I swear my pores look smaller. It doesn’t really claim to do all of that, but it works for me. I use one drop over a moisturizer at night and on my beauty blender when I apply foundation. My skin looks young and dewy all day, which is something at 48. It sinks in more quickly that others I have used,which I guess could be the reason I don’t breakout with this one. Thanks Tarte!

product_name: Superscreen Daily Moisturizer Sunscreen SPF 40 PA+++
review_text: - makes my combo skin looks like a shiny greasy mess- gets into my eyes so fast and irritates my eyes so bad (happened when I was driving a couple of times and really freaked me out. now I only wear hypoallergenic and fragrance free sunscreen)- emphasizes texture and makes my nose peel (rare because it’s where my skin is most oily)- smells horrible
review_title: May work if you have perfect skin and eyes

product_name: Squalane + Marine Algae Firming & Lifting Eye Cream
review_text: This eye cream is extremely hydrating and noticeably helps my fine lines and wrinkles through hydration. The cream is really thick and takes just a few minutes for my skin to absorb it. I would recommend this product to someone looking for a hydrating eye cream that has clean ingredients.  These ingredients help the skin around your eye absorb and retain moisture. The cream makes your skin look more supple, fresh, hydrated, smooth and full after a week or two. I received this product complimentary to try and review.

product_name: Mini Mandelic Acid + Superfood Unity Exfoliant
review_text: i have very sensitive skin and this does not cause me any discomfort! with the heat and humidity lately, this has been a perfect refresher before heading out and helped me feel fresher longer, especially with already having oily skin.  highly recommend!
Cleared up my skin in one use alone. After using it, my skin felt so soft and had a glow
Best for the buck! Loving the fact that it comes in a larger bottle so I don’t have to order as often ;p

product_name: Skinlongevity Long Life Herb Anti-Aging Face Serum
review_text: I liked my initial use with product. It absorbed into the skin well. There was no oily residue and no super dry feeling. It did not have an over powering scent, encouraging to me that is actually natural ingredients. The application of the product was so soft and easy. I can’t say how well it works because I only used a sample size but I would be willing to continue use to test results.

I love love love this exfoliator! It isn’t super abrasive and it does the job well! I have super sensitive skin that typically doesn’t handle exfoliation without pain. This wash doesn’t hurt at all. Downside- don’t leave it in the shower. It’s a powder and if moisture gets inside the bottle it will ruin it. Kinda smells like baby formula too.

I received this complimentary from Josie Maran. One of my new favorite sunscreens, one for the purse for sure! The packaging is very nice, very luxe. It’s a sturdy dark tinted glass with a very convenient pump applicator, only one to two pumps needed. It has a very light natural scent, no artificial fragrance. The formula is full of naturally derived and organic ingredients such as Josie Marans famous organic argan oil. It’s a very lightweight, milky texture that melts into the skin. It doesn’t leave a white cast or greasy feeling, it’s very comfortable. Skin looks glowy, hydrated, and bright after use, a huge plus!

Very impressed by this product from this Dr. Jart  line. This is the first serum I’ve ever tried, and will be part of my skin regimen from now on! My skin feels refreshed after a long day of makeup and exposure to the environment. I received this product complimentary for review purposes.

I wasn’t to sure what to expect from this but I’m very impressed. It’s a strange texture and you don’t need a lot it feels like a balm more than a cleanser and it doesn’t really have a smell. I have sensitive to combo skin and it works pretty good as a cleaner. It’s a little oily, but not in a gross way in a moisturizing way. I find that it leaves my skin silky smooth. You can also use this as a mask and that is pretty much what I have been using it for. I have left it in overnight a few times and my skin feels nice and smooth and moist. I’m not sure how oily skin would work with this as it does leave your skin a little oily after.
review_title: I love the mask feature, it’s my main use.

review_text: To be honest, I had no idea about the Kate Somerville brand. I purchased a bunch of products off of sephora.com and put it in for my free deluxe sample.My first impression was that it was stinky, having a sensitive nose. However I got used to the smell fairly fast and started noticing how my skin’s texture, moisture, and clarity changed within a week. I have combination skin, so I wasn’t sure how well this product would work out since I found it to be super moisturizing. It does not make your skin “oily or greasy“ as others have put it. It completely hydrates the skin for the entire day. I put it on morning and at night after cleansing. The texture in my skin significantly was noticable from having an uneven skin tone. Made my appearance look more youthful and also noticed that the little acne here and there I had disappeared. Sadly today was the last day, it ran out :(. Pretty good for about 2-3 months worth for a deluxe sample. It’s safe to say when I finish going through all the other moisturizers i have, I definitelly will come back for this product.I definitely recommend this to all clients of Sephora. Tip: You don’t need a lot of product out of the container. i dip two of my fingers til the end of my nails are evenly coated and it spreads easily on the face. If you do tho tend to feel “greasy“ I recommend using this product in the morning and at night time a different moisturizer.
review_title: Best thing out there for dry skin!

review_text: There’s some real goodies in this serum: Niacinamide, Cocoa extract, Arnica etc and I think it’s the ingredients that really drew me to this product, more than the redness around my nose which I was curious to see how it would work on. The pro’s: it goes on light and is totally non-tacky. No breakouts, no itchiness, nothing negative to report on, and that’s despite having reactive skin. I could apply my moisturizer and CC cream during the day without piling, or night serum before bed, right after this. More importantly, the redness around my nose did calm down somewhat which was great, I’d say a 50% reduction at least (I usually cover with my MAC Studio Finish Concealer but didn’t need to use as much as normal). Better still, the redness is still reduced even though it’s been over 1 week since I stopped using this. The cons: None whatsoever!~ My Sephora Top 7 must-have list ~(My top 7 must-have beauty products of all time, focusing mainly on my purchases at Sephora)1. Lip Liner: ‘Sephora Collection’ - Rouge Gel Lip Liner

product_name: Guava Vitamin C Dark Spot Treatment Serum
review_text: I am a huge fan of most Glow Recipe products so I was more than ecstatic to get my hands on this. I have been in the hunt for a vitamin C serum to help with some skin issues I have been having from.syn exposure. My years in the sun are finally catching up to me and I am trying to nip it in the bud befire it gets worse. So far l, I an quite pleased with this serum. If feels light and airy and applies like a dream. After the initial application, it may feel a tad sticky. Not to worry though, the stickiness eventually subsides and makes the skin feel like a smooth canvas. I cannot say it adds a tin of moisture, but thats what moisturizer is for! After the serum, I apply a thin coat if moisturizer to seal everything in and it adheres perfectly. Sometimes when you layer, you get the pulling effect however I have not experienced that with this product. I even applied Foundation and ot really acted like a base and allowed the foundation to adhere smoothly. I feel it helps brighten up my Complexion and boost Radiance. While I hace only been using it a short time, I am hopeful it will help even out my skin tone and start fading those pesky spots.  I cannot wait to see what the next few months bring!

I just received this in my Influenster voxbox and i was kinda disappointed in how small it was but man, when they say a little goes a long way, this product is a prime example. It is so moisturizing, i like to apply to a damp face and let it all soak in at once. Theres almost a burst of coolness immediately after applying it and it lasts a very long time. You can barely even feel that you have something sitting on your face! Not a huge fan of the scent but it doesnt take away from the product whatsoever!
review_title: Big things come in small packages!

review_text: After reading about their all natural skin care, I decided to try the YTTP line for myself. This product wasn’t what I expected - for some reason, maybe because of the packaging, I expected something that was very thin. This is a nice thick facewash. That being said, I don’t think it’s worth the price. It’s good, definitely, but in my opinion it’s no better than something you can get in a drug store for $5.
review_title: A bit expensive for drug store quality

review_text: Amazing product this truly helps lift sun damage! Use with resveratrol & feurlic acid, as well as hyularonic acid. My skin hasn’t looked this good in a long time! I am 44 and my skin looks dewy and the sun damage has faded significantly. Highly recommend!
review_title: This stuff works! Be consistent though

product_name: Super Spot Remover Acne Treatment Gel
review_text: For the young readers out there, look forward to another round of hormonal acne once you hit your 30’s. Only this time, it’s a random cyst pimple that decides to take up residence on your face for over a month. Enter this spot remover, which does remove smaller pimples, but not the big ones. That’s ok, because nothing can (not even cortisone at the derm). However, this stuff will calmand shrink those lovelies for the day; and that’s good enough for me.

This is my first Skinfix product, and it’s not bad! I use this as a first cleanse to remove my makeup, and it does a nice job overall. A little residue around my eyes, but that’s nothing a second cleanse can’t remove. My only complaint is that this does leave a TINY bit of a film, so I do recommend going on with a second cleanser. It makes my skin feel really nice though, and super soft!

This is one of the best products I’ve EVER used. It is expensive but you won’t use it every day, and you don’t need much of it for it to be effective. It is one of the most clarifying products out there, and I’ve tried quite a few of them!

product_name: Liquid Gold Exfoliating Treatment with Glycolic acid
review_text: I’ve been using this for about 2 weeks now and I’m loving it! I apply after cleansing and follow up with vitamin c oil and moisturizer. My skin looks and feels great and I haven’t had any new breakouts since trying. It can be very drying so make sure you use a moisturizer!

product_name: Mini C.E.O. Vitamin C Brightening Rich Hydration Moisturizer
review_text: Love this!! Worth every penny! The added Vit C to this moisturizer is a key ingredient and there’s no need to buy an extra C serum!

product_name: Mini Cicapair Tiger Grass Color Correcting Treatment SPF 30
review_text: Like so many other reviewers, I basically never review products, but this is so amazing, I had to. I have fair, super sensitive skin, prone to dryness and redness and have tried dozens of products to address these issues. This product essentially addresses all of them. It’s hydrating and immediately calms down my redness and evens out my skin tone. I don’t have much acne or scarring, but the redness around my nose/chin and on my cheeks tends to make my skin look uneven. This evens everything out and neutralizes the redness. It’s amazing and I don’t need to wear any BB cream or foundation on top of it. A little does go a long way, so I think this is worth every penny. I got a sample of this in store and ordered the full size the next day.

Amazing for my super dry skin. Not too thick or oily but definitely creamy and hydrating. My winter skin is amazing because of this stuff. Also love the smell nothing too gross which is often the case for product I buy for sensitive skin.

I don’t understand why people rave about this. Yea, it gets off your makeup and it’s gently, but it separates in the tube and oil comes out. Also, it leaves my eyes greasy and a wash with a foaming cleanser is required so everything doesn’t look foggy. It’s just not my favorite.

My new go-to retinol. It smells nice, doesn’t dry out my skin, and doesn’t irritate my skin. Best of all...it works! I highly recommend this product especially if you have sensitive or acne prone skin.
This product does a so-so job. It smoothes my skin but I do no notice smaller pores.

product_name: Advanced Night Repair Synchronized Multi-Recovery Complex Duo
review_text: Overall there is nothing to dislike, it’s lightweight. My face is constantly oily but this product did not cause more or less oil. I did notice a bit of firmer skin. My fine lines have not gone away but maybe I need to be more consistent with the serum. Age: 23

product_name: Volcanic AHA Pore Clearing Clay Mask
review_text: I received this product complimentary from innisfree. The product comes in a greyish paste that is easy to apply. The directions are easy to read and understand. I  apply it after I put my kids to bed and relax for 10 min after I apply the mask. Then rinse with warm water and massage it off. My face feels brand new after. It is so soft and I have noticed a huge difference in pore size and the overall texture of my face. I definitely recommend this product.

product_name: Mini Revitalizing Supreme+ Youth Power Creme Moisturizer
review_text: I received this product for free from Influenster to try for my honest review. I found this product to be very smooth and lightly sent it. However, I do not believe I received enough to see if it would make a difference. But it did leave my skin very soft when using.

It’s a great moisturizer if you don’t have issues with your skin. I used higher end creams for the past 8+ years and this is super comparable for a fraction of the price! Giving it 4 stars because it doesn’t absorb as quickly in the skin.

I love this facial cleanser. Most products make my already dry skin dryer, and this does the opposite. It really hydrates my face and leaves it feeling clean and refreshed. It’s my favorite to use, especially first thing in the morning. It has this burst of what I would say reminds me of mint. It really wakes me up in the shower. I love the fact that it is also a clean product!! I would and have recommended this over and over. I’ve gotten so many compliments on my face!! #freeproduct.

Recent purchase. Really like them besides being a little small for removing make up. I’m used to larger sheets. Still love them! A little dewy when I wake up in the morning after use but no break outs.

I give this 3/5 stars.  I found it absorbs really quickly unless you just coat your face in it at night,   almost like you would a mask.  It broke me out so now I just use it on my hands.  I do like the cooling lightweight texture, but for parched skin like mine, it just did not do the trick.

I love this cleansing balm! It melts away makeup and SPF SO well and it emulsifies so easily. It’s very gentle, but effective and the bottle will last you a good while. Student Esthetician approved! Follow @selfcarecoka for more faves!

product_name: Ultra Facial Moisturizing Cream with Squalane
review_text: I’m super impressed with this Kiehl’s Ultra Facial Cream! It is really moisturizing and does an excellent job of softening the skin, but is also SUPER  lightweight and not greasy. In fact, I’ve been using it for about a week when I suggested to my husband that he’d like it- he does not have much of a skincare routine at all because he can’t stand being greasy or feeling the moisturizer on his face. I’ve gotten him using this Kiehl’s facial cream and he loves it as well. This is an excellent everyday moisturizer that will leave your skin feeling super soft and supple! No scent (another thing my husband especially loves), no added colors. Just a great facial cream. You also do not need a lot at all. Even using it every day, morning and night, this 1.7oz will last me for months.

product_name: Midnight Recovery Concentrate Moisturizing Face Oil
review_text: This product gave my skin a mild burning sensation. I also really didn’t care for the smell. I am not into old fashioned flowery scents. This product is filled with essential oils which are known for irritating the skin. I wouldn’t suggest this product for someone with sensitive skin.
review_title: Not for sensitive skin/strong unpleasant scent

review_text: I have dry skin and it’s hard to find a face wash that is good but doesn’t leave my skin feeling tight. This is a really good face wash compared to other ones I’ve tried. Sometimes I have to use 2 pumps to get off my makeup but that’s when I wear a lot. On days I don’t wear makeup or just mascara, half a pump works. Probably my favorite face wash I have used so far.

Let me start by saying that this product glosses on your face and does provide a luminosity thanks to the niacinamide and silicones providing very smooth skin. As a primer it works well for easy application of foundation on top and doesn’t pill. I can’t say that my makeup lasts longer with this however. Also, the fragrance in this is very strong with the jasmine, limonene and citronellol and all of these fragrances can cause skin irritation over time. I’m sure some women will love this for the luxurious feel and classic dior expensive scent. Me, I would rather not irritate my skin with this much fragrance in my skincare.
review_title: Fragrance, perfume and alcohol oh my!

review_text: I have normal/dry skin and have been using this cream as part of my night time routine. It is a little bit on the thicker side and a little bit goes a long way. It is super rich and moisturizing but absorbs nicely into the skin and after a few minutes leaves your skin feeling moisturized and plump. It has a little bit of a green tint to it which I believe it neutralize any redness you may have. So far I am really loving this product and will continue using it. I received this product complimentary for testing purposes.

I received a free sample of this product from Influenster and Esteelauder in exchange of my honest review. This eye cream is nice and smooth to apply. It’s pretty oily but feels nice on the eyelids. I’ve used it several times it is definitely hydrating but I didn’t notice much improvement in my dark circles but maybe I should have used it longer but again I only received a tiny sample. So I cannot recommend it or not recommend it.

I am not normally a fan of a gel moisturizer except in the summer because my skin is super dry. While this is more moisturizing than most gel lotions, it’s still not quite enough for me in dryer months. This would probably work better for those with oily/combo/normal skin.  I do love the brightening you get from the vitamin c though. And I figure it would have more benefits with extended use.  This moisturizer was gifted by Dermalogica.
It clogged my pores .. I could tell right after the first couple of times I used it . I just can’t use it .
Loved the the feel of this stuff. This was my first time trying this brand. It reminds me a lot of some Korean beauty skincare products I’ve tried, fresh and natural feeling!

After using this product for a week I’ve noticed considerable improvement on my skin! It’s cleaner, smoother, and clearer. I use it in the shower with a silicon face tool, after letting my pores open up. The smell is so citrusy light and refreshing, it’s kind of addicting! I did receive this product free for testing and will definitely be buying a full size once my trial is out. Absolutely love it.

product_name: Double Serum Firming & Smoothing Anti-Aging Concentrate
review_text: I got a seven day supply of this with my rewards points. I could only use it for 4 days.  The active ingredients were to strong for my sensitive skin, it made my roseaca angry, hot and itchy.
This stuff was abit too watery for me, other than that it was great!

product_name: Water Bank Blue Hyaluronic Gel Moisturizer
review_text: I am gifted by Laneige and I feel honored to take a try on this new product. I like the package very much because it looks like an airpod. The texture is very fresh. I think it’s more suitable to use it on summer. My face looks a little tighter.
I really wanted to love this. It didn’t really do anything for me.

product_name: Super Spot Remover Acne Treatment Gel
review_text: I was skeptical, but decided to try it.  I want to stop pimple formation at the first sign, not use it every day as a preventive.  I’ve used it 3 times and has worked each time. There is an initial smell that I don’t particularly like, but it goes away fairly quickly, so easily ignored.
I love that they don’t test on animals. The cream feels very light and absorbs well on my skin. I just start using it so I need more time to see the results but so far so good.
I love this product! Doesn’t have a bad smell and it’s super creamy. Makes me skin feel soft and dewy after I use it. Helps a lot in the morning when it looks

I am obsessed with this facial cleanser. I got a sample of it and been hooked ever since. I have oily/dry skin that happens to be very sensitive too and this cleanser does magic; it leaves my skin feeling fresh&baby soft. My pores are smaller& it aids to my monthly breakouts. Its definitely worth a try.

product_name: Green Clean Makeup Removing Cleansing Balm
review_text: Dries my skin so bad it causes red patches. It feels very good at the beginning but the dryness appears the next day

product_name: Clarifique Exfoliating & Hydrating Face Essence with Glycolic Acid
review_text: Wonderful product. I like how easy it is to use and it doesn’t cause any break outs. It’s fragrance free and I noticed clearer and brighter skin in just few days
I really really like this acne treatment...I had a few break outs..used this one night and woke up and they were nearly gone!

Keeps my face moisturized and soft which is nice, haven’t noticed fine lines disappearing but I also haven’t broken out from it. 4 stars cause I feel like I have to use a lot to get the effect I’m looking for. Overall good price for product

I love this soooooo much!!!! I put this on before bed and wake up with little to no redness in my cheeks. I have minor redness in my t-zone. The formula is soooo soft and a little bit goes a very long way! Worth the money !

product_name: Super Multi-Corrective Anti-Aging Face and Neck Cream
review_text: Loving this cream so far. I have acne scars, really bad dark/sun spots, current acne, and now getting fine lines and wrinkles so I was really excited to try this cream. I have to use benzoyl peroxide treatment before bed and I love that I’m able to use this cream before the bp treatment and it doesn’t cause pilling. It also sits well under foundation and tinted moisturizer. The consistency is thick but not heavy or slimy. A little goes a long way so this jar will last you a while. I wasn’t expecting this to help clear up my skin but it has. I’ve been using about a month so the jury is still out on the dark spots and fine lines.

This moisturizer makes you so greasy and oily. It doesn’t sink into your skin it sits on top. It’s such an uncomfortable feeling too. After 3-4 hours when I rubbed my face the moisturizer turned into little goobs and flaked off my skin. Really didn’t like it I’ll stick with drunk elephant and tatcha

review_text: I would like to preface this review by letting you know that I have very sensitive skin and normally have a reaction to any change in my normal skincare routine. However, about day 4 or 5 my face started burning after I put the serum on.  I tested it against my other skincare products I was using to make sure the burning was really truly coming from the Ilia and not another product.  After several attempts I was able to positively say it was the Ilia.  Unfortunately, I won’t be able to use it any longer.  I did pass it on to my daughter who uses it every single day and loves it!!  I would highly recommend this product, just be aware if you have super sensitive skin, like I do, it may not end up working out for you.

Finally a product specifically targeted at aging, acne-prone skin. I thought I’d outgrow the breakouts now that I’m approaching 40 but sadly that isn’t the case. This has worked well for my combination skin so far. I don’t find it too drying and it has a nice tingle.
Just began to include this in my regimen... Like the brand...

Amazing face cleanser; I love it. It does not really foam up at all for me, but it does do a great job of gently cleaning my face and taking off my makeup. One of the best things about it for me is the effect it has on my eyes and eyelashes. It is really gentle and seems to benefit my eyelashes rather than strip them of moisture and make them fall out. I could see how this cleanser would work on any skin type (although perhaps not super oily). I will definitely be purchasing this again.

product_name: Beauty Elixir Prep, Set, Glow Face Mist
review_text: It smells nice, and makes my face feel refreshed and look toned.

product_name: Revitalizing Supreme+ Youth Power Creme Moisturizer
review_text: I love this Estée Lauder Revitalizing Supreme+ Youth Power Creme Moisturizer. It’s super thick but absorbs quickly. My skin is moist all day. It has a light fragrance that doesn’t linger. This is definitely good for super dry skin. I would get this product again.
I absolutely love The Inkey List Brighten-I Eye Cream. The coolness of the roller under the eyes is such a wonderful feeling. It really seems to help with the darkness underneath my eyes as well.

product_name: Mini Cicapair Tiger Grass Color Correcting Treatment SPF 30
review_text: Does it neutralize the face color? Yes. But you must really warm it up in your hands before applying. I didn’t really like the texture or how it felt on my skin. Sort of like a really thick oily texture and it does get oily. I’d rather a tinted moisturizer over this

It’s a nice mix of gloss and moisture with a very light amount of color while not being sticky like some glosses tend to be. It goes on very light and sheer. My one complaint is that it tends to melt in my purse during the summer, making it tricky to use until it returns to a more solid state. However, despite this issue, it is a great product. I’m addicted.

product_name: Alpha Beta Extra Strength Daily Peel Pads
review_text: I like this product for what it was. I’m not generally into facial peels, but this one was not abrasive at all and I didn’t mind it.

The first thing I noticed is that this product smells wonderful. its lighter than the moisturizer I use during the winter so I think it’ll work great for the summer months! It leaves my skin feeling smooth and moisturized without being weighed down or sticky. I have very sensitive/acne prone skin and this has not made me breakout. Would recommend
Made my skin feel super oily as the day went on. Too much of a shine. I did like the smoothness of the product when applying.

Having combo/sensitive skin, it can be rather difficult finding a perfect moisturizer. But I did with the Tatcha Water Cream. It’s so lightweight and gentle on the skin keeping me super hydrated but never oily. I can’t live without it!

product_name: Acne Solutions All-Over Clearing Treatment Oil-Free
review_text: This worked wonders for me. I added it to my regular philosophy face wash routine and it has completely cleared my skin.

product_name: Squalane + Vitamin C Rose Firming Oil
review_text: Love this oil! It’s light weight but really hydrating and can be worn alone with makeup or other skin care. Doesn’t make me break out and is gentle on sensitive skin!
This is lovely, and smells heavenly. I haven’t used it long enough to rate it over the long term, but it makes me skin feel really nice - moisturized and soft to the touch.

This face cream is decent. Not my favorite but it wasn’t the worst. During the day my face felt moisturized. After sleeping, my face was dry when I woke up. Not the best for dry skin. Might be better with normal to oily.

product_name: Aqua Bomb Brightening Vitamin C Cream
review_text: It moisturizes. I lm not sure if it brightened my face with the sample size I received from Infuenster but it smelled ok and was light.

product_name: Clear Improvement Active Charcoal Mask to Clear Pores
review_text: This mask seriously works. My pimples go away after two days or even one! It does smell weird.

Love this moisturizer! It was gifted by Tata Harper Skincare. It really does lock in moisture all day and has my skin feeling so smooth and soft. Love that this product is vegan, cruelty-free, and gluten-free. Love that all of the ingredients are derived from natural sources. Love that this product is great for all skins types. This product is also lightweight . Would highly recommend this product .
I normally like Kate Somerville products, but this did absolutely nothing for me. Poor as a spot treatment for my skin, so I returned it.

Dermalogica never disappoints me! I typically like to use a cleansing balm to remove my makeup but really wanted to try this oil. It put all my cleansing balms to shame! It removed my makeup incredibly easy and fast without having to scrub over and over again. This will definitely be a staple for me! Gifted by Dermalogica

product_name: Super Spot Remover Acne Treatment Gel
review_text: Great acne product! I have light to moderate acne depending on the day and this has done wonders for my face! Did cause some drying intially like the first week or so but now I use it twice a day everyday and I have no dry spots at all. It doesn’t stops all acne from coming up but it knocks the breakouts out FAST! Will continue to have in my arsenal always!

I was gifted by Dermalogica in exchange for my honest review. This Precleanse Cleansing Oil is high quality, very light had a slight pleasant fragrance. It spreads and lathers nicely, and a little goes a long way. It removes makeup well, and leaves skin feeling soft and refreshed.  I have been using it before a regular cleanser, and have been happy with the results.
Works very well for my dry skin. I top it off with Ordinary moisturizer

This is the product from Inkey list that I would repurchase in a heartbeat. My skin loves Ceramides. Hyaluronic acid doesn’t really do anything to my skin but Ceramide on the other hand has helped with my skin barrier. I notice the instant plumping effect from ceramide. It’s a serum, but sometimes when I got lazy I mix this with either my moisturizer or my night cream. I don’t know why this product is only for PM, I tried using it AM and I still find it very useful. Unless it’s not good to be worn during AM???

I have dry skin especially my under my eyes area and it feels amazing on my skin  leaving my eyes hydrated and bright. I have been using it for 2 weeks and it has helped a little with my dark circles. It’s a luxury eye cream. The only thing I didn’t like very much personally was the smell. It smells like if the product was old or like expired.

product_name: Smart Clinical Repair Wrinkle Correcting Cream
review_text: Tried for a few days and the results are very fast working, wrinkles minimize amazing, very gentle with my skin, definitely will buy it again.
I love that this cleanser does NOT leave my skin feeling dry. It completely removes even the most stubborn mascara (multiple coats!) and lipstick!!!! It’s a MUST HAVE!!!

product_name: Mini Ultra Facial Moisturizing Cream with Squalane
review_text: This cream is helping my skin a lot in this dry summer.  My skin feels more hydrated and healthier.

I love how silky this product feels. I use this once I take off my makeup with a makeup remover wipe. It really makes takes away left over makeup, dirt and oil. All while leaving a moisturizing feeling afterwards. Amazing!
My favorite cleanser. I use this 2-3 times a week and it work wonders for my skin
I have very sensitive skin, and this works wonders. The cream is abrasive enough to cleanse my face without causing redness or irritation.
“Nnnnngh.“-- Me the first time using this cream. Feels amazing on my skin, smells like a dream, makes me feel like royalty. AND the jar is adorable. What else could you want?

product_name: Mini Glowscreen Sunscreen SPF 40 PA+++ with Hyaluronic Acid + Niacinamide
review_text: Super nourishing and dewy product! I have been using this in lieu of foundation for my wfh morning routine.

I absolutely love how I can spray this product wherever I need to. I have particularly problematic back acne, so this spray allows me to deliver an acne treatment to where I need it without asking another person for help or resulting to contortionist-type maneuvers. Once I spray it on, I can tell that’s it’s working by the tingling sensation that goes over my skin.
Wish it were cheaper but does the job and smells awesome!  My skin is really soft now too!
Literally in love with the product, it’s amazing!!!!! Gave me full and repaired lips in a matter of hours after trying it for the first time!

really loved this as my morning cleanser for awhile until i realized it was causing my breakouts. there is absorbic acid (vitamin c) added which i didn’t notice until after i checked the ingredients which can cause breakouts for some but is good for others. a lot of our skin naturally produces enough vitamins (like C/E) already, so when we add more on top it can throw the balance off, causing breakouts. just something to be aware of with skincare. depends on your skin type!

product_name: Ultra Facial Moisturizing Cream with Squalane
review_text: This may be considered a “cream“, but for my oily, sensitized skin, it works.  It’s not heavy and does not feel greasy.  Absorbs quickly and no scent. It definitely helps with the flakiness that Retin-A brings, along with days that my skin just feels more thirsty.

product_name: Mini TL Advanced  Tightening Neck Cream PLUS for Firming & Brightening
review_text: I’m in my 30’s now and admittedly starting to get conscious about my neck lines. I noticed some tightening with just a few uses. I’m gonna continue using to see how this works with my neck lines, but so far so good! I’m liking this a lot!

I love this product, I have acne prone skin and this really helps control break outs. This also helped significantly reduce the sebaceous filaments on my nose (which I mistakenly thought were blackheads). I use this once daily in the morning and apply Paula’s choice niacinamide after, along with moisturizer and SPF.

I received this product complimentary on Influenster and let me tell youuuuuu, it did not disappoint. I loved it. So much, I would pay for it. THAT’s how good it is. You only need a little tiny pea sized amount and that is more than enough to cover your whole face. It leaves you glowing and godlike. Highly recommend!
I love this toner I’m never going back to the Thayers Toner
Been using this for three years, makes my skin feel amazing! Washes off all makeup and doesn’t irritate my sensitive, acne prone skin. Little goes a long way!

product_name: Adaptogen Deep Moisturizing Cream with Ashwagandha + Reishi
review_text: I have friends that adore this moisturizer, but it dried me out! It didn’t irritate my skin, or cause any break outs, just left my skin feeling tight and dry. I have combo skin that gets the occasional cystic acne around my jaw during my time of the month. Was hoping to find a good moisturizer for the winter but this seems to do the opposite.

product_name: Rénergie Lift Multi-Action Ultra Dark Spot Correcting Cream SPF 30
review_text: I needed something for a sunscreen and my dark spots, So I got this product and for helping with the dark spots it works very well. It has a great smell and it doesn’t leave you feeling all clammy. I also notice that my crows feets on my eyes are also clearing up.

product_name: Green Clean Makeup Meltaway Cleansing Balm Limited Edition Jumbo
review_text: I’ve only used it this past week and I already know this is going to be a staple in my skincare. I love the feel of this on the skin and the result after. I have dry skin and this doesn’t feel like it strips my skin like other cleansers do. I also really enjoy the scent.
Great for cold and windy days kept my lips protected without being sticky!

I love this serum! I started using it and within days my skin was silkier and the texture smoother. I never had an issue with my skin getting irritated and dry while using it, it just seems like a gentle and hydrating serum with serious power. The smell isn’t great but I really don’t care about that at all, considering it makes my skin look so good.

I ordered the sample size, and after one use I was not impressed. It just didn’t win me over like other ole products have. I didn’t notice any significant improvement to my pores. The pigment is very bright which I don’t particularly like in a face product. The only good thing about it is that it truly does have a relaxing, cooling effect. If all you want is that sensation, go ahead and try it. But in my opinion, it did not benefit my skin at all and I will not be repurchasing.
review_title: Relaxing and cooling, but not impressed w/ results

product_name: 15% Vitamin C and EGF Brightening Serum
review_text: Didn’t improve my skin, felt like it was doing nothing.

product_name: Blue Tansy BHA and Enzyme Pore Refining Mask
review_text: I struggle with cystic acne and my skin is textured, but this mask is the only mask that has consistently cleared my acne, smoothed my skin and evened my skin tone! Also the SMELL is FABULOUS - my fave!!
Very nice eye stick. I liked the idea of it as it is so unique! Truly loved it and would recommend it.

product_name: Vinoperfect Radiance Dark Spot Serum Vitamin C Alternative
review_text: For a moisturizer, try the new DiorSnow products.For a mask (quick fix brightening), try Steep Clean mask by Bliss.THOSE are good products.
review_title: makes skin healthy, BUT doesn't improve radiance

product_name: Clearly Corrective Dark Spot Solution Duo
review_text: In using this Dark Spot Solution, it seems to work about the way any dark corrector works. It does what it says, though of course, much more time is needed in order to truly see any benefits of the product. I have used it in conjunction with my normal skincare regimen, though I use it first after I’ve used my toning product (usually hyaluronic/aha/bha toning pads.It’s a thin serum, so that feels odd, and it has a sort of weirdly water-like textured feel to it. Other than that, it was fine. There are just cheaper alternatives that work as well- if not better than this. I definitely would not purchase this because it’s just too expensive, and the results are the same with other cheaper alternatives.
review_title: Eh, But Pricey, with Cheaper Alternatives

review_text: I used this emulsion before my moisturizer and it soaked into my skin quickly. I really like the lightweight texture; it doesn’t leave my skin too shiny or oily. I could tell my complexion was hydrated all day!

product_name: Mini Faded Serum for Dark Spots & Discoloration
review_text: This serum faded my hyperpigmentation considerably over the course of 2 months. I’ve found that consistency and patience are key when using this! It’s also been amazing with overall skin texture.

product_name: Mochi Mochi Luminous Plumping & Hydrating Moisturizer
review_text: I reaaaaally like this moisturizer!!! My skin can get really dry in certain places, especially my forehead, and it makes wrinkles look more defined. The plumping feature of this really helped fill out and moisturize my dry areas. I love it!
Usually a huge fan of all drunken elephant line - but this one fell short for me. This left my skin feeling more dry and exaggerated the fine lines.

product_name: Mini Rose & Hyaluronic Acid Deep Hydration Toner
review_text: did nothing for my skin. i used it for 3 months straight. hydrated a little bit(only after application) but no other benefits. in fact, i think it made my skin worse. a cheap cream might hydrate your skin better than this.

I’ve been using this product for about three weeks and I’ve seen such a huge difference in my skin. I have really dry skin during winter and this has made my skin so hydrated and smooth. Definitely will repurchase.

I have only been using this for a couple weeks, so it’s not enough time to see any anti-aging benefits. I can say that this hasn’t caused any sensitivity in my skin. If you are used to using strong retinol products, this might not be strong enough for you, but I’d say this would be great for beginners.

I really want to like this product but I just don’t...I didn’t really feel like it did anything to benefit my skin and that’s after I’ve been using it for more than 2 weeks. It was easy to apply and didn’t have any fragrance that I noticed, which is nice in a skincare product, but other than that I can’t really say anything about it. If it was helping my skin it didn’t show any outward improvements, if anything I broke out more while using this product. Overall it’s a fine product but I don’t really feel or see any improvements after using it.

I prefer this over The Ordinary. It doesn’t pill, which was my biggest issue with TO. But there seem to be some product inconsistencies. The serum in my most recent bottle is very watery compared to my last bottle.
I have light/medium skin tone that tans pretty well in the sun, but it fades as soon as fall/winter comes along so I’ve been wanting to try a self tanner forever now

product_name: Vitamin Enriched Face Base Priming Moisturizer
review_text: Great product! First, I noticed the awesome smell. Very refreshing scent, almost a lemony or citrus smell. I have extremely dry skin and it feels very creamy and hydrating on my skin. It also makes my skin appear very fresh and shiny. I love the way it looks! I will definitely be purchasing **I have received this product complimentary from influenster for testing purposes**

product_name: Clear Improvement Active Charcoal Mask to Clear Pores
review_text: My skin always felt amazing after using this, and I feel like it helped out with breakouts as well! It cleared them up while smoothing out the rest of my skin. This is a great charcoal mask, my favorite by far.

product_name: Mini Crème de la Mer Moisturizer
review_text: You’d get more moisturization out of the cream filling in an Oreo. Overpriced garbage.

I got a sample of this and I’m in love. I bought several other REN face products because my skin is suddenly dry and flakey. This helped to remove most of my dry and dead skin. I will be purchasing it next time I visit.

product_name: Lip Sleeping Mask Intense Hydration with Vitamin C
review_text: Picked this up the other day at my Sephora store. Have been using it for a couple nights and it has become a favorite! product_name: Original Skin Retexturizing Mask with Rose Clay
review_text: made my skin smooth and helped with small bumps on my forehead, one of my new favourite masks

*Longish Review*Okay,  at first I got this as a free sample, and I wasnt too sure it was going to work on me.  My skin  is very random.  I usually have combo skin,  but sometimes I have dry,  patchy  skin around my T zone.  I’ve  been trying different moisturizers left and right. i even tried essential oils, but those left my face too greasy.  Once I tried this product,  it worked instantly.  my skin soaked it up. I had put it on before bed,  and I woke up with no more dry skin. love the feel of this product and the way it leaves my skin feeling. It is smooth without being to heavy or oily. Not stinging or irritation around my eyes, which is a common issue I have. if you use alot it makes your skin feel oily obviously. but i don’t mind it.

I don’t get this product. I really want to understand because I know this is a holy grail product for many, but it does not do it for me. I have seen no change to the quality of my skin but worse is the smell. I just can’t get past the foul smell. Unfortunately this one is a hard no.

I have had varying severity of my hormonal acne for years and have tried countless products with no real success. Let me tell you: This. Is. The. One! I’ve been using this morning and night since November and it has made such a difference in my skin. I find that I see far fewer spots (though I still will get the occasional one now and again), my skin texture has significantly improved, and a lot of my severe scarring looks much less noticeable. The truly incredible price just makes this find all the sweeter. I hope you also find as much success with this product!

product_name: Super Multi-Corrective Anti-Aging Face and Neck Cream
review_text: I liked the cream but just didnt quite love it. I liked how moisturising it left my skin but I didnt care for the scent of the cream. I did see alittle fine line improvement since using the cream every night. So if you can get past the smell and very thick texture then I would say go for it. I received this product complimentary for review purposes.

I love double cleansing my face starting with an oil-based cleanser. This product is great to loosen up sunscreen, make-up, and build-ups. I enjoy the scent but as mentioned by others, it might be irritating for those with sensitive skin.

product_name: Drink Up Intensive Overnight Hydrating Mask with Avocado & Swiss Glacier Water
review_text: My face just sighs with relief every night when I put this on. I am not into noticing micro-changes, but I can say that I wake up with less upper lip creases and crow’s feet. My skin is a lot happier with this heavier moisturizer. I am so glad I found it- this is great for that “Holy cow, I just hit menopause and my skin looks awful all of a sudden!“ phase. Smells pleasant, too.

Love this mask! It has a wonderful rose scent. The gel has a nice cooling effect and the cream isn’t too thick. My skin felt so soft and hydrated the next day. I received this product complimentary for review purposes.
I received this from Influenster and I love it! Leaves my skin feeling smooth and polished. Also smells good. the scent reminds me of the laneige lip sleeping mask :)

product_name: Black Tea Anti-Aging Moisturizer with Retinol-Alternative BT Matrix
review_text: Fresh gifted me. My skin hasn’t looked this refreshed, hydrated and overall healthy. I have been impressed with how plump my forehead lines look and I have even got compliments. I have already bought a back up for when this one runs out.

product_name: Revitalizing Supreme+ Youth Power Creme Moisturizer
review_text: I received this product in exchange for my honest opinion from Estée Lauder and Influenster. After using this every night for a month, I can say I absolutely love this. My face feels hydrated, plumper, smoother, and my fine lines are disappearing. Definitely recommend!

product_name: Vinopure Oil-Control Moisturizer for Acne Prone Skin
review_text: I really like this as a daily moisturizer! The only reason I didn’t give it 5 stars is because the scent is a little unique for a moisturizer... personally I think it smells like pot (nothing wrong with that, its just not exactly what I want to smell first thing in the morning) but I’d buy this product again anyway. Its not ultra hydrating but it does the job!

Like other reviewers, I received this in a large sample size as part of a VIB promotion. Usually I’m fairly “meh“ about these samples - they are fun to try, but I usually go back to my tried and true favorites. Not the case with this sample - now I’m hooked.The first night I used this, I didn’t give it much thought. I noticed that I was looking particularly good the next morning, but it took a few more uses before I realized the connection between using this cream and having a “good face day“ the next morning (like a good hair day, but, you know.... with your face).I’m only 29, so I’m just starting to think about wrinkles, but this cream is great for all sorts of skin issues - my biggest problem is redness / ruddiness, and this makes a huge difference in how my skin looks when I wake up the next day. In fact, the only time I’ll go without foundation / concealer on is when I’ve used this product the night before, because my skin is usually blotchy.It’s got a very thick texture, and I wouldn’t say it’s “lightweight“ per se. It does leave my skin feeling a little on the oily side, but for a pre-bedtime moisturizer, it’s great.Yes, it’s very expensive (I never thought I’d be a person who would spend this much on moisturizer), but it goes a long way. My 1ml sample tub has lasted through a few months of regular usage.My results with this have been so good that I can’t wait to try out Algenist’s eye creams to see if they can work the same magic on my dark circles ...

product_name: Lip Sleeping Mask Intense Hydration with Vitamin C
review_text: Was suffering from constant dry lips and didn’t even know what to do anymore. My friend recommended this product and can’t believe I haven’t used it previously. This product makes such a difference after just one use. I apply a thin layer so I don’t wake up with any in the morning. I personally love fruity scents so this was right up my alley. Will repurchase once the jar is empty.

product_name: Mini Abeille Royale Advanced Youth Watery Oil
review_text: Im in love with this product , it became part of my everyday routine. Hydrate so well. I strongly recommend.

This brightening Gel Crème is the business!! My face had been dull before and really needed that oomph factor to really give it some life and that’s exactly what this gel did. Wonderful smell and made my skin look glowy and feel fantastically smooth. Amazing product! #OleGlow #influenster #complimentary

product_name: The Water Cream Oil-Free Pore Minimizing Moisturizer
review_text: I’ve always heard really good things about this brand so I was very excited to finally invest in this cream. The texture definitely feels high quality, and it left my face looking luminous and hydrated. I honestly fell in love with it instantly, the next morning my face was filled with white heads (which I never get) and visibly clogged pores. I used the cream for exactly 3 days and my face is still recovering from it. The neutrogena hydro boost gel-cream is truly what deserves 5 stars as it has never failed to give me outstanding results.

product_name: The Deep Cleanse Gentle Exfoliating Cleanser
review_text: I absolutely love this cleanser. I have super dry skin and even though this is geared towards people with normal to oily skin I thought I’d give it a shot and I was so happy I did. This cleanser does not strip my skin and I use the rice enzyme powder after I use this and my skin feels nice and soft and smooth. I do use a mask everyday after I cleanse though either the tatcha violet c mask or farmacy honey potion to help with hydration and then use the tatcha water cream. My skin loves this product and will repurchase again. You don’t need a lot just a small dollop and you’re good. If you don’t like the smell of tatcha products then you won’t like this.

I decided to try out First Aid Beauty since it had such good reviews. I used the cleanser, exfoliator and the moisturizer. At first, it looked like my acne was clearing up and my skin was feeling really soft. The second week I used the products, I noticed that my skin started to get oily again. Then I slowly started to break out again. I guess I’m just one of the unlucky few. I guess the search continues.

Not as moisturizing as I had hoped and a bit difficult to apply but using the applicator and waiting a bit after using a serum helped. My skin does look good and not as expensive as some of my other favorites

A good lip moisturizer that is thick, hydrating and unscented. It is a good product but not one that I reach for over other lip masks that I have. I feel like there are other drugstore options that are comparable. Would recommend to wear under lipsticks as it isn’t oily so it will hold the color.
Super nice. I have oily skin and this makes it nice and smooth combined with face serums I use.

Definitely purchase for the 3.3oz one!
review_title: Amazing Cleanser and Buy the 3.3oz Size One!

review_text: I spray this on every morning and apply my moisturizer while my skin is still damp. I love the feeling of waking up my skin and think that it helps keep my skin better moisturized. Very nice smell and also a great pick me up on an airplane (transfer to smaller container).

product_name: Green Clean Makeup Removing Cleansing Balm
review_text: The BEST makeup remover I have ever used! It breaks it up, takes it off, soothes your skin and doesn’t hurt your eyes. You NEED to try this!

I originally tried this product out from the Caudalie 500 pt reward box.The texture was really light and I personally didn’t think it would be very moisturizing (at the time my skin was dry and flaky from the winter cold). review_text: I know this is a mask but I use this as my wintertime night moisturizer and I adore it. It makes my skin so soft and supple and it’s completely absorbed by the morning.

This cleansing brush, is just alright.  It does get the job done, however for $99, there are better ones out there.  For starters, I don’t really like having to change a battery for my cleansing brushes.  It ends up not only being wasteful, but way more costly in the long run for batteries.  The vibrations seem pretty weak compared to other facial cleansing brushes too, there is also only two setting speeds on this brush.  I also don’t see the need for a pulsating vibration for your face either, they would’ve done better to just add more speeds instead. The perfect circle brush actually doesn’t get around my nose nearly as good as a slightly curved “hard silicone“ brush tool since this is a “hard“ brush and not a soft bristle brush. The circle is just really small so it takes more work to get all of your cheeks washed a satisfying amount.  I actually have to hold the device by its head because otherwise it doesn’t actually press against my skin enough to actually wash it.  The handle is just really bendy when you place the tool onto your face.  I also think the handle is really just a waste of space.  Not only is it not easy to store upright even with the tiny stand they provide (and without that tiny stand, you wont be able to store it upright at all), but like i said, I don’t even hold it by its handle otherwise the brush bends backwards away from your skin and it feels like I am going to break it.  I find the small silicone bristles to be great, but the larger ones are really abrasive on the skin as well. This brush just really misses the mark for me on a lot of things.  I don’t recommend it at all, I highly recommend at looking at other brands.
