Not only does it make your lips softer than anything else out there, the strawberry scent is intoxicating (if not somewhat reminiscent of your old strawberry shortcake doll). If you like the smell of strawberry, this balm is for you!!!!!
review_title: BEST Lip Balm (and I've tried too many to count)

product_name: Ginzing Vitamin C Eye Cream to Brighten and Depuff
review_text: I have tried many eye creams in the past but once I tried ginzing origins it worked perfect. My under eyes were dark but the eye cream brightened my under eyes and my puffy under eyes went away. The product is vitamin c inside which is great.

I pat this eye cream under my eyes everyday with my index fingers and it’s amazing. I enjoy how it has a gel consistency and it how quickly my skin absorbs it. I find that if I use a thick eye cream, my under eye pores get clogged (believe it or not). I found that when I don’t use this eye cream before my primer, my makeup doesn’t stay on as long and doesn’t look as flawless. I love this product, it gives the slightest cooling sensation.

product_name: Squalane + 10% Vitamin C Dark Spot Serum
review_text: I tried this as I love my other BIOSSANCE products and had high hopes. When I first regularly for about a month, my skin was fine, no real difference, but also no negative changes. However, after continued regular use, started to notice large splotches of redness, sensitivity and a sunburned feeling. I stopped usage to have my skin repair and switched my other products as well. I then attempted to use it again at night with no other products and sure enough my skin immediately reacted the next morning. I’m so disappointed as I don’t have sensitive skin to any other products, including those with heavy fragrance. Will absolutely NOT use again!

I first want to say that if you haven’t tried retinol products in the past, start off slowly maybe every other day or every 2 days and introduce them to your routine daily. Your skin will thank you later. I am a woman in my late 20s and I am already seeing aging around the eyes (fine lines) and that is something I want to prevent. I also see it on my forehead because of facial expressions we make, which I want to point out is totally normal but if I can prevent it, I will! I’ve always been told by make up artists that moisturizing is your best friend.So after I cleanse my face and use a toner, I would put a Retinol Youth Renewal Youth Serum and finish it off with this Retinol Youth Renewal Night Cream. I really enjoy this pump application - just press it down once and that is plenty for your face, neck and chest but one more pump won’t hurt if you want to spread out product evenly. The cream does not have fragrance and it didn’t burn my face. The cream feels expensive when putting it on, which is a huge bonus. Overall, I would recommend it! I can’t wait to see what this product does in the long term and I would love to try their other products. I am really curious about their lines and would love to own all of them. There is a reason they’re so highly rated among consumers!

product_name: Umbra Sheer Physical Daily Defense SPF 30
review_text: I’ve never been a fan of heavy goopy spf, because i feel like it adds this greasy layer to your skin and makes me break out. So i used to opt for a foundation with an SPF, but since I’ve been doing my hot girl summer and trying to go make up free, this isn’t an option. I was gifted a pack of the littles and immediately gravitated towards this spf. Not only is it 30 which is high for light feeling and skincare forward SPFs but i have seen no sort of break outs from wearing it every day. I mix this with a moisturizer and sometimes a drop of their d-bronzi anti pollutant and it is all i need to get me through the day. It is a bit of a bummer that is is one of DEs few non-vegan products but spf is so necessary so the trade offs are worth it. you need an spf! And a little goes a long way. It took me a month to get through the sample. I just bought the full size and i am so excited that I’m finally loyal to an SPF that protects my skin from sun damage and isn’t clogging my pores in the short term. Love love love
review_title: An SPF for the long and short term

review_text: I’ve been using this every morning and it’s so hydrating and lightweight— great for using under makeup. If only it had SPF, then that would make it a perfect day cream. Love how it feels on my skin, not greasy at all.

product_name: Smart Clinical Repair Wrinkle Correcting Cream
review_text: I received this wrinkle correcting cream has a sample and i apply it everyday ,i like how my skin eyes look ,more brighter and smooth,so I had to buy it ,cause I’m liking how if left my skin

Best exfoliant I’ve tried. I have a lot of scars and bumps on my face due to acne, this polish left my skin very smooth and soft. After two weeks of using it my acne is more under control. I just recommend not using moisturizer after using it, it leaves your skin very moisturized.

I have been using Shani Darden Skin Care Retinol Reform® for 2 weeks and can tell it is working!With my combination this works very well. I’m excited to add Shani Darden Skin Care Retinol Reform® to my normal skin care routine. I use it at night before bed.
My acne got worse with this product.
Simply the best. And it has SPF which I love. This brand is slept on. Their SPF is amazing as well as the hand cream despite the scent. Highly recommend all of them!!

I have combo-oily skin and this moisturizer glides so easily onto my skin when blending in. it provides moisture, which lasts the entire day! it does take a few minutes to dry, but the wait is worth it!

I can’t recommend this enough! My face is improved not only in the fine line department, the general texture has improved and my skin has a nice healthy glow. Most retinols dry out my skin so much I only have ever Used them for a few days, but several weeks in and my skin looks great, no drying , just healthy skin:) no irritation, no redness , and I have been using it every day . I’m 40 and super stressed about the aging skin issues I have noticed, and though I was able to try this for free, I have now a customer for life!

I had the pleasure of working with influenster and korres to try out the Santorini Grape Poreless skin cream for free in exchange for my honest review. I actually really like this cream. It’s nice and hydrating on my skin! It makes my skin feel smooth and hydrated. I feel like this product would be nice under makeup. The only things I don’t like about this product is the scent. It has a light scent that I feel like doesn’t need to be in the product. Other than that I really like it!

My first impression was impressed with the packaging. You can tell they carefully chose packaging.When I see skincare say for all skin types I get skeptical because I have sensitive skin. However if been using 2 weeks now and no irritation! I have plump an glowing skin! This was complementary for product testing purposes.

I received the mini size in an Ipsy subscription box, and let me tell y’all! This stuff is amazing! I have combination skin that is also acne-prone and this stuff is heaven sent. I was able to use it morning and night for about two weeks of the 10mL version and my skin had noticeably became more plump, pores were less visible, and any dry spots I had vanished! It also made my acne look less irritated so it helped with redness as well. I think I found the perfect moisturizer!

product_name: Hello FAB Coconut Skin Smoothie Priming Moisturizer
review_text: I got a deluxe sample of this and I loved it so much that I purchased the full size. I’ve been using it for a little over a week now and it hasn’t broken me out. It has very fine shimmer in it that makes your skin look illuminated. It smells good, but I wish it smelled more like coconuts.
This toner helps my skin a whole lot. It successfully gotten rid of all of the oiliness and pores in my skin.

I bought this as my first retinol because the formulation is pretty gentle. I use it at night with a niacinamide serum. While I can’t yet speak to the effectiveness of the retinol, it didn’t break me out or cause any dryness or irritation. I do wear sunscreen daily and alternate between this and a chemical exfoliator. I’m not a huge fan of the smell, but it’s not intolerable. It kind of reminds me of stale sweet tea. I’ll probably opt for a more potent formula once I finish this product but I think it’s a great starter retinol.

product_name: Vinoperfect Radiance Dark Spot Serum Vitamin C Alternative
review_text: Omg this serum is amazing I received a tiny bottle for my bday and it’s amazing in just a week my face is plumped, moisturize. When I run out I’m buying a new one ASAP! I get excited to put this on my face it’s that good

I found this cream hydrating for the super dry parts of my face.  I did not like that the smell was dough like or starchy.  It really turned me off.  It’s not the first moisturizer I reach for, but it did make my face feel hydrated.

My skin feels slightly encumbered with this on. After applying it I look a bit like the Tin Man from The Wizard of Oz! I really wanted to like this product but it pills so there’s no pretty glow that some sunscreens can give. The product coming out of the tube is nice and smells like juicy watermelon on a sunny day but it does not blend well. I tried this with my normal essence underneath and it pilled. I tried it with absolutely nothing on my fully dried face... and it pilled. Sunscreen is essential but I’m not sure this is the best one for anyone who: is in a rush or is low maintenance, wears makeup over sunscreen, or has olive or brown skin.
lately I’ve had a redness problem and the first aid stuff really helps. i like the creamy texture of the cleanser. it works great with my clairsonic too.

I use this year round but it is especially wonderful for the winter. My skin gets very dry and cheeks get very red in the winter. This has helped to dimish that greatly. The lotion is slighly thicker then other night creams but it blends into your skin very easily. You wake up with lovely soft skin in the morning. It also has a very mild rose scent which is lovely.

product_name: Mini Cicapair Tiger Grass Color Correcting Treatment SPF 30
review_text: I purchased this after reading great reviews and I’m OBSESSED. It is so creamy and functions perfectly as a color-correcting base/ sunscreen. I personally have mild redness and I don’t like heavy foundations. This perfectly corrects my redness and gives me a natural, dewy glow. It’s the only thing I wear over my serums and moisturizer during the day. I don’t even need concealer under my eyes when I wear it! It will not provide a lot of coverage if you have more vibrant redness or blemishes, but it could also be layered under a tinted moisturizer or light foundation. I really can’t recommend this enough. My one complaint is that it’s not for every shade of skin. I have medium-fair olive toned skin and it blends perfectly, but I don’t know how well it would work on darker skin which bums me out.

product_name: Mini Clarifying Blemish & Oil Control Cleanser
review_text: Fell in love with this cleanser and have been using it for over two years. Recently I wanted to save some money and switched to a drug store acne cleanser. I broke out after 3 weeks! I’m never switching again, this is just the best. It never dries me out, just feels clean and smells amazing.

product_name: Sunshine Vitamin C + Squalane Face Oil
review_text: Very rich and moisturizing formula. I have sensitive skin and had no issues when occasionally using this product on my face/body. I love to add it on my collarbones for a boost of shimmer. When my face is needing some extra moisturizing,  I add it to my serum and mix well before applying all over my face.

product_name: Mini Take The Day Off Cleansing Balm Makeup Remover
review_text: I’ve purchases the large tub about three or four times and a little mini size to keep at our vacation home. I refuse to use anything but this balm when taking off my makeup. Mascara literally slides off of your eyelashes, it’s magic.

product_name: Retinol Firming Cream Treatment with Peptides + Hyaluronic Acid
review_text: This is a great eye cream because I have very dry under eyes. It feels very moisturized and I can mix this with concealer. I love how is blends in very nicely as well and doesn’t feel sticky at all. I love how great results it left on my under eyes.

i’ve loved Dermalogica for the LONGEST time so i was super stoked to test out this product! they’re usually always worth spending the extra coin - of course this did not disappoint! my skin has been drinking it up this winter! my pores are visibly smaller and my skin feels plump! Gifted by Dermalogica - Sephora

product_name: pores no more Vacuum Cleaner Pore Purifying Mask
review_text: It DOES smell just awful. But it really does do what it says it is going to do. I received this in a subscription box and saw results the first time I used it. My pores were visibly smaller and my skin was soft and so clean feeling. I liked the cooling sensation as well. I will sacrifice the bad smell for such an effective product but it may be too much for some people.
review_title: This does what it says it will do

review_text: After using this product for a few weeks I like it. It’s not something I would use as my go to cleanser but when I run out of my cleanser it’s definitely something I would use.
I love this stuff. Really moisturizes. Stays on for awhile. Leaves a tingling mint sensation.

A physical exfoliate I love using. A little goes a LONG way. Make sure to add water and rub in your palms before putting it on your face if you haven’t used it before. My face (and hands) feel so soft and fresh after using this product.  This has been a staple in my skincare. “gifted by Dermalogica Sampling“
Omg. I love it. Nothing else left to say. This cleans, moisturizes, is great for double cleansing.

product_name: Good Genes All-In-One AHA Lactic Acid Treatment
review_text: This is my first ever Sunday Riley product and whoa, am I bowled over. This product has seriously improved my skin - my skin is brighter, more even toned, and noticeably radiant. I’m such a convert. I don’t call anything holy grail - but this might be it.I use it in the night - I read that it works better for your skin that way. I cleanse, tone, apply good genes, followed by moisturizer and some face oil (not Sunday Riley). Really enjoying this, and really recommend it!

I received a sample of Pink Cloud with an order and as other reviewers have mentioned, it does smell like stinky feet. As far as the plumping it gives I’d say that’s fairly good. Moisturizing is no better than other drug store brand I’ve used. There was some pilling and flaking when I used it over a serum. My skin is on the dry side so when putting pro’s and con’s together *too high priced* I’d have to take a pass on this in the future.

product_name: Midnight Recovery Concentrate Moisturizing Face Oil
review_text: Love this and I would definitely recommend

It’s an okay product for me. It does what it claims but it leaves a sticky feeling after applying. Now I use it at night before retinol. One tip I learned and found to be a game changer is applying it on a damp face.
I use the thicker one for the ends of my hair (light on my face) and it’s great! Would highly recommend this! Only use a couple drops though as less is more with this product

product_name: Mini GOOPGLOW Microderm Instant Glow Exfoliator
review_text: A little goes such a long way with this product, which is just one of the amazing things about this product! I have used many microderm exfoliants and this is by far the least aggressive and most effective! It doesn’t leave your skin dried out or distressed. Will definitely be buying more!

product_name: Bye Bye Pores Leave-On Solution Pore-Refining Toner
review_text: You know something is working well when your husband asks what your doing different for your face lol!!!  I used this for about a week and I loved it...then he asked me a few days after what I was doing different bc my face looked “so smooth”?  This is definitely going to be part of my regiment for a long time to come!

I have oily, acne prone, problematic skin and this PTR cleanser does a good job on it. I used it when I was on a trip just because I had a sample mini bottle, not expecting anything great, but it was nice! It smelled nice, it made my skin smooth right after I washed my face and most importantly it prevented breakouts. Not sure about anti-aging effect since I used it only about a week, but it definitely makes skin feels nice and smooth after the wash. It felt like it removed dirt and all the impurities from skin without stripping moisture.

product_name: Lip Sleeping Mask Intense Hydration with Vitamin C
review_text: Leaves my lips dry every time I use it. A lot of the initial ingredients listed (meaning there is higher concentration of these) are petroleum derivatives so this is basically a fancy expensive Vaseline.

I have been using this product for a couple months now and absolutely love it. It leaves the skin so dewy and glowy in such a beautiful way. And I have noticed such a reduction in the amount of oil my skin produces. And my pores look smaller! Amazing product, smells just as great!

I love DE - have become a recent near exclusive convert - but this eye cream u fortunately made me take pause. I was expecting amazing results with the 5 types of vitamin C and the anti-aging peptides. I wanted to see the crepiness and the areas where my concealer unfortunately sinks into become a bit less obvious and perhaps a tad bit brighter healthier skin! However, I saw none of this after using this nightly - I couldn’t wear it in the morning bc it balled up under said concealer. In the mornings I noted no change except a bit of redness and irritation. And this is coming from a woman who can religiously use retin A (not around my eyes!) with no irritation! I also felt that it made my eyes a bit tears and sensitive although I do wear contacts. I thought a clean and natural product would be a bit more gentle than it was. All of this being said, I do love the thick consistency and will finish the bottle using it every other night with a super hydrating cream on the nights in between. I wish I could give a better review but if you have a delicate eye area you may want to look elsewhere than DE, I am sad to say.
I used to steal this stuff from my grandmother, I was so happy to see this and the smell reminds me of being a kid.
I love how this makes my skin feel! I can tell it’s working a few minutes after I put it on my skin.

This is a great cleanser. It has a clean scent and a little goes a long way. I use it as a basic cleanser but if I have full makeup on I use a different cleanser because it doesn’t really give a deep clean that removes all the makeup. Still a great product though!

This is the gentle foam cleanser I was looking for. While cleaning, it is ultra-lightweight and doesn’t dry out my skin. The most positive aspect is that my skin is not stripped after washing. Those of us who have sensitive skin, such as myself, will absolutely love this product!

Have used oil-free products for decades because of oily skin, and am so glad to have discovered Tatcha through a Sephora sample!  This moisturizer is absolutely perfect for oily skin; does the job right and is so pleasant to use (nice light texture and fragrance).  After getting the sample I got the full-size product plus a backup, true love at first sight!

So so good for soothing my eczema prone very combo skin without causing breakouts. It has a pleasant scent. I am 33. My mom is 63 and felt she needed stronger anti-aging skin cream, but I thought it worked great for me. I have bought multiple times.

This product is so amazing for scarring. I suffer from acne scarring in my chin and cheek areas and I tried everything. Murad’s acne line was my saving grace. I use this and the face wash every night before bed and I seriously have seen such a difference in those dark scarring areas. I have repurchased twice now!

This is so soothing and creamy, ive used this for a couple of night and my skin is so plump and hydrated in the morning. It’s quite thick but spreadable and it feels so good on my skin. Very moisturizing Negev used in combination with the serum from the same line.

While there’s a lot of good comments, this product may not be for most people. This product makes my skin feel awful and can result in break out even though I don’t have acne prone skin. An awful smell to it. Quite like fish oil. Do not recommend
i love this oil! it instantly gives my skin a glow! definitely non-greasy
review_title: the most amazing oil ive ever tried

review_text: I just realized that this is the ONLY lip product I’ve ever had where I used a whole container. Not only that, but I’ve bought about 4 of them & used every one up! They last quite awhile, months. I use mine at least once a day. It’s great to use before lip liner & lipstick. It’s like lotion for your whole lip area & makes your lips so soft! It takes a minute to absorb but immediately improves the look & feel of your lips. I definitely recommend it!

I have combination/oily skin and am sensitive to harsh products. I only wear BB cream and Clinique moisturizer, so not a heavy makeup wearer. I normally use CeraVe Foaming Facial Cleanser for Normal/Oily skin and it has been a godsend. However, I saw YTTP advertised and thought..hmm, this looks like it might be a cool new thing, I’ll try it out.Wrong! This does nothing. I’d be better off washing my face with hand soap from the dollar store. It doesn’t remove makeup, it doesn’t foam or lather well, and my face gets oily hours after using it whereas it takes a full day with CeraVe.I could never recommend this for the price. Maybe if it was $5 and someone didn’t wear any makeup at all? *Shrug* I don’t get the hype. I’ll stick with my $15 bottle of CeraVe.

product_name: ICE Ceramide Moisturizer with Vitamin F
review_text: This cream is kind of a heavy cream, so at first I was worried... but it absorbs quickly, and doesn’t have a heavy, greasy feeling to it. A small amount does go a long way, because of the thickness of the cream. I have combination skin, so the greasiness is always a concern for me. It has a bit of a weird smell, but it wasn’t gross or anything, just weird. It didn’t linger, so that was good, also. Since I live in the high desert of Az, I was really hopefull that it would work well for daytime moisturizing, as well as at night, but I think it might be a tad heavy for daytime use, unless you are used to heavy feeling during the day. I don’t wear much makeup daily, so I am not really used to that feeling. I do like using it at night, though, and I wake up with a “fresh“ looking face. All in all, even if only used at night, I would totally recommend this product.

I have no idea why I hesitated for so long to try this! My skin feels so fresh and clean afterwards, but not tight or drying at all! My combo skin has never looked better and have been on the search for quite some time for my HG cleanser. This is it. I don’t recommend it for makeup removal, but otherwise, I don’t think I can go without ever again.

product_name: The Water Cream Oil-Free Pore Minimizing Moisturizer
review_text: I first received several samples from a Tatcha Rep while I was visiting Sephora. I already have my morning and night cream but I’m constantly looking for new products. Whether for myself or for my family. I’m a firm believer that there are multiple skin care lines that fit every budget, you just have to do the research. This cream is will be the next cream I will purchase as part of my daily regimen. The cream is lightweight, moisturizing and blends perfectly with my skin. It doesn’t feel like you have anything on, a little goes a long way.  I don’t know what magic Tatcha puts in their products but this one is worth the buy. It leaves my skin feeling soft and smooth.This water cream leaves your skin with a beautiful glow. It completely removed my dry patches. My skin is interesting: it’s sensitive, prone to blackhead and clogged pores, oily T-Zone but dry everywhere else. This is worth the money, I promise.
The skin feels soft after using it.

I’ve been wearing eye cream since I was 16, so I’m definitely a big believer of eye creams! I dab a good amount around my eyes at night and it leaves me  with plump, well moisturized skin the next morning.
review_title: We all scream for eye cream!

review_text: I do really like this product and I am a fan of belif’s Aqua Bomb products. I just wish this came in a tube. It made my lips feel super soft and hydrated, which is exactly what I expected from belif.
I absolutely love using this collagen night cream along with liquid collagen at night. I wake up with soft and radiant skin in the morning.

product_name: Squalane + Vitamin C Rose Firming Oil
review_text: Pros: smells good, applicator allows you to control how much product comes out at a timeCons: so greasy and takes awhile to absorb, which has caused me to break out a few times after using it. I didn’t see a difference in my skin after a month of use either.

I was so impressed with this product that I gifted to my niece who has been struggling by with acne. It seems to haven’t improved her skin and she said that she like she better to a different brand she had used prior.
review_title: Works for adults and teens alike

product_name: Revitalizing Supreme+ Youth Power Creme Moisturizer
review_text: I received this product from Influenster in exchange for my honest review. I love this product and how it felt on my skin.

I have super sensitive skin and this product does not irritate it at all. I swipe it over my clean face at night and it dries with no sticky residue. It also has a nice refreshing, minty scent to it. Overall I like the product. I have been using it for a few days. Can’t wait to see the results. I do notice my skin feels softer.
Holy grail moisturizer!!!! If you have dry skin this is a MUST buy. It lives up to the claims of keeping your face moisturized for hours without feeling heavy or looking greasy.

product_name: Watermelon Glow PHA + BHA Pore-Tight Toner
review_text: J’adore le produit mais j’ai pris le petit format et je regrette car pour le prix le plus gros en vaut plus la peine car le produit est super bon mais prenez le plus gros format

product_name: Sugar Advanced Lip Balm Intense Hydration Treatment
review_text: I don’t know why so many people love this, I saw no difference in my lips after regular use.

After reading reviews and watching a few tutorials, I decided to buy a gua sha for myself. I’m so happy that I did! If you’re on the fence, I’d recommend investing in one to try it and see what it can do for you. I sleep on my tummy wity my face squished against my pillow, and I retain water especially if I ate anything salty the day before. So most days, I wake up with a puffy and “bloated looking“ face (how fun) Within 5 minutes in the morning, this tool has helped so much to de-puff and rejuvenate my face. I feel more relaxed and the blood flow really helps decongest. I’ll use it at night at times too for a lymphatic massage and to release any tension in the face and neck.  Mount Lai crafted a great little tool, smooth and good quality so I opted for this one because I wanted a reliable product that will last a while.
review_title: A little self care goes a long way

product_name: Original Skin Matte Moisturizer with Willowherb
review_text: I received this to review for free from influenster. I absolutely love the matte moisturizer actually I love them all. But it smells so good. Like grapefruit or Fresca, a little goes a long way and your skin feels baby soft after using

I received this product complimentary from Glow Recipe in exchange for my honest opinion. This is my review after 7 days of consistent usage. The Dew Drops are a gel serum that I find to be a perfect primer for makeup because of the bit tackiness it leaves to the skin. My foundation applied flawlessly over the serum. It took only a few seconds before I felt it was fully absorbed. After 7 days, my skin looked and felt more refreshed and had a significant glow to it. I contribute that to the niacinamide and hyaluronic acid it contains. My favorite way to use Dew Drops is definitely during the day with or without makeup! Don’t forget your SPF!

I struggle with bad acne and oily skin! I read prior reviews after already purchasing this product. I was worried after seeing every body complaining about the texture and how it was gritty! I received the product and the first thing I did was text it out and now see what the disappointment was about. It was nowhere near as gritty as others indicated! I was blown away. The product stung depending on how much I placed on my face. I do the recommended amount and the sting isn’t as bad! I am used to Vitmain C on the skin so I was prepared for it. The grittiness is not as bad as they stated. It sinks in the skin. I use it only for PM since I have such oily skin. So far I loved the results! My face hasn’t been this smooth in over a year! Love the product!
review_title: Misguided off previous reviews! Actually amazing!

review_text: So at first I didn’t think these worked at all because I was using them on little flesh colored bumps on my forehead (not whiteheads, more like little grease balls waaay underneath my skin but they make my forehead look all bumpy. Idk that’s the best description I have) They didn’t work on those. Then I tried to put them on whiteheads that were ready to pop but when I took them off in the morning, they hadn’t taken all of the gunk out. My whitehead was still there. Finally I just decided to try it on some whiteheads I popped and I am soooo glad I did before giving up on these! It sucked all of the liquid and other gross stuff that was still in there after I popped it. My pimples were not raised at all and they were just little scabs and in the healing process!! I was sooo excited! I could see all of the stuff it took out bc the patch was white! My pimples still took some time to heal completely but not waking up to raised pimples that I popped the night before was the most relieving feeling bc I could just easily cover them with some concealer! I know you aren’t supposed to pop pimples but these are the best for pimples you can see are ready to pop and then you pop them and just put one of these on them so they can heal overnight.
review_title: These work well under the right circumstances!

review_text: Amazing product! Makes my skin look so youthful and smooth. I use it as my nightly routine and I wake up glowing. I’m in my mid 30’s with combo skin.

I got a small pot of this in a sample bag. I absolutely love how it smells and how it feels on my lips. Very nourishing and hydrating, without feeling sticky or goopey. I really wish it came in a squeezy tube rather than a pot. I don’t like having to put my finger in it. That’s the only reason I gave it 4 stars. The product, itself, is wonderful.

product_name: Estee Lauder Advanced Night Repair Synchronized Multi-Recovery Complex Serum
review_text: I received a sample in an order and was able to use it over 3 nights. While I didn’t use it long enough to see any visible benefits, it was light and not at all greasy, and left my skin hydrated with a matte finish. I have incredibly sensitive skin and did not react at all. The price is the only real downside otherwise I would probably purchase a full size.

product_name: City Skin Age Defense Broad Spectrum SPF 50 PA++++
review_text: If you hate the feel of sunscreen on your face & the typical smell, you need this in your life. It’s super light weight & has a slight peach tint to avoid any white cast. I feel this goes on smoothly & doesn’t leave any shine behind. It really just feels nice & natural so that I don’t mind using it. I don’t have any issues with foundation laying over it nor has it caused any breakouts. It is small but I like that for travel purposes. It is def on the pricier side but in addition to the mineral sunscreen it also has antioxidants that are good for skin. I like multitaskers. Win, win.

I didn’t expect to see a difference in my under eye area as fast as I did with this product, specially considering I only use it at night. Within 7 days I woke up and I noticed the eye are looked noticeably brighter and smoother. I looked more youthful and well rested - I am on day 13 and have kept those results with daily use of this cream. I  had no irritation whatsoever when using this product. Package is very cute - there’s a cooling applicator built in, but I prefer using my fingers to distribute and tap the cream.

Best cleanser ever. Hands down. I used to make my own face wash because I never liked anything commercial. I was able to stop making it because I discovered this. Elegant formula with gentle surfactants. It cleans very well without stripping your skin. It won’t take off every trace of makeup with your hands, but will with a Clarisonic. If it did clean more, it would just dry out your face. I recommend it to everyone, but my sister says it’s smells weird, being unfragranced. I never noticed because I apparently hold my breath when washing my face (which I never noticed before she complained of the smell). Either way, the smell is not off putting and people shouldn’t really want fragrance in every single thing they use.

Not worth it. It’s so cheap & the convincing reviews will make you want it but please don’t. It’s a very unnecessary product. I tried it out for week straight day & night as it says to. If anything they were getting worse cause I was not using my eye cream. Also I keep getting a white cast around my eye when it dries down ? Most definitely do not apply this before makeup it will make your under eye dry.

product_name: Mini Ultra Facial Moisturizing Cream with Squalane
review_text: The best! I’ve been using it for over a year, and my skin used to be so dry. It has improved the texture of my skin and made it so soft
I love this night cream! It’s lightweight but has the same affects of a typical night cream. The smell is great and not overpowering!

I was really excited to try this mask abs even though I’m not disappointed I’m not completely happy. I try to ready instructions on how to use it properly and I think it is just like any other mask but for some reason it felt weird wearing it just because it does not have that mask texture like other ones I have tried. I love how light it is abs easy to removed also how soft my skin was afterwards, the scent was really nice as well but I would have preferred no scent at all

I really wanted to try this and the rest of the line, but something in every single product irritated my eyes so badly that the scent had me watering all day. I gave up after trying them both altogether and individually. I’m not sure if it’s a fragrance or the scent of a key ingredient, but I couldn’t get past it and couldn’t spend all day in tears either. I will say, it didn’t irritate my skin or make things worse! So there’s a positive.

product_name: Blue Tansy BHA and Enzyme Pore Refining Mask
review_text: I bought this to help with my cystic acne. I didn’t notice a huge reduction in acne itself but I did notice my scars fade much faster when I use it regularly. My expectations for this may have been too high after seeing the reviews but overall I’m happy with it. I love the smell even though it’s weird and it’s also not irritating but it has a gentle burn like any good AHA product.

product_name: Skinlongevity Long Life Herb Anti-Aging Face Serum
review_text: I’ve really enjoyed using this product! It has a great scent and is not over powering at all. I’ve noticed that my skin is looking a lot more refined, which is great! I only had an small issue with the pump I think mine was a bit busted

product_name: Papaya Sorbet Smoothing Enzyme Cleansing Balm & Makeup Remover
review_text: vraiment un bon produit! Bon ingrédients et laisse ma peau douce et soyeuse sans l’agresser. Convient au peau sensible aussi ✨ il suffit de le mélanger avec de l’eau pour obtenir un «lait» qui va vraiment nettoyer en profondeur ! Je recommande !

I am in LOVE! I got this in my ipsy trial and had been using other moisturizers but none compare to this one. I had to buy the full version of this. Sometimes when I’m in a rush for work or to start my day, I use this as a pick me up and it’s perfect! Definitely will keep on buying this moisturizer.
review_title: Definitely will keep on buying this one!

review_text: I received this product in my first box from “Influenster” I have to say I’m VERY impressed. The first time I used it I noticed my skin looked brighter and my skin tone was more even. The second time I used it, 4 days later, my pores didn’t look as deep and dark. Ive been searching for a product to minimize my pores and I can’t believe the difference after 2 uses. & it smells AMAZING which is always a plus!
I was given this product for free in return for an honest review and loved it! It was light which I like for creams. It smelled good but was subtle and not too overpowering. I would use again.

I had super dry skin and this literally made it better and hydrated in two days applying once at night. I apply this at night with my UFO oil. My skin hasn’t been dry since I started using this. I use a more matte moisturizer to last me through out the day since I have oily skin and this kinda leaves a oily look to your skin. But so good to just put on and go to sleep and wake up to hydrated skin ! Love love love !

I must admit that I love multi-use products. I mean who doesn’t want to save time and steps when doing your skincare routine. Who needs such a routine when you can use this Dior Cica Recover & Repair Multi-use Balm. I tried it on my hands first because they are always dry and sensitive. It is a rich, smooth cream but also lightweight and non greasy. I have now used this on my face and neck for two weeks in the morning and evening. This fragrance-free multi-use balm is perfect for my dry and sensitive skin. It soaks into your skin but also somehow leaves it feeling moisturized all day. I will definitely add this to my must purchase list. I highly recommend this product for any skin type.
review_title: One of the best multi-use products I have used.

product_name: Papaya Sorbet Smoothing Enzyme Cleansing Balm & Makeup Remover
review_text: This product smells AMAZING and so refreshing! It completely melts my makeup off. I received this product to review for Influenster, and I am absolutely loving it!

I absolutely love this lipbalm. It is the best I have ever tried. It’s lightweight, smells nice, moisturzing, non-greasy. Kind of suck a bit that I have to use my fingers to apply, but I got over that fast.
This is the best hand and body cream I’ve ever used. It’s a little expensive, but I love it. I highly recommend it. It is not greasy.

I usually really like getting eye serums because I notice a big difference in my under eyes when I use them.  This was no exception.  I really did like this serum and am so happy that I received this complimentary to review from BzzAgent.  Murad is a great skincare brand.  I have always liked everything I have tried from them!

product_name: Perfecting Day Cream Broad Spectrum SPF 30 PA+++
review_text: This was terribly heavy and oily for me. I returned it.

It dried my face so badly and aggravated redness. I bought it for the simple ingredients and was so excited, but it was extremely harsh for my skin. If you have sensitive skin, especially Rosacea, I’d stay clear away from this.
Fave toner makes my skin feel so fresh and clean. I apply this and use it while doing my gua Shua facial massage. A definite staple in my skin care routine <333
Having dry skin and eczema flare up sometimes I Love this sunscreen it’s so smooth and no smell

product_name: Revitalizing Supreme+ Youth Power Creme Moisturizer
review_text: I received a complimentary deluxe sample from Influenster and it lasted 2 weeks. I instantly feel tightness and love how it plumps and hydrates my skin. The formula is thick but not greasy. It absorbed quite well. I highly recommend this product.
This is the only thing I can’t live without. I’ve been using it 4 years and I’ll definitely continue. It makes my skin smooth and radiant. Non greasy and absorbs fast. Love it.
review_title: the only one I keep using

review_text: After a 15 hour flight home from Japan, my dry broken-out skin was so pleased to have Murad’s Replenishing Multi-Acid Peel. (I had a pimple the size of Mount Fuji to prove it!) After using the acid peel and toner at night, my skin felt totally hydrated and glowy in the AM. My breakouts were less enflamed,(Fuji shrunk down thankfully) and the dry redness from traveling decreased. I was gifted this product by Murad, however after seeing the initial results, I’d definitely consider repurchasing!

product_name: The Deep Cleanse Gentle Exfoliating Cleanser
review_text: I was buying the mini due that included the small bottle of Cleanser and the Water Cream. Tatcha is the bomb, as is Kate Somerville. This bottle is huge and a little goes a long way. If you wear a full face like I do, I recommend Clinique Toner afterwards and with a cotton ball to remove any excess makeup/dirt/debris. And once a week the Dr Jart+ microdermabrasion (lightly scrub). Follow up with a nice moisturizer. 4 stars because I think the exfoliKATE does a way better job of removing makeup

Got this with my birthday gift. Was super excited but it smells awful, and its a chunky goop with leaves in it. Used it anyways and it made me break out very badly each time. Doesn’t feel nice on the skin and I had to moisturize immediately after. After I stopped using it the breakouts stopped and cleared up.

I recently received this product for free from Influenster in exchange of my honest review. I must say this made my skin feel very soft and fresh. The sugar scrub is very gentle on the skin and is not at all abrasive like most of the scrubs. There is a very faint lemon scent to the product, I use this about twice a weeks as there are some chemicals to help soothe and exfoliate the skin.
absolute favorite sunscreen for my oily T-zone skin in the humid months!

product_name: Line-Filling Eye Cream with Bakuchiol and Caffeine
review_text: Alpyn Beauty Line-Filling Eye Cream is the perfect addition to my clean beauty skincare routine! I love that it brightens, moisturizes, and fills in those pesky fine lines that are starting to really show on me! I also am thrilled that it is a planet positive product! I highly recommend!
The gold standard in cotton pads. These hold their shape, and are incredibly soft.
So nice but more towards oily skin, i have dry skin and it was kinda drying (but nothing to worry about)

product_name: Mini Barrier+ Triple Lipid-Peptide Face Cream
review_text: I love the way my skin feels so nice when I use this moisturizer. I always use this in the night before bedtime. Only thing that worries me sometime is I am prone to breakout esp with some thick texture. Thankfully I haven’t had issues with breakouts after using this moisturizer ( just saying).

I loved the coconut cleansing wipes, so I figured I would try this. It has two sides- super exfoliating then a much softer side. The exfoliating side actually hurts my skin, its like sandpaper. If you have sensitive skin I wouldn’t buy these.

Bought this hoping to find a cheaper alternative to the St.Tropez bronzing water (of which a bottle lasts me about 1.5 months) and was quite disappointed. The spray bottle is terrible - it is far from a fine mist and sprays in large droplets which is problematic with a sunless tanner. Also, it is extremely tacky and does not dry which leads to smearing and transferring. In an effort to not be wasteful, I have decanted it into an empty St.Tropez bottle so it will at least spray evenly - but honestly thinking I should just return it. The color itself is nice but that’s about it.
review_title: Sticky, smeary and awful spray bottle.

review_text: this was recommended by an instore beauty advisor to use on the days I feel I have dry spots (even though I use the gel and love the gel) but this lotion feels to me like I had a heavy mask on and I had to take it off immediately so I returned it.

I had high hopes for this but it’s honestly the worst cleanser I’ve tried. I won’t bash it for the fact that it gave me red dots all over my face because that is could be my own issue, but aside from that I do not like this formula. It doesn’t lather well, and when I start working it onto my face, it basically melts away to the point where I feel like I’m washing my face with just water. My face was left feeling dirty and still had dead skin flaking off, whereas my drugstore cleanser would have taken that all off. I’m extremely disappointed.

product_name: Mini Watermelon Glow PHA + BHA Pore-Tight Toner
review_text: I really enjoy this product. I was hesitant at first because I have very sensitive skin but my skin loves it! It smells like a watermelon starburst and it really hydrates my face. My pores are visibly smaller and my redness has definitely calmed down. I use it morning and night, depends on how I feel. It does leave a little stickiness but it will fade away.

product_name: The Rice Polish Foaming Enzyme Powder
review_text: Hardly have to use any, feel like this is going to last me a long time, not rough on your face.. feels smooth and fresh after wards.
It works! It keeps the blemishes away and doesn’t dry my skin out. LOVE IT!!

DiorTotale Firming & Wrinkle-Correcting Crème is the saving grace my skin has been looking for.  Elegance at every step from opening the box to the soft smooth feel of the cream.  The lines and wrinkles under my eyes were improved noticeably within just a few days.  I’m in love with how this universal cream texture keeps my skin hydrated and do we looking all day long.  I received this product complementary for testing purposes.  Love love love it!

I tend to have really bad acne and this thing cleared my skin up so fast. Not only that, it also cleared any dark spots I had. I really recommend this item ands it’s a pretty big bottle for its price. Also make sure to wear sunscreen with it.
review_title: Must have for acne prone skin

product_name: Alpha Beta Extra Strength Daily Peel Pads
review_text: I really enjoyed trying Dr. Dennis Gross Skin Care Alpha Beta Extra Strength Daily Peel it let my skin feeling smooth and silky and it looks radiant as well

product_name: Rose & Hyaluronic Acid Deep Hydration Toner
review_text: I have perfectly clear skin and this broke me out really bad. Was hoping it would help hydrate my skin since its dry but it didn’t do anything but break me out. Checked the ingredients list and there’s some GROSS stuff in there, not surprised my skin hated it. Sad because I love the rose moisturizer and eye cream from fresh!

Love this! I have combination skin that tends to be drier in the cold Canadian winter. I’ve tried a number of products and this is the only product I use at night that helps keep my skin moisturizer overnight and soothes the dry patches that occur on my cheeks. The first layer does smell a bit like cucumber but it’s nice and refreshing. the second layer smells more like rose.
review_title: great for dry skin in the winter

review_text: I received this product for free from Influenster and I absolutely love it! The packaging feels and looks so luxurious. The orange-y smell is so satisfying. But the product itself works so nice, my skin still feels soft and hydrated in the morning and keeps my skin hydrated under my makeup all day!

I was gifted this complimentary from Dermalogica for review. My primary skincare concern is firming and antiaging, especially under my eyes. This eye gel applies smoothly and absorbs quickly, and my under eye area feels more firm and hydrated after use. The fine lines also appear noticeably smoother.

I have used the older Sephora cucumber eye masks for years. This new “clean” eye mask resulted in an allergic reaction. After removing the masks, I immediately noticed several hives and redness. I would not recommend for sensitive skin.

product_name: Mini Liquid Silk Canvas: Featherweight Protective Primer
review_text: Love it! I got it from Influenster to try it out and I honestly fell in love with it!

my dry,  sensitive skin LOVES this cleanser!  it feels so luxurious and nourishing,  the perfect prep for treatments,  makeup,  moisturizer,  etc.   pleasant scent,  non drying,  worth every penny.   I will always repurchase.
I am so in love with this product! I haven’t broken out in since using this! Makes you skin feel nice. Worth the money.

This is the only thing I’ve ever used that has cleared the stubborn blackheads on my nose! I was suspicious because I didn’t “feel“ anything while it was on...no burning of tingling which I usually take to mean it’s working. But I noticed improvement as soon as I rinsed it off and my skin looked even better the next morning. And it smells nice. Very happy to have discovered this!
I love the texture to help my pregnancy hormonal acne ive been experience these past 2 weeks . Helped clear up any active acne with out any scarring issues

product_name: Midnight Recovery Concentrate Moisturizing Face Oil
review_text: I really like this product I actually wake up with glowing skin and my skin feels very hydrated. I would recommend getting the mini size first because it has a lot and Ive had it for about a month now and there’s still a lot in it

I wanted to like this product as a cleanser but I don’t. The balm separated so there is always an oily liquid that comes out before the balm, shaking… if you remember, does help this. The balm is like an ointment consistency, it feels like you are applying diaper cream to your face. Makeup is melted away, particularly waterproof eye products but I found I had to use a cleansing cloth to remove everything. Skin is soft and this balm is gentle, it seems to be quite difficult to rinse off the skin. Unless I washed my face, at least twice, with another cleanser… this remained as a greasy layer. For extremely dry skin, I imagine this would be really loved. For me, I can’t stand the greasy feel, the oily separation and the residue feel.

I have normal/combo skin and I used this product for a few days to see the results. Right away it absorbed straight into my skin leaving no residue behind, it has a very unique light weight texture that’s quick absorbing. My skin felt soft and light and not weighed down. Later on in the day I noticed that my skin continued to feelmoisturizer and hydrated. This would be a good formula to use during the summer months, or if you live in a very humid area,  but I would not recommend for super dry skin or for dryer months for combo skin.
Do not spend your money on this, such a small bottle for so much. It was very ineffective for helping clear up my skin and if anything made things worse.  I do not recommend.
I am almost through my second bottle of this and I will continue to buy it! This moisturizer is perfect for summer as it gives such a nice glow and immediately makes my skin look so radiant.
I can tell a difference just after using a week. A must have!

I have little-no acne now, I when I have small breakouts, I use this at NIGHT only.  It really dries out the skin, but the redness and zit (essentially) is gone overnight.  It’s crazy strong.  This is not a product you can slather all over your face; this is a SPOT treatment, so you should only place it on the problem spot, not the whole area.
i bought this stuff for my hair. it is pure argan oil and does not contain all of the chemicals in the hair serum from this line. it is not greasy at all and really improves hair condition.

product_name: Hyaluronic Marine Makeup Removing Meltaway Cleanser
review_text: I have been looking for a product that will remove my makeup and also leave my skin feeling hydrated. This product does all that and more. It is easy to use and to  take with you when you are on the go. I use it in the morning as a cleanser and in the night to remove my makeup. I love this product!

LOVE this moisturizer. No weird smell, not greasy or irritating in any way. Cloud like texture that sinks in to your skin. I usually have to moisturize 2 or 3 times in the winter, but with this one application and I can start my makeup. My only complaint is the small size - would love to see a double or triple size available!

product_name: Smart Clinical Repair Wrinkle Correcting Eye Cream
review_text: I received this #freeproduct from Topbox Circle. I’ve been having issues with fine lines around my eyes so was looking forward to see the result. It’s easy to apply and doesn’t feel oily at all. After using it for couple of weeks, I do see the fine lines fading away by a bit. Would love to continue using it to see any big difference

Gave a wonderful color when applied but came off super patchy, looked like I had vitiligo. The smell is horrendous and lingered around for several days. The pump is difficult to use and got stuck several times so my index finger was extra tanned from trying to use the pump. Will be difficult to use for a first timer because it goes on clear and will look streaky is spots are missed. Will not be repurchasing. Will stick to St. tropez.

product_name: 24K Gold Pure Luxury Lift & Firm Hydra-Gel Eye Patches
review_text: These patches are worth your buck! Yes yes I know they’re $70 ish but I mean just use em while needed. For example, if you have a big day ahead of you wear those patches and you’ll feel an instant depuff, with in time they also reduce wrinkles. They’ll illuminate your under eye to give a fresh look and feel. The 24k gold is meant to renew that under eye! I wear these while I do my make up or while I’m cleaning my house. Best investment yet!

A little goes a long way with this. I have combination skin and hyperpigmentation from mild acne scarring. It’s been a couple of weeks and the hyperpigmentation is going away. I really, really like this product. My fine lines are visibly lessened and my skin is dewy. It sits well under makeup and absorbs in a decent amount of time. Will repurchase.

I received this product as an incentive for my honest feedback. I haven’t really noticed any changes just yet. I need to continue using it regularly to experience or notice change. However, the product made my ship feel a little tight. I didn’t notice there was no noticeable fragrance.
review_title: Will continue to use for effects

product_name: Mini Deep Cleanse Gentle Exfoliating Cleanser
review_text: I truly love this product, I always say I am going to find something less expensive as the bottle is about to run out so I buy another product then end up rebuying this because I find myself missing it. I think it is just time to give up the search and admit to myself I am just going to keep using it. I would without a doubt recommend this product!
review_title: Giving up trying to find a replacement.

review_text: I was super excited to try this new serum from Dermalogica as it’s hands down a new generation of serums. It’s able to determine the needs of your skin (hydration, brightness, soothing or fine lines) and provide what’s your skin needs at this particular moment. I’ve been using this serum for a couple of weeks now and I can see the improvements already. My skin feels hydrated and the dark spots on my forehead are getting lighter every day. My fines lines haven’t changed that much, but I believe I need to give it a little bit more time.The texture of the serum is super lightweight, it absorbs in seconds and doesn’t leave any sticky film on the surface. And it works nicely with all my other skincare items. A+

product_name: Pure Argan Milk Intensive Hydrating Treatment
review_text: THIS IS SO GOOD FOR DRY SKIN. I haven’t been able to use anything to make my dry skin go away but after one application of this stuff it went away completely 10/10 would recommend

eceived this item complementary for testing purposes but this is my real review. This item was great on my skin . Most cleansers either dry my skin out completely or does not clean it effectively. This product left my skin clean without drying it out

I’ve been using this cleanser for awhile now it’s always been my safe go to. I have very sensitive skin almost everything makes me break out. This cleaner is so gentle for the skin, cleans and softens extremely well. I have a red under tone on my cheeks and haven’t seen an improvement as the product description says it targets. But other than that I am happy with the product and would recommend!
i have dry skin and love this cream..wish it have anti wrinkle but still love it!!!
I love how this product is super hydrating and doesn’t dry out my skin like other tones have.
I really like this product. I have never tried this brand before so I was super excited to try it.

product_name: Vitamin Enriched Face Base Priming Moisturizer
review_text: I really like this product a lot! The packaging is beautiful and the consistency of the product is so moisturizing. It’s an incredible base before applying makeup and will continue to recommend to my friends!

This stuff had no effect on me whatsoever. It just felt heavy and greasy on my skin and didn’t play nice with my other face treatments. They give you a lot of product, but a lot of product that does nothing.
Received this as the birthday gift along with the serum and loving both!

product_name: CC Me Vitamin C + Niacinamide Serum
review_text: This product smells nice and has really nice packaging, but unfortunately it did cause my skin to break out within a day of using it. I think this form of vitamin C really does not work with my skin, which is a shame. I am sure that for other people this product can show results, but it definitely isn’t compatible and non-irritating for all skin types.

I purchased this moisturizer on a whim. The description and the fact that the packaging is refillable we’re all a plus. WARNING: once you use it, you’ll never want to use anything else. Tata Harper hit a home run with this formula. The texture is sublime. It absorbes and leaves your skin hydrated but not oily. This is a truly modern approach to skin care. It feels great knowing that you can take care of your skin with a luxurious product, from a brand that cares about the planet. A win win on my book!

I’m a mom so my go to “makeup wipe” is usually a Huggies baby wipe. That being said, I received a Coconut Water Cleansing Wipe with a Charcoal Exfoliating Wipe as a sample with my recent purchase. The Coconut Water Cleaning Wipe has a pleasant smell, that’s isn’t overwhelming, it is SUPER soft and removed my makeup almost effortlessly, and left my face feeling clean and soft. The Charcoal Exfoliating Wipe also has a pleasant not overwhelming smell. For me, it was the perfect degree of roughness for exfoliation. It helped to remove a decent amount of stuff from my pores. I will definitely be making the switch to these wipes over my usual baby wipe go to.

product_name: Watermelon Glow PHA + BHA Pore-Tight Toner
review_text: I received this complimentary from Influenster! I love how it makes my skin feel and I love the glow I wake up with in the morning. The only thing I dislike is the smell- in my opinion it smells like the skin of a watermelon not the juicy goodness inside. It’s not a terrible smell, just not what I expected. Overall, the product is great!

product_name: Cicapair Tiger Grass Color Correcting Treatment SPF 30
review_text: I was so excited to try this after hearing so many great things about it. However, the second I put it on my skin, it turned an awful shade of yellow/orange, clung to my dry patches like crazy (even after moisturizing beforehand), and looked like cakey, thick foundation on my skin. Super disappointed! Will be returning.

product_name: SEA Mermaid Skin Hyaluronic H2O Serum
review_text: This is an amazing product to add to a hydration routine if you have dry skin. For me, it cannot work alone but it create a dewy, soft feel when coupled with other products. Great for days when you want a light hydration boost sitting on your skin.

product_name: The POREfessional Tight ’n Toned Pore-Refining AHA+PHA Toner
review_text: This product was gifted by Benefit. After using this, it helps tighten up my pores and cleared up my skin. It makes my skin feels more hydrated. It absorbs quickly and applies easily with fingertips..

product_name: Argan Beta Retinol Pink Algae Serum
review_text: I really like this product so far. It brightens my skin and doesn’t have any weird smells or side effects. I’ve only been using this for a couple weeks so not quite long enough to see full effects but I have faith it will do as it says. I also like I have the option to use day or night. Great addition to my routine.

product_name: Black Tea Anti-Aging Moisturizer with Retinol-Alternative BT Matrix
review_text: I have sensitive skin so I was a little nervous to try this. Wow was I impressed. The texture is rich and creamy, and the packaging is stunning. I put it on my bare, clean skin to get the full effect. I woke up with soft, supple skin. Gifted by Fresh

product_name: Take The Day Off Cleansing Balm Makeup Remover
review_text: I have oily/combo skin so I use a lot of primers and products targeted for my skin type, which means they can be stubborn with removal. An associate recommended I try this product because I found that a makeup remover wipe and washing my face wasn’t cutting it. The product texture is weird and can be gritty. My biggest problem is it doesn’t really remove my waterproof/resistant eye products, instead leaves a film in my eyes! I also find it makes my eyes tear a lot in my sleep which causes extra build up and dry tears in the morning despite frequent cleansing and flushing with water. This has ruined many a pair of contacts- even if I’m not wearing them when I use the product. Do not buy.

I have very sensitive skin and and despite that, I do a lot of things to make my skin worse - I don’t sleep enough, stress out waaaay too much, drink too much caffeine and alcohol just to name a few. This left my face in a terrible state (red, flaky rashes across the cheeks and forehead and I was looking for something to not only help but to heal. This in combination with HUM skin heroes honestly transformed my skin. In a matter of days, my skin looked and felt better than it had in years and now I don’t even put make up on some days. I still have a long way to go to get my skin to where I want to to be, but this helped create such a positive change that I cannot recommend it enough to everyone.
Don’t know why they changed the formula. Now it’s not even a lipstick, it’s just a hard wax stick, and smells chemical.
review_title: Can’t even call it a lipstick

product_name: Mini Superberry Hydrate + Glow Dream Mask
review_text: Liked the texture and scent, but think it’s a bit too thick and slightly too oily on the skin. Wake up with more oil on my nose than usual every time I use it. For reference, my skin is combination & slightly sensitive. But, this is a very good hand creme. Actually the best hand creme I’ve ever used ( I’ve tried at least 6 different brands haha)
review_title: not so good on face but wonderful on hands

review_text: Makes my skin feel so clean and it smells amazing!
Has really improved my texture issues on my forehead, does not leave my skin dry. Would recommend to any with texture that are not pimples.

product_name: Mochi Mochi Luminous Plumping & Hydrating Moisturizer

product_name: Urban Environment Oil-Free Sunscreen Broad-Spectrum SPF 42
review_text: It’s amazing. Super moisturizing. Makes my skin so glowy on a no makeup day. Glides on smoothly. Love that it has sweat/water resistance. I honestly can’t say enough great things. Usually I use Cerave cream to restore my barrier but I thought I’d try this one out in exchange for an honest review. It is subpar in comparison to cerave in my opinion. It’s very greasy with its finish and I find it does not soak in very well and sits on the surface of my skin like petroleum jelly products do. I actually notice my skin is less hydrated and more tight in the mornings. I used this in conjunction with the DeliKate serum, as the steps recommend. I like that it’s fragrance free and a little goes a long ways but some of the ingredients I find unnecessary. I would not buy this at its price point and will continue to use the Cerave cream as my “recovery cream” if you will. It is far more inexpensive and effective. Don’t waste your money if you’re serious about skin.

review_text: While I really enjoy this product, I’m not convinced that it’s worth the hefty price.  Perhaps it has fine ingredients, but I don’t see any compelling changes in my skin or makeup. I wouldn’t recommend using as a facial mist because it’s irritating, but if you like the scent you can recreate it easily, and for a lot less. review_text: I think the reason I don’t always trust a ton of negative reviews on here about people breaking out from this product is because you never know what products people are pairing with this mask... from what I’ve learned, if using this mask, it’s meant to be used BY ITSELF, once a week, with the exception of adding marula oil/moisturizer after using it. It shouldn’t be used with any other acids/retinoids because that may cause irritation/breakouts! Also, I think there’s a common misconception that you need a TON of product from a mask for it to work - that’s DEFINITELY not true with this mask! You only need a very thin layer, and it should be kept on for 20 mins max, even less for those with sensitive skin! Personally, I usually have both sensitive and acne-prone skin, and this mask has been a life saver for me! Every time I use it (which is no more than once a week), my skin is extremely soft & my pores are basically non-existent - pretty no blackheads the day after using it! It’s definitely a strong exfoliant mask, but worth it if you use it correctly/listen to your skin & it’s reaction. One tip: avoid putting it on open wounds on your face (aka popped pimples)- it will burn very badly & it definitely won’t help. P.s., got most of this^ info going through the drunk elephant Instagram and thoroughly reading their advice/tips about using their products! They make many posts and respond to many questions on their Instagram, a lot of which isn’t actually on their website.

review_text: This was one of the first products I purchased from The Ordinary, as it touted numerous benefits for my congested/acne-prone, oily, sensitive, mature skin. I’ve been battling various degrees of acne and oiliness for over 2 decades. When I wasn’t dealing with active acne, I still had nasty hyperpigmentation; purple discoloration on my otherwise very pale face. They take months to disappear and as I’m nearing my 40s, it takes even longer to heal. In the last year I revamped my previously minimalist skincare and started incorporating multiple steps like that of Korean skincare, and adding a few simple but effective products like those from The Ordinary. I avoid fragrances, alcohols, and other potentially unnecessary or irritating ingredients and have found that proper pH is extremely important.The true turning point in my new skincare regime was adding in this niacinamide serum. I’d been poking around on YouTube researching skincare and listened to the recommendations of Wayne Goss and George Popovic, both of whom had absolutely awesome things to say about it and the brand. In George’s case, he reported his results after 7 and 10 months of regular use on acne-prone, oily skin and I was sold. While my oiliness had shown some improvement with the initial changes in my skincare routine, this serum literally slaked it. A couple of drops in the morning (I only use it in the a.m.), after I wash and tone, I pat this on my trouble areas and go about the rest of my routine. Incredible. My pores are less noticeable, the congestion is gradually disappearing, the discoloration is fading fast, and where I would normally be an oil slick by the end of the day, I simply have a healthy glow. I’ve since purchased other Ordinary products, all of which I’ve found to be fabulous and inexpensive. My true ride or die products are the niacinamide serum and the rose hip seed oil.

review_text: This sunscreen is beautiful in terms of texture and finish. It blends into my skin perfectly and has a really nice tint for fair to light skin. I also don’t mind the feel of it on my skin throughout the day--I have combination skin, so it can be a struggle to find sunscreens that don’t suck the life out of my face OR make me feel like a greaseball.Unfortunately, this SPF has two major drawbacks that I simply cannot move past. First is the ungodly smell--I’m used to natural scents and fragrance-free products (my entire skincare routine is free of fragrance), but the scent of this “unscented“ product is awful. My boyfriend described it best--it smells like a mildew-y towel that you haven’t washed in a long time. The first time I wore this, my bf said that he wondered if I had just used a mildew-y towel to dry off with after my morning shower! This is more than just a slight, natural odor--it’s strong, and others around me can smell it too.The second dealbreaker for me is the price of this SPF. I care very much about the long-term health of my skin, so I’m often willing to splurge on sunscreens and serums in particular.
