I’ve only been using this retinol serum for two weeks and I’ve already noticed some differences in my skin. The lines on my neck are less prominent and the overall texture of my skin has evened out. This retinol is effective without being overwhelming for my skin, which I really appreciate.
Really light great oil to use before make up or integrate into your skin care routine. I like it more than other facial oils I have tried this one is my #1.

product_name: Pure Argan Milk Intensive Hydrating Treatment
review_text: I got a sample in the Josie Maran 500 points box and I love it!! It’s not greasy, feels silky smooth on skin and hydrates like nothing else I have tried. I loved it so much I purchased a full size bottle. There is only one down side to this product and that’s the dropper, it doesn’t work well. They should really redesign the dropper and the bottle, I would like to see when I’m running low so I can reorder before running out.

product_name: C.E.O. Vitamin C Brightening Rich Hydration Moisturizer
review_text: This was an okay moisturizer, but I definitely expected better from Sunday Riley. It did moiturize my face, and make it soft, but I really didn’t like how thick it was. It was very hard to spread, which means that I had to use quite a bit of the product.

product_name: Mini Adaptogen Deep Moisture Cream with Ashwagandha + Reishi
review_text: A small bit goes a long way. This lasted me for almost 2 months. It’s very weightless and I like the texture. Although I felt like it had a hard time absorbing into my skin unlike other creams.

product_name: Mini Take The Day Off Cleansing Balm Makeup Remover
review_text: I wanted to like it, but it made me breakout, even though it’s for sensitive skin.

The smell is fantastic. i do love the gloss it gives on your lips. i find it more sticky than glossy. i prefer things i put on my lips to be buttery smooth. the color was also not my favorite. but it wasn’t too bad.

Whoa! I am IN LOVE with these complimentary products i was sent to try. So my thoughts are : the mask is extremely nourishing and left my skin literally glowing for hrs. The serum/toner is more of a serum , actually, and works perfect as a day time routine for me - light, hydrating and nourishing. Love them ! Grateful to be part of this campaign 🙏🌺 #complimentary #Ceramidin @Influenster @drjart

product_name: Mini Abeille Royale Advanced Youth Watery Oil
review_text: So I received this for free for review, but I wasn’t expecting to love it because I have never had an oil product that I didn’t have some kind of issue with. My skin just doesn’t like them usually. For reference, I have eczema and sensitive skin. First of all...the packaging. It’s gorgeous! I felt like I was opening some fancy-pants rich lady stuff. The bottle is stunning and feels expensive. Now, the product (because that’s what matters most.) The little gold bits were interesting and at first I thought hmmm is this to make me think it works but really does nothing? I should have taken before and after pictures. I put two drops on my fingers and then put the oil on my skin. It has a texture much more watery than most oils (I guess that’s why it’s called watery oil haha) but two drops does my face and neck. What was so special about this? It soaked in. Like all the way. I wasn’t oily after. But I was moisturized. VERY moisturized. My skin looked supple. I’m 36 years old, supple-looking skin isn’t a given anymore. I usually have to use three or four products to achieve that. This did it on its own. What surprised me even further is that there is fragrance in this. I almost didn’t use it and was going to decline to review because of how fragrant it is and my skin is NOT a fan of fragrance. I have to put perfume on clothes. My skin didn’t react badly at all. It wasn’t a one-off either, I use it most nights and I always have the same result. I definitely notice a difference when I don’t use it which is bad for my wallet haha. What is this stuff??? I don’t know how Guerlain did it, but they defied my skepticism in each category and I can’t give them a fail in any area. Well done! I’m sold! I received this product complimentary for review purposes.

I bought this product when my hair was just below shoulder length (I’ve since cut it short). I have wavy, color-treated hair, and needed something to keep if feeling soft and supple.The feel and smell of this product are great, and I loved it on my skin, but it seemed that no matter how little of it I put on my hair, it just wouldn’t absorb properly, and I was left with stringy, oily looking hair.I ended up giving it to my niece, who is mixed race and has beautiful, very curly hair, and it works great for her, so I’m assuming something about this product just didn’t work for my white girl hair. YMMV

i have been using the moisturizer for 3 years now. it is the only moisturizer that does not feel heavy on my skin and make me break out/get oily. my skin is dry, with the occasional break out, this moisturizer soaks in quickly and leaves skin dewy and soft, not waxy or heavy. great for the summer months. i knocked off one star because during the cold, dry, winter months i need to apply several layers to achieve the same effect.

product_name: The Silk Canvas Protective Primer Mini
review_text: This is a nice size to try out the product. I like the texture and it feels nice on my skin, but I really don’t feel like it makes a difference. I haven’t been a believer in primer and this hasn’t convinced me otherwise.
I enjoyed this product as I am very sensitive to smell, and it did not have anything strong, floral, or perfume-y. It made my dry skin feel very soft and healthy.

This is the first toner I’ve ever used and I have no reason to switch. It has completely changed my skin and helps it stay clear since I’m very acne prone. It leaves a very cool menthol feeling on your face which I find very refreshing. It hasn’t dried out my face, but moisturizing is part of my daily skin care regime. (This moisturizer in this skin care line was decent, but there are better in my opinion)

product_name: Clear Improvement Charcoal Honey Mask to Purify and Nourish
review_text: This product left my skin feeling great. I think the smell is lovely. You can actually smell the natural honey which makes me feel like I’m using a wholesome product. It can get quite messy but that’s all part of the fun! Saw radiant, smooth, balanced looking skin after using it. I would have never thought to try out this product had a company not sent it to me. I will be repurchasing!

I bought this because I have it in the tin, but it didn’t always feel sanitary putting my fingers in it while out and about. SO glad I got it in a tube! I use it everyday, and it leaves my lips so soft, and smells like a hint of rose. For the price, I’ll be buying this again and again.

product_name: Rose & Hyaluronic Acid Deep Hydration Toner
review_text: I was not a fan of this product. I used it for 4 weeks and it was very oily for a toner, but I gave it a chance. I tried to look past the oiliness and noticed that my pores were more blocked than usual when I was using this. This was the only thing I changed in my routine. They should market this as more of a hydrating face oil than a toner. It didn’t make my skin feel clean.

I personally wasn’t impressed with this. The moisturizer was a little too oily the smell was a little overbearing and the exfoliater was a little too harsh on my skin. Felt like I was washing my face with cinnamon. Over all I wouldn’t pay for this product. Luckily I got it free thanks to Influenster. I got to try before I buy.
Excelente peeling químico, ayuda mucho en la eliminación de manchas
Product has a great scent and leaves my skin feeling clean but not dry.

product_name: Mini Barrier+ Triple Lipid-Peptide Face Cream
review_text: I received this as a free sample through Sephora and I am hooked. I had such irritated skin, prone to irritation from any and every product, in addition to having acne-prone skin. This has calmed my skin down so much, made it so smooth, and clear. I really think my skin barrier on my face was compromised. I purchased the full size of this product. So worth every penny. BUY THIS!

product_name: Indigo Overnight Repair Serum in Cream Treatment
review_text: What a great moisturizer! First off I love how it’s a combo of a serum and moisturizer because it makes my rougher effective and short! I’ve used the cream for about a week at night only. My skin can get sensitive and red but this product helped even put my skin tone in one week! I look forward to the long term effects of this product!!!
review_title: A Must Try For Redness Skin

product_name: Ultimate Sun Protector Lotion SPF 50+ Sunscreen
review_text: This product is amazing. This sunscreen is a lilttle runny but it blends well with your skin. You dont have to use alot. It makes my skin feel smooth and amazing.

This stuff works great as an all-over treatment and as a spot-treatment, but if using as an all-over mask, take care to rinse off as much of the product as you can with a damp washcloth first before splashing your face with water, otherwise too much of the product can get in your eyes, and it can irritate your eyes for several hours after use.
review_title: Incredible, but take care of your eyes

review_text: This lip balm makes my lips feel great. The stick looks small but that tube last a very long time. Love it.
Skin feels smooth and refreshed. Scrubbing beads are small and effective. Highly recommend!

It feels very nice on skin and gives healthy and fresh feeling after using this. Skin feels hydrated and rejuvenated after applying and gives nice glowing skin. I will purchase it again and I recommend it to others.

I love Josie’s Argan oil. I was very skeptical to use this because it’s an oil but I’m so happy I gave it a try. I have extremely sensitive and dry skin and was having issues for the past year with dry patches that would appear as soon as I put foundation on. I have tried different products and this was a winner. I have been using it for 2 months now. I wear it alone at night after cleansing and then in the morning I wear it on top of my moisturizer. It works really well as a primer. I don’t have dry patches anymore. By the way, I also have First Aid Beauty to thank since I use the cleanser and moisturizer in combination with the argan oil. Also, it has a pleasant smell.

I finally stopped using this after my hubby asked why the black eyes. Like many reviews, I ended up with fine lines that i I never had before and under my eyes was also red and burned. I had a live chat with the company who said to use every other day and use their other eye cream in between. So digging in more I spent $65 on the vitamin c cream which was better but using this, every other day was still irritating, and the lines under my eyes continue to get worse. I got a facial. They advised me to immediately stop using it which clearly I should’ve done earlier. I foolishly assumed retinol wouldn’t cause wrinkles but I can under your eyes. Sadly I’m past being able to return it . Don’t buy!

I’ve been looking for something that would make my pores disappear, minimize, whatever you wanna call it and I have to say this does it. I only use at night by rubbing between palms and lightly patting on face and neck. I have combination skin so I put a little extra on the T zone and it works for me. With this Texas humidity this works wonderful. Not to keen on the price but everything come with at a cost and I’ll probably stick with it seeing this would last me a really long time. Smell isn’t bad like some reviews. Even for my breakouts I apply a little extra and it reduces them rather nicely, unlike some other reviews. Overall I’ve seen an improvement with my complexion and pore shrinkage even for keeping my pores clean.

This serum activator HAS ACTIVATED my quest for healthier, more glowy skin! I’ve been wanting to find a product that can help me in my skincare journey to more plump, moisturizer, firm skin. I’ve been using this product and I have seen a dramatic transformation take place and it’s beautiful everyone and their mother and grandmother needs this product to stay confident in their skin. This was gifted by Sulwhasoo
Finally made the jump from $20 minis to the full size. This was the best birthday sample I ever got. I am thrilled to have so much of my favorite face cream and so is my skin.

I received this as a sample via Influenster’s Voxbox program. This product helped to remove left over stubborn makeup. I am a big fan of the Belief brand. I also like cleansing balms to help remove dirt and makeup. The Aqua Bomb line is always on point so I had faith that this was going to be good too. I am probably going to purchase the full size. Great product!!
This stuff really works! Shrinks blemishes and exfoliates the skin! I swear by it. I apply it right before bed and let it do its magic over night!

product_name: B-Hydra Intensive Hydration Serum with Hyaluronic Acid
review_text: My skin has been very dry during my pregnancy. This has helped tremendously. I actually bought this in the mini, then purchased the full size, and received a full size free from influenster. I use this in the morning and usually mix it with the c-firma. I think this is one of the better priced drunk elephant items. I’ve used intense moisturizers while pregnant but I was still getting dry patches until I used this.
This stuff is awesome, it gives me the best glow and is so hydrating. Definitely recommend!
Really  impressed with the little bumps and how great they work and feel.

product_name: Mini Deep Cleanse Gentle Exfoliating Cleanser
review_text: This cleanser is a holy grail for me. It’s the perfect gentle cleanser but has some fine little exfoliating particles in there. It’s not a scrub by any means, but it is definitely for a deeper clean, yet isn’t stripping at all. It leaves my oily, sensitive skin feeling soft and smooth after washing it. However, the packaging is such a nightmare, and for the price I wish Tatcha would consider repackaging it or adding a pump. I found myself wasting more than half of the actual product, which is ridiculous for a $38 cleanser.The problem with the actual packaging is you have to squirt the product out, but it’s hard to actually get it to dispense enough, and when it finally does enough comes out for three uses. I end up having to let half the product go down the drain because I can’t use it all, and it’d be unsanitary to just throw it back into the bottle. If I store it upside down it helps the product come out a bit better, but it’s hard to control how much actually squirts out. It’s just very wasteful. I’d much prefer a pump on this, and until it has different packaging, I won’t be repurchasing.
review_title: Won't Be Repurchasing, Even thought I Love it

product_name: Beauty Elixir Prep, Set, Glow Face Mist
review_text: For some reasons I am very fond of spray products for my skin or my hair. Maybe that’s for lazy person. Anyway, this Elixir is just FANTASTIC! The splitz is very fine and all over, very evenly distributed. Then the scent is just heavenly! The feel is clean, cooling, hydrating, calming and so forth. I will never not have this product on my vanity. MUST HAVE!!!

product_name: Sugar Advanced Lip Balm Intense Hydration Treatment
review_text: I live in a cold climate so my lips tend to get really dry especially in the winter. This immediately helps with any chapped lips. I like the smell, but I do wish they would do something about the taste.

Moisturizer is the one product I can’t find the right one of for my skin. Until now. Yes the price is expensive, but a little goes a very long way so this will last you a long time.What I find surprising and wonderful about this product is its ability to smooth my skin overnight! It’s like it has an invisible exfoliator in it. I put it on at night and I wake up with such smooth skin. It seems to really combat that sensitive redness I get from washing my face.The description says no oily residue feeling...this is true after you let it absorb. I do feel like it seems a bit oily when I first apply it, but it seems to be completely gone within five minutes.The reason I gave it four stars is because I HATE the packaging. I do not find this type of dispenser convenient or even sanitary. Because the moisturizer is so thin, I don’t like this dispense method for this particular product.

product_name: Green Clean Makeup Meltaway Cleansing Balm Limited Edition Jumbo
review_text: Great clean. Soft scent. Doesn’t burn or dry out my skin.
I love this mist. I use it as a setting spray everyday! Makes my skin glow! Obsessed. Just purchased my second bottle!

When I applied this moisturizer at night (after washing my face with CeraVe’s hydrating wash and applying the ordinary’s hyaluronic acid serum), this caused my face to tingle quite a bit. My skin seemed a little flushed. In the morning, it was okay, but seemed drier than usual. For my morning routine, I did the same as the evening but applied sunscreen on top. The product was flaking and pilling quite a bit throughout the day. With my normal moisturizer (FAB or CeraVe) this doesn’t happen. After checking the ingredient list, these so many potential things that could have irritated my skin. I didn’t even want to continue using it since I was afraid it would continue to irritate my skin or cause me to break out. Also, it pills, yuck. Would never purchase this for the price, there are so many better, simple, cheaper moisturizers out there that aren’t filled with crap. I received this complementary in exchange for my honest review.
review_title: Got sensitive, acne-prone skin? Skip it sis

product_name: Hello Results Wrinkle-Reducing Daily Retinol Serum-in-Cream
review_text: Ive been using this IT Cosmetics Hello Results Wrinkle-Reducing Daily Retinol Serum-in-Cream for about a month now and I can say I have seen some improvement in my skins overall appearance. The retinol did cause me a few days of flaking, dry skin but once that passed, my skin was looking radiant, firm and Ive seen a slight reduction in the fine lines on my forehead. The product itself is a nice light texture,  and absorbs well into my skin. Love the packaging with the push release of the product so you dont ever get more than you need. It has a light scent that isnt overwhelming. Im excited to continue to use this to see how my skin continues to improve

This product has impressed me enough that I will stay loyal to it as my main night cream unless the formula changes. My skin type is combo, and I have VERY sensitive skin with acne and a lot of rosacea/flushing. I’m also experiencing wrinkles becoming deep set, so my primary goal is to help the wrinkles. I’ve used this continuously for about a month now, and notice my skin texture is so much better. The wrinkles are not as deep! I don’t expect any product to completely erase my wrinkles, so I’m grateful and impressed this one has actually made a difference so quickly.Not only that, but it doesn’t make me break out! All retinol products I’ve tried have caused acne, but this cream doesn’t clog my pores or irritate my skin. I’d even say my rosacea looks better, which is surprising considering this cream is strongly fragranced. It has a nice smell, though.

I received this sample from Influenster and have been using it for the last 10 days. I disagree with the “whipped” description because it is definitely a heavy cream in my opinion, too heavy for daytime (at least in summer). I’ve been using it as a night cream over my usual actives and it’s been lovely! It goes on a bit thick but isn’t greasy, and leaves my skin hydrated, plump, and glowing by morning! It hydrated so well I’ve been able to skip my daytime moisturizer at least a few times. The only negative is that the name seems like a ripoff of Sunday Riley Good Genes.

product_name: Rose & Squalane Deep Hydration Oil-Infused Serum
review_text: I wanted to like it because I hear good things about rose oil but I think this broke me out a little. Not big zits or anything just slight irritation and some itty bitty pimples but still...I haven’t had a zit for months until I used this. Smells good though

product_name: Take The Day Off Cleansing Balm Makeup Remover
review_text: This cleansing balm has become the holy grail of my skin care routine. I was introduced to cleansing balms by Brooklyn Blonde (she highly recommends using a balm and cleansing cloth to remove makeup as it’s more thorough and gentle). I compared several brands and decided to get the CLINIQUE one for its wallet-friendly price. IT WORKED MIRACLES. The key though, is to use a muslin cloth or cleansing cloth (I rotate between Ole Henriksen and Nature Republic) to wipe off the balm after massaging and taking off the makeup, and then use your cleanser, otherwise it’d feel oily even after washing your face. I’m on my 4th one now and I will continue using this balm. It’s a great product at great price.

I’ve been using this product for about 2 weeks after receiving it from Influenster. I personally don’t like the consistency and the way my skin feels after using this. It is really heavy for my skin. However, it does assist with removing makeup. But I’ve used products that were less heavy to do that.

product_name: Blue Tansy BHA and Enzyme Pore Refining Mask
review_text: First off, the smell is horrendous. To me, it smells like a mix of cough syrup and vitamins.. But besides that, the mask itself is good. A little really does go a long way- just be careful opening the jar. Every time I open it some of the mask pours out and it gets messy, maybe because it’s a super thin consistency. Overall, though, I like it and will continue to use it.

product_name: Vinoperfect Radiance Dark Spot Serum Vitamin C Alternative
review_text: I received this as a sample & only used it twice because I felt like it was clogging my pores.

product_name: ICE Ceramide Moisturizer with Vitamin F
review_text: Oh my Goodness. Did my skin feel and look Amazing after using this Sunday Riley Ice!! I have a combination skin type. It worked Fantastic. It was cooling on the skin. Not oily or greasy at all. It was just right!!

The consistency of the serum is a little slimey it’s not watery or thin, but it’s not super thick either, it leans on the thick side but you can still move it around your face very well. More on the sticky side when it dries down but it adds a considerable amount of shine to the face. If you are okay with using serum as a make up base I’d say go for this with a hydrating or dewy foundation, not a matte or dry foundation. Use a light primer on top then go for the foundation. I first tired this a day before I used some heavy make up. I didnt realize how expensive this was until I looked it up on sephora so I will highly go on the route of using this when I have nowhere to go and everyday to not waste it. If I could afford it I’d buy it.
I love this and if i could afford it I would buy a bottle every time i ran out. For now i continue to get the samples. However THIS WORKS WONDERS. my skin looked brighter and smoother and healthier.

product_name: LUXE+ Advanced Sonic Dermaplaning + Peach Fuzz Removal
review_text: I love this facial tool, but I’m disappointed with the mechanism to eject the blade. I bought this a couple months ago and realized how difficult it was from the beginning to remove the blade. I’ve had countless troubles with trying to remove the blade after each use that it has started to wear down the material surrounding the eject button. I spent way too much money for this that I feel that either the product is defective or maybe they need to come up with an easier way to discharge the blade. Other than that, I love my results but very unhappy with this issue, which is way I’m rating this on a low scale.
review_title: Need to fix the eject button!

product_name: Yo Glow AHA & BHA Facial Enzyme Scrub
review_text: I really like this! Have been using for about two weeks A couple times a week, and so far I’ve noticed brighter and softer skin. My skin is so dry and wrinkles and pores are accentuated during the winter. This stuff is great for getting rid of all the dead skin cells and smoothing my skin out. It’s a gentle exfoliant but the real work happens after you wash it off by way of BHA’s and AHA’s. I also think it’s really cool the way it pills up and you can see the dirt melting off your face, gross but good lol!! I’m looking forward to seeing more improvements to my skin.
review_title: Don't understand the hate, it's a good product!

review_text: I bought these while having terrible pimple problems on my chin. I would put them on overnight and could see how much gunk they were pulling out when I woke up. I did feel like they were drying things out which was good, but sometimes almost drying out too much to where it became a separate problem. All in all a good solution when an unwanted pimple became too big/red but not a long term solution or something I would use constantly.

I LOVE this product, HATE the price. I originally got it as a sample years ago but never purchased because of the price. I finally splurged during the 20% off and I’m in love. This does have a light citrus scent however it does not bother my sensitive skin

review_text: Love love love this. Makes my skin so soft and smooth and smells like heavenly pumpkin pie!!!  A little goes a long way so this jar is worth the money!!!  Thank you so much for this product!!!

Loving this! Soothes my sensitive skin and leaves a gorgeous glow. Feels good under makeup, just let it soak into the skin a bit before applying primer!

product_name: Urban Environment Oil-Free Sunscreen Broad-Spectrum SPF 42
review_text: I received this free for my review from influencer. Great smelling sunscreen goes on smoothly. It lasts as long as it says it does. Does not leave skin feeling sticky. I would definitely recommend.

product_name: Estee Lauder Advanced Night Repair Synchronized Multi-Recovery Complex Serum

product_name: Original Skin Retexturizing Mask with Rose Clay
review_text: LOVE this mask. I tried it as a sample before I purchased it. It came as a recommendation from a Sephora employee who always helps me (Shout out to Ms. Jackie at Cumberland Mall). product_name: Mini Faded Serum for Dark Spots & Discoloration
review_text: Honestly obsessed with this product. Had my doubts because I know products like this either tend to take a lot of time to work, or don’t work at all. I was prepared for my skin to purge (and it definitely did, for maybe 3 weeks or so) but now I can use it every day on my hyperpigmentation with no break outs. I really couldn’t see any difference using this on my skin. An odd slightly tacky feeling was left on my skin because of this, but nothing too unpleasant. Because I refuse to use any other lip balm. This lip salve is the best! It keeps my lips soft and hydrated feeling nice a smooth. Not only do I love it, my fiance loves it too. It’s not too sticky, perfect combo for lips.

product_name: Magic Cream Moisturizer with Hyaluronic Acid
review_text: I received from #Influenster for review. I like that a little goes a long way. It makes my skin feel super hydrated and I love the hyalauronic acid added to the cream. I especially like how it makes my neck appear younger looking. The cream feels like my skin stays moisturized all day long. gifted by dermalogica - sephora. this is my first time using a vitamin c eye cream and i love it. this cream does a fantastic job hydrating, plumping, and priming my under eye area for concealer. i use it at night too and it definitely helps hide insufficient sleep!
This cleanser has cleared up my skin and does not over dry. I have been very happy with all of the clinque products.
This is so highly talked about I thought I would like it. It feels way too much like a soap for my taste. I also find it a little too drying.

Perhaps it is a sensitivity issue but I do not like this lip balm. It is somehow gritty and isn’t very hydrating which is surprising as I normally love Biossance products. I would take the Aerin lip balm over it any day.

product_name: B-Hydra Intensive Hydration Serum with Hyaluronic Acid
review_text: I’d have to agree with some other reviews on this - I have combinstion skin with dry patches on my cheeks and around my mouth. Used this product for 2 months and saw no change. I even found that it pills easily, but that could be due to me using too much product. Packaging is great, kind of a shame.

I really wanted to love this! Especially since it said it was really hydrating. Unfortunately for me, it dried the skin under my eyes after 2 days of using it. I returned it right away. 2 stars for no scent formula and lightweight serum.

product_name: Checks and Balances Frothy Face Wash
review_text: At first I thought this face wash was really nice and refreshing, but after a week of use I broke out on my ENTIRE face. I have never once had bad acne but this face wash made me break out so bad and left my nose super dry but the rest of my T-zone really oily. As soon as I switched to a different face wash my acne cleared up within a week. Ugh so disappointed
I’ve been using this product for about 3 weeks now, and my skin couldn’t be happier! Highly recommend.

I wouldn’t necessarily say I hated this but it didn’t seem to work for me and my acne. It does attract a lot of the gross stuff out overnight but it didn’t do much in preventing that pimple from forming or reducing size or redness for me. I had to use patch after patch after patch on the same spot all day long to see slightest bit of improvement. Doesn’t do enough for me, will not repurchase.

I’ve tried other Dermalogica products and have enjoyed them, but this one hit different. I have normal/dry skin so I figured this product would work well with my skin type. I feel like this product is too much for my skin. I only used a small amount but my face felt greasy all night and when I woke up the next morning it was still to much for me. I used a few other times and you can use once or twice a week, but I found it’s not for me. Now if you suffer from extremely dry skin this might be worth trying.

These work pretty effectively, but the one thing that annoys me to the point that I won’t repurchase is that the edges come up when wearing overnight. So by morning they’re almost off. It doesn’t matter how clean my skin is before application, it happened every time.

I am a really big fan of this cleanser. I don’t necessarily have sensitive skin, but sometimes I do react to stuff but this cleanser was a win! If you’re unsure I would definitely recommend buying the mini version to test it out. The only thing I wish was that it was in a plastic bottle as opposed to glass because I would like to bring it in the shower. I’m afraid it’ll break if I do!

I have never spent so much on one product, that being, I can’t imagine not having this product in my arsenal. I tried a sample given to me by an SA, she suggested it and I looked at the price tag and thought, that’s not happening! Immediately upon use, I noticed how soft my skin felt the very next day. I was sold and bought the product. A little will go a very long way. I use it daily and can see it last 6 months easy. I love that the product has retinol, but is not drying. I have sensitive skin and I felt no burning, tingling, no irritation with nightly use. It does have a unique smell to it, some don’t like it, I find it calming and it dissipates quickly. I don’t have wrinkles or fine lines yet, but the retinol in the product has drastically improved my acne. It’s not awful, but bothersome. I just love how soft my face is. I won’t give this one up!

I’ve been using this for over a year now. This leaves my skin feeling deeply cleaned an does not over strip my skin at all! HOWEVER, This will not remove all ur makeup!! Always go in with a oil based cleanser first THEN use this to get ultimate clean skin!

product_name: T.L.C. Sukari Babyfacial AHA + BHA Mask
review_text: Love it! It’s something you have to work skin up too such as starting with the Framboos and then doing this mask for a couple minutes and work up to the 20 minutes. My skin is so smooth and bright now! I also noticed a difference when I forgot to do it for several weeks and was duller and more clogged but once I did it again it felt like my skin was reborn. It’s pricey but well worth it.

product_name: Mini C.E.O. Vitamin C Brightening Rich Hydration Moisturizer
review_text: i received a super sample with my last order and used it last night and this morning. so far, i’m happy with the result. my skin is soft and plump and dewy. it’s true this is a heavier cream, but i’m ok with that. just dab a few dots on your forehead, cheeks and nose - no more than that or it will feel super heavy on. i used it under makeup this morning and i really like the result. keeping my fingers crossed this is a winner. oh, yes -- and it smells delicious, too!

Haven’t put this down since I’ve got it. Works great and deep cleaning your skin to really get every last bit of dirt and makeup from your skin once you’ve cleansed. Leaves your skin feeling clean and refreshed.

this product does seem to aid in giving more moisture to my skin without making it oily or break out- I thought the price was reasonable fro the amount of product you get- as it does not take much to do the job

product_name: Cocoa Cleans'r Soothing All-Over Cleansing Bar
review_text: I love this product. It smells like coconut and leaves a very light scent on the skin. It feels like African black soap, shea butter and cocoa butter hybrid and I LOVE it

I’m impressed. I don’t say that often. I was skeptical at first, but did some research on the brand and figured I’d try it out. I will never use another moisturizer. EVER! As the name suggests, this is a light cream, and that’s how it feels. Don’t expect some heavy night time cream. I’ve been wearing it under my make up in the morning and I’ve been very pleased.It is expensive but it drastically changed my skin within a few days of use. I mean, this cream is remarkable. What’s impressive is that the instant effect actually improves the more you use it. I’m more impressed now than the first time I tried it. I’m in my late 30s and my skin is prone the hormonal changes — let’s say I have good skin and bad skin days. This cream is a sort of stabilizer. This is a very, very good product. HIGHLY recommended

product_name: Advanced Génifique Radiance Boosting Face Serum
review_text: I used this product morning and night for about 2 weeks and did not see many changes. My skin was slightly smoother if anything. It did not dry me out and layered well because it was fast absorbing which I liked. Overall I didn’t see many changes and with the high price, I would not recommend.
I received this product in a gift set from a family member and fell in love with the creamy texture and the way my skin felt and looked so I purchased a large size so I’m never without it!

product_name: Lip Sleeping Mask Intense Hydration with Vitamin C
review_text: Amazing! I love waking up with super soft lips, even in the middle of winter!
This product works very well. After daily use for a couple of weeks, it brightened the skin around my mouth which was my main concern.

product_name: Umbra Sheer Physical Daily Defense SPF 30
review_text: disappears completely on skin, unlike all other sunscreens with titanium/zinc that either give you a chalky look or discolor you. this one will not, you will look completely normal!  i have dark skin and usually easy to tan.  this will not let the rays through, i finally feel my skin is protected!  you can wear makeup over it and the makeup looks just like normal.

product_name: Lip Sleeping Mask Intense Hydration with Vitamin C
review_text: I received this product complimentary from Influenster.  This product really works, which is awesome!!  It’s super easy to use and has a nice scent.  You don’t need to use a whole lot on your lips for it to work.  I would recommend this product for anyone looking to rid themselves of dry lips.

glow recipe is one of my favorite skincare brands so when i saw this i knew had to try it. my skin has been dry lately and i was drawn in by the ingredients—specifically because it has collagen. this has been a tremendous help in keeping my skin looking healthy.disclaimer: i received this complimentary from glow recipe.

product_name: Mini Yo Glow AHA & BHA Facial Enzyme Scrub
review_text: I was super intrigued with this product, but it’s been mediocre. The product reacts quickly with the elements (it’s not your dead skin) and is hard to work with. It was easy to wash off and I did notice my skin to be softer/brighter, BUT it was short lived because it went away after 5 minutes. I’d say spend your money elsewhere.

product_name: Green Clean Makeup Removing Cleansing Balm
review_text: This balm is phenomenal at getting EVERYTHING off, I recently took my mini while traveling and I didn’t miss makeup wipes at all! I use this at night in combination with the Azaleaic Acid cream and my pores have shrunk and my skin feels smoother, more hydrated and softer. Did not help reduce my acne though.

product_name: Good Genes All-In-One AHA Lactic Acid Treatment
review_text: This is my first time ever writing a review. This product is absolutely worth the money! I am half way through my first bottle and my sun spots are almost completely faded! The smell takes getting used to but the results are worth it. I highly recommend this product.

Gifted by Murad! Oh my goodness this serum is amazing! It has become a staple in my skincare routine! As soon as you put it on it goes straight to work! It’s so lightweight on the skin & leaves my face with that smooth & Dewy fresh look! I feel refreshed & moisturized! Game changer product right here!
I used the 3-step and it didn’t work for me, Ive tried alot of things as I have moderately severe acne I would say. Your not supposed to use alcohol on your face is what my dermatologist told me

product_name: Ultra Facial Moisturizing Cream with Squalane
review_text: What more could I ask for? Non greasy. Fragrance free. No break outs. Instantly felt hydrated the first time I applied it. It felt like a spa experience. I really like the smoothness my face feels after applying. Within a week my skin looks hydrated and brightened and healthy!

product_name: The Deep Cleanse Gentle Exfoliating Cleanser
review_text: Best cleanser ever! Does not strip my skin of my natural oils but still thoroughly cleans and exfoliates!

This overnight mask is incredibly hydrating and feels so good on the skin. I woke up to my face silky smooth, glowing and moisturized. It’s not heavy or feels to clog the pores, perfect formula. Couldn’t ask for an easier beauty treatment.

product_name: Vinoperfect Radiance Dark Spot Serum Vitamin C Alternative
review_text: I love how quickly this absorbs into my skin.  My skin is glowing, though for the price tag  I wish it did more for my complexion and acne.
review_title: Great product, not sure if it’s worth the $

It smells like most toners do, but did get more dirt and grime off my face than just the face cleanser did. I was very happy with the results as part of using the SK-II system.

This product goes a long way with just a small amount. My under eyes felt really hydrated and rejuvenated after applying in the mornings. I will be adding this product to my skincare routine. I did receive this product complimentary for review.

It’s like an Advil for your face. Calms absolutely everything down almost 100% from little tiny surface zits to big under the skin ones. Lightens my acne scars. I’ve bought this three times now, my face has been clear ever since I started using it. No joke.

Don’t sleep on it. Get it. It changes the game.If you are struggling with dry skin combo and random breakouts then this is for you. This is it. Just get it. There isn’t a downside. Maybe the price? Eh it’s worth it.

product_name: Mini Indigo Overnight Repair Serum in Cream Treatment
review_text: From packaging to product, few brands feel as indulgent as @tatcha and #myindigorepair is no exception. (Bonus when they include a tool so no product goes to waste!)With a texture that looks like vanilla pudding in tub (I mean this in the best way) but applies light and clean with a subtle, barely there scent, this night cream definitely left my face and neck feeling quenched and nourished. Excited to see how my skin responds after a few weeks.

product_name: Private Party: Supports Vaginal & Urinary Tract Health
review_text: These are great if you are prone to UTIs and they also have cranberry which is great for overall vaginal health. I have no bad side effects when I take these and I notice with some vitamins and probiotics I don’t feel great but I’ve had no issues since tasking these for over a week. It’s an easy way to take care of your health since it’s just a pill each morning

I never write reviews but after using this product ONE time, I knew it was a game changer. From time to time I over produce oil but yet have random areas of dry skin. I haven’t needed medium to full coverage foundation- in fact I’m just using the tinted dr jarts day cream and that’s all I need.

product_name: FILLING GOOD hyaluronic acid plumping serum
review_text: This may very well be the most hydrating serum in existence, but the scent is so bad I can barely keep from gagging when I apply it. It smells like honey that’s been left out in the sun for a whole lunar cycle.

I recently received a sample complimentary from Dermalogica Sampling of their Daily Microfoliant Exfoliator. It produces a creamy foam with a mild, fresh scent. The beads in it are very gentle, and I’ve gotten no scrapes or scratches at all. Per the directions, I also tested leaving it on an extra minute for additional brightening, and though the handful of times I tried it wasn’t enough to make a huge difference, I can report I had zero irritation. The chemical exfoliation is gentle, as well, and while I don’t see any extreme or dramatic results as far as brightening, my skin is noticeably softer and smoother after a week of use. It’s so gentle I’m able to use it twice a day without no reaction. I will note that though this exfoliant is meant to be used after washing, the foaming action does have a bit of a cleansing effect, so I do sometimes feel a bit dry. The feeling goes away completely with the rest of my usual routine, but I might require some additional moisture while using it come winter. Overall, this is a nice, gentle exfoliant that provides results without irritation.

product_name: All About Eyes Rich Eye Cream
review_text: This is a very moisturizing creme. I’ve tried a few others such as Origins, Roc, etc. however this is the best so far. When you’re over 40 the eyes need constant moisture to keep elastic since that’s one of the first places one ages.

I gave it a 4 start because I don’t have any puffiness under my eyes so I can’t say it works for that, but I really do enjoy this eye cream. it’s very soft and creamy. It absorbs very nicely into my skin. I can feel a difference when I use it. I have very dry undereyes so I like something that keeps them moisturized. I don’t wear a lot of make up, but I found it does work well when applied under some concealer.

I received this as part of my birthday gift from Sephora.  The scent is very off-putting, but I was still willing to try it.  I tried this for two weeks, but it does not clean the skin very well.  I always use toner after I clean/dry my face and I still had residual make-up/dirt left on my cotton square (I do not have this issue with my regular cleanser).

Bought this product as I was trying to find an alternative to the DE night serum. There’s nothing necessarily bad with the formula, it does the trick. However, the top part of the packaging started to wear off after a month so every time I applied it, I had little gold specs all over my face from just pumping out the product. Poor packaging that ruined the experience for me & I did not repurchase for this reason. Not a cheap product either, I was expecting the packaging to be a little better.

I bought this so I could remove makeup late at night without disturbing anyone in my house and I’m so glad I did. When I initially went looking for a micellar water I was a little bit hesitant because I have super sensitive and acne prone skin, but I’m a big Caudalie fan so I took the plunge and this has not disappointed. For eyes and face, I can always trust it to get everything off and I think it actually makes my skin better. No more excuses for not taking off all my makeup late at night because this makes it worth it. It has now become one of my bathroom staples.

I use these to apply toner when I use toner in my skin care. I also use these to remove nail polish they are good for that as well. Also good for eye makeup removing as they are super duper soft. One pack will last me up to 3 months sometimes.

product_name: Green Defense Daily Mineral Sunscreen SPF 30
review_text: I am not generally one to buy the same product over and over again - I like some changes in my makeup and skincare - BUT this sunscreen is all I buy. It’s the most moisturizing sunscreen without making me feel greasy. To be fair I do have a dry skin type, but if you do as well you will like this! It also does not have dimethicone in it which is VERY difficult to find in a good sunscreen. I am on my 4th tube now!

I have been using this for the past couple of years and it is the only brand that helps my breakouts. I have tried so many... I only gave 4 stars because I still have acne, though it is hormonal. I do find that murad does keep it under control. I recommend to everyone
I love this face wash! It made my skin feel so clean, smooth, and looked brighter. I did receive this product for free in my voxbox from Influenster.
Wasn’t as good as cheaper options like Pacifica or Stridex.

VERY moisturizing and does not cause itching. A little goes a long way. Moisturizes the face completely and works well with a light/sheer SPF. Recommended for eczema prone skin that gets dry and flaky during the winter.

product_name: Revitalizing Supreme+ Youth Power Creme Moisturizer
review_text: I love how this moisturizer sat on my face. My face instantly felt so soft and hydrated. It literally made my makeup lay down on my face so nice. I would definitely buy it. I just wish it was a bigger size.

If your looking for a good serum I recommend you this one. It will make your skin so supple and moisturize. I also like the smell of this serum and the consistency is lightweight. It will make your skin so radiant and glowy. #Shisheido

product_name: Skinlongevity Long Life Herb Anti-Aging Face Serum
review_text: The bareMinerals skinlongevity serum  made my skin feel very soft and smooth . I wish I had more to try I would like to use for several days to see how my skin reacts to the product over time.

Great moisturizer! Not too heavy but very hydrating! I saw DermDr on TikTok rave about it. I ended up watching some of his YouTube videos, that he does with another dermatologist, and saw it was a product he really liked (not just an advertisement thing). I bought it and I’m glad I did!
review_title: Most used out of my moisturizer collection!

review_text: I have mild to moderate oily skin and I personally love this face wash. It gives me that clean feeling after I use it and it gives me a dry feeling. However, that is what I am looking for. If you have dry skin it might not be for you. Will definitely be buying again

I have dry combination skin, so I’m always looking for something super hydrating. I received this as a sample and was excited. You do have to put quit alot on just to feel moisturized, i wasn’t happy about that or it’s price. Maybe it’s better for not super dry skin.
I like this a lot, very moisturizing, works wonders on my dry areas, and doesn’t grease up the rest of my face. The price is a bit steep, but I will probably repurchase.

Really liked the very mild scent and texture. I have a combination skin, not too sensitive, but unfortunately, this moisturizer made me breakout. I thought that maybe it was just at that moment, but every time I went back to it the same thing happened :(

review_title: Cured my forehead bumps/milia!! Skin looks radiant

product_name: Mini Revitalizing Supreme+ Youth Power Creme Moisturizer

product_name: T.L.C. Framboos Glycolic Resurfacing Night Serum
review_text: Excellent For skin texture! I received this project free for testing, but love how it improved my skin texture overnight. I would rotate between this & retinol & never experienced much dryness. I could tell a difference in the texture & dullness of my skin.

review_title: Not the wow factor I hoped for

product_name: Cicapair Tiger Grass Color Correcting Treatment SPF 30
review_text: This is everything a high end BB cream/tinted moisturizer should be, masquerading as a color correcting cream. I have extremely sensitive and dry, cool toned, ruddy skin. I purchased this intending to use it as a spot treatment to cover red spots and blemishes. This would not be very effective for my intended purpose. It provides the semi-sheer coverage of a BB cream in a heavy, soothing formula. The stuff seriously MELTS into my skin, blends effortlessly and feels heavenly. It evens out redness without looking overdone, provides a “no-makeup makeup“ look, and packs some serious side benefits for my dry, easily irritated skin. I am in love.If you have a red completion and aren’t thrilled with your current tinted moisturizer or BB cream, this is the product of your dreams. BUY THIS NOW.

product_name: Brightening Treatment Drops Triple Vitamin C Serum

product_name: Original Skin Retexturizing Mask with Rose Clay

perfect for combo skin and before makeup application

product_name: Checks and Balances Frothy Face Wash
review_text: This sproduct is not bad, but I would not repurchase. It smells good, it is very foamy and your skin will feel clean after you use it. However, it is quite drying, which makes my oily skin produce even more oil. My skin didn’t stay matte for a very longtime.

review_title: Alright, but for the price, no way

product_name: Mini Watermelon Glow PHA + BHA Pore-Tight Toner
review_text: I received this as a sample and thought it would be fun to try but didn’t expect much - but it cleared all my pimples and I had the clearest skin I’ve had in months the week I started using this, and the week after through today (it’s the only thing that changed in my skincare routine and in my life). product_name: Advanced Night Repair Eye Concentrate Matrix Synchronized Multi-Recovery Complex
review_text: I received this tester and I can’t notice much difference. It does feel nice and love the applicator since it makes it easier to apply without making a mess. The consistency is nice and hydrating, but I don’t feel is comparable to its price.

product_name: Faded Serum for Dark Spots & Discoloration
review_text: Do not listen to the reviews with bad ratings. I then applied it to my face and it felt great, but after a few days (7), I developed About five pimples along my chin line on either side of my face. review_title: Great product with a unique feel.

review_text: Smooth, moisturizing, felt nice, no adverse reactions. But No improvement in my dark circles.

review_text: I absolutely adored the packaging, so feminine and soft . The product itself is amazing. It is light and silky. I’m switching over from using harsher chemical exfoliating pads like peter thomas roth and dr. dennis gross - these both have a high amount of alcohol, which will cause you more problems in the long run. After constantly getting frustrated by those products (break-outs would go away for a few days, followed by an even worse one with terrible pigmentation that took forever to fade), I decided to switch over to a much more gentle skincare regimen that’s free of alcohol and fragrances. The FAB pads fit right into that.Now I cleanse, then use the facial radiance pads as my toner, and then follow with Clinique’s mild clarifying lotion before my serum and moisturizer - I’m two weeks into this routine and haven’t had a SINGLE break-out, which is unheard of for me. Plus, my old acne marks are fading rapidly, and clogged pores are clearing up as well. I would definitely re-purchase this item, and I think the most important thing is to remember to be gentle to your skin :)

product_name: Find Your Balance Oil Control Cleanser
review_text: When I hit 16/17 years old, my skin was so oily! I’d have to blot every couple of hours and no makeup lasted on my face. I tried all the mattifying products that all the YT gurus would recommend or what was listed as 4-5 stars here on Sephora. Unfortunately, nothing helped. Fast forward to today. My skin is no longer oily. This product changed my skin type so much. It balanced it in ways I could not imagine, I’m not oily, not dry, but rather normal and balanced which I love so much. It does not control my hormonal breakouts and I still get pimples here and there, but I can’t be mad that my oiliness is gone AND my pores have shrunk over the course of using this. Also, a little goes a long way!
Have used this product for awhile now. Very lightweight, soaks in, so if you have dry sensitive skin you might love this as I do. (I am 63) I use this under moisturizer.

I have only been using this product for a couple night, and I already love it.

product_name: D-Bronzi Anti-Pollution Bronzing Drops with Peptides

Amazing!!! Works so fast to get rid of acne! One of the only products that helps my skin!

product_name: Abeille Royale Advanced Youth Watery Oil
review_text: So I received this for free for review, but I wasn’t expecting to love it because I have never had an oil product that I didn’t have some kind of issue with. My skin just doesn’t like them usually. For reference, I have eczema and sensitive skin. First of all...the packaging. It’s gorgeous! I felt like I was opening some fancy-pants rich lady stuff. The bottle is stunning and feels expensive. Now, the product (because that’s what matters most.) The little gold bits were interesting and at first I thought hmmm is this to make me think it works but really does nothing? I should have taken before and after pictures. I put two drops on my fingers and then put the oil on my skin. It has a texture much more watery than most oils (I guess that’s why it’s called watery oil haha) but two drops does my face and neck. What was so special about this? It soaked in. Like all the way. I wasn’t oily after. But I was moisturized. VERY moisturized. My skin looked supple. I’m 36 years old, supple-looking skin isn’t a given anymore. I usually have to use three or four products to achieve that. This did it on its own. What surprised me even further is that there is fragrance in this. I almost didn’t use it and was going to decline to review because of how fragrant it is and my skin is NOT a fan of fragrance. I have to put perfume on clothes. My skin didn’t react badly at all. It wasn’t a one-off either, I use it most nights and I always have the same result. I definitely notice a difference when I don’t use it which is bad for my wallet haha. What is this stuff??? I don’t know how Guerlain did it, but they defied my skepticism in each category and I can’t give them a fail in any area. Well done! I’m sold! I received this product complimentary for review purposes.

review_text: I was using the Neutrogena hydrating makeup wipes and I continued to feel like they were just drying out my face. So I figured I’d give this a try, thinking I would hate it because I couldn’t imagine rubbing oil all over my face on top of my makeup. (I’m one of those people who likes a REALLY clean feeling after I take my makeup off). I was SO SO pleasantly surprised with how well it dissolved my makeup! And when you hit your face with water after rubbing the balm into your skin, it completely takes away all the makeup and residue. I was worried it would leave a filmy feeling behind but it did NO such thing! So awesome.Two things I want to point out: 1. Please don’t let the reviews that say it “broke me out“ sway you from trying this. I have a feeling that those reviewers did NOT do an actual cleanse after they used this. This is the first step (similar to a makeup wipe) to your routine. Use this, then wash your face with your normal cleanser. This is a makeup remover and you therefore still need to go in and do an actual cleanse to get into your pores, which is why people probably broke out, thinking they could just use this and call it a day. 2. The reviews that mention the blurry vision if getting it in your eyes are true. However, it causes no pain and there is a solution to avoid this. I take a bit of the balm and put it on the back of my hand, then take another bit and put it in the palms of my hand. For my face, I use what is in my palms, and only after I completely rub off my face do I go in with the extra balm on the back of my hand for my eyes. That way I never open my eyes during the process. Voila! No blurry vision!Try this! You will not regret it!
