product_name: Hydra Vizor Invisible Moisturizer Broad Spectrum SPF 30 Sunscreen with Niacinamide + Kalahari Melon
review_text: Love this SPF moisturizer. The smell is nice. No SPF smell. I use it under my foundation and it blends well. Also really like the pump applicator.

After the first application, I felt the unimaginable smoothness of the skin!  Peel off.  Black dots become less visible.  The skin after such washing breathes!  The action resembles a light scrub, but does not injure the skin at all, but gently exfoliates, which is the most important thing for my skin.  Doesn’t dry out at all, just makes it matte and fresh.  I really liked this tool! Complimentary from Dermalogica Sampling.

I love this Sunday Riley retinol + niacinamide eye serum. This formula fights to get rid of those fine lines and wrinkles that are underneath your eyes plus supporting natural collagen production. Simply apply a pea size amount daily and in the evenings under the eye area. I’m starting to see results in just a few days! I also love that their cruelty free!

I’ve been a fan of Fresh since I bought their fragrance Life, and recently Sugar.The face polish is an excellent scrub, it goes on easy and your face looks fabulous after, a few days even. I would recommend using it at night as the natural oils do remain on your skin a bit creating an excellent moisturizer while you sleep. It is not the cheapest scrub on the market, but it is absolutely worth every penny. I would highly recommend it.

I love this face wash! I am so picky with my cleansers during different seasons. I know this is definitely one that I can use for all seasons without feeling too dry! It also feels amazing afterwards! It smells like cucumbers too!

So this is the first product containing AHA and PHA i hv ever used.... and till now its giving great results.... the smell is pleasant, formula is light on skin... initially it tingles or caused me a little redness for first few used but soon my skin started to adapt... so far so good

I didn’t think this product would help me as much as it actually does. Thank you Murad for sending me this product to try! The InvisiScar Resurfacing Treatment helped me get rid of a few acne scars that I’ve had for years. It worked quickly and my skin is looking flawless now. Very easy to apply and the scent is great. No need to worry about bactera because the pump bottle. Love the clean feeling this product gives. 5 stars!

Amazing. After the first use combined with the serum I woke up to almost all redness gone. After using it for a week, my skin is so much better. Super hydrated and smooth. Such a difference in texture and zero redness now. I stopped using my Jet Lag mask because this stuff is magic. I use the cream at night and the gel in the morning. I received this product for testing purposes.

product_name: Barrier+ Skin Barrier Niacinamide Restoring Gel Cream
review_text: I was intrigued to try this gel moisturizer version of skinfix barrier. I have dry skin so I definitely prefer original cream version over this.Regardless this is a great moisturizer. Loved the light refreshing texture of it and great addition is Niacinamide in it. Great for acne prone skin.Packaging is same as the original.

product_name: Daily Cleanse Clear Skin and Body Detox Supplement
review_text: I feel like I had immediate results. Shortly after I began use my forehead acne was gone and my skin appeared much smoother. Now I’m questioning the product a bit since I have been using it almost a month and my skin seems to be back to its original state.
review_title: I would purchase and try for another month!

product_name: Power Couple Advanced Retinol and Lactic Acid Duo
review_text: I love this line of skin care -- HOWEVER -- the bottle of Good Genes is deceptively large. I honestly used this for maybe two weeks once a day -- and then it was gone. I thought the pump was broken so I looked inside and realized the product is in a tiny bag in the bottle and it was already empty! Really feel like I got duped!

product_name: Black Tea Anti-Aging Moisturizer with Retinol-Alternative BT Matrix
review_text: It was my first time trying Fresh products, and this truly did not disappoint. I love the subtle black tea scent and how it nicely it absorbs into the skin. I have sensitive skin, so I was a bit worried, but I could tell how gentle and fast acting this could be. Can’t wait to continue using this.  This product was gifted by Fresh.

Noticed results in just a week’s time of use! I have sensitive skin, so I’m very careful and picky when it comes to exfoliating products. I also always do patch tests especially for products with acids or strong ingredients. I’ve heard from others that these pads are very gentle even for sensitive skin. I still had a bit of sting during the first few uses (yup, skin’s that sensitive), but no burning, redness or irritation. It says in the product label that it can be used 2x a day, but I just use this during my PM routine. On days that I include this on my AM routine, I make sure I slather on a lot of SPF. Received as sample, but opinions are my own.

product_name: Super Multi-Corrective Anti-Aging Face and Neck Cream
review_text: This product is great, it has really help me out. After using for two days I can definitely see a big difference thanks!!

So to start, I did receive this product free from influencer and I thank them for the opportunity. I personally was not impressed with this product. The packaging was very beautiful however I found it very difficult to use. The instructions say to press a palm full on your face and neck. So I of course try to pour some into my plam. It does not work that easy so I ended up turning it upside down a few times to get a “palm full“. The product is very liquidity almost just like water. Putting a “palm full“ in my hand was a bad idea, cause it ended up overflowing and dripping on the backside of my plam. So naturally I panic and start picking some up with my two fingers and ultimately lightly slapping my face over and over again. I found that a “palm full“ was not much of a musurement that could possibly be done. So I tried just turning the bottle upside down onto my two fingers so I can apply it. I tried it for one week every night and I could see it made my face shiny a bit, but that’s all. I actually started seeing parts of my face breaking out with acne. I do suffer with adult acne and I try my best to keep it under control but I struggle. Over all I found that this product was just not for me. Maybe I was doing it wrong, but the instructions were very vague. So I did what I was told, by instructions, and I honestly didn’t see much of a difference and found it difficult to use.

I would put this in the top 5 cleansing balms that I have tried. It has a nice texture and takes off eye makeup well. I can’t say for sure how it would do with super intense glam makeup as I have been wearing minimal makeup due to wearing masks. All in all it is a good first step cleanser.

product_name: Lip Sleeping Mask Intense Hydration with Vitamin C
review_text: I’m increasingly conscientious of fine lines & wrinkles as I’m about to hit 30 & also began taking Wellbutrin nearly a year ago which causes me to dry out a bit faster than usual; that being said, my Combination-Oily skin has become Combination-Dry, so I have to be meticulous about my moisturising, protective, etc. products... which led me to this fabulous new forever product! The smell is fantastic, the taste is entirely inoffensive, & it feels absolutely incredible. My lips have never been more plump & retrained as much moisture! I personally also use a vape, which has me unconsciously licking my lips from time to time, so it’s been extremely helpful at preventing me from drying out due to that habit!

product_name: The Water Cream Oil-Free Pore Minimizing Moisturizer
review_text: I’m not sure if I expected too much from this product because it’s so hyped up, but I don’t think this moisturizer is all that great. It’s definitely more of a surface moisturizer as opposed to a moisturizer that penetrates deep into your skin. I also don’t really care for the water consistency, but I guess it makes sense since it’s called the Water Cream. I’m finishing the product since I spent $70 on it, but I don’t see myself buying this again.

Dermalogica daily microfoliant smooths plus brightens skin in seven days I started off by getting my hands wet using a tea spoon amount gently rubbing into my skin in a circular motion all over my face avoiding my eyes it gave me a nice glow I noticed my skin was brighter than before overall my skin looked healthy with a nice natural glow. I love this product it works so good my skin feels incredible and looks so beautiful.

I moved states in the last year to a more humid and pollen based climate and my skin changed from sensitive breakout prone to oily acne prone; I’ve been trying everything and decided to give this brand a shot: WOW it’s only been three days and the effects have been amazing! I’ve stayed with a cleanser I’ve been used to but added this is nightly and in just three days my redness has reduced and my breakouts have almost completely disappeared! My forehead and cheekbones have also been glowing since starting this product which is perfect for me I really love the dewy look. I also bought the AHA/BHA peeling solution and the lactic acid solution, I’m going to slowly add them in and review those two as well but I imagine they’re going to also improve my skin.
review_title: Great if your skin type has started acting up!

product_name: Rose & Hyaluronic Acid Deep Hydration Moisturizer
review_text: So far, I really enjoy this moisturizer. It is on the thicker side so it feels super hydrating. The only downside to this is that I tried it right after trying a super super hydrating moisturizer so this one doesn’t moisturize as well but compared to my old moisturizer, it is good. I would not recommend it unless you really really like rose scents because it is very strong.

product_name: C.E.O. Vitamin C Brightening Rich Hydration Moisturizer
review_text: I’m pretty surprised at the range of reviews for this product. It seems like people either love it or hate it. I recently switched birth controls and my face broke out the worst it’s even been. Since then it’s calmed down and I’m just left with deep purple scars. I got a sample of this cream and I personally love it. Doesn’t break me out, the smell is nice, and I’ve already seen improvements in my acne scars after only a week. It does take 5-10 minutes to soak in but it really doesn’t leave a ’waxy’ residue at all. I will probably end up buying a full size even though it’s more on the expensive side!

Sulwhasoo gifted me their activating serum to review, and boy am I ever impressed! It’s the perfect first step in your skincare routine because it’s super hydrating, adds glow and really helps all other products absorb into your skin. I’ve found even my thickest of my moisturizers sink in twice as fast as they normally would. So it’s officially a new staple in my skincare routine!
review_title: Let this serum ACTIVATE your skincare routine!

product_name: Hydra Zen Gel-Cream Oil-Free Moisturizer with Salicylic Acid
review_text: Highly recommend this Gel Moisturiser !! It smells amazing and your skin feels so fresh and hydrated afterwards! My skin felt so soft, radiant and fresh ! I  received this product complimentary for testing purposes by influenster !

product_name: U.F.O. Salicylic Acid BHA Acne Treatment Face Oil
review_text: This product has helped my skin improve my acne so much! I stopped using this product for about a week and a half and all of a sudden I saw my acne reappear. I didn’t realize how truly transformative this product was for my skin until I stopped using it. I would highly recommend to anyone. However, I would only use this product at night. It leaves your skin looking oily, but when you wake in the morning you’ll find your skin looking hydrated, clear, and vibrant. My holy grail for clearing acne without stripping my skin.
review_title: Amazing - Cleared acne without stripping skin!

product_name: Ginzing Vitamin C Eye Cream to Brighten and Depuff
review_text: I was hoping to love this product as I have always like Origins products. The eye cream felt cool and nice when I applied it but although this was tinted I felt that that it could have a little more color. After using it for about three weeks consistently I have not seen a big difference, but it did depuff the skin in the mornings. I wanted to love this product but it just fell a little short for me.

Ive been using this for the past two weeks and my skin is so much brighter and feels amazing. I put this on in the morning and see a good difference just by putting it on. Doesn’t leave the skin feeling greasy and does not have a strong smell to it either. Will be buying again and again !
I bought this as I had lost my medicated drug store lip treatment, I picked this up as 1) It would soothe my chapped lips 2) It was a great price 3) It has an SPF! Simply amazing product!

I received this Peace Out Retinol Face Stick complimentary from the brand in exchange for my honest review on it. First off, I love the stick shape, and how easy it is to store. However, I hate how greasy it makes me feel. I haven’t noticed any difference so far to my skin with use, but maybe it’s too soon to tell.

This product it’s okay, but I’m not sure the price is right for the product. It does leave a very soft skin but I do not see improvement in texture or pores in the long run. Still, if you can get a sample, try it and see how it works for your skin. Mine is quite sensitive and I didn’t have many problems (although I never leave it longer than 2 minutes).

Absolutely love this product. I’ve tried numerous face wash products in hopes it would remove my makeup; and this was the first one that actually did the job! I’m always left astounded at the amount of makeup it’ll remove, including water-proof mascara. It’s also extremely gentle on my combination skin. Try it, you won’t be disappointed!

When I first started using this product, I loved how clean my skin felt after using it but after a week or so I noticed drastic changes in my skin. My face felt tight and dry even after heavily moisturizing, and I began breaking out in places I never do. At first, I thought this was just my skin reacting to new products, but my skin kept getting worse. I had high hopes for this cleanser, but it didn’t work for me.

I typically don’t go for physical exfoliators for my face because I’m worried about being too harsh on my skin, but this sugar exfoliator is so gentle and nice! The sugar granules are nice and small and they really do melt after gently exfoliating. The scrub is a nice color too - you can tell it’s not full of fake dyes and a bunch of chemicals. It smells like strawberries and good enough to eat! I received this product complimentary for review purposes.

I really liked how gentle this product was on my skin. I am somewhat of a retinol rookie but I have used it here and there, and I’ve always struggled with irritation off the bat. This didn’t irritate me (so glad!) and it felt really smooth and hydrating on my skin. I don’t feel like I’ve noticed a big difference in fine lines in 2 weeks but I am also not using it daily because I needed to gently introduce the product to reduce that irritation risk. Overall, I do like it, and I really love that it was formulated with other ingredients from my routine (vitamin c, peptides) so I can skip those steps!

I bought this bc of ig and it’s praise of it. I have oily skin & acne prone(very rare). This was just sooo greasy and not light weight. It also made me pill a little and gave me dry patches. I went right back to my Elta md spf… if you have hyperpigmentation Elta md will literally take away your red cheeks in 1 minute of application!

I am tempted to fully replace my higher end brands for this! Try this before you purchase similar serums of other brands... You know! I still love their products however, this performs better on my skin & I get faster results. My skin has improved significantly! Less texture, more hydration & smoothness. I love the way this plumps my skin. This serum is very lightweight, fast absorbing and does have a slight fresh floral scent. This does not irritate my skin, hasn’t caused any breakouts nor makes me feel oily. I hope Shiseido discusses the fragrance in this and reformulates for those who have highly sensitive skin or those who are worried about fragrance.
love this balm! makes my lips look sooo kissable :)

product_name: Green Clean Makeup Removing Cleansing Balm
review_text: I love this! A little goes along way. I don’t have raccoon eyes in the morning.

OMG I’ve used this for a few days now and I’m hooked! I love the gel cream formula - it absorbs super fast and skin immediately feels so soft and hydrated. I have combo sensitive skin, but in the winter I get very dry and tight. This soothed my dryness immediately!

This is the oil cleanser that started my obsession with everything oil. Great for removing makeup, however, this oil feels thick compared to other oil cleansers I have used so I have to rub harder on my eyelids to remove my eyeliner. Also they should redesign the pump; after going through half the bottle the product starts spilling through the sides of the pump. After this problem happened to three of my bottles I knew there is a problem with the design.
I received this as my free birthday gift and loved it! Smells good and my face feels so clean afterwards. I’ll be buying this in the future. Best face wash I’ve tried!

product_name: The Rice Polish Foaming Enzyme Powder
review_text: I enjoyed it at first because of the smooth soft feeling it has on my skin but I am really sensitive , it actually made my skin scaly and red only after a week of using it . I don’t recommend if you have sensitive skin  but if you don’t it may be a good choice only dry not sensitive

product_name: Powerful-Strength Dark Circle Reducing Vitamin C Eye Serum
review_text: This has really helped rejuvenate under  my eyes .it has helped remove the dark circles and given back a glow to my skin

Try the mini first, it lasts forever! I recently moved up to highest prescription strength tretinoin so my skin is usually peeling and dry. I use it once a week to once every 2 weeks to remove the dead skin, exfoliate and help remove my stubborn blackheads. I used it more often prior to tretinoin and it left my skin feeling soft and looking like I just got a facial. I read that it’s best to use in the shower right before you’re about to get out so your pores are open and I’ve found it’s more effective that way, (just don’t keep it in the shower). Be careful, it’s strong and your skin will tingle but I like it because I feel like it’s working. The smell is great if you like pumpkin!
review_title: Turns my skin from dead to ALIVE

product_name: Mini Cicapair Tiger Grass Color Correcting Treatment SPF 30
review_text: Got this as a generous sample.  Ordered a jar before I’d finished the sample!  It is now my go-to daytime moisturizer, color corrector, and sunscreen.  I am older, very, very fair, and have rosacea. This works wonders. An application of the Cicapair color correcting treatment, a dusting of fine powder, and a touch of blush is plenty for most days.  Still, I’m thinking it might not work so well for someone with large pores and/or deeper skin tones.  Get a sample and give it try.  If it’s going to work for you, you’ll know right away.

This lip treatment is amazing. The color is buildable and the formula is incredibly hydrating. The color can work on multiple skintones. I love the ingredient list too. All natural and safe ingredients! I got this complimentary from Fresh.

I received this free cream thanks to influenster, it has an Ami scent, I love it, its texture is quite thick, my skin is combination so I prefer to use the night cream, the face appears bright and hydrated, maybe skin oil not like in the morning this product

I am currently trying (aka trying to use up) the Strawberry one that I bought recently. When I’m done, there’s no question that I am DEFINITELY switching back to the ORIGINAL Rosebud Salve. It is moisturizing, smells lovely, and if you have any excess on your fingers from using it as a gloss, just rub it into your cuticles or elbows.It is just glossy enough (I’m not a fan of super shiny, blinding glosses), not sticky at all, and perfectly moisturizing. Don’t leave home without it.

product_name: Sunshine Vitamin C + Squalane Face Oil
review_text: I love the sunshine vitamin C +, it was easy to apply, dried quickly  and left my skin smooth and moisturized without being oily and that’s a big plus since I have combination skin. The citrus smell is very nice and I liked that you have to push the button and roll to apply it. Definitely recommend.

product_name: Watermelon Glow Hyaluronic Clay Pore-Tight Facial Mask
review_text: I was skeptical of this this mask but man, I love it so much! It comes with a scoop which is nice. I don’t like using my fingers. The mask has a lovely scent that isn’t too strong. It’s great for every day use. I’ve found that it really helps my skin when it is feeling and looking dry. Thanks to the hyaluronic acid and exfoliation, my skin feel and looks so much better after use. I’m glad to have tried this and will purchase for sure.

product_name: Hydra Zen Glow Liquid Lightweight Moisturizer with Hyaluronic Acid
review_text: Absolutely amazing! I am head over heels in love with this product! My face feels so fresh, smooth, and relaxed! I recommend this to everyone! It has been a life saver! I recieved this product complimentary for review!
As someone whose eyes reflect the lack of sleep easily, this is my new best friend.  Makes those puffy eyes look normal and that is saying A LOT.

product_name: Superscreen Daily Moisturizer Sunscreen SPF 40 PA+++
review_text: I was really excited to try this out after doing some research into different clean sunscreen brands, but was a little disappointed with the superscreen daily moisturizer. I’ll probably finish using this because it wasn’t cheap... but won’t re-purchase. It’s too greasy for me to use as a daily moisturizer, but using “less“ product makes it useless for the SPF protection... might as well just get a good moisturizer and a better facial sunscreen.It definitely doesn’t leave a white cast and the smell isn’t very noticeable unless you’re very sensitive to smells. I have normal/combination skin depending on the season, and this ended up being too greasy for me right now -- summer makes my skin pretty oily and I found that this was too heavy for hot humid days. It doesn’t “dry“ well and leaves my skin really greasy/tacky even after waiting 10-15 minutes so it’s difficult to use under my makeup if I want to layer. I’ve tried using less product like some of the reviews suggest, but I don’t know how effective the SPF would be at that point of just using a tiny tiny amount. You need something like 1/2 a teaspoon (more than you’d think) for your face and neck -- and if you’re using less than that, the SPF is doing nothing for you.
review_title: not worth it if you have combo/oily skin

product_name: Squalane + Omega Repair Deep Hydration Moisturizer
review_text: I really really wanted to like this product, and at first I did. However, I’m sensitive to smells and this product doesn’t have a pleasant one. Additionally, it left my face looking and feeling oily, greasy....not a good look.

product_name: Rose & Hyaluronic Acid Deep Hydration Moisturizer
review_text: I was amazed how great this product work we d on my dry skin and it lasted for hours after use not bro mention the amazing scent highly recommend this product

product_name: Mini Water Drench  Hyaluronic Hydrating Moisturizer SPF 45
review_text: I really like this moisturizer because the high spf and the inclusion of hylaronic acid. I usually use 2 separate products (an spf and hylaronic acid) but this combined both making morning routine easier. When you first put it on it can feel a bit heavy and look shiny, but after a few minutes it really sinks into the skin and gives a nice glow. I have combination skin and tend to get oily in the summer, but bc I use a matte bb cream or foundation, this product keeps my skin glowing, but not oily and helps the matte from settling into creases or fine lines.

product_name: SEA drink of H2O hydrating boost moisturizer
review_text: My skin got more and more dry. I used it for a few weeks. At first it was okay, but I think I’ll just throw it away now.

product_name: Lip Sleeping Mask Intense Hydration with Vitamin C
review_text: I def can feel how soft my lips are in the morning since I’ve started using this lip mask!  Also the smell is just perfect!
It stayed sticky on my face a long time before it dried. I’m not sure how much it’s accomplishing, frankly. Not sold
great product, doesn’t dry skin

product_name: Skinlongevity Long Life Herb Anti-Aging Face Serum
review_text: First off, I want to say how pretty and simple the packaging is for this serum. Feels fancy, yet feels like thought was put into it. When I opened the serum and used it for the first time this evening, I was pretty impressed. I’m used to serums being thick, and sticky, or too gooey. Long Life Herb Serum was not that. It’s light, smooth, and refreshing. When I put it onto my skin I felt I was breathing fresh cool air. Feels amazing on the face. Makes my skin feel lovely and not smother in product. Leaves me looking dewy for some time. The ingredients amaze me! How can such a clean product work so well! It’s the ingredients. All natural and best for our skin. I’m already in love and I’ve o my used it once. I cannot wait to see my results after 4 weeks!
i think it works really well and it takes the redness away from my skin 100% recommend
Perfect summer lip balm. Such a cute shade that delivered right amount of moisture and pigment. Very buildable color and smells so good

product_name: Wrinkle Blur Bakuchiol Eye Gel Crème
review_text: Absolutely love this product! I dont typically have many wrinkles but I do have a few in my eye area. This has notably firmed my eye area. Not harsh at all. This product did not make my eyes water. I didn’t notice any strong chemical smell like I have with some products. Just an overall good product!

product_name: Guava Vitamin C Bright-Eye Gel Cream
review_text: Ok eye cream, hydrating but no real brightening despite regular use. The real downside is the packaging. After using the product for a week, can no longer get product out! There is so much left in the bottle and pump does not work. Having to scoop it out with a toothpick to not waste it. Such a shame. Love other glow recipe product, but they really need to redesign the packaging.
review_title: Packaging awful, can't get product out

review_text: Great cleanser and beneficial for my skin. It feels very healthy, smooth, clean after using. I see great improvement in my pores. Definitely helps a lot. I also love it’s vegan and cruelty free. Happy to add it to my daily beauty routine. Was gifted by Josie Maran.

One thing I really loved about this new eye cream was the applicator. The smooth metal felt so cool and refreshing right off the bat. I like how my under-eye skin feels after I use it. The cream doesn’t leave my skin feeling tacky like a lot of other products do. I do notice that fine lines look less pronounced, but I’m not sure if I’m seeing much reduction of dark circles yet.

Wow this such a great serum! I really feel like this is one of the best vitamin c serums! The dispenser is great for protecting the active ingredients in this serum. I love how clear and bright this makes my skin look. I recieved this complimentary from Sunday Riley.

ACNE? Scars and dark spots?I loooove this night cream! I purchased in on a whim and it has been single handedly the biggest game changer in my skincare routine. My acne looks so much better in the morning after just one use. I have adult (26) cystic hormonal acne on my skin that I pick at when nervous and I’ve given myself some ugly dark spots and scars, this has faded them tremendously. Would def recommend!

I’ve used astringents in the past, but switching to this is well worth the extra money! I have dry combination skin... oil t-zone and dry everywhere else. I used to have issues with flaking on my cheeks by the corners of my mouth. This has completely solved that problem and leaves my face feeling very smooth. It does a great job at helping prevent breakouts as well.

So soft and thick! Seriously, comparing these to the regular ones you’d get at the store, these are so superior. I know use them to dav my face dry in the morning instead of a towel. They do not leave any lint on the face. Perfect for serums and toners. I find that it absorbs my Chanel toner very well and it spreads easily.

product_name: C5 Super Boost Vitamin C Eye Cream
review_text: This is honestly the only eye cream that ever worked for me. I’ve tried Inkey list caffeine eye cream, Kiehl’s vitamin c eye cream and the biossance one and it still didn’t get rid of my dark under eyes near the corner of my eyes. What I like about this product is that it doesn’t have dimethicone like the Kiehl’s one which made my eyes feel weird. The other 2 eye creams I mentioned only hydrated my eyes but didn’t reduce the darkness underneath. I’m so glad Paula’s Choice released a vitamin c eye cream because I’ve been looking everywhere that didn’t break the bank. I’ve been using this product now for 2 weeks and I’m already seeing results. It glides on so smoothly with no irritation and I think the price is decent. Just because it works for me may might not work for you, but I recommend trying it.
review_title: A must have in my routine!!!!!

review_text: This is, by far, the best lip treatment I have ever used! I chose it based on other customer reviews, and I certainly haven’t been disappointed.Not only does it do a great job of softening lips when applied at night, but it’s perfect for use under and over lipstick as well. Surprisingly, it “stays put“ and doesn’t cause lipstick to smear, disappear or migrate. Perfect as a lip primer and a gloss! (Way better than a lot of products that are supposed to be lip primers.)I mainly got this to serve as a base for my Obsessive Compulsive Lip Tars (because I find them to feel a bit drying). But after using this balm, I’ve realized what a great product it is--with or without lipstick. Lipsticks and Lip Tar stays put with this as a base.After trying this a few days, I reordered one of every fragrance (since they really don’t have any “taste“) to give as gifts and to stash all over my home, vehicle and office.This is way better than the Fresh Sugar line and the Yu-Be lip balm (although I love the Yu-Be Moisturizing Skin Cream for my hands and feet). Don’t waste your money on anything else!
Love this lip gloss! Isn’t sticky
This stuff is so lush!! It keeps my lips hydrated and smooth for a long while before I have to re apply. It smells awesome and it makes my lips look healthy and fuller. Looks great over lip tint!
Amazing product! Super hydrating and fast results. Ever time I wear this under makeup, I get so many compliments on how fresh my skin looks. Love this!!

product_name: High-Potency Night-a-Mins Resurfacing Cream with Fruit-Derived AHAs
review_text: I’m obsessed. The smell is amazing and my skin looks so refreshed in the morning

Toners are some of my favorite skin care products and this one hasn’t let me down! Before using this SKII toner and essence, my face was sensitized and burning upon application of almost anything. However, using this product resulted in no burning or irritation and actually felt soothing. And the hydration? My skin absolutely drank it up! I apply a couple layers of this to give my dehydrated skin the extra hydration it needs, and within a few days, all my flakiness and sensitivity was gone! It’s expensive, but I can see myself purchasing full size eventually after finishing this one. Scent is a little weird, though.

product_name: Advanced Night Repair Synchronized Multi-Recovery Complex Duo
review_text: Really disappointed in this product. I have heard people rave about this so I was absolutely ecstatic when I found out that I was receiving this product. The only thing I liked about the product was that a little went a very long way. I could use a small drop or two and it would completely cover my whole face. Therefore this product will last for a very long time. However, I tried this product a few different times and my face broke out and got so irritated and sensitive every single time. I have very sensitive skin and maybe that’s why it broke me out. I would not suggest this product to those with sensitive skin!
Although this product is easy to apply and scent free-which I enjoy, I do not like the thick slimy feel. With one wash I still feel like it’s not completely off. I wouldn’t recommend this product.

product_name: Out of Trouble 10 Minute Mask to Rescue Problem Skin
review_text: LOVE! I have only been using this product for 1 week and I have already seen an amazing improvement! This mask is fantastic for getting rid of those tiny pimples that seem to pop up every other day. I would say that this works better for when you feel a big pimple coming on rather than a big one you already have.

product_name: Rénergie Lift Multi-Action Ultra Dark Circle Correcting Eye Cream
review_text: Soooo moisturizing! I’ve had dark circles for as long as I can remember. This product visibly diminished my fine lines and dark circles! I haven’t even finished the entire jar and I see a difference! Definitely a staple in my skincare routine!

This is the best balm (without SPF) that I’ve ever used. My lips get very dry and I’ve tried literally over a dozen different balms but this is the only one that consistently helps. It even helps more than the original Rosebud salve. I layer it on before I fall asleep and it makes my lips super soft. I keep one in my purse too. It sticks on your lips for a long time and smells great-not too sugary/sweet which happens often with strawberry scented products.

product_name: Redness Solutions with Probiotic Technology Daily Relief Cream
review_text: Helps with redness from dry skin while mosturizing.

After repeated use of the Eye Awakening Essence, I feel that have seen some improvement in my under my eye area. I love using it in the morning to depuff my skin and lighten dark circles, then applying my regular facial moisturizer afterward. I would definitely recommend this product!

I really loved this mask because not only was it not oily, but it seemed to dry down to a matte finish on my face. I didn’t try this under make up so I can’t speak for how it would effect foundation, BUT I put it on at night and woke up feeling very moisturized. It’s really hard for me to like a moisturizing product due to my oily skin. But this was making and defiantly worth the cost if you have oily skin and would like a good nightly moisturizer. I also received this for free for testing purposes from the company, though that does not sway my opinions.
I recieved the product for free to test out and to review.I enjoyed how this product made my skin feel! It left it smooth and refreshed. I did notice an improvement in the brightness of my skin

product_name: The Dewy Skin Cream Plumping & Hydrating Moisturizer
review_text: I got a sample of this and wish I could afford to buy a full size. It’s so great! I started using prescription retin-a (Tretenoin) and my skin has been peeling around my acne. This moisturizer manages to feel thick on my hands, but lightweight on my face. It smells great and leaves my skin feeling soft. I’ve tried many moisturizers since getting on Tret and this has by far been the best.
I really liked the sample I got! I’m a fan of Kate Somerville products, but had only used acne products before this. Feels great and my skin looks nice with it.

Softer skin. A bottle goes a long way. Gently massage it into your clean skin every night for great this leaves my skin with a glow. And don’t believe the hype! I tried Deciem’s night time serum oils and after two weeks of it, my skin became dry again. So I switched back.

product_name: C Beyond Triple Serum SPF 40 Mineral Sunscreen with Vitamin C 10% + Niacinamide
review_text: I didn’t like this product as much as I thought I would. It does give me a lot of glow but not in a cute way it actually makes me look really oily. Not for sensitive skin I had a few break outs after using it. The only thing I like about it is that my skin felt soft after taking it off. I will probably give it another try.
Got rid of blackheads without irritating my skin at all.
Been coming back to this moisturizer in the winter!A little goes a long way! I use it in the summer as a night time moisturizer!
review_title: I tried others and I keep coming back!!

review_text: I absolutely love this cream, a little goes a long way and it’s so light and hydrating!

There was no instant brightening effect within the first week, but I decided to use up the entire bottle before forming an opinion on this serum. I’m not a fan. It’s expensive for no reason and made no difference to my skin. Plus it stings upon application
review_title: it’s not giving what they said it would...

review_text: This is a holy grail moisturizer! I would recommend everyone try it! It is very light in texture and smell, but it really works. I have incredibly dry and acne prone skin and this completely hydrates me and has never broken me out! The price may seem high, but now I don’t have to double moisturize! I received one in my spring FFF and now can’t see my skincare routine without it!

product_name: Avocado Soothing Skin Barrier Serum with Ceramides
review_text: I was gifted this by Glow Recipe. My first impression was how amazing it felt on my skin immediately. It is a creamy texture but not too heavy. It absorbed really well into my skin and made my skin feel so hydrated.

product_name: The Cream Cleansing Gel with TFC8 Gentle Cleanser
review_text: This has become a staple in my skincare routine. I love that it cleanses so well without being drying. It definitely helps with the redness I normally experience. I normally use about 3 pumps. This cleanser does not lather but it still definitely gets the job done! If you are looking for a great cleanser to use during the day and at night, I highly reccomend pampering yourself with this!

While I loved how well this cleanser foamed up, I’m not sure if I find that it’s worth the money to purchase. It doesn’t dry my skin out, which I found as a plus, but I think there are other cleansers that could do the same job for a better price.

This left my skin bouncy and supple!  It absorbs well and leaves your skin looking and feeling hydrated.  It’s deeply moisturizing for me (combo skin/ dry in the winter) but without being ‘oily’ feeling.You can replace the moisture pods that fit in the jar. Awesome for those looking to be more sustainable.

product_name: Tonique Confort Re-Hydrating Comforting Toner with Acacia Honey
review_text: THE BEST! I put this on when I first wake up to give my face a good morning kiss! It smells as AMAZING as it works! My face feels SUPER soft after using for hours!

The mist mechanism is awesome, you get a nice fine even spritz every time. I like the smell, I like the feel, and I like the instant dewy glow. I can’t go 5 stars for one reason - when it dries, which happens like super quick, it feels tacky. If you worry about product being sticky in the slightest bit, you might not love it.

product_name: Acne Solutions All-Over Clearing Treatment Oil-Free
review_text: It has a weird medication scent to it. Regardless of the scent, this is still a fantastic product. It is great for oily/combo skin, probably not best for dryer skin types as this may be drying. It’s a decent product, probably not worth a repurchase.

This cream instantly makes my dry skin feel better. It does not just put a greasy film on my skin as some lotions do. It absorbs in and my skin looks and feels less chafed. It helps when i sunburn or when i just have dry spots.

product_name: Sugar Advanced Lip Balm Intense Hydration Treatment
review_text: I’ve purchased this product two times. I love the scent of it, and the feel of my lips when it’s on. I don’t feel like it does anything special and that’s why I didn’t rate 5 stars. But I will probably purchase it again, and I would still recommend it to others.

product_name: Midnight Recovery Concentrate Moisturizing Face Oil
review_text: Amazing product for your nightime routine. It has the most relaxing luxurious smell. It gives really good hydration to skin and gives it a healthy appearance.

I product seems to be very nice and smooth & creamy but I personally just can not tolerate the rose scent. It is just too strong for me right under my nose. If you like that scent I am sure it will be fine for you :)

product_name: Mini Plum Plump Hyaluronic Acid Moisturizer
review_text: Okay I haven’t seen this before but a refill moisturizer! such a cool idea! The moisturizer is a gel like texture and soaks into the skin quickly and it left me with hydrated skin. The consistency of this is perfect!

product_name: Rice Drops Face Oil Hydrating Serum
review_text: I absolutely am OBSESSED with this product. Since using it, I have seen REAL results in the glowiness, dewiness and elasticity of my skin! The moment I started using this product, I saw so much of a difference that I started using it in the AM and in the PM! I am completely in love with how it leaves my skin feeling and looking. 10/10 recommend to anyone with oily to mederately dry sensitive skin!

This is by far the best cream I’ve tried! Wears OH SO WELL under make up and definitely hydrates. This cream is a rebuy for me! I feel like if it REALLY works money is not an issue, and I will definately continue using it! I’ve got my sisters getting it as well now!

product_name: Mini Plum Plump Hyaluronic Acid Moisturizer
review_text: I use the Glow Recipe Pink Juice moisturizer in the daytime. At night, i like to use a “thicker“ moisturizer, and this is the perfect one for me. The ingredients and the gel-cream feel of it, it hydrates my skin overnight and it does not clog my pores, it doesn’t give me blackheads, it doesn’t break me out, which is what every other cream moisturizer does to my oily skin. It is perfect for me, for nighttime use.
review_title: Excellent Nighttime Cream for Oily Skin

review_text: I have mild rosacea and luckily this product does not irritate it at all which is a blessing (those with sensitive skin may agree) because most products out there are very irritating unfortunately. A little pricey, but the lack of negative side effects makes it worth it.

The texture of the product is super silky. Such a great texture! It feels really nice on the skin. I used about 3 pumps to covervmy face. I have eczema prone skin and felt well moisturized. There is a faint smell to the product and I do see fragrance listed as an ingredient so if you are sensitive to fragrances, may not be the best product for you.

product_name: Violet-C Brightening Serum 20% Vitamin C + 10% AHA
review_text: So I’ll start by saying I really didn’t want to like this product. I mean, come on, 85$ a bottle? That’s pretty steep. But I’ll admit, I tried it for about 3 weeks and I can’t get enough! Initially I noticed my skin feeling a little smoother and about 2 weeks in I could tell my acne scars starting to fade which is AMAZING! I received this product as a promotion from Influenster for testing but the reviews and opinions are fully my own

product_name: UV Expert Aquagel Defense Sunscreen, Primer & Moisturizer SPF 50 Duo
review_text: This is one of the only sunscreens I’ve found that doesn’t leave ANY white cast on my skin. It can be extremely greasy if you use too much and beware if you have sensitive skin. This also is not water or sweat proof. One of the first few ingredients is denatured alcohol and it can and does burn. I’ve been tapping it onto my skin and then once it’s a thin layer, rubbing it in to help with the burn sensation. I don’t notice much of a cooling effect. I’m acne prone, but haven’t had any issues with this causing acne. Overall, it’s a great sunscreen and I plan to repurchase.

product_name: The Dewy Skin Cream Plumping & Hydrating Moisturizer
review_text: Once you start using this, you will never want to use anything else! My skin looks younger, I get compliments all the time and it’s not heavy (even though it is). It’s perfect.

product_name: The Water Cream Oil-Free Pore Minimizing Moisturizer
review_text: I know that this is incredibly expensive, but it is completely worth every penny.I have never noticed such long-term amazing affects with any other skin care product. This truly makes my skin feel like a six year old’s. It completely replenishes dry patches/any general dryness instantly. I feel it penetrating through the deepest levels of my skin. It’s almost as if I took a bucket of water and stuck my head in it. To say I’m impressed is an understatement. If you are able to, PLEASE BUY THIS. You will not regret it. My normal-oily skin LOVES THIS. And my mom who has VERY dry, mature skin also adores this product!!
review_title: literally the best moisturizer to exist

review_text: I LOVE this mask. I didn’t realize how good it was until I stopped using it. Simply apply it once or twice a week; keeps my skin clear and lovely.
Very gentle, leaves skin super hydrated! Perfect for sensitive skin. Been using it for over a year as my second cleanse and I love it!

product_name: Mini Deep Cleanse Gentle Exfoliating Cleanser
review_text: ive always had blackhead and pore issues and this actually works for me its very much like japanese skincare which is what im used to because...well im japanese lol. but seriously if you want something worth the price this is it. ive been using this for a week with a balm cleanser and my skin has never been better!

product_name: Mini Crème de la Mer Moisturizer
review_text: This face cream has made my skin feel so soft with a beautiful, healthy glow! I love the texture of the cream, which applies evenly and easily to my skin. The cream provides long lasting moisture to my skin and keeps it soft all day. I really love this moisturizer! I received this product complimentary from La Mer.
I have been using this product since I was 15 years old. 10 years later, I would never use anything else. It is just an all-purpose balm for everything. A must!

This cleanser is very different from anything I have ever tried. It actually is like jelly and it is rather sticky and can be messy. It definitely hydrates the skin, but I am not sure that it actually does anything for the pores like it claims. I will continue to use because I like how it leaves my skin feeling.

product_name: Essential-C Day Moisture Broad Spectrum SPF 30 PA+++
review_text: This moisturized well, and smelled amazing but unfortunately left my face feeling greasy and too shiny.
BEST EXFOLIATOR EVER!! This product lightened my scars and brightened my face! I love this product!!
It’s like petroleum jelly, very thick and hard to squeeze it out. It doesn’t feel like a cleanser at all, it leaves your skin super oily and doesn’t wash off well. I wouldn’t recommend at all.
This didn’t really absorb that quickly into my skin. I did like the gel consistency and it did hydrate.

My skin becomes very dry in the winters and I love a good moisturizer that can keep it hydrated for longer time period. I really like this moisturizer as it has turmeric which is really good for the skin, and it does make my skin soft & hydrated. It looks fresh and plump when I use it in combination with their serum, It’s nice and I Will recommend this.

I have rather puffy eyes as I work on my computer all day and wear glasses, but this caffeine product does work to relieve the puffiness. It’s got a really nice gel texture that soaks in quickly. Can feel a slight heat to the underage area, which is rather pleasant upon application. Would definitely buy again.

I love this lip balm. It tastes good, smells good and hydrates better than any other. I’ve tried the original Rosebud and the minted rose, and I like the consistency of the strawberry one best. The other two are great, but stickier.

product_name: Mini Water Drench  Hyaluronic Hydrating Moisturizer SPF 45
review_text: I really like this moisturizer. All the low reviews make me sad because this is a good hydrating SPF. This product gives me a nice smooth finish. I use as an overnight moisturizer.

Absolutely love this cleanser - super gentle and non drying. My skin is very sensitive and reddens quite easily; I’ve tried dozens of different cleaners and this is the only one that doesn’t irritate or redden, nor over-strip the skin of healthy oil. Love it!

I received a sample of this for review purposes from Influenster. I struggle a lot with finding something that I’m not allergic to that is also not going to aggravate my oily skin as well as protect the dry patches. My absolute favorite thing about this stuff is the tiny amount needed to cover the entire face and neck area. And it doesn’t feel greasy or heavy at all, which can drive me absolutely insane. No itchy spots and no breakouts at all while using this, and since I’m the kind that likes to spend a maximum of 30 seconds getting ready, this is a dream. I think the only drawback for me is that I really can’t tell what the difference is between this and any other daily user moisturizer/sunscreen. What exactly makes it “Prisma“ I couldn’t say, but regardless of that it’s still my new daily favorite!
review_title: Light, silky, and lasted all day!

product_name: Lip Sleeping Mask Intense Hydration with Vitamin C
review_text: Product smells nice and comes with a snazzy applicator. I typically rely on chapstick through-out the day, applying it every couple of hours. With this mask I don’t need chap stick more than once a day.

product_name: Beauty Elixir Prep, Set, Glow Face Mist
review_text: My skin had been through the works this winter in Northern Canada. So refreshing, tightens pores

product_name: Mini Take The Day Off Cleansing Balm Makeup Remover
review_text: I love how this does not tug on my skin. I know all the make is coming off and I am not tugging and pulling with a wipe.
review_title: love This remover for my eyes

product_name: Smart Clinical Repair Wrinkle Correcting Cream
review_text: I was lucky enough to be able to sample the Clinique Smart Clinical Repair Cream. It was incredibly hydrating. Unfortunately the sample was too small to notice any difference in my skin. However, I think with extended use it would show great results. I would definitely consider this product when looking for new skincare products in the future.

product_name: Cicapair Tiger Grass Color Correcting Treatment SPF 30
review_text: I got this product in my sephora play box and it is hands down the best product I’ve ever received. My skin has been so broken out and so dry from the cold weather and this definitely saved my skin!

I got the trial size so I would have something portable to carry on vacation.  I do like the texture etc of the product but it just didn’t work.  I got sunburned anyway.  I really wanted this to work.  Should have tested it before vacation.

I wish I could give 0 stars.  Such a let down. I love their heavenly sixteen oil. Maybe I misunderstood this product but I thought it would be a nice moisturizing mask to recover from a peel or retinol but I agree with what others said, it melted my skin and I broke out, just so reactive for sensitive skin. Lots of folks say it reacts with this or that but a quality product should be stable, there are many recovery serums and masks that can be used with retinol, ahas, bhas, niacinamide, etc. so yeah if you use nothing go for it. The majority of the good reviews are incentivized. This is garbage.

product_name: Bye Bye Redness Neutralizing Color-Correcting Cream
review_text: Someone I don’t even know recommended this product to me in a beauty blog and I’m forever thankful to them!My skin is very light and unfortunately very red in the morning so I needed something to even it out before I apply my regular foundation. This product is a perfect base which I apply AFTER my moisturizer and BEFORE my foundation.It evens out my skin tone perfectly!This container lasted me exactly 6 weeks and I use it everyday so can’t complain about the size too much even though I wish it was a little bit bigger haha I just ordered it for the second time because its that good.

product_name: Mini Deep Cleanse Gentle Exfoliating Cleanser
review_text: I really do like this product. Nice large bottle, slightly scrubby and foams with water. I put this on my Clarisonic brush head and it foams wonderfully. I love that it is the Clean brand and that it has green tea ingredients which are great for the skin.

product_name: Mini Mandelic Acid + Superfood Unity Exfoliant
review_text: My new favorite toner! Lightly scented but tolerable. Best part is that is has AHA, BHA, & PHA!

I have acne prone skin and I have come to accept that I will always have to take preventative measures to ensure that my skin remains breakout free. I use this is the morning on the areas of my face that are prone to break outs namely my chin and my cheeks. It really does help to control breakouts and i’ve seen a significant reduction in them since introducing this. It doesn’t overly dry out my skin either. Out of all spot treatments and over the counter acne treatments this is the best that I have used.My dermatologist has also given it her seal of approval.

product_name: Clear Improvement Pore Clearing Moisturizer with Salicylic Acid
review_text: I absolutely love this moisturizer. I don’t have a lot of acne but get breakouts on my chin and forehead every once in a while. I also suffer from texture in those places. After using this moisturizer just once, I woke up the next day with significantly less texture and the breakouts that I had were much smaller. This also eliminated any redness from the breakouts. After a week of using this once a day, I’m still in love! My texture is basically gone and I haven’t had any new breakouts. I did receive this product free for testing purposes but that doesn’t change my opinion.

product_name: Protini Powerpeptide Resurfacing Serum with Lactic Acid
review_text: It’s passable, but why? It performed about the same as a couple other products that are staples for me, but went in and stayed greasy-looking rather than being absorbed/drying rapidly. The smell wasn’t awful, but not pleasant like those equivalent products. So, ok, but I won’t be buying this underwhelming product again.

Got a little sample of it the smell is good and florally from the botanicals so it isn’t too strong and is still fragrance free but the consistency is more of a think oil than a serum but it felt very nice in the skin not sure if I will purchase a full size due to the price but I am curious

product_name: Original Skin Matte Moisturizer with Willowherb
review_text: Best moisturizer I’ve used in a long time!! The texture is super light weight but feels like your skin is taking a big drink of water when applied. It smells so fresh and clean, exactly how I want my skincare to smell. It’s a pretty strong scent, but it’s more floral/clean smelling so it’s perfect. I have oily skin and it truly does mattify the skin and dull imperfections exactly like it says. Love love love! Definitely will purchase and recommend.

I bought this over a year ago, and my bottle is still 3 quarters full because I don’t use it much and I never got the chance to return it then. An employee referred this one to me since I was looking for a nice moisturizer. I don’t like like cream because it barely absorbs into my skin and seems difficult to absorb it. I don’t like the fact that it doesn’t have any scent because it makes it feel like I am applying some kind of medicine cream. I don’t find this hydrating at all either, barely notice any difference. I still do use this cream from time to time just because its sitting in the cupboard and I might as well use it since I bought it.

Pleasantly surprised by this product it’s so light and the texture is almost like a jelly. My skin feels instantly hydrated like it’s drinking water. I love using this after a hot shower/before bed, very happy!

I received this from Influenster in exchange for my honest opinion. I don’t do sheet masks very often, but this one was pretty easy to apply! Like most clay masks it does a good job of soaking up oil on the skin, and it felt nice when it was on. However it’s very cold and dry where I am so I think it was a little too drying for me right now. I might like it better in the summer when my skin is more oily!

product_name: Superberry Hydrate + Glow Dream Night Mask with Vitamin C
review_text: Deeply moisturizing!  My older skin is rejoicing!  I use retin a, and this helps reduce the uglies!  I can only use retin a a few times a week because it peels so much, and this has definitely helped it to recover faster!

I bought this cleansing balm to see if it would be a good dupe for the Clinique take the day off balm. It did a nice job removing makeup but felt goopy and didn’t dissolve well. The style of product delivery via tube is wasteful. I thought I finished it but cut it open and there was tons of product left. The biggest plus was that it’s gentle and didn’t make my face feel dry after. If you don’t want to spend tons of money this is a good option but it definitely does not match Clinique’s cleansing balm.

This stuff is plain awesome. I always mix a few drops with my normal face lotion/moisturizer and it has done wonders. Its not an overnight thing, but with time, you will see a difference. I have combination skin, and my skin hasnt been dry at all since using it. Also, my tiny bumps on forehad have cleared up. This is safe for people with acne prone skin and sensitive skin as I am both. If your scared about the price, try the $14 bottle out for a month. You will be happy you did! I use my morning before makeup and at night before bed.

product_name: Blue Tansy BHA and Enzyme Pore Refining Mask
review_text: My skin is normally fairly sensitive to strong exfoliating products so I was a bit hesitant to try this mask - but, it has been great! I only leave it on for about 10 minutes, and while it does tingle, my skin has been feeling great since I started using it. As well as just being overall clearer and softer, my hyperpigmentation has finally began to fade thanks to this mask! I will definitely be repurchasing.
Used for a month and it made absolutely no difference in appearance or texture of my skin.  It’s just weird smelling water at a very very high price. Don’t fall for it like I did.
review_title: Its just weird smelling water w/ hefty price

review_text: If you care about your skin texture, this is great! It leaves the soft and moisture feeling afterwards. However, it does not do the best job to remove the eye make-up. You have to make extra effort.
Excellent product! It does what the package says.....moisture intense!

product_name: Green Clean Makeup Removing Cleansing Balm
review_text: Love this product. I swear the pores on my nose nose shrunk!
I have skin issues and it’s very sensitive. This Clarifying Lotion cleans my skin. It feels clean and looks great. I love it.

product_name: Lip Sleeping Mask Intense Hydration with Vitamin C
review_text: LOVE this product. Discovered in a beauty insider point perk and fell in love. Yes it is $20 for a lip balm, but for the amount of product you get it is WELL WORTH IT! I will use it at night, morning and during the day. Also, my boyfriend loves it.
Like the smell wasn’t too drying on my normal to combination skin received this product for free or complimentary for testing purposes

This moisturizer is emollient and plumping, and my skin feels really soft from using it. But sometimes after applying it, my face feels tight which could be the firming part, but it’s a little uncomfortable. I’ve noticed that when I apply it to more damp skin, I don’t have that sensation.

I always look foward to washing my face at night. Spray some toner, and use a few drops of this oil. My skin feels clean and soft with oil!! I noticed the texture and dark spots of my skin have improved.

I received a free sample of this product in exchange for my honest review.Honestly, I love this exfoliant. It’s like nothing I’ve ever used before and the results have been noticeable.I have acne prone skin, and I’ve been using salicylic acid based cleansers for most of my life to keep pimples at bay and control breakouts. Those have done the job for the most part, but there’s always been some lingering breakouts or blemishes. With this product though, my skin has been taken to the next level.I can see why the price point is as high as it is - this stuff really works and if you’re like me and want something to really get your skin to where it needs to be, give this a try.

This is my #1 must have. I work as a mail carrier, so I am out in the sun most of the day. I HATE using sunscreen because it either leaves a white cast, pills up, or leaves my face feeling tight. Supergoop is the only suncreen I have found that doesn’t do ANY of those things! It glides on, you only need a small amount, it’s clear and makes my face feel like velvet. I love it and will always have it in my arsenal to use daily.
It’s an effective product, if you can get past its strong smell. Personally, I didn’t mind the new shakeable formulation, but I just couldn’t stand the smell. I returned immediately.
review_title: Effective if you can get past the smell

product_name: CC Me Vitamin C + Niacinamide Serum
review_text: This serum is so sticky doesn’t feel nice at all horrible!!!!don’t buy this save your money

product_name: Abeille Royale Advanced Youth Watery Oil
review_text: I received this Guerlain Abeille Royale Advanced Youth Watery Oil in exchange for my honest review.I absolutely loved this product. I used it twice a day, morning and night, after thoroughly cleansing my face. I really liked the watery oil compared to regular face oils, because it is less greasy, easily absorbed and dries quicker. Prior to using this Advanced Youth Watery Oil, my skin was dull and a bit dry, and after only two times of using it, I noticed how radiant my skin looked, with a glow. I can really say that product is like liquid gold in a bottle. This watery oil has a pleasant scent that I enjoyed. I highly recommend this product as I really saw positive results on my skin.

This serum left my skin so bright and glowy! I have pale skin and I not this helped with my dullness and evened my skin.  It absorbs beautifully on the skin and doesn’t leave a sticky residue behind. It’s great for layering under moisturizer. Complimentary from Sunday Riley.

product_name: FAB Skin Lab Retinol Eye Cream with Triple Hyaluronic Acid
review_text: Love this-!  I’m half Asian and my upper eyelids started dropping as I got older (I’m 48 now) and started using this couple of weeks ago twice a day (as instructed) and WOW my upper eyelids are starting to get less droopy / puffy.  Was not expecting that!!! Love it!  Also my crows feet are diminishing.  Over all great product and will /already have recommended this to others.

I love the packaging how it’s so simple but cute in a way. The consistency of it being milky is somewhat in between being a little thick and watery which it somewhat runs like a serum. It’s smell isn’t so strong. For removing makeup off the face it doesn’t take it off completely but I use it after using makeup wipes and then use this product afterwards which takes off the leftover makeup on skin which I really like. Dried quickly and maybe the best part- NO TRANSFER ON MY CLOTHES AND I COULD SLEEP WITH IT ON!!!Cons- patchy when it fades. Like. Really patchy. I’m going to keep using this product, because of the pros. I can live with the cons. Just make sure you’re exfoliating WELL because it does come off patchy.:)

product_name: Goodbye Acne  Max Complexion Correction Pads
review_text: I am obsessed with this product. I get random breakouts and flare ups in my skin and this has significantly reduced those instances.

I was introduced to this product do to having very sensitive skin and very white with spots of redness. since iv started using it as a primer my skin looks even younger then it already did. I am so grateful to have found it. :) however the glass bottle does make it hard to transport.

product_name: Honeymoon Glow AHA Resurfacing Night Serum
review_text: So far I am loving this. The only cons I have are I am not a fan of the scent, and I’m not crazy about the tingle, but it’s not as bad as the Tarte Knockout. I do get a little bit of dryness in my usual dry spots so I’ll use my moisturizer after. A little goes a long way. About a pump and a half is perfect for me. Skin is soft, clear, Smooth, glowing in the morning.

For reference, my skin is normal to dry and I found this to definitely dry my skin out. After my cleanse my skin felt tight. I put on my essence and serums and STILL felt tight and dry. Aside from that the absolute biggest deal breaker is the scent. Since it is a face wash that I rinse right off I didnt think the fragrance would bother me that much, but it is beyond tolerable for me so if you are buying beware that the fragrance is very strong.

product_name: Mini Ready Steady Glow Daily AHA Tonic
review_text: In love with this toner. I have dry skin & with the colder air recently in socal, my skin got worse & even started to see the dead skin on my face. I went in to Sephora to get a new cleanser & more moisturizer, one of the reps recommended this to exfoliate the dead skin. I immediately saw the difference in my skin from the first use, my moisturizer went on so smoothly. It is also gentle enough to use daily. I would 100% recommend this if you’re looking to resurface your skin!

product_name: Lip Sleeping Mask Intense Hydration with Vitamin C
review_text: The best lip mask! I have ever used. And I had tried a few other brands this by far is superior. I highly recommend it. I also use it during the day. Just use a little and the price makes up for the hydrating your lips.
Cleared up my acne in a matter of days. This is the holy grail product. Worth the price, especially for cruelty free.

I cannot love without this product now that I’ve been using it! It has a sweet, like strawberry and citrus, like lemon, scent to it which is awakening but not overpowering. It’s an easy exfoliator to use too. Simply rub into skin until the sugars are dissolved. No over exfoliating, no redness, no irritation. Only skin that is soft and smooth.

product_name: Clear Improvement Charcoal Honey Mask to Purify and Nourish
review_text: You want to get rid of your pores and have a clean skin use this product. It came out a few years now. And its the best mask to use at Origins. Go with the charcoal honey and skip the old charcoal.

HOLY GRAIL!!! this product is amazing, I’ve been using for two weeks at night and sometimes morning and my skin is glowing, my pimples are gone my skin tone is even, my pores shrunk and my wrinkles I could barely notice them. If I could rate this product 100 stars I will
I like this product because it does not leave your skin sticky like most products. It leaves a nice glow.

So far, I’ve been loving the results from this product! Glow Recipe has been my favorite over the past couple of years! My only complaint with this product is that the cleanser comes out too quickly even without squeezing the bottle, and I feel like I waste product because of it.

product_name: Magic Cream Moisturizer with Hyaluronic Acid
review_text: Charlotte Tillbury lives up to it’s price and is an extremely luxurious cream, both in presentation and use! I have to say I’m a massive fan of the packaging, the unboxing feels exciting and the bottle itself is beautiful. The cream itself is very moisturizing and really does wonders to brighten and make the skin appear and feel hydrated and dewy. Definitely a great addition to my skincare routine! :-)

product_name: Fat Water Hydrating Milky Toner Essence with Hyaluronic Acid + Tamarind
review_text: I received this product from a free sample program and I’m honestly in love with it! I have a fairly simple skin routine and toner isn’t really part of it, but this toner just goes on so nicely that I decided to include it. I love how hydrated and moisturized my skin feels after I use it without feeling sticky or greasy. I’m also totally in love with the fragrance. It has a nice and fresh floral scent, but it’s also not too strong.

product_name: The Water Cream Oil-Free Pore Minimizing Moisturizer
review_text: Makes my skin sooooo soft and my pores appear much smaller whenever I use this. I have oily-combination skin that is usually very breakout prone to silicone in skincare but this product works very nicely. Granted I do still get oily throughout the day, but it has really helped with the redness I get around my t-zone!! It’s expensive but amazing for that porcelain-skin look! The formula is very lightweight but still hydrating: Melts into the skin!!

product_name: Find Your Balance Oil Control Cleanser
review_text: I love that this product is clean. It washes your face well. It smells like tea tree, so you feel fresh. I don’t honestly think it does anything in the way of preventing blemishes or reducing current blemishes. It does last a long time. I’ve had it for 5 or so months. Lathers well. Price is good. All in all it’s ok but I certainly do not think it is the miracle products others have reviewed.

product_name: Vitamin Enriched Face Base Priming Moisturizer
review_text: OBSESSED with this primer!!!! My make up stays on so well and glides on so nicely over this! It does have an orange smell but this goes away by the time I am done with my makeup. It is a little pricey but a little goes a long way and worth it as it works so well!

product_name: Mini Vitamin C Glycolic Brightening Serum
review_text: Amazing product, I use this at night and wake up with such radiant skin. I notice that my old acne scars start to lighten up!

product_name: Ultra Sun Protection Lotion Broad Spectrum SPF 50+ WetForce for Sensitive Skin & Children
review_text: Very disappointed with this product. I had been using the dark blue bottle of this same product and loved that it went on my darker skin very clear and smooth. I had been breaking out due to stress and decided to try this sensitive skin version and it made my skin look very white and streaky. I’m extremely disappointed compared to the other product. I will definitely be returning this. This is all I had brought with me on vacation and I had to buy new sunscreen it looked so bad.

product_name: Skinlongevity Long Life Herb Anti-Aging Face Serum
review_text: Overall, I really like this product. I have dry, acne-prone, sensitive skin, and can often get irritated by products that contain niacinamide. Niacinamide is one of the main ingredients in this serum, but fortunately did not cause me to break out. It is a thin, watery, non sticky formula and has a pleasant scent. A little bit goes a long way and I find that if I use it at night, I wake up looking brighter, clearer, and more even skin toned. Overall a really nice product. Could be slightly more powerful in disguising fine lines and wrinkles but does overall smooth out skin significantly.

I have combo/oily skin, so when an ugly blemish on my face decides to visit, this is definitely my go to. It does an awesome job drying it up. A little goes a long way, so if you pack it on- once it dries, it’ll flake.
Doesn’t feel sticky and makes my skin feel so moisturized all day.

product_name: Yo Glow AHA & BHA Facial Enzyme Scrub
review_text: I figured this would be just another overpriced product that wouldn’t do what it promised. But I was wrong. It smells amazing first off. It leaves my skin feeling so smooth without drying me out. And a little bit can go a long way when using this product. Also the size of the product is something I would be very happy with when purchasing. Often times you don’t get much product for your money but this isn’t the case here. I would forsure recommend!

I have very textured skin so compliments about my complexion are rare. That being said recently I was struggling with oil production and went to change my moisturizer. The Sephora staff tested the moisture levels on my skin and recommended this to me... holy cannoli ladies!!! Immediately people started suggesting I was pregnant because according to them I appeared to be “glowing”. No exaggeration every day since I started using this as my moisturizer someone tells me that I look beautiful sometimes they struggle to find the word and jokingly initially I would offer “glowing” as the word they might be looking for and 100% of the time they admit that is the word they wanted to say but shy away from because of it’s implicated subtext (pregnancy) and guess what I’m not pregnant. Nothing else in my routine has changed and all I can say is I’m sold...
review_title: Made so many people compliment my skin!!!

product_name: Mini The Essence  Skincare Boosting Treatment
review_text: Absolutely love this essence. I have been using it for about a week now and each time I apply it my skin feels very plump and hydrated. Did not break me out. Packaging is beautiful and easy to use! I did receive this product complimentary.

product_name: The POREfessional Tight ’n Toned Pore-Refining AHA+PHA Toner
review_text: Benefit Cosmetics gifted me this tight and toned aha-pha toner for free in exchange for my honest review. I have not used an active aha toner in a long time, but I have been experiencing pore congestion and thought I would try this toner. It is interesting to use because it’s not a regular liquid that you apply with a cotton pad. It’s a foam that you apply with your hands. I only use this toner every other day because of the drying out factor. I feel like using this in conjunction with the other products from this line is too drying, but you can use this on its own and just put a good moisturizer on top and skip the irritation. I recommend this product for anyone with congested pores or acne prone skin. Just make sure to wear SPF, too.
review_title: Nice, but too drying without a good moisturizer.

product_name: Ultimate Sun Protector Lotion SPF 50+ Sunscreen
review_text: I love this product! It’s tough to find good SPF to go under makeup but this is the holy grail. It has a very light, clean scent as well.

I’ve always been hesitant of face oils because I do have combo skin but this on its own and under makeup is so flawless and makes me glow without a greasy look. Definitely has helped with some dark spots as well and a little goes a long way if your concerned about price I think this is worth it!

I’ve been scarred from using exfoliators in the past when I didn’t know anything about skincare so I was hesitant about using this one but I’m glad I’ve tried it out!! This exfoliator is amazing and surprisingly gentle!
These are great on days I don’t wear makeup. Instead of washing my face for a quick pickup I just use the towelette. It feels great afterwards and I’m ready t go again.

product_name: Mini Cicapair Tiger Grass Color Correcting Treatment SPF 30
review_text: I do not have symptoms of rosacea anymore!  I think I have finally figured out the right combination and I love this stuff!
review_title: Expensive, but I am worth it!

I started using this regularly as recommended and I can see the difference. This will definitely be my “go to“ toner when I need to erase the appearance of dark spots on my skin.
I love how rich this cleanser is. It’s great if your worried about drying out you’re face. I received this product in a box from Influenster.
Omg!  This stuff is amazing!  It goes on smoothly and absorbs quickly into my skin.  It’s light and not sticky like most sunscreens I’ve used.  I absolutely LOVE it!!!

super creamy hydrated eyes. you must try this!!! before bed
i was i afraid of using this at first because of my sensitive skin, however i’ve used it a couple of times now and i loooooooveeee how my skin looks and feels!

This is fabulous. I’ve switched from the Clinique 72-hr hydration to this permanently. My skin loves it.I have dry/combination skin and I am prone to hormonal breakouts. I’ve noticed less breakouts since using this toner/moisturizer.

Absolutely in love with this cleanser, it’s so gentle and soft my skin feels amazing afterwards. Ever since I’ve started using this my acne has cleared up and my skin is way way less oily!!! At first I thought it smelled gross but after one or two uses I got used to it and now it doesn’t smell at all, plus no ones going to be smelling your face so that’s just a small con to this amazing wash, would highly recommend!!

I received several large samples of this cream and I ended up purchasing the full size. I would say it’s really more of a gel than a cream. It is so smooth, almost cooling, and doesn’t leave any kind of residue or feeling on the skin. I love it!
I’ve always been apprehensive on spending extra money on skincare products as there are endless products but this ACTUALLY makes a difference on how healthy my skin looks!

product_name: Protini Powerpeptide Resurfacing Serum with Lactic Acid
review_text: While the product itself may be great, I find that the quality of the packaging has declined. I noticed my sister’s protini serum bottle broke, but assumed it was just a one off thing.
