I use this as a spot treatment at night before bed and I wake up with terrible blemishes gone!  I don’t know how it does it, but I’m a believer!

product_name: Mini Watermelon Glow PHA + BHA Pore-Tight Toner
review_text: Really good , noticed the difference within a week of my face texture. Use it everyday with or without makeup.
This product doesn’t do a great job at moisturizing my skin. It has a thin, almost serum-like texture

product_name: Wrinkle Blur Bakuchiol Eye Gel Crème
review_text: I am a fan of Ole Henrikson products. I love the citrus scent and how lightweight it feels upon application. I like her versatile the product is i can use it a night or right before applying my makeup. The product has a slight tingle once applied. I have natural dark circles under my eyes and am not quite sure that this product would help remove it.

product_name: Multivitamins 15% Vitamin C + Retinol Mini Set
review_text: Love these products honestly but these bottles are very tiny as per value of gift set. But good part is you get to try the products for less value.
review_title: Good product but tiny size for value

review_text: Love using this tone at night! I actually started using it because of my friend. I loved it so much I got the cleanser too! I sweat so much from the gym and doing my hair the oils travel down my face over time so this works great for that
review_title: One of the best toners out !

product_name: Daily Cleanse Clear Skin and Body Detox Supplement
review_text: I received this product complimentary from HUM Nutrition. I’ve been using it for about a week now and can’t say I see any difference in my skin. I saw some of the other reviews however and decided that I would only take one capsule a day instead of 2 as it says to do on the bottle as I didn’t want an upset stomach. I like that it has a few minerals too in addition to their herbal blend though.

product_name: Take The Day Off Cleansing Balm Makeup Remover
review_text: Texture is so soft and gentle on my skin. Removes my dark kohl eyeliner and mascara without blinding me with oil smears. The large tub will last forever but I intend to repurchase
I think this product is really good! it makes your skin feel so soft. It also cleared up some of the bad acne i have.

product_name: Mini Deep Cleanse Gentle Exfoliating Cleanser
review_text: I love this stuff and bought the big bottle hoping it would have a pump or something and was disappointed to see it is the same as the sample! You have to dump it over and hit against your palm to come out. As expensive this is it should come with a better top. Other than that I love this stuff!

I’ve been using drug store brand cleansers for most of my life-don’t ask me why- and they never worked for me. My face gets very dry in the winter and it makes it so difficult to put on even the best primer and foundation. It always looked cakey. A Sephora consultant suggested this with the Fresh soy serum and face cream and oh my gosh what a difference! I use it every day, and my skin is brighter and there’s literally no more dry skin, even when I skip a day. It makes my primer and foundation glide on. I’ll never go back to store brands, that’s for sure!Also, the soy exfoliant is awesome too! Just make sure not to use it every day like I did (because I’m a dummy).

I really wanted to like this. Unfortunately, I hate plumping lip products. Burning mentholy or whatever burning ingredient is in there just isn’t for me. Couldn’t focus on how it felt I was just trying to get it off. #freeproduct #trywithtopbox

game changer. really visibly brightens my overall complexion. also, whenever i see a pimple coming on i use this at night before bed and the next morning the pimple is already dried out. niacinamide is a miracle.

I use the laneige glowy lip balm on its own. It provides a really subtle color on the lips and a really lovely smell. It’s really hydrating and long lasting, I was surprised! I received this in my voxbox from influenster!

Not sure why I saw so much hate about this in these reviews....it’s a cleansing balm. All that I ask of a cleansing balm is these 3 things: 1. Take off my makeup 2. I have very very dry skin so I decided to purchase something small to carry around to use as body lotion. I do like it but it doesn’t smell that great nor does it work that well. product_name: Skinlongevity Long Life Herb Anti-Aging Face Serum
review_text: I’ve been using this serum every night for the last month or so. I have noticed my skin is more radiant and some of my post acne hyperpigmentation has gone away faster than usual. I love how they’ve partnered with a real dermatologist, Dr. Joyce Park

product_name: Ultimate Sun Protector Lotion SPF 50+ Sunscreen
review_text: This is a great SPF to protect your skin. However, I took one star off because it doesn’t cooperate with my foundations. It will pill and clump up with my foundation after about an hour. It could just be my skin/makeup combination that doesn’t agree with this sunscreen because others have said it works great with makeup. I suggest getting a sample before getting the full size. This also has a heavy fragrance which I really love but others may not. I was given this product for free for review purposes.

product_name: Advanced Retinol + Ferulic Overnight Wrinkle Treatment
review_text: I’d give this product 6 stars if I could. I have repurchased it over and over for years. It is the only product I’ve ever used that visibly reduced the appearance of the deep smile lines/parentheses around my mouth. I am in my early 30s. In my 20s I smoked for (I know), which really makes those lines around your mouth very deep. This is the only serum I have ever found to reduce the appearance of those lines, and it does a phenomenal job. I often get compliments on my skin, and this is one of the two products in my routine that really makes a difference (the other is Vivier CE Peptides, which isn’t sold here). This product is fantastic and I never want to be without it.

This product was alright. I used it twice and noticed each time afterwards that I would get a couple pimples/rough bumpy skin. I have sensitive skin. The scent was super light. A little goes a long way.

I’m in love with GOOPGLOW Microderm Instant Glow Exfoliator from Goop.  Very delicate skin exfoliating.  Nice texture.  Skin after very soft, fresh and clean.  Thanks goop for gifted me this amazing product!
December hit and my skin freaked out! I was super dry. This oil saved the day. It’s not too greasy either.

product_name: Mini Cicapair Tiger Grass Color Correcting Treatment SPF 30

product_name: Daily UV Defense Invisible Broad Spectrum SPF 36 Sunscreen
review_text: Really great affordable SPF. Feels smooth and leaves no white cast.

product_name: Squalane + Omega Repair Deep Hydration Moisturizer
review_text: I actually thought my product was expired because it smells like when my husky is wet. Think of stinky feet mixed with wet dog and that’s what this smells like. The ingredients felt nice and creamy. Good hydration. But the smell is so bad, it feels gross putting it on clean skin. Had really high expectations but this is a hard pass. Please change this smell and you’ve got a customer.

product_name: Lip Sleeping Mask Intense Hydration with Vitamin C
review_text: I recieved this product complimentary to review from Laniege and Influenster. Upon recieving the product I was quite curious as to how it would work as I am quite picky but I was pleasantly surprised by the results. The lip mask smells absolutely wonderful with delicious hints of grapefruit and has a light moisturising feel to ensure that your lips will always be hydrated. I love wearing this all day no matter what time but it is recommended to put on before sleep. It reminds me of a luxurious lip balm and my lips havent felt smoother.

Gifted by Dermalogica Sampling- Used it a few times, it does not have a scent to it, it’s just a white powder that needs to be mixed with water and massaged on the skin. I found it very messy to work with, the powder got on my entire bathroom counter. It is meant to be a physical exfoliant so it felt grainy with somewhat large beads. I would honestly rather a pre made and a chemical exfoliant like alpha or beta hydroxy acid!No mess, even results, happy life :)

I have always wanted to try a spray tan but i was very nervous to spend the money on it incase I looked orange or looked patchy. But after reading all the reviews I bought the product (in shade light) and I am very happy with the outcome! I’m usually very pale but this turned me, as the light color is called sun kissed glow. Applying the product was so easy and for my first time ever no streaks or patches! I recommend it for beginners. The smell is nice too! Just shower shave/exfoliate and moisturize at least a few hours before your tanner application and the mitt by isle of paradise is okay, it feels a little thin like it could rip but for your first glove it works like a charm!

product_name: Mini Glowscreen Sunscreen SPF 40 PA+++ with Hyaluronic Acid + Niacinamide
review_text: I really wanted to love this product after reading such rave reviews, but after trying it only two times, my skin was not happy. The burning feeling lasted all day until I realized this wasn’t working for me, and washed it all off. I also broke out in tiny little whiteheads all over my face, especially on my forehead, which I read in reviews has happened to others as well. My face hurt so bad and looked so irritated for weeks. This has to go back, and if you have sensitive skin, I’d be careful. My skin is pretty normal and I’ve never had a problem with a sunscreen before, but it did not like this product at all.

product_name: Mini Liquid Silk Canvas: Featherweight Protective Primer

review_text: I have been very pleasantly surprised by this sunscreen. review_text: Love that there is no smell. Thick and not oily. Don’t ever need to rinse afterwards.

I tried as a sample and have restocked a couple of times.

review_text: This cleansing balm is the bomb! It’s very dense until you swirl it around and then it becomes soft and creamy. My makeup comes off easily and effortlessly without any residual remnants.  The mini lasts longer than you would think. Definitely recommend if you are a cleansing balm person.

product_name: Lip Sleeping Mask Intense Hydration with Vitamin C
review_text: I have both the original and vanilla and they are amazing!! i absolutely love this lip mask

product_name: Double Serum Firming & Smoothing Anti-Aging Concentrate
review_text: I received this for free by influenster for my honest review. I love everything Clarins so I’m probably biased, lol. But I literally saw results in like 4/5 days of using this product. Feels good going on and your skin is hydrated. I’m 39 so I don’t have any wrinkles or sagging skin but I’m sure this will definitely make sure that will never happen.

product_name: The Water Cream Oil-Free Pore Minimizing Moisturizer
review_text: This cream has greatly improved my skin after a week of use! I use it in the AM and PM after cleansing and toning my face. I don’t wear makeup on the daily, so I can’t say if this cream holds up to makeup. I used to have tiny little milia around my eyes and on my cheeks. This cream has helped to get rid of them altogether. AND my pores look way smaller than before! I seriously was not expecting that much of a difference. I agree with others who said the texture is odd at first. It most definitely feels like I’m applying plain water, but you get used to it quickly.  I also recently purchased the Satin Skin Mist, and let me tell you these two together are a wicked combo!!Now that summer is around the corner, my skin is going to be on oil hyperdrive, which no one wants! The water cream has been a life-saver for me, and I look forward to seeing it in action over the next couple of months!!

product_name: Revitalizing Supreme+ Youth Power Creme Moisturizer
review_text: I was very excited to try this moisturizer out, and so far I have really loved using this. I would repurchase it but it would not be the only moisturizer I would use, I try to follow what my skin needs and there are times I need a little extra hydration and so I would use one of my heavier creams instead. It is scented so if you are sensitive to smells this may not be for you.

review_text: Honestly, I don’t even know where to start.  This product is AMAZING!  I couldn’t believe how good the texture felt, creamy yet not oily. I am SO glad I did.  I wouldn’t have known how amazing this is.  It is definitely worth the money, and I will be buying it. I will be using this forever.  I am a lifelong fan.

(Prequel obligatory skin type discretion: I have fair skin, semi-sensitive, large pores, normal-leaning-dry skin that becomes oily in hot weather, occasional dusting of small surface-level pimples, and sticky cells that respond well to glycolic acid and AHA’s for exfoliation) Okay ya’ll. I’m almost finished with my bottle because I wanted to give this a real shot at showing long-term results, and let me preface this review by saying: I adore DE products. I never saw as much tangible visual difference in my skin tone and texture than the before/after of when I used their vitamin c, glycolic night serum, peptide moisturizer, baby facial, and marula oil. My friends and colleagues cannot get me to shut up about how great they are. My skin dramatically changed for the better when I incorporated those products into my skincare, but perhaps they corrected me to the point where I will no longer notice visible results, because absolutely nothing happened from the before/after of using the F-Balm Waterfacial.Literally nothing. I’m talking zero difference in: tone, texture, hydration, moisture retention, brightening, breakouts, blackheads, or sunspots. Zip, zada, zilch. I suppose it “tightened” and “reduced the volume” of my bank account though. It’s a medium-thickness viscosity, which makes me wonder why the heck someone even needs this when they have a super thick moisturizer and fast-absorbing marula oil in their line. And in the mornings it pills up in little dry balls and flakes off the face. Very very strange. I don’t understand the point of this product.

Note: This product does NOT do anything for dark circles.This product is great if you have dry eyelids and under eyes. Super moisturizing! I didn’t even know dry eyelids and under eyes were a thing until I started wearing makeup. I’d always notice little flakes of skin popping up when I blended eyeshadow on my crease and eyelid, and when I blended concealer on my under eyes, the flakes would show and make my under eyes look dry, cakey and heavy looking. Not so when using this eye cream! It goes on super smooth and creamy and it’s instantly moisturizing. It’s thick and heavy enough to provide ample moisture that you can feel, but not too heavy that it’s uncomfortable. 10/10 would recommend to anything suffering with dry/flaky under eyes and eyelids. I don’t really have dark circles, but as the title and description of this product stresses that it’s geared more towards correcting dryness and not darkness, and that the ingredients list doesn’t list anything known for lightening darkness under the eyes, I wouldn’t say that this is useful for correcting darkness under the eye that isn’t brought on by dryness.
review_title: Great for moisture, not for dark circles

review_text: I’ve tried many retinol serums with mixed results, some are too strong to use on my sensitive skin or too weak to notice a difference- this one has been game changing! Thankfully the moisture bomb tempers the impact down (but doesn’t stop the topical from working - they might be a perfect match). If someone could mix the aqua bomb and the moisture bomb, this would be the best ever. Sadly, mixing on my own for nearly $70 isn’t something I’m interested in.

product_name: Black Tea Corset Cream Firming Moisturizer
review_text: I received this Black Tea Corset Cream as a birthday gift. It is a nice, smooth, pleasant skin cream. It smells good, but not strong or perfumey. It works pretty well as a moisturizer.But the “Corset” part is nowhere to be found. A lot of the Fresh products I’ve tried are like this: Pleasing to use, but no quick results. And in my case, I use it almost exclusively on my neck. Sagging or loose skin and loss of elasticity are problems only on my throat and upper eyelids, so I use Caudalie serum and La Mer Cream on my face.For several weeks, I’ve faithfully used the “corset” cream on my neck and jawline.For the bold claim implied by its name, and the price, I really expected at least minor results by this time. But this corset ain’t pulled tight enough!I don’t even feel a minor, brief tightening or firming sensation when it goes on my skin. I feel nothing but a fairly light-textured moisturizer.The biggest disappointment is that the skin on my neck looks looser and less elastic than it did more than a month ago! I gave it three stars for the nice scent, smooth texture, and moisturizer. But the main attraction—that ‘face corset’ feeling and results are completely absent so far.I know there are much better skin firming neck and décolleté creams out there. But since this is a brand that, to me, makes milder and gentler products with slower results, I will be patient, hope for any firming of my throat, and finish the jar.With luck, Corset Cream is just a late bloomer that takes a long time to kick in. If it doesn’t start tightening skin, I’ll be heading over to Algenist, Perricone, or PTR. If this Black Tea Corset Cream doesn’t start showing any firming results, I will not purchase this (glad it was a gift) nor try the eye cream that goes along with it.

product_name: Alpha Beta Ultra Gentle Daily Peel Pads for Sensitive Skin
review_text: I have very sensitive skin, and I was a bit nervous about trying these at first, but I’d heard such great reviews that I decided to try out the sensitive ones. If you’re sensitive like me, I’d also start building your tolerance to chemical exfoliants slowly - maybe once a week at first until your skin gets used to it all or else you’ll get redness and irritation no matter what product you try.

5 points:  (1) This is a hidden gem & I am surprised we don’t hear more about this really great product. It is scent-free. It is offered at a reasonable price - you get 150ml which lasts quite a long time, given you only need a bit of product per face wash.  (2) This is a BALM which means the product is in between being solid and liquid. Thus it is a thicker consistency than your typical lotion or liquid cleanser. (3) How to use: I rub a dime-sized amount between my hands, which changes the consistency from balm to liquid, then apply it to a damp or dry face.  I then add a bit of water to my face and massage it into my skin. Adding water gets the product to lather a bit. I personally am not into the “double cleanse“ routine, so I just wipe off the cleanser with a super-soft face cloth.  It leaves my face feeling soft, without any residue. (4) It is great for removing eye makeup, without eye irritation. (5) I have VERY sensitive skin. I use prescription tretinoin (retinoid) which makes my skin dry & sensitive to most products. My skin often stings when applying moisturizers or cleansers. This balm is actually soooo soothing and calms my skin: no stinging, no burning, no irritation.  BOTTOM-LINE: This is a cost-effective, scent-free cleansing balm which is safe for use around your eyes. It is calming to most skin-types & an effective cleanser. It is definitely worth a try!  (PS - At first it was hard to get the product out of the tube, but that improves with use.  If you have any problems, just knead the tube to soften the balm).

review_text: Received as part of a promotion in exchange for my honest review. This stuff is awesome! The jar is nicely sized to last. A little goes a long way. It’s silky smooth and goes on easily. Left my skin so hydrated and soft. I haven’t used it long enough to see all the benefits, but my skin is definitely glowing after just a couple uses! It has zero scent, comes with a cute little applicator. Amazing moisturizer!!

product_name: Lip Sleeping Mask Intense Hydration with Vitamin C
review_text: Really liked this formula, very smooth and smelled great! My lips get dry very often and after using this overnight, my lips definitely felt smoother than usual the next day. I received this product complimentary for testing purposes.

This lip balm saved my dry, peeling lips this winter and has continued to keep them soft and healthy ever since. I keep it near me at all times. I took one star away because I wish the ingredients did not include the essential oils that are the last few items on the list.

I was gifted by dermalogica daily mircrofoliant , I really love the results on my skin so effective products, my skin more smooth and brightening I looks more younger and beautiful. I highly recommend it.

I really loved this product! You only need 2 pumps to fully cover your face and its the perfect amount dispensed! I have dry sensitive skin and this did not cause any irratation and it kept my skin hydrated and soft! Its very refreshing and it dont have a strong smell, its a light crisp scent. I like that it didnt leave any residue or feel sticky or slimy, instead it absorbs right away leaving soft hydrated skin! I will now be adding this to ny beauty routine and will use it through out the day when my skin starts to feel dry and i need a little refresher! I recommend this for any skin types even sensitive skin types like myself!
Smells to yummy! It left my skin feeling silky and smooth. I used it in the morning when I woke up and followed up with the moisturizer and it was heavenly!

Love this mask! I wouldn’t spend the money for the large jar however. I bought the set which includes the mask, face cream and toner. I use all 3 after I get out of the shower at night. I am loving how hydrated my skin feels. The mask is very lightweight and I love that. I have used other masks before that crust on when they dry and it starts to hurt but this mask is actually really good. I would def recommend this to people. My face is always changing between oily and dry so this is actually a nice balance for my skin.

Love that this sunscreen stick is ocean friendly. It is super lightweight and didn’t cause me to break out. It smells nice and goes on completely clear - I even put it on over my makeup with no issues. Would definitely recommend

product_name: Ultimate Sun Protector Lotion SPF 50+ Sunscreen
review_text: Goes on smoothly and has a nice thin consistency. The scent is mildly perfume-y and it leaves a bit of a greasy residue. It’s the middle of winter in NY so I cannot attest to its sun blocking benefits at this time but I’m looking forward to using it as the weather warms up. I received this product complimentary in exchange for my honest review

product_name: Ultra Glow Serum: Glow + Strengthen Vitamin C Serum
review_text: Leaves skin feeling softer and satiated instantly. I use it in the morning with a moisturizer on top. My skin is happy! Well worth the price.
I’ve been using this product for 2 weeks now and my skin is so clear now ! Love it!!!!
Great basic eye cream at an affordable price. Not necessarily for firming deep lines and wrinkles, but will smooth fine lines as it hydrates. Put it in your fridge for a soothing, cool eye treat.

product_name: Vitamin Enriched Face Base Priming Moisturizer
review_text: To achieve flawless makeup, a well-moisturized and hydrated base is needed.  I decided to try this face base before applying my makeup on my face and it helped achieve a dewy finish. Going to try this out more.

I think i had my hopes a little high on this one. I did get a pretty bad sunburn and figured it was because i didn’t use enough. The next time i used way more and still got burnt and it ran into my eyes. I was glad i got the mini to try it out.

This is my current fave product! The Retinol + Bakuchiol combo works so well with my skin. My skin is so smooth and texture has improved a lot since I started using it. It applies very easy and I like the creamy consistency.
Addicted to this! It’s a very gentle scrub that I use daily. It makes my skin look so bright!

product_name: Skinlongevity Long Life Herb Anti-Aging Face Serum
review_text: I got this thru PINCHme and I love how great my skin is starting to look!

I bought this because of its high rate, and it didn’t disappoint me at all. Smells sweet like a real yogurt, light foam. and it’s the first amino acids cleanser I’ve ever found that actually has enough cleaning power to make my oily skin feeling refreshed. A perfect pal with my LUNA.

This is a really great product! I like to really wait a few months before reviewing the product but it truly works. I love that it also contains Lactic Acid, Niacinamide and Aloe! It’s like an all in one! A great product! Glad I got the chance to try it.

This mask will leave your skin glowing and so, so hydrated. I use it as an overnight mask after doing my whole skincare routine. It lives up to the hype! I wake up with the smoothest, refreshed skin. It is a must have. I cannot wait to see the rest of the line!
I really like these acne healing dots/pimple patches. I don’t care for the hefty price tag but whatever helps out I will conjoint to purchase!!

this is a great cleanser. my skin was so dry and other cleansers i tried would dry it out more. This cleanser did none of that. Its so gentle and when it says that it has ingredients to calm redness.. it does. The first day I used it my face was full of red blemishes and I swear the day after they were just a LOT less red. It has really no scent so its great for everyone and fairly inexpensive compared to other cleansers.

product_name: Midnight Recovery Concentrate Moisturizing Face Oil
review_text: I ordered the 100 ML bottle last month thinking it would last me a little while! I am so upset i noticed the little glass syringe wont reach the product anymore!!! They make the actual glass bottle so heavy that I didn’t even notice how much product there was when i received it! I have only been using 2 drops as instructed and it is not possible for the product to be finishing in a month! I got the product when it was 15% off but thats still 155 dollars i paid with tax! Unbelievable. I am so disappointed with Sephora in not ensuring i received a full product!! Has anyone else has had a similar experience?

I mean it works and it def takes your makeup off but it doesn’t melt into your face. You def have to work it in. Once washing it off it feels like you still have to wash it off so you def have to double cleanse. I got this under the impression it would work as a 2-in-1 (kind of like an oil to water based) cleanser but that is not the case. I probably won’t buy it again.
review_title: Doesn’t Melt into Face, Hard to Wash Off

review_text: This moisturizer is lightweight yet super moisturizing! It feels nice and rich when you blend it in your skin keeping you hydrated all day! Love it!
I really like this product! It smells great and leaves my skin feeling moisturized and even. Definitely becoming part of the regular regimen.

I’m a little amazed how well this takes off make up. I’ve used it in the shower to melt off my make up then cleaned with my BHA cleanser after. I tried to see if some make up was left by wiping w micellar water afterwards but the cotton pad was clean, no make up residue was left. I have acne prone skin with blackheads and this doesn’t aggravate it. My only complaint is that it does kind of remain on the surface of the skin and makes your vision a little cloudy/greasy after using it on the eyes. All in all a good cleanser to get make up and waterproof sunscreen off
review_title: Takes off all make up, OK for acne prone skin

review_text: I received this from Dermalogica Sampling to try out and I am VERY impressed. It says it smooths and brightens skin in seven days, and it definitely did with my skin. It contains Papaya Enzymes, Salicylic Acid, and Phytic Acid, which is from Rice Bran. It is super easy to use, and rinses off quickly. The powder isn’t abrasive, and made my skin feel so clean and fresh.

I have been really enjoying the toner because it leaves my skin feeling moisturized, it doesn’t take off all the moisture off of my skin. I have a lot of pores around ny nose and cheeks and I haven’t seen improvement with pore shrinkage. My skin is normal and I get minimal breakouts. I only ever break out when it’s that time of the month. I have been using it and any small breakout has been minimized or completely gone(kills any little bumps overnight). However the large pores I still haven’t seen any improvement. Overall I think its good to keep skin clean and help fight small breakouts. This product was gifted to me by innisfree.

product_name: Smart Clinical Repair Wrinkle Correcting Serum
review_text: I have been using this for a week straight mainly at nights. I can tell a huge difference. The serum soaks right into my skin. It also gives me a slight glow. My skin has also cleared up since starting this serum. I love the look of my skin.
Feels amazing on skin and leaves it glowing. Rinses off easily and doesn’t leave a film

I am enjoying the microfoliant cleanser Dermalogica gifted me. I notice my skin appearing to glow more and feel smoother. I currently have a sun tan on my face and this Microfoliant has made my sun tan pop if this makes sense. It doesn’t irritate the skin or leave it feeling dry.

Hands down best for 30 somethin’ combo skin that can’t decide if it wants a drink or an oil-blotting sheet. Adds that needed moisture to my sandpaper spots & controls over-production of oil on the t-zone. The gel formula feels light, not heavy or greasy. Love it!
Smells and feels great !

product_name: ICE Ceramide Moisturizer with Vitamin F
review_text: This is some of the best moisturizing cream I have ever tried. I have always had fairly dry skin and used to avoid wearing black shirts bc I would notice flakes from my face halfway thru the day. This stuff has changed my life. The best part is a little goes a looooong way. I feel like I have barely made a dent in it so far. I love the way it feels when applying and my skin is SO soft afterwards. It doesn’t feel like it clogs my poor’s and I look forward to applying it ever night after washing my face. Highly recommend!

This has been the answer to my winter dry skin nightmare! I’ve been searching for a moisturizer to tame my dry skin and I’ve finally found it. The texture is more of a gel but not slimy like some I’ve used. It goes on smooth and absorbs nicely. Don’t leave skin feeling sticky or oily. I wake up to skin looking so hydrated, plump and glowing I’m so glad I was sent this complementary in my  o box. I will definitely be purchasing again and again!

The lip balm feels very nice and moisturizing at first. However, after 30 or 40 mins, it starts to dry down and leaves my lips feel dry and chapped. It’s not the worst product in the world, but not the best either. I received this as gratis so I am not emotionally invested in the pricing on this, however, I imagine had I paid for this I would be very upset at the $18 wasted. For what it’s worth, I prefer the tarte quench lip rescues which are the same price, or the very expensive fresh lip balms.
Good product. Seems to work well. Pretty pricey, though.

product_name: Mini Take The Day Off Cleansing Balm Makeup Remover
review_text: This by far the best make-up removing balm I have ever used! I’ve tried a few others, and while good, I always end up going back to this one. It removes the majority of my make up and does not strip my skin or make it feel tight - it works great with my sensitive skin. One of these will last me a couple of months and I think I’m on my third repurchase. I do a second cleanse with a gentle face wash after using this (just to ensure my skin is completely clean) and my skin feels fantastic!
This mask actually surprised me. I have really sensitive, acne-prone skin and this mask didn’t cause any problems— no breakouts or irritated skin.
Used for the first time tonight and I’m very impressed with the feel of it.  My skin felt smooth and goopy right away.  Excited to see how this goes.
Had a couple samples of the jar sent from Sephora and opened one this morning to use only to find hair in the cream.

product_name: Mini Cicapair Tiger Grass Color Correcting Treatment SPF 30
review_text: I bought this product to help with my rosacea. It does it’s job neutralizing and calming redness, but i don’t think it has helped reduce the amount of flare ups. Goes from green to natural looking skin very quickly. I also had some issues with the texture of the cream, it’s thick and coarse so be careful with how you apply. I have very dry and sensitive skin, so it clings to dry patches and accumulates in noticeable pores if I’m not hydrated enough. I recommend using a good moisturizer before applying and tapping it lightly. I used a damp beauty blender and everything went on smoothly. Overall a good product for rosacea, but it takes some tricks for it to look nice on the skin.
review_title: Difficult to apply but does the job

product_name: Green Clean Makeup Removing Cleansing Balm
review_text: This is the best cleansing balm that I have ever tried, and I have tried a lot. The consistency is very light and when you begin working it into your skin, it quickly turns into a slippery oil which makes it SO quick and effective at removing makeup (even the layers of waterproof mascara that I use daily). I don’t really like thicker cleansing balms like the Drunk Elephant Slaii Cleansing Balm. I find those thicker balms hard to work into the skin and it feels like I am tugging at my face and eyes to try to get my makeup off. I also really enjoy the scent of this product, it is like a light lime scent that is very uplifting.
My favorite cleanser/makeup remover and I hate cleansers. This completey cleanses my face, even mascara and eyeliner. Leaves my face feeling perfect, not stripped. I love this!!

product_name: Mini Liquid Silk Canvas: Featherweight Protective Primer
review_text: I loved the silk canvas so I was excited for liquid silk canvas and it didn’t fail! Amazing application goes on smoothly. One pump is enough for all over the face. Pore-filling and smoothing for-sure! Would recommend more for oily/combination texturized skin. I apply with fingertips as I feel it slips into skin smoother. Great value for it’s price. I luckily received it complimentary on Influenster. Pic is me after 6 hour wear.

product_name: THE GRADUAL Illuminating Gradual Tan Lotion
review_text: Perfect buildable tan, especially if you are on the pale side to start. Not very hydrating so I supplement with my normal lotion a few hours later.

I really like this cleansing oil. I have tried several, but so far I like this one the best. My skin can be sensitive at times, specially during the winter and I enjoy using this oil because it’s so gentle on my skin. It’s pretty good for removing make-up, but I follow with my regular cleanser. I mainly use it to remove my makeup. It lasts a while since it’s so thick.

product_name: Ultra Facial Moisturizing Cream with Squalane
review_text: I have combination skin where my oily spots are really oily and my dry spots are extremely dry and flaky. I love this moisturizer so much because it’s very hydrating, but also super lightweight! Absorbs into your skin so nicely and is not greasy at all! It’s really humid where I live and I sweat a lot so I originally thought this might be too heavy for a summer daily moisturizer, but it’s absolutely perfect! Highly recommend!

I have combination skin that very dry in the winter months. I purchased a mini-size of this moisturizer based on the reviews. This product did nothing but made my skin matte looking (which I hate) and feels drier. I had to add jojoba oil on top of it. I think a product should be able to stand on its own without having to add anything. Glad I purchased the small size.

product_name: Redness Solutions with Probiotic Technology Daily Relief Cream
review_text: I love the natural Aroma, texture and calming relief! This helped me thru RX tretinoin or Retin A. Perfect for irritated skin of any kind. It’s really just very GOOD!

product_name: Advanced Night Repair Eye Concentrate Matrix Synchronized Multi-Recovery Complex
review_text: I received a sample of this for free to try from Influenster and I am so glad I did! I have been looking for something gentle for my eyes. My allergies have been acting up and I have been working a lot of all-night shifts. I was very pleasantly surprised to see how rested my eyes look in the morning when I use this. I will be purchasing the full size. I do recommend, it is just what I would expect from one of my favorite brands in skincare!

It goes on smooth and it really helps improve the texture of my skin. I use this once a week. I put it on after I have washed my face and washed off my clay mask. It works great with my Clinique night cream and can see an improvement over night.
This product breaks me out so badly... my skin is always so congested after I use this. Although it does hydrate and soothe, it breaks me out like nothing before.

product_name: Mini Glowscreen Sunscreen SPF 40 PA+++ with Hyaluronic Acid + Niacinamide
review_text: This sunscreen has an advertised pearlescent glow which I am sure is nicer on fairer skintones. I have a deep skintone so the pearlescent glow shows up as more of a silvery shimmer on my face. I sort of look like the tin man from the Wizard of Oz. I would not recommend this for deep skintones because of the color but I do like the texture of the product. It does seem like it would be a good makeup primer because it is slightly tacky (very light) and should grip makeup well. I wish they would come out with a version of this product with more of a golden or bronze shimmer for deeper skintones.
review_title: Product works well but not for deeper skintones

product_name: Mini Revitalizing Supreme+ Youth Power Creme Moisturizer
review_text: I’m not a huge fan of thick moisturizers. But I have to say I’ve really enjoyed trying out the Estee Lauder New Revitalizing Supreme+ Youth Power Creme. My skin looks and feels soft and glowing after using this moisturizer.

I haven’t seen much results from this orthodoxy but I do love how it feels under my concealer. Very interesting texture- almost like a solid cream to liquid one you rub it between your fingers. Hoping for good results as I’ve been using the product for 2 weeks now. I received this product for free in my influenster’s voxbox.
5/5 !!! the only negative to this product is that my boyfriend now says “PEACE OUT ACNE“ every time I’m wearing one of these dots.. but they work! LOL

I hate that I love this product so much! I am not a Gwenyth fan, but this is exfoliator is so amazing! My skin is so soft and dewy after. My skin has cleared up of texture. It’s pricy, but, it’s actually worth it
review_title: Hate that I love this so much!

product_name: Skinlongevity Long Life Herb Anti-Aging Face Serum
review_text: The Skinlongevity Long Life Herb Anti-Aging Face Serum is great. It made my skin feel smooth and look rejuvenated. I love that it blended well and did not make my skin feel greasy. I highly recommend this product.
Received in the Trendmood box. Love the fine mist. Leaves skin looking dewy not oily.

This has become my all time favorite first step cleanser. It is so soothing and comforting on my eczema-prone skin. It does leave a little bit of moisture on the skin if you don’t thoroughly rinse, but that is honestly part of why I love it. I wash my face at night in the shower, and I do this step before getting in while my face is dry. I intentionally don’t rinse this off completely.  The tiny bit of moisture left before my second cleanse (Paula’s Choice Hydrating) keeps my skin from getting so dry and irritated from the steam and keeps my second cleanse from over-stripping. I haven’t yet tried this without a second cleanse because I’m paranoid, but I might as we get deeper into winter.Also love that I don’t have to mess with jar packaging.Now, you do have to learn to work with it a bit, but it’s totally worth it. I shake and massage the tube every night before use to keep it from separating. It’s also quite thick, so I use a little more than I would other balms to ensure I can cover my face and neck without tugging. I don’t know why some reviews say this doesn’t emulsify - I add a little water to my hands and it gets perfectly milky and rinses away. You do have to start with it being dry, though.My expensive cleansing balms just sit in the drawer because this is honestly so much better. So happy they brought out a smaller size for travel!!!
review_title: Holy Grail for Dry and Sensitive Skin

product_name: Hello FAB Coconut Skin Smoothie Priming Moisturizer
review_text: I first tried a sample of this and soon fell in love! I had to purchase it. The smell is amazing, it feels nice and moisturizing without being too heavy. I use it in the morning after cleansing and before putting on my makeup.

This cleanser has quickly become my favorite cleanser. It smells and feels really good. I like to use it every morning because I know I don’t have a lot of products on my face, and I love how gently it cleans my skin without drying it out. I wouldn’t recommend it as a makeup-removing cleanser, but it’s an excellent cleanser for a feel-good or light wash.

product_name: Advanced Génifique Radiance Boosting Face Serum
review_text: AMAZING! Love how soft my skin feels when I use it and how it dries so quickly. This lets me do my makeup and other daily routine right after wearing it! Definitely recommend!

product_name: Face Glaze Skin Barrier Protect & Glow Moisturizer
review_text: I have oily skin, and this product works nice as a highlighter on top of my skin. It’s in light shade, and it reflects light when applied to the bridge of my nose or on the highest points of my nose. Very natural and I like that it doesn’t have big glitters in it.

Great product that really works well. This serum really cleared up my skin within a couple of days. I really like the bottle and how you just need a little squirt every night. I definitely recommend this serum!

product_name: CC+ Cream Oil-Free Matte with SPF 40
review_text: For a long time I thought IT cosmetics foundations were overhyped but I love this. I use a pretty small amount, like half a pump and it spreads so nicely and looks so seamless and natural although it adds really good coverage. I can’t wait to get a bit tanner because this is my summer shade but I can’t get enough of it. I find that it doesn’t crease in my fine lines or accentuate pores either.
My lips drank this right up. I loved the consistency, it reminds me of coconut oil how it soaked right into my lips leaving them hydrated and smooth.
review_title: True Cream Aqua Bomb is the bomb

product_name: Tea Elixir Niacinamide & Hyaluronic Acid Anti-Aging Serum
review_text: I’ve only been using this product for about 2 weeks and I haven’t seen a change in my skin. I have oily and acne-prone skin. Refer to the photos for more. The application of the product is nice against the skin and I do feel hydrated.
Love this product! I have very dry skin and this helped my dry patches go away and stay away!
Best product ever..if you have acne this is heaven
Does a great job as the first step in a double cleanse and a morning cleanser that isn’t overly stripping! Has helped keep my skin calm under a mask all day
I’m not usually a fan of unscented products but I really like how this cleanser works with my Clarisonic.

product_name: Mini Deep Cleanse Gentle Exfoliating Cleanser
review_text: Got the trial size with the Bazar rewards. I had high hopes for Tatcha products. Did not like the smell or the texture. Didn’t see any difference on mg face. The smell is very artificial flowery/fruity. I can’t describe it, but not a fan.

I do feel it was wonderfully gentle on my skin.  I had zero irritation after use.  I am not a fan of the tube.  It is a very thin product and easy to over dispense.

I received this product complimentary from Dermalogica. This was a wonder product. I loved that it started off as a powder. It was super easy to use. It did my face wonders. I felt like my skin was so soft and smooth. It also cleared up my face a bit.
I adore CLINIQUEIt for me the most suitable variant

product_name: Alpha Beta Extra Strength Daily Peel Pads
review_text: This product has been great! It has helped to smooth my skin, shrink my pores, and keep my skin from being as oily! It is truly divine!

This is a great product! I used the other daily microfoliant from them and decided to try this new product. It does have more of a smell to it, but the results are great! Smoother, brighter skin is worth a slight smell. (Smell doesn’t stay on your face, goes away with the rinse.)

This is a very nice hydrating moisturizer. It’s got a gel like consistency that doesn’t clog my pores. I personally wear this as my daytime moisturizer under make up as I like something a bit more heavier at night.

So far i only have used it a couple times (i use it as a base for when applying concealer on my under-eye areas) and no results yet! but once i put it on my under-eye its sooo smooth to put the concealer on! love it!

product_name: Magic Cream Moisturizer with Hyaluronic Acid
review_text: With super sensitive skin, I really prefer unscented skincare. This also feels greasy on my acne prone skin. For my skin type, I would say there are better products out there.
This product is so good!! The best spot on treatment I have ever had so far. It has this nasty sulfur smell to it but man does it work overnight! I will definitely purchase again

I bought this specifically because I feel like I’m at the spa every time I wash my face with this cleanser. It smells amazing!! Bonus, it’s uber moisturizing!  It is a weee bit expensive when you look at it per ounce.
Not my favorite. Does the job, but there are some better cleansers for my skin.

product_name: Bright Eyes Collagen-Infused Brightening Colloidal Silver Eye Masks
review_text: Don’t waste your money. These eye masks are the worst. I would give it zero stars if I could. The packaging and eye mask is pretty to look at, but ineffective. There isn’t enough serum in the product. I was hoping the first mask I used was a defective one, but the second was as bad. Hopefully Sephora will let me return these.

I love a gel based moisturizer and this one succeeded all expectations! It feels so good and calming going on the skin, and instantly soaks in! Leaving my skin filling supple and hydrated without being greasy. Must have daytime moisturizer!

product_name: Mini Ready Steady Glow Daily AHA Tonic
review_text: I have a combination / sensitive skin and I very cautious in trying out products with actives but surely a sucker for anything with willow bark. As a beauty enthusiast for more than a decade, I surely can say that I had my share of hit and miss and with my age and profession, I definitely am aiming for just hit! I cannot afford to deal eith unncessary breakouts as they bo longer heal as fast as they used and sometimes would leave a nasty marks. Talking about my experience with this beautiful bottle that REN sent me, it is just AMAZING! It is so gentle to the skin without any sting at all. And since I started using it - it surely gives a visible result as my skin looks a lot more hydrated, glowy, free from uneven tones, spotless and brighter! I will surely repurchase! Always thankful for opportunities to try amazing products!
review_title: My AHA Tonic Holy Grail for Lasting Glow

review_text: Love this face wash. I found it to be hydrating for my skin. This is definitely a staple in my skin care routine.

Life saver during winter months. I use it as a top coat over my usual skincare routine. Gives the extra moisture needed, lock everything in. Don’t put too much or you’ll end up looking oily!! I also apply a few drops on my hands before going to bed :)

product_name: The Water Cream Oil-Free Pore Minimizing Moisturizer
review_text: not really moisturizing. my skin has been pretty dry and I’ve been using this for a month.
I absolutely love the smell of this stuff but it is way to rough on my skin and leaves my face burning and red after use.
Awesome Detox Mask!! I actually see results from using it. Not harsh and damaging on my skin. Worth the money!!

I like this cleansing oil. It smells good, kind of like citrus. The oil is thin, spreads over my face smoothly, and removes most of my mascara. Following up with a regular cleanser, removes any traces of mascara that might be left. I rub it on my face dry and massage for a minute then wet my hands and continue to massage and emulsify the oil. When wet, the oil turns a white, milky color. It rinses well and easily. Product works well but I wouldn’t repurchase due to the expensive price tag.. I also personally prefer a cleansing balm rather than a cleansing oil because balms are less messy and easier to handle. I would definitely recommend if you like cleansing oils and cost isn’t an issue. Product received from BzzAgent in exchange for my honest review.

this is very hydrating and i really like it. if you are worried about the price i wouldn’t recommend. you can get products similar to this for much less. i won’t be purchasing this again but it is good and hydrates the skin.
A couple of hours after I put this on my zits they go down

I have suffered from acne my whole life and have tried MANY different products. review_title: very moisturing, use it every day

product_name: Take The Day Off Cleansing Balm Makeup Remover
review_text: Love this cleansing balm.  I generally use miscellar water first to remove my make up but always leaves remnants.  By itself or after my miscellar water ritual this cleanser melts all makeup remnants away.  It really like it because you can use it all o we, including the eyes.  Love It!

product_name: Mini Liquid Silk Canvas: Featherweight Protective Primer
review_text: I loved the silk canvas solid but it was tougher to use. This is perfect and solves all my issues with the original, plus it smells amazing!!!!
left my skin sticky , and I do not not that feeling at all.

review_text: Even this says it can be used on oily skin, it can’t really. It left my oily combination skin very greasy and shiny. Do not use this if you will be active--it is not a non-comedogenic product and will especially clog your pores if you sweat with it on. If you have normal or dry skin, this is for you because it left my dry patches feeling very smooth and hydrated.

review_text: I have combination skin. My cheeks tend to be dry and my forehead and chin normal. I count myself lucky but when I put on a heavy moisturizer it makes the normal skin oily and the dry skin normal. I needed something that would evenly moisturize my face and this is it! It’s heavy enough that it locks in the moisture but light enough that I don’t feel like I have a mask on my face. I absorbs into your skin quickly but seems to last even with my extended mask wearing. I’m very happy with this product. I highly recommend for anyone looking for a great moisturizer with a light scent that has stay power but isn’t heavy.

product_name: Yo Glow AHA & BHA Facial Enzyme Scrub
review_text: This is a very light exfoliating cream. It doesn’t have any scrubbing beads or harsh particles. It’s more of a ‘peeling’ wash so it gently peels away dead skin cells.

review_text: I received a sample from Influenster and it was non greasy, easy to apply, made my skin feel soft to the touch and hydrated.

Then got this brand as a sample. This time I tried it, and it was instant magic over night. Way less swollen,  and even most of the redness was gone. Still shocks me!!
It’s totally fine but nothing special. No real effect on my skin - positive or negative. The price is great but I can’t get past the grassy smell.
review_title: I don't understand why everyone loves this product

this mask is divine after using it my skin was firmer and just glowed

review_text: I am one that keeps my beauty routine fairly simple. I do enjoy trying new products to see what they have to offer. product_name: Mini Crème de la Mer Moisturizer
review_text: I received a sample gifted by la mer but I started use this product more than 10 years ago. It works best on dry skin or problem skin or when you have irritation. You need to follow the instructions otherwise very hard to apply evenly or you might apply too much. It’s a must for your skin problems.

Like another reviewer, I have alligator lips. They’re always very dry and flaky, and I’m constantly gnawing at the dead skin. Especially in the winter, they get cracked and gross. They’re just gross. No matter how much product, balm, or scrub I use or how much water I drink, nothing ever works. After buying this product, I laid it on pretty heavy, using it only at times where I wasn’t about to eat or talk a lot. It’s lotion, so it’ll rub off easily. Then I smothered it over my lips before bed.There are a few key points about this product I’d love to highlight:1. When it soaks in all the way, it leaves your lips a little dry with some white residue. I was worried about this at first, but after using a wet toothbrush to gently scrub my lips, I noticed that the white flakes were actually my old dead skin, and it brushed right off. Amazing. After one night of use, my lips were already looking less like a peeling mess, and more like lips.2. It made a great primer after it dried. I noticed my bright red lipstick didn’t feather out.3. After a week of use my lips were no longer flaky or dry so I could wear lipstick again without my cracked lips showing through it.The only reason this didn’t get 5 stars is because it did nothing for my wrinkles or lines. No plumping at all.But if you’re simply looking to get rid of cracked, flaky, dead-skin-ridden lips, look at Clinique All About Lips. It’s amazing.

review_text: What a sensory overload! This is a beautiful cream that clams and hydrates skin overnight. The texture is buttery and rich yet it blends smoothly and not at all greasy or heavy. The cold weather can dry and irritate skin and this gives my skin the opportunity to reset and heal overnight. I wake up to a soft, soothed and hydrated skin. They always do a good job of providing an incredible sensory experience, especially their scent.

Put this on your face at night after your skin care routine and within 2 days I promise you’ll see awesome results! Softer face! No lines! I even had a acne scar (and I never get ache) and that disappeared after 2 uses! And this stuff lasts a long time!

review_title: A much needed refresh for my face

review_text: I had begun using a couple new things and was trying to figure out why my skin was breaking out so badly. Eventually I isolated this toner as the culprit. I have combo/acne prone skin and this did not mesh well with my skin. My skin is generally pretty clear now but if I do get acne, it’s when some topical/makeup doesn’t agree with me and it’s always a white head or a smallish cystic nodule.I noticed around the time I started using this that I was developing breakouts and blackheads. Blackheads form deeper in the skin than whiteheads. I did some research and learned that glycolic acid penetrates deeper into the skin than lactic acid (what I had been using previously without incident). As soon as I discontinued this toner the acne/blackheads went away. This toner just penetrated too deeply into my skin and caused my acne to go into overdrive. This did make some noticeable difference in my skin’s texture since it felt smoother, but any positives are greatly outweighed by the negatives of it exacerbating my acne.
review_title: This did not work with my skin

product_name: Mini Take The Day Off Cleansing Balm Makeup Remover
review_text: Pretty great makeup remover. Especially in the winter when my skin needs a bit of extra moisture and protection, the oil really helps my skin to feel protected and nourished.

I just bought this yesterday after a sales associate recommended it to me for my extremely dry yet extremely acne prone skin. I have been through so many different moisturizers over the past 5ish years- drugstore, high end, oil free, even just straight oils. everything either wasn’t enough moisture, or left my skin oily and did nothing for the dry patches. this changed everything. i just started using a 10% glycolic acid toner, so I was starting to get even more dry (but my pores needed that glycolic acid lol). this soaked right into my skin and didn’t leave me feeling greasy, but actually hydrated for once. and when I woke up this morning, there was no excess oil in my t-zone (like there usually is) and my dry patches were GONE. like, gone gone. not even a little roughness on my forehead where I’m perpetually dry. My face feels so smooth I just want to run my hands all over it (but I won’t because I’ll probably break out more). I have a sinus infection right now, and my undereyes and nose have been very red, and today I can’t see any redness. since I’m only 20 I don’t use an eye cream, but if this is contact-safe, I’ll be smearing it around my eyes too every night. I’m actually amazed by how much redness this took out of my skin, since I’m super fair and redness shows up so easily on me. don’t be put off at how thick it is. a little product goes a long way, and soaks right in. I’d recommend trying it in store like I did. overall, I am so grateful to the sales associate who showed me this. given that I’ve only used it for one day, I don’t want to be so quick to call it my holy grail product, but I will update this review in a few weeks and again in a month to let y’all know. if a product can do that much good my face after one night, it’s so worth the price tag.

It leaves your skin glistening. I use it every morning and night after cleansing and before moisturizers. Would recommend if your looking to incorporate hyaluronic acid into you skin regimen, I’d highly recommend this product.

review_text: I cannot express how much I love this toner. I have hormonal cystic acne and never has it cleared up as much as when I’ve been using this toner. review_text: I haven’t been using this long (so I can’t attest to the long term effects), but my initial impression of this serum is that it’s very nice. Two pumps is all I need. Not oily. The sample bottle looked so tiny.  Surely I’d get only a few uses out of it...right?I was so wrong, on both counts.  It really doesn’t take much.  I’ve been using my little tiny 10 ml sample bottle for over three weeks now, every morning and every evening.  After washing my face, before moisturizing, I pour a very small amount into my hand, just the tiniest splash (a puddle slightly larger than a dime), rub my hands together, and pat it all over my face and neck.  I have combination skin with hormonal breakouts once a month.  My skincare routine for decades (until now) has been rotating, changing by the week, depending on what my skin is needing at the moment.  This has been an effective way to manage my skin, but it’s tiresome having to constantly assess my skin’s needs.  Plus I have to purchase quite a few different products for both oily and dry skin, making my skincare routine much more expensive than I’d like it to be.From the very first day I used this essence, my skin improved.  Smoother texture was the first thing I noticed.  As I continued to use it, my fine lines became significantly less pronounced and my breakouts stopped entirely.  Not even exaggerating.  This week is the week that I normally break out like crazy.  And yet, all week, I haven’t had a single issue.  My skin has been perfect for three weeks.  Perfect.  This never happens to me. I’m sold.  I’m going to be buying more this week, once this little bottle is empty.  This essence is as amazing as they say.  It’s not just hype.  It really does balance the skin.  It’s amazing.  And yes, you should try it, especially if you have combination skin.  This might just be your holy grail, because it’s definitely mine!  Ask for a sample the next time you’re in Sephora.

It left my face feeling soft and smooth and it didn’t irritate my acne spots or my skin too much even when I scrubbed hard. It did however make my skin feel pretty dry which I didn’t like. It’s not as drying as other products I’ve tried, but I’ve also tried better.Overall: I don’t think I would buy this myself. I would only use it once a week at most because of how exfoliating and drying it is, not to mention I feel that if I use it more than once a week it’ll start irritating my skin. In addition, if you are going to buy this, I’d say only use it at night because the AHAs can make your skin more sensitive to UV rays. So no i wont use these agin. I really wanted to love these, i really wanted them to work.
I was pleasantly surprised to see a small difference in my under eye dark circles. It took a side by side photo to be able to tell, but it gives me hope in this product!

product_name: Advanced Night Repair Synchronized Multi-Recovery Complex Duo
review_text: I’ve been trying to avoid using anti-aging products for as long as I could. I guess I didn’t want to admit the fact that I’m almost 30! But I do realize how important it is to take care of your skin, even at a young age, to prevent aging and wrinkles. I haven’t been using this product long enough to see any long term results, but so far what I have seen I love! It’s super easy to use. I just put it on at night after washing my face and before moisturizer, so it’s been super easy to incorporate into my routine. My skin feels so soft and smooth in the morning and I love it! I was only given a weeks worth of a sample to try, but I heard that if you use in the morning as well it gives you a little extra boost. I received this product for free to test and review, but I would consider buying the full size option to use!

product_name: Mini Revitalizing Supreme+ Youth Power Creme Moisturizer
review_text: This face cream is smooth, medium in texture and soaks into the skin nicely. I didn’t see immediate results, but most face products I’ve used take time. Also, it’s not a bad fragrance.So grateful to get this sample from influenster!

I got a sample of this cleanser with my last order. I loved the creamy formula and it made my skin very soft, but I absolutely hated the smell. I ended up throwing out the rest of the packet because it smelled so bad.

product_name: Mini Gentle Cleansing Foam Hydrating Makeup Remover
review_text: I have sensitive skin, I’m prone to breakouts, but I had no worries with this product! It foamed up nicely, leaving my skin feeling nice, smooth and clean! It has a slight scent to it, but nothing harsh.

product_name: Advanced Retinol + Ferulic Texture Renewal Serum
review_text: Dr Gross does it again! LOVEEEEEEEEEEEEEEE this! It gives me such a good texture. I use at night.

I have oily skin and have always been a little cautious when using serum as they can be too heavy. This one is super lightweight but still works as I see a difference in the appearance of my skin! I’ve re-bought this one several times now and definitely see a difference!

product_name: PRO Strength Vitamin A/C/E Retinoid Treatment
review_text: I am loving this cream. I like to apply it every night right after I get out of the shower, I let it work it’s magic throughout the entire night. I have uneven skin texture so this helps balance it out.

product_name: Cicapair Tiger Grass Color Correcting Treatment SPF 30
review_text: I first received a few sample packets of this with the tiger grass serum. I didn’t pay much attention to the package, saw the word “cream” and slathered it on before bed after the serum absorbed and immediately was horrified. I thought I had accidentally used some kind of mask instead of a cream. I had a good laugh when I read the packet and was really excited to try it appropriately— a small amount, during the day as a color correcting spf cream. I’m so amazed at how much coverage you get from a cream that absorbs this quickly. This has much more natural coverage than any bb cream or tinted moisturizer I have tried. It isn’t a fix all for anyone with PIP or dark spots, but for uneven skin tone and redness it’s a miracle worker. I haven’t not tried this under foundation but a pea size on its own it can get a little shiny. It’s far less shiny than any other SPF 30 cream I have tried, so I will take a little shine over oily any day.
review_title: Exactly what I’ve been looking for, spf and color

review_text: I absolutely love Protini! Most moisturizers are too thick for my skin. Protini is lightweight but still provides my skin with adequate moisture. I’ve been using DE products for over six months now and my skin is much happier!

I was getting tiny bumps along the side of my face and this cleared them up. I love how it cleans and shrinks my pores without drying out my skin. I love Murad products as I have very sensitive skin and so far none of their products irritate my skin. I would have given this 5 star but wish it was cheaper or bigger bottle for that price.  I have been using for about 4 months morning and night. I would definitely recommend this product

I really like to give my skin and pores a break from SPF in the gall and winter months, and this wrinkle smoothing moisturizer is perfect. It leaves my skin dewy and glowing. I’ve noticed a decrease in fine lines around my eyes and forehead.

product_name: Tonique Confort Re-Hydrating Comforting Toner with Acacia Honey
review_text: First of all, this product smells amazing. It is a much thicker consistency than I am used to with toners but if feels very soothing on my skin. I think that this will definitely be my go-to when the seasons start to change and it gets a little colder and dryer. I feel like this will be so soothing and hydrating during the fall/winter months. I did receive this product for testing.

product_name: Mini Take The Day Off Cleansing Balm Makeup Remover
review_text: I was not a fan of this product when I followed the directions. Massaging it into my face felt alright, but made a huge mess once my mascara dissolved and it just took too long to rinse all the black off. Plus, the jar got tainted with makeup from putting my fingers in it. Now, I take a cotton pad to apply the product, which gets a lot of the makeup off while keeping the jar clean, then I rub it in some and rinse. It seems far more efficient and I don’t waste nearly as much product.
review_title: Easy to Waste but it Works

review_text: Great lip gloss! Leaves my lips soft all day. The pear scent is lovely. I do think it’s more glossy than a balm, but not in the way your hair sticks to your lips. This is another great product by laneige! I do think the tube is a little small for the price. I did receive this product complimentary for testing purposes

product_name: Double Serum Eye Firming & Hydrating Anti-Aging Concentrate
review_text: This product makes my under eyes feel and look amazing! It makes my under eyes feel so hydrated and brightens up the tired look of them. I love using it morning and night under moistuizer to wake my eyes in the morning and treat them throughout the day as well as at night.

product_name: Mini The Essence  Skincare Boosting Treatment
review_text: OK, so, I don’t really use essences or this type of product typically because they feel gimmicky and like a probably unnecessary extra step in my skincare routine. BUT! Omg, after I cleanse and pat a little bit of this stuff on my face (a little goes a long way!), I swear all my other products just go on smoother and sink in deeper. It actually does what it says it will. Full disclosure, I received this product complimentary for testing purposes, but when this bottle eventually runs out I will rebuy. So worth it.
review_title: Where has The Essence been all my life??

review_text: I received this setting powder from Supergoop! in exchange for my honest opinion. I love how it has SPF in it. I had a difficult time telling if I had some on my face, like I couldn’t tell if I had setting powder on my face. The directions say to tap on your wrist until the powder flows through the bristles, but I really couldn’t tell if I had enough setting powder on my face.

product_name: Revitalizing Supreme+ Youth Power Creme Moisturizer
review_text: I’m taking a star off for the scent, because I do prefer unscented skin care, but this cream is wonderful, hydrating, and smooth. The hydrating power is great, I use a pea size amount to cover my whole face and neck and my skin feels so smooth, specially the next morning, after my nighttime routine!

Recommended in store to help glow from the inside out and tackle some new texture that’s been popping up. After less than a week it’s already made such a difference! It smells naturally lovely and hasn’t overwhelmed my often sensitive to fragrance skin. Would definitely recommend if you’re looking for a vitamin c!

This. Stuff. Is. Bomb! After seeing Manny MUA’s review months ago, I finally decided I would get it now as the VIB sale just happened & I have been very stressed out and when I’m stressed I break out. I have normal to dry skin. And my skin is quite clear. I have been using it now for a little while and OMG. My breakouts? Gone. My redness from those stubborn breakouts? Gone. A little goes a VERY long way and i use it with my clairsonic brush. Gets nice and foamy. No weird smell or anything. The pricepoint is also perfect! My pores have become less visible too! Do yourself a favor and buy this!

product_name: Capture Totale Super Potent Eye Serum
review_text: The packaging was beautiful and exactly what I would expect from Dior. When I opened the cap and saw the waves on the applicator it seemed like a well thought out design. The rounded edges looked like a great fit for the sensitive eye area. The product is scented with a pleasing fragrance. Getting the right amount of product to dispense took a little bit of skill. I have some indentation around my lower eyelids. The next morning, the indentation seemed softer and less pronounced. I am interested in seeing how much difference the product will make over a more extended period of time. Overall, I enjoyed the product.

product_name: Invisiblur Perfecting Shield Broad Spectrum SPF 30 PA+++

review_title: My favorite product on the planet

review_text: I got this as a deluxe sample and despite being super excited to try it, it took me 4 minutes (which felt like an eternity) before I had to wash it off from feeling nauseous from the gasoline/chemical smell. I was thinking of tossing my sample until I washed off the mask, and was amazed at how soft my skin felt while rubbing it off my face. When I dried off my face pores were tightened and my face was so smooth and supple - like a babys bottom. Its like Good Genes on steroids, wow. And in 4 minutes? Guuuuurrl, hold up now. Now I am so conflicted about this product because although I despise its smell, the effects were so instantly amazing for me, and I cant turn a blind eye to that. I am not sure if I would purchase this product, I would definitely not use it on a regular basis. However if I had a skin emergency and needed amazing skin ASAP, I would definitely re-use this. Use at the risk of your nasal passage.

product_name: Green Clean Makeup Meltaway Cleansing Balm Limited Edition Jumbo
review_text: Not sure what the hype is with this. I got a sample with my Sephora points. Sure, it takes makeup off but it leaves a greasy residue that anyone with normal to oily skin will hate. review_text: I got this in the cheer kit and starting using it right away. I woke up with a few breakouts around my mouth. I stopped using the product and tried again a few weeks later and the same thing happened. I have very dry lips and I wish this worked.

In a nutshell, if you have super sensitive skin, this may not be the product for you.

product_name: GOOPGLOW 15% Glycolic Acid Overnight Glow Peel

product_name: Lip Sleeping Mask Intense Hydration with Vitamin C
review_text: I recently had a septorhinoplasty. I had packing and tubes in my nose for 11 days. The day after surgery, my normally soft lips were dry and cracked from breathing through my mouth/the surgical breathing tube. This sleeping mask cured my cracked lips OVERNIGHT. It outperformed my vaseline and smelled better to boot. It kept my lips soft and hydrated for the remainder of the time I had packing in my nose (10 more days of mouth breathing 24 hrs a day). I still use it nightly to keep my lips super soft.

product_name: Vinoperfect Radiance Dark Spot Serum Vitamin C Alternative
review_text: I’ve been using this product for about 2 months now in the morning and evening and I have seen no results. I always take a before and after pics when I try new products and both pics look the same. I still have the discoloration and dark spots I bought this for! I am really disappointed because I had high hopes for this! :(The product itself is nice to use and it leaves my skin feeling smooth. I am sure the bottle will last me a long time because I use only about 4 drops a day (2 in the morning and 2 in the evening). Hopefully I’ll see some kind of difference after I finish the whole bottle.

product_name: Glowscreen Sunscreen SPF 40 PA+++ with Hyaluronic Acid + Niacinamide
review_text: Good protection for skin year round. Strong SPF and nicely packaged.
The product is a new favourite in my skincare, it is removes my makeup with ease while leaving my skin smooth and hydrated. Highly recommend it!!

product_name: Lip Sleeping Mask Intense Hydration with Vitamin C

review_title: Disappointment after so many good reviews

review_title: great but do it before bed!

review_text: I like it. It does not leave white cast on my dark skin...just make sure you don’t overdo it!

product_name: Advanced Night Repair Synchronized Multi-Recovery Complex Duo

A little goes a long way with this product! Definitely recommend to anyone looking for something that will help even out and soothe skin!
review_title: Love it! Great for sensitive skin too!

And I love the rose scent.

It’s refreshing to spray on my face after a shower, but I do not see any differences. I have super dry skin, and I do not notice any significant hydration or glow. However, it is very gentle on the skin and I really do like that there is no alcohol in this product. Overall, I did not find this to be anything special.
Amazing lip balm! Works immediately.

product_name: All About Eyes Serum De-Puffing Eye Massage
review_text: I do like not having to apply eye serum with my finger and it does feel cool going on but can’t honestly say that I’ve noticed much difference in my under eye puffiness. I still feel the need to use my regular eye cream along with this serum. I’ll use this product until I run out but probably won’t buy it again.

product_name: Good Genes All-In-One AHA Lactic Acid Treatment
review_text: This product was complimentary from Sunday Riley but all opinions are my own. Let’s start of with I love this product. First the packaging is nice and sturdy. I love that it’s in a glass container, as for the product itself it’s really nice. It states that it instantly plumps the look of fine lines, I can’t say anything towards that since I don’t quite have them but it will be good for when I do. What I can tell you is that it let my face brighter. I had a pimple that was growing but the day after using it, the pimple was reduced. It might be due to the lactic acid and the other great exfoliants (prickly pear,agave,cactus) it wasn’t irritating at all and it was soothing a bit? , could have been the aloe in it. I love that in the ingredient list it has a high quality of exfoliants and nourishing things it has squalene too! I think it leaves your face smooth because of the dimethicone but I don’t mind that ingredient because it’s farther down the ingredient list so the percentage it has is lower. It was easy to use, love the pump! It absorbed quickly and it had a nice lemon scent like my lemon tree. If you don’t like or your skin is sensitive to scented skincare this might not be for you. I recommend this, although it is pricey, this is one skincare that matches its price due to the ingredients and how awesome it is. I still will continue to use to see if it can get rid of my hyperpigmentation, that will be the real test but for now I’m very satisfied with the product.
review_title: Love it but need to continue to use it for results

review_text: This product was gifted by Glow Recipe and is one of the yummiest lip products I’ve tried! The blueberry smell is amazing and I love how it makes my lips feel so soft and delicious. The packaging is also really cool and I love how this reminds me of products from when I was a kid, but in a more grown up way.

I typically have quite an oily face and have always been looking for ways to reduce the shine produced from my oily skin. I thought the Kiehl’s Ultra Facial Oil-Free Gel Cream would be a perfect fit! Unfortunately it was not. After trying for a couple of weeks I will say I did find days where it worked somewhat well but other days where it had virtually no effect on reducing the shine. I tried it both solo (applying no other facial creams or products) as well as mixed in with my daily routine (typically a facial toner followed by some moisturizing lotion). The end effect however did not seem effected either way. Ultimately I probably wouldn’t get this product again although it didn’t hurt to try on some days.

product_name: Cicapair Tiger Grass Color Correcting Treatment SPF 30
review_text: I absolutely love this! I haven’t even been using foundation that’s how great this is

product_name: Squalane + Marine Algae Firming & Lifting Eye Cream
review_text: I love this eye cream, helps you look fresh, very light, but creamy, didn’t do much with one little wrinkle under my eye, but I didn’t get any new ones for a year since I start to using it. Reason I gave 4 star because of price and also I bought it twice and both times lid got broken, if you push a little too much when you close it, it just starts to crack and fall apart really bad. So first cream got dry when I still had 15% on a bottom. On second one I’m improvising to prevent drying out lol. So be careful, I guess. But cream itself is great.

product_name: Charlotte’s Magic Eye Cream with Retinol
