product_name: Fenty Skin Travel Size Start'r Set
review_text: I bought the 3 piece starter set to try it out. I was really hoping the products would smell like the fenty primer but they don’t. The wash is kind of a fake coconut soap smell which I’m not a fan of but works. The fat water has a light smell and dries nicely. The face cream is probably my fave! It’s super thick so don’t buy it if you don’t like that. And it has a slight pinkish shimmer to it that leaves me feeling glowy before bed which I don’t mind at all! I haven’t broken out from using any of it and have pretty sensitive skin. Wish all of it smelled better! But would probably buy again.

product_name: The Deep Cleanse Gentle Exfoliating Cleanser
review_text: I am currently on my 3rd bottle of this product and I absolutely love it. It DID take about half a bottle for me to start to like it as my skin broke out horribly the first while. Was just about to ditch it, but then my skin started turning around. The light exfoliation is super gentle, but effective. At first, I wasn’t able to get a decent lather, but make sure you use plenty of water on your face and hands prior to application and you will get the smoothest lather. Light scent, great for my sensitive combo skin. Reduced my oil throughout the day, making me breakout less. Overall, it wasn’t love at first use, but I’ve grown to absolutely love this product and will continue to use it as I’ve seen dramatic results over the past couple of bottles. Has helped with not only acne, but skin texture, brightness and has helped with my redness slightly.
review_title: Wasn’t love at first use, BUT..

review_title: Good for body, not for face

review_text: This product worked wonders for me! I have dry skin and that includes lips! I have a bad habit of always biting or licking my lips because they’re so dry. review_text: This is the first and only face oil I’ve tried so far and I’m in love. I’m a 21 year old female with hormonal acne and sensitive combination skin. To keep my acne under some semblance of control, I have to use things like benzoyl peroxide, which dries and irritates my sensitive skin. This argan oil absorbed into my skin (I think the other reviews saying that skin “drinks it up“ are accurate) without any discomfort at all, giving my skin the soothing moisture it desperately needed.I wouldn’t consider this argan oil a direct acne treatment, but I think it helped my acne by effectively moisturizing my skin and reducing irritation, as irritation can worsen acne. It was also effective at hydrating my sensitive eye area in addition to its use on my entire face as a daily moisturizer. I think this would also be effective for sensitive, chapped, dry skin in the winter.It’s an oil but it has a somewhat smooth texture when applied, definitely not greasy like my skin’s natural sebum. A few drops give my face a slightly “dewy“ look, but if you use more your face may look a little oily. I bought the 0.5 ounce bottle and have been using it on my whole face for about a week and the bottle is still nearly full. I use about 2 drops just for my eye area, and about 3 or 4 drops for the rest of my face. It is expensive, but I think it will last me a few months. Because of the price, I only use this on my face, not on my hands, body, or hair. I don’t recommend rubbing it on your hands to warm it before applying because this oil absorbs so well, it would be wasted on your hands before reaching your face. I just use the dropper to drop a little on my fingertips and apply that directly to my face. The packaging is nice and the dropper works well, but keep your hand under the dropper because product will drip from it. I usually don’t need to squeeze the dropper to get some on my fingertips.I cannot say how this would act under makeup because I never wore makeup over it.I would definitely recommend this to anyone with dry, sensitive, or irritated skin that needs gentle hydration. The only drawback is the price.

product_name: Mini Take The Day Off Cleansing Balm Makeup Remover
review_text: I received this product as a sample in my April subscription box and this was enough to convince that this product was not for me. review_text: The size was very awkward to use at first, as I’m accustomed to more standard sized balm, but this stuff is worth every penny! I also noticed at first that there was a gritty feel after the first few applications, which almost turned me off of it, but that sensation went away; maybe my lips or the product itself wasn’t warm enough to emulsify? The sweet taste, which I’m not a big fan of in balms, isn’t overpowering and the moisturization lasts hours. I applied it before I went to bed tonight at 11 to test it and when I woke at 2am, even after sipping pop to quiet my dry mouth, it’s still going strong. I tried the kiehl’s super multi corrective anti aging eye cream and i really liked the results i got from it , it got rid of my fine lines around the outer corners of my eyes and the dark circles i had beneath my eyes and it left the skin around my eyes looking bright and youthful, it had no scent and applies really easy, in my opinion it is a really great product to use.

I like that one better - and I’m a true Algenist fan. product_name: All About Eyes Rich Eye Cream
review_text: I have used this product before but found it to be too heavy for the summer. However, now that winter is here it does a good job of providing moisture while preventing puffiness.
Really love this! It’s really light and goes on great after moisturizer. It makes my skin glow and has an immediate impact. Perfect for brightening skin during the winter.

product_name: Mini Superberry Hydrate + Glow Dream Mask
review_text: Not good for my acne prone sensitive skin. It felt like it never totally absorbed, even overnight in the dead of winter, and instead felt almost like a film of Vaseline around my jaw line. Not worth the hype; I’m glad I bought the trial size since it won’t be used.

product_name: Alpha Beta Extra Strength Daily Peel Pads
review_text: Omg I love it so far! yesterday was my first day so I’m not really sure of what’s the full effect but so far so good.

product_name: Green Clean Makeup Meltaway Cleansing Balm Limited Edition Jumbo
review_text: This balm works wonders for getting off stubborn makeup with very little effort, which is a godsend especially on sharing and not wanting to create more fine lines around the eyes. Because of this alone, and after trying almost every eye makeup remover on the market with subpar results, this product is now my holy grail! Glad to see they’ve made even a bigger size (double) with a value price.

product_name: Advanced Génifique Radiance Boosting Face Serum
review_text: I appreciate this product because it definitely moisturizes my skin. However, I haven’t honestly noticed a lot of other differences in the way my skin feels or looks. I’ve been using it morning and night for approx. 2 weeks now. I received this product for free from influenster for testing purposes.

The price is nice, but the taste is not. I like how it feels on my lips, it smells very light and faint (not like strawberry but fruity for sure) and I definitely wake up with my lips feeling soft, but I HATE the taste of it. It’s like a soapy kind of taste, not strong at all but it’s there. Maybe some people may not notice it because it is light and may manage, but I personally can’t especially when I wake up in the morning. That’s why I gave it 3 stars, because while it does deliver and gives soft hydrated lips, I just don’t like that slight soap taste.
review_title: Soft Lips! But Has Soapy Taste

product_name: The Deep Cleanse Gentle Exfoliating Cleanser
review_text: At last a cleanser that helps my face from feeling greasy all day! It feels great as I am cleaning face and it doesn’t leave me dry. It is stubborn to get out the bottle though. Will probably jerry-rig a way to get every drop out. A

Really love this stuff. Gotten a sample of it twice on my playbox and I’m not disappointed. Keeps my face nice and hydrated and doesn’t feel heavy on the skin at all. Will be purchasing the full size once I run out

I received a sample of this product so the amount wasn’t enough for me to see dramatic results. I have dark spots on both sides of my cheeks and did notice that it has gotten lighter. Upon coming to the end of the sample I woke up to a huge amount of white heads on both sides of my cheeks. I do know that normally when u have break outs that can be a good thing because it can mean that the product is working and bringing all of the impurities to the surface.

I didn’t have many dark spots to begin with, but I did notice a brightening of the skin. The product was easy to apply, I really enjoyed the pump design, and my skin felt soft after application. The scent could have been better, but it wasn’t a turn off. I would recommend the product.

product_name: Mini Revitalizing Supreme+ Youth Power Creme Moisturizer
review_text: I usually don’t buy into these creams but this one is amazing! I get excessive dry skin I’m winter and this moisturized my cheeks and made my skin feel great! Highly recommend!

product_name: Mini Adaptogen Deep Moisture Cream with Ashwagandha + Reishi
review_text: Tbh I expected sooo much more from this product. I have normal/oily skin & I was looking for an intensely moisturizing cream to use at night since my oiliness is due to living in the desert (hydration at night is key to help combat oiliness in the skin with dry environments!). After reading all the great reviews I was willing to invest the money since I was *expecting* it to be the holy grail of deeply moisturizing creams. And honestly it’s just OK, didn’t do anything special for my skin in terms of ‘deep’ moisture and I feel like I’ve used better deep moisturizers in the past (that cost a fraction of what this costs) that have given me noticeably better moisturization results. The cream has a light, almost clay-like consistency that I think other people might like, but it was not what I was expecting/looking for in terms of results. Gave it 3 starts because 1. It’s not terrible, 2. it didn’t smell bad, and 3. the ingredients are really good. All in all I would not buy this again.
review_title: Just OK, not worth the price

review_text: This product is amazing. I had received this for my birthday month gift( the 10ml) and when I first apply this it absolutely felt refreshing. It instantly made my skin feel so hydrated. I been trying so many products, since I have really dry skin and this stuff freaking work with hydration. I will definitely be buying the full sized of this product. It made my skin felt so much softer and not to mention this product didn’t have a strong scent. So that’s a plus for me. I am also reviewing this product for a contest with Influenster.
review_title: It's amazing.Must have for dry skin.

review_text: The bottle can last a long time because you truly don’t need much. I tried to give this 2 months to see results but to be honest I don’t notice a difference in my dark spots or overall glow. It could be that I needed to give it more time but I received this product for free for testing by Influenster and I needed to write a review in a certain amount of time. The amount of time I was given may not have been enough or the product itself didn’t do much at all. Hard to tell. The smell to me isn’t the best, although it doesn’t linger so once you put it on your face, the smell goes away after a few seconds. Another little note is that I started breaking out on my cheeks and chin around the time I began using this product. I don’t know if this product made me break out or if it was due to stress or the weather or whatever but I have been consistently breaking out for the last 2 months. I’m going to stop using it then maybe resume later to see if this product really made me break out but I just thought I should mention it

product_name: Set The Stage Hydrating Primer Serum
review_text: I received this product complimentary from Lawless Beauty.  I am really liking this priming serum.  It works well with my skin.  Sometimes when I use something under my makeup it tends to leave a residue and starts to flake.  That is not the case with this.  It goes in well and leaves my makeup looking smooth and fresh throughout the day.

New improved formula. Appreciate this one over the one that initially launched. First one was very hydrating but it burned my undereye area. Whatever caused it is gone now. I use this as a quick hydration mask and it does just that. Doesn’t fade my faint scars as some reviewers have claimed. I apply after cleansing and leave on for 10 minutes and remove with a damp face cloth. My only negative is that this drys on the skin...it’s not like your typical moisture mask. This drys down to a matte finish and it’s a very obvious look too.

My new favourite serum!! My skin is significantly less oily and has no congestion! At first I was using too much product and it would cause some peeling around my nose and chin. A little goes a long way, can’t get enough of this!!

product_name: Essential Energy Hydrating Day Cream Broad Spectrum SPF 20
review_text: i was actually needing a moisturizer then i received this in the mail from influenster. and it was just what i needed. i like that this has an spf in it. i always like wearing an spf because my skin is really sensitive to the sun. this isn’t too oily. its just right. and its a huge jar also.

I’ve been trying out the Watermelon Moisturizer that I received complimentary from Glow Recipe. It is intended as a lightweight moisturizer for oily/combo skin; but it definitely still works for my dry skin! I love to use it after toner and before my thicker moisturizer as a moisturizing serum and it definitely increases the hydration and glow to my skin. I also love that it’s really lightweight and has a very subtle tackiness that helps to grip makeup when used as a primer. The scent is a light, watermelon scent that I enjoy that isn’t overpowering or lingering so it doesn’t bother even the most sensitive to smells like myself.  I also love that you can use it with other skincare and it doesn’t leave any weird texture or pilling or anything that other skincare combos can. It works great in combination with the other Glow Recipe products too! The other day I used the watermelon toner, this moisturizer, the banana moisturizer and the avocado eye cream and loved the way my skin looked and felt! This is definitely not my first Glow Recipe product and will definitely nit be my last!
I love this face spray!! It is so hydrating and light and makes my face feel so fresh.
I was not a fan of the clinique foam face soap but I did like this product. This product is sensitive to the skin and leaves my face feeling clean. I would maybe buy this again in the future.

product_name: Lala Retro Whipped Refillable Moisturizer with Ceramides
review_text: I received this product complimentary from Influenster only a week ago but I knew I loved this moisturizer from the very first use. My skin is very dry and during these colder months it’s ever worse! Dry, patchy, itchy. It’s frustrating. I’d been trying a ton of different PM moisturizers because my skin feels dry and tight after removing makeup in the PM. This moisturizer hit the spot from the first application. My skin immediately felt relief. The biggest test was the morning after because by the time I wake up my skin already feels dry and itchy. But the morning after using Lala Retro my I awoke to amazingly hydrated skin. When you deal with dry skin the way I do you notice a great moisturizer immediately. This product has been a lifesaver. I can’t wait to see how my skin might improve with long term use going forward. I also love the air tight, pump packaging of this product. I’ve never used anything like this and I love how it dispenses and how you can mix other products right on the component. If you struggle with dry skin, this product is a must have.
review_title: Lifesaver for my super dry skin! LOVE!

review_title: Don’t use if even slightly acne prone

product_name: Super Nova 5% THD Vitamin C + Caffeine Brightening Eye Cream
review_text: I have extremely sensitive skin and this did not irritate my eyes at all! Literally the first eye cream I haven’t reacted to. I’m encouraged & am hoping to see a difference under my eyes in the future. For now, I notice a brightening under the eye once the product is applied.

I rarely give one star review, but this one I had to. I got this as a sample, because if I’m committing to an eye cream, I wanted to see if it’s compatible with my skin first. Good thing I did, because this cream put my under eye in a panic mode. I didn’t change anything about my skin care routine except this cream, so I’m confident that the ingredients are too strong. If you have sensitive under eye/cheek area, test it out first. This cream made my under eye area flare up to some serious redness, puffiness, and tenderness. Above my eye was fine, but I know I have little sensitive area under my eye, so this just really made it worse from the first use. I was dumb enough to use it 3 times before realizing this cream was the issue. I wanted to love it so bad, but I have to pass.
review_title: I wanted to love this so bad!!

PLEASE READ THIS! WOW. I was a little skeptical when I first heard about these tanning drops, and I read through every single review (probably like you’re doing right now), and after reading through, I figured, I am really only going to know if I like the drops if I use them MYSELF and experiment. I, too, like others, use Loving Tan Mousse as my go-to self-tanning product and I LOVE Loving Tan, but sometimes it’s just annoying to use for some reason. SOOOOO I have tried the Isle Of Paradise Self Tanning Drops in the color DARK (I have pretty fair skin, and tan kind of easily but not super easily in the sun) but I always love a really rich tan, so I went with the Dark option(purple bottle). The first time I used this I did 6 drops with my normal body lotion I usually use, and I did that for every body part, 6 drops for everything! Went to bed, woke up with some color, it was very even and not splotchy at all so I was happy! BUT, I wanted to be a little darker, so last night, I did TEN drops for each body part and I am THRILLED with the outcome! I have such a rich tan, it really does look amazing, and the process is SO easy. I didn’t even have to shave my legs! Haha. My advice for a rich tan, 10 drops mixed with lotion for EACH body part, and let it develop for at LEAST 8 hours. (the bottle doesn’t tell you any of that). You will be so happy!! Buy this product, I will be using it in addition to my loving tan, but these drops are just sooo much easier to use! AND WASH YOUR HANDS AFTER application. My hands have absolutely no tan on the palms so they look great, because I washed :) ENJOY!!!
